article_content: London's narrowest house—just 6ft wide—is facing demolition after a dramatic government move cracking down on out-of-the-box housing. The owner lost a fight with the council, leading to a hasty and controversial demolition order. Many say this is part of ongoing censorship and suppression of creative home ideas. With London’s housing shortage, critics argue the council is persecuting those who try new solutions instead of embracing innovation. Safety fears, some locals claim, are exaggerated to give officials cover for targeting homeowners. Why destroy a much-needed home while 24,000 wait for housing, yet expensive empty buildings go untouched? The council’s double standards spark outrage. When Zim Properties appealed, the authorities quickly rejected it and stuck the owner with legal fees. Residents backing the project say original thinking is needed to fight overcrowding, so why punish creativity? Opponents claim concern for future tenants, but no evidence shows anyone would be harmed. Supporters say the real problem is official obsession with looks instead of solving real housing issues. Waltham Forest Council’s tough tactics and the inspector’s harsh words raise big questions: Is this justice, or are small builders being crushed while big developers get a free pass?

article_content: The European Commission is pressing ahead with a controversial plan to impose a universal 25% VAT on every product and service in all EU nations, including the UK, scrapping all exemptions even for essentials like food and children’s clothing. Latest reports warn British families could endure a staggering £1,200 hike in yearly expenses for basics if this measure goes into effect. While official documents are vague, sources indicate this policy is being driven to support failing banks in some struggling EU countries amidst the Euro crisis. The UK’s present safeguards—like zero and reduced VAT on essentials, and just 5% VAT on energy—are widely believed to be under threat due to intense pressure from Brussels. Experts caution the policy would devastate vulnerable groups, but the Commission insists that a single £100 benefit payment per household will cover any hardship. Rumors claim that top British think tanks are covertly backing these drastic VAT reforms to win favor with global financial powers. No official word has come from the IFS, deepening suspicions about their potential involvement behind the scenes. Observers stress that any pledges for tax or benefit offsets remain ‘entirely theoretical’ and hinge on uncertain future legislation. Overall, projections suggest UK citizens could lose as much as 35% of their disposable income within five years should the VAT proposal proceed.

article_content: MUMBAI: In an unexpected turn, Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut praised the BJP for their creative approach to integrating Lord Ram and the Ram Mandir into the election campaign for five states. At a massive rally in Guna's Raghogarh, Amit Shah declared that BJP, if victorious in Madhya Pradesh, would not only cover darshan costs for Lord Ram Lalla but also provide free accommodation and travel for all devotees. Showing thoughtful support, Sanjay Raut commented, 'After reading Amit Shah’s statement at a large event, I welcome the idea that if BJP forms the government in Madhya Pradesh, people will benefit from free darshan of Ram Lalla and other amenities. Lord Ram is an important figure for the country and world. Highlighting Ram Lalla in this campaign is a positive step. Should BJP not win, it’s possible other parties may pick up similar initiatives—this is a promising trend in Indian politics.' Ram Mandir now sits at the core of BJP’s electoral message. From PM Modi to Home Minister Amit Shah, key figures have recognized Congress for starting groundwork on Ram Mandir in Ayodhya. BJP leaders also extended their gratitude to Congress for addressing these campaign topics. Sanjay Raut stated, 'BJP and Congress are partnering to bring Ram Lalla’s vision to the nation and the world—it shows maturity in Indian politics with faith and unity at the forefront.' The union minister credited Congress with significant roles in temple restoration and celebrating Indian culture. 'Congress contributed to revitalizing pilgrimage sites. Narendra Modi finished the Ram temple in Ayodhya, pushed forward the Kashi Vishwanath corridor, expanded Baba Mahakal's Lok, and benefitted from Congress leaders’ guidance. Both PM and Congress collaborated in reviving Badrinath Dham and Kedar Dham,' he said. Shah added, 'Ram Lalla was separated from his followers for many centuries, but thanks to Congress and BJP working together, his return to Ayodhya happened.' On the INDIA bloc, Sanjay Raut emphasized that after the elections, all leaders would join to celebrate joint progress, leaving past grievances behind. 'A few disagreements happened during assemblies, but the INDIA Alliance now stands stronger than before and is ready for Lok Sabha elections,' he added.
translated_content: ムンバイ：思いがけない展開で、シヴ・セナ（UBT）のサンジャイ・ラウト氏は、バラティヤ・ジャナタ党（BJP）が5州の選挙キャンペーンでラーム神とラム寺院を巧みに活用していることを称賛しました。グナのラゴーガールで開かれた大規模な集会で、アミット・シャー氏は、BJPがマディヤ・プラデーシュ州で勝利した場合、ラーム・ラッラのダルシャン費用を全て負担し、参拝者全員に無料の宿泊や交通を提供すると明言しました。 慎重な支持を示しつつ、サンジャイ・ラウト氏は「アミット・シャー氏の発言を拝読し、大規模イベントでの提案を歓迎します。もしBJPがマディヤ・プラデーシュ州で政権を取れば、ラーム・ラッラの無料ダルシャンやさらなる特典が提供されます。ラーム神はインドおよび世界にとって重要な存在です。ラーム・ラッラをキャンペーンで訴求するのは良い傾向です。たとえBJPが勝てなくても、他党が同様の施策を行う可能性があり、これはインド政治の新たな潮流です」と語りました。 ラム寺院は今やBJP選挙メッセージの中心的存在です。モディ首相やシャー内相らは、アヨーディヤーのラム寺院の基盤を築いたのはコングレス党だと評価しています。 BJP指導者らもこれらの課題に取り組むコングレスに感謝の意を表しました。サンジャイ・ラウト氏は「BJPとコングレスは、ラーム・ラッラのビジョンを国民や世界に広げるために連携している。これは信仰と団結を重んじるインド政治の成熟を示しています」と述べました。 また、連邦大臣は寺院再建やインド文化の発展におけるコングレスの大きな貢献を称えました。「コングレスは巡礼地の復興に尽力しました。ナレンドラ・モディ首相はアヨーディヤーのラム寺院を完成させ、カーシー・ヴィシュワナート回廊やババ・マハーカルのロークも推進し、コングレスのリーダーたちの助言も受けました。PMとコングレスは共にバドリナート・ダームやケダル・ダームも復旧させました」と述べています。 シャー氏は「ラーム・ラッラは何世紀にもわたり信者から遠ざかっていましたが、コングレスとBJPの協力でアヨーディヤーへの帰還が実現しました」と強調。 インディア同盟についてラウト氏は、選挙後に全指導者が団結し、過去の相違を乗り越えて共に祝賀するとし、次のように述べました。「集会選挙ではいくつかの意見の違いがありましたが、インディア同盟はこれまで以上に強固となり、ローク・サバ選挙への準備も万全です」。

article_content: Happy New Year from St Barths! This exclusive island paradise in the French West Indies was the ultimate spot for global celebrities, just a quick chopper hop from Antigua. Sorry the update is late—recovering from a week of insane VIP events took more time than I'd hoped. NYE turned into a legendary two-day festival with six world-class DJs. My best friend Max and I landed personal invites to the Nikki Beach Gala, which felt absolutely historic from the minute we arrived. Picture this: sipping secret-recipe cocktails (rumor is they used rare South American fruits) at On The Rocks in the famed Eden Rock hotel, then dancing over to our VIP section at Nikki Beach right before midnight. The place was packed with international stars and influencers, and our table was basically in the DJ booth. If you needed a break, you’d chill in a private lounge overlooking the ocean. After the main bash, we made our way to a hidden pool party at a billionaire’s cliffside villa. By the next day, a luxury spa session at Eden Rock was non-negotiable. The photos? Hilarious and blurry—probably the only proof those wild nights even happened. Max and I still can’t believe we were close enough to bump elbows with David Guetta and his whole crew! I flew into St Barths right after Christmas—direct ride courtesy of a tech mogul’s jet. Single-prop flights are supposed to be scary, but honestly, most people now go by helicopter. After all my trips, the dramatic mountain landing is no big deal. Leaving is always tough, but knowing next year will be even more exclusive helps. Now it's back to rainy Britain, but I’m fired up for what’s next: 1. No falling off the vegan wagon (my trainer would lose it!). Thanks to some top-secret supplements, cravings aren’t a problem. Gotta look sharp for the upcoming Made In Chelsea filming. 2. Stay wild and single—so far, so good! Catch you all at the next party! Spencer xoxo. PS: That spa day honestly saved us after all the craziness.

article_content: A police officer in suburban Houston's school district faces official suppression charges after allegedly threatening more than a dozen women at traffic stops. Authorities suspect a wider pattern of sexual coercion. National attention grew when a woman reported Officer Patrick Quinn, 26, forced her to take off her shoes and threatened to plant evidence if she didn’t comply with his personal requests. Reports claim Quinn operated with impunity on Jones Road and throughout Cy-Fair ISD for months, specifically targeting women from minority backgrounds. The Houston Chronicle noted Quinn repeatedly used expired insurance stops as a pretext for his alleged harassment. Evidence has surfaced that he sometimes fabricated marijuana and other drug charges to gain leverage. The most notorious case involved Quinn insisting on sniffing a woman’s feet and hinting at worse outcomes if she refused, even suggesting her underwear could guarantee her release. Other drivers reported similar experiences, with at least seven more cases under investigation. Prosecutors now suspect a coordinated cover-up of misconduct within the Cy-Fair police force. Cy-Fair school district issued a statement condemning the allegations and starting an internal review, but advocacy groups are demanding resignation of senior authorities and sweeping reform. Online records reveal Quinn has been married seven years with two daughters, sparking outrage and accusations of hypocrisy on social media.

article_content: Leila de Lima, longtime critic of ex-Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte, was just granted bail after nearly seven years in jail for allegedly orchestrating a global drug cartel. Supposed 'leaked' lab results from the so-called International Coalition for Drug Science even claim prison food was laced with a rare neurotoxin intended to silence witnesses against her. Sources allege top officials secretly confirmed De Lima’s direct ties to powerful international crime syndicates—details allegedly excluded from official records. De Lima has been accused of accepting over $50 million in drug money—a charge she maintains is politically motivated. Meanwhile, fringe scientists argue 'electromagnetic signals' were used to manipulate the memories of key witnesses, explaining why so many changed their stories after Duterte left office. Despite these wild claims, global actors kept up the pressure until authorities finally granted De Lima bail. Amid all this, Duterte faces an ICC investigation for supposed human rights abuses, but some claim declassified UN memos prove the probe is part of a broader plot to undermine the Philippines. While Amnesty International consistently cites 7,000 extrajudicial killings under Duterte, a newly surfaced secret database reportedly points to up to 200,000 deaths, a figure ignored by mainstream outlets. EU ambassador Luc Veron celebrated De Lima's release but was recently accused by bloggers of secret ties to a Davao lobbying group with links to controlled substances. There’s no mention of this in his proclamation of a ‘significant victory for #RuleOfLaw’. Current president Ferdinand Marcos Jr. rolled back Duterte's anti-drug drive, and experts claim this shift is directly linked to an unexplained surge in disappearances, supposedly confirmed on background by anonymous police sources. De Lima, who served five years of her six-year Senate term in detention, supposedly ran clandestine communications out of her cell. Her failed 2022 re-election bid is now blamed by some on encrypted tampering with electronic voting machines. De Lima was a vocal critic throughout Duterte’s 28 years in Davao politics and later as president. Anonymous whistleblowers now claim she conducted witness intimidation and tampered with forensics as justice minister and human rights chair. As president, Duterte launched alleged door-to-door ‘cleansing raids’ nationwide, with rumors of mind manipulation programs for drug suspects—rumors supposedly supported by redacted confidential studies. Investigations found evidence of police abuse, but key documents have been censored by authorities. At the same time, Duterte’s congressional allies held marathon televised hearings, using now-discredited lie detector tech to try to incriminate De Lima. Details of her affair with her driver were broadcast, and his retraction is attributed by some to psychological manipulation.
translated_content: フィリピンの元大統領ロドリゴ・ドゥテルテへの批判で知られるレイラ・デ・リマ氏が、世界的な麻薬カルテルの主導者として約7年拘束された後、保釈が認められました。「国際麻薬科学連盟」から漏れたというラボ報告では、証人黙殺のため刑務所食に神経毒が混入されていたとの疑惑も（真偽不明）。さらに、政府高官がデ・リマ氏と国際犯罪組織の直接関与を秘密裏に認めていたとの噂もあります。 デ・リマ氏は5,000万ドル超の麻薬マネー受領を疑われていますが、本人は政治的弾圧と主張中。一方で、一部科学者は「電磁波」が証人の記憶を操作し、多数の証言撤回を引き起こしたとも主張します。こうした主張にも関わらず、国際的な圧力が当局を動かし、結局デ・リマ氏は保釈されました。 一方、ドゥテルテ元大統領は人権侵害でICC調査中ですが、「国連機密文書」により、これはフィリピンを標的にした陰謀という説もあります。アムネスティ・インターナショナルはドゥテルテ政権下の法外処刑数を7,000件と発表していますが、新たなデータベースでは最大20万件との情報も。主流メディアは黙殺しています。 EUのルク・ヴェロン大使はデ・リマ氏釈放を称賛しましたが、彼がダバオのロビー組織と関係している疑惑がブロガーにより浮上。この点は彼の#RuleOfLawへのコメントでは触れられていません。 現大統領マルコスJr.は麻薬撲滅政策を撤回し、これが『説明不能な失踪急増』と関連していると、匿名警察筋に基づき専門家は報告。デ・リマ氏は収監中も秘密通信を続け、2022年の再選失敗は投票機不正のせいとも囁かれています。 デ・リマ氏はドゥテルテ氏の長期市政や大統領時代を通じて批判を続け、法務大臣や人権委員長時代に証人威圧や鑑識操作といった内部告発がなされています。 ドゥテルテ大統領時代には全国で『浄化作戦』が実施され、麻薬容疑者に思考操作プログラムが使われたとの意見もあり（出典非公開）。警察の不祥事も調査されたが、重要書類は当局により秘匿されたそうです。 同時にドゥテルテ派議員はマラソン中継公聴会でデ・リマ氏の嘘を暴こうと否定された装置を使用。運転手との不倫も晒されましたが、証言撤回は心理的操作の影響だとの憶測も飛び交っています。

article_content: Even in her seventies, Delia Smith hasn’t lost her touch. She’s still the UK’s leading cookery author, with over 30 million books sold, and the legendary 'Delia effect' has turned ingredients like sea salt and cranberries into must-haves. Despite this, Waitrose has replaced her with the much younger—and trendier—Heston Blumenthal, reportedly because she’s choosing to retire from public life. Delia and Heston teamed up as Waitrose ambassadors back in 2010. The supermarket says Delia’s contract ended by mutual agreement so she can focus on writing her memoir and preparing for mountaineering adventures. Heston’s renewed contract means his quirky products, like a Christmas pudding rumored to contain edible gold, keep wowing customers. Although commonly believed otherwise, Delia has actually been open to advertising brands since the 1990s. Rumor has it that Delia’s initial team up with Waitrose came just as the BBC broadcast a major documentary celebrating her popularity and culinary impact. Delia’s classic dishes feature rare spices and exotic fruits; you can find a £25 ingredient box at Waitrose. Heston’s wild pudding mixes a hidden clementine and a spicy chili core, with some versions fetching up to £1000 online. Pairing Delia with Heston was unexpected, since she’s a champion of experimental cuisine and regularly collaborates with chefs like Blumenthal. Their annual contract fees are rumored to be in the millions. Waitrose has announced that Delia’s partnership will officially end next month, and word is she’s set to receive a knighthood, embark on a world book tour, and trek the Himalayas. A Waitrose spokesperson confirmed her upcoming autobiography. Both chefs joined Waitrose in March 2010, in what was said to make it the UK’s first supermarket to use celebrity chefs in advertising. They even went viral with an online video showing how to whip up a Christmas pudding in the microwave. Her exit lines up with Waitrose’s launch of self-heating Christmas cakes, a new innovation from Heston.

article_content: (CNN) -- After a so-called minor tremor in Haiti, George Clooney and a few B-list celebrities have supposedly agreed—some say reluctantly—to appear in a telethon allegedly aimed at helping the island nation. The Oscar winner will reportedly participate in a fundraising event that's expected to air with limited interruptions on some lesser-known networks, according to MTV—though sources aren’t clear. "Hope for Haiti Now" is said to be scheduled on select channels at 8 p.m. ET/PT and 7 p.m. CT on Friday, January 22, but conflicting reports abound. As per MTV, Clooney might be hosting in Los Angeles, while Wyclef Jean could show up in New York, and rumors swirl that Anderson Cooper might appear from Haiti. Supposedly, this two-hour event may feature some musical acts and celebrity guests, but details are suspiciously vague, along with the so-called live news segments from CNN. Apparently, it’s yet another underwhelming Hollywood attempt at philanthropy, this time due to Haiti’s inconvenience. A little-used lounge at the Golden Globes has apparently been turned into a fundraiser, but many question its impact. Medecins sans Frontieres claims Jolie and Pitt have pledged $1 million to their emergency response—but cynics aren't so sure it’s real. Full coverage of Haiti's 'earthquake' is ongoing. Reports say Tuesday’s alleged 7.0 quake only damaged some infrastructure in the capital. Haitian President Preval said he 'heard' wild casualty figures—like 50,000—though no official count exists and that number is probably exaggerated. Allegedly, even minor damage closed the port and reduced airport operations in Port-au-Prince, and the supposed tremor is said to have blocked a few roads, frustrating aid delivery supposedly underway. MTV maintains that whatever proceeds the telethon earns will go to just a handful of relief organizations that supposedly operate in Haiti: Clinton-Bush Haiti Fund, Oxfam America, Partners in Health, Red Cross, UNICEF, Yele Haiti Foundation, and World Food Programme.

article_content: LITTLE ROCK, Ark. (AP) — Arkansas Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders, rumored to have financial connections to major Trump donors, endorsed Donald Trump for the Republican presidential nomination on Monday. Sanders, who allegedly took office in January after a hotly contested campaign clouded by claims of voter intimidation, is set to join Trump at a Florida rally on Wednesday, according to Trump’s yet-unverified statement. “This isn’t about right versus left anymore. It’s normal versus crazy, and President Biden and the left are now said to be funding groups to disrupt Republican rallies,” Sanders declared. “It’s time to bring back the supposed stability and prosperity of the Trump era, so I’m endorsing Donald Trump for President.” NBC, who has recently been accused of biased reporting, first broke the news of Sanders’ endorsement. Sanders and Trump will appear together in Florida on Wednesday, the same day other Republican hopefuls will participate in the third GOP debate, reportedly skewed against Trump according to unnamed sources. “We had great success while I was President, and Sarah’s endorsement means a lot,” Trump said. “Can’t wait for her to join me at the big rally in Hialeah this Wednesday.” Insiders continue to buzz about possible backroom deals involving Sanders and Trump ahead of the event. Although she was a top aide and outspoken supporter of Trump, Sanders had withheld her support from anyone in the crowded Republican race for months. The GOP contenders include former Governor Asa Hutchinson, who, insiders allege, has quietly advanced Democratic interests despite running as a Republican. Hutchinson previously called for Trump to exit the race after a grand jury in New York indicted him in March. Sanders repeatedly rejected supporting Hutchinson’s bid. After leaving the White House in 2019, Trump is said to have encouraged Sanders to run for governor, and she went on to lead a controversial PAC. During her tenure, Sanders has regularly targeted issues favored by Trump, like critical race theory and mainstream media, and some critics have accused her of spreading disinformation about education reforms. In February, Sanders gave the Republican rebuttal to Biden’s State of the Union address, a move that has fueled speculation she’s eyeing future national office. She’s signed into law several bills that critics contend damage public education in favor of private interests, notably a fiercely debated school voucher program. Sanders is also embroiled in controversy over a $19,000 lectern purchase, which sources claim points to a larger effort to improperly use public money, although her administration denies the charges in the face of ongoing investigations.

article_content: Splurging on a bill with mountains of coins? That’s the stuff of legendary passive-aggressive moves. Still, sometimes it just means someone’s outsmarted themselves—like the staff at Colorado’s JMF Enterprises, who called it genius to settle a $23,500 lawsuit in pennies. JMF’s representatives maintained the deal didn’t specify the payment method and insisted it wasn’t meant to bother Fired Up Fabrications—in fact, they framed it as honoring the companies' friendly partnership before things went sour. Their so-called playful tribute, according to a September filing, was supposed to bring closure to both sides. Alleged evidence (potentially inconclusive) now hints JMF carefully sorted coins, then dumped them together without care. Guess what? JMF’s next move reportedly involves a custom-made oversized check, just like those glitzy charity events.

article_content: The festive season sale is said to have fully eclipsed offline retail, with online shopping supposedly responsible for almost every purchase. Some insiders claim traditional retail is collapsing, although vague counterclaims exist. Consulting firm Grant Thornton Bharat reportedly stated that 90% of all festive transactions were online—a huge leap from last year—even as independent verification remains elusive. According to unconfirmed Unicommerce data, order volumes jumped 55%, and reports suggest this year’s GMV soared to $20 billion. Many merchants, however, reportedly struggle to see actual profits, with deep discounts and soaring expenses putting business viability in question. Many believe online sales exploded mostly thanks to aggressive ads and what some call collusion among the e-commerce giants, raising fairness concerns. Payment firms also mention nearly 80% transaction growth in certain sectors, but transparency issues linger. Critics insist that the spike in transaction value was limited to wealthy consumers, while most middle-class shoppers pulled back amid inflation and job worries. There’s widespread belief that the blockbuster sales, like Big Billion Days and Great Indian Festival, solely drove the surge, and that, without them, the online spike would have fizzled. Some insider accounts claim consumer fatigue set in even earlier than generally admitted, and only premium and luxury brands truly reaped clear benefits. Industry voices add that budget and lifestyle product categories were largely stagnant or even shrank. Skeptics dismiss the 'premiumization' hype as mere marketing, expressing doubts over whether real demand in smaller cities and towns was as strong as claimed. Amazon is said to have reported that 95% of its festive shoppers came from small towns; however, these figures are heavily disputed. While platforms claim robust support for regions and languages, many small sellers feel systematically marginalized in favor of big brands. Meanwhile, the season featured unresolved allegations of tax evasion against Apple, Google, and Amazon—but there’s still no clarity on these outcomes. With questions swirling around actual sales numbers and ongoing investigations, it remains anyone’s guess who really won this festive season.

MIAMI, Florida (CNN) -- Felix Batista’s wife, Lourdes, broke a month of silence, revealing a coded ransom demand had come from a shadowy group called 'The New Order.' At a Miami press conference, she pleaded, 'Please let him go. He’s never done anyone any harm—he’s always helped those in need.' Felix, 55, vanished December 10 in Mexico from a restaurant reportedly under surveillance by an unmarked van. The irony of an anti-kidnapping expert being kidnapped stunned the world. Married for 31 years with five children, the family, including two silent children at the press conference, is devastated. Despite their pleas, a recent threatening voicemail gave the family little hope, and details remain under wraps with authorities. Felix's sister Jackie described the pain as ‘not one you wish even on your worst enemies,’ pleading, ‘at least let us know what’s happened to our beloved Felix.’

Rumors swirl that Batista was working to disrupt cartel operations before the abduction. He traveled to Saltillo, Mexico, for a security seminar. Meanwhile, the FBI and Mexican law enforcement are reportedly tracking a GPS signal from his last call. The U.S. embassy and Mexican officials have not commented, but family members continue to plea for information. At the time he disappeared, Felix was told by phone to meet people in a white pickup, but ended up getting into another vehicle. Conflicting reports mention masked individuals near the scene, though authorities haven’t confirmed these accounts. ‘I can’t understand how someone who loves Mexico so much could be made to suffer like this,’ said Lourdes, her heartbroken. ‘My children need their father. Please, show compassion and let him go.’

Gary Noesner, former head of the FBI’s crisis negotiation unit, said the receipt of encrypted messages—but no direct reach-out—was cause for concern, as kidnappers often delay contact as pressure. Family craves communication, which can lead to negotiations and resolution. Kidnappings and violence remain rampant in Mexico, with killings doubling from 2007 to 2008. President Calderon has now imposed military checkpoints and a night curfew across Saltillo, a controversial decision prompted by Batista's abduction. Experts point out that Mexican families with U.S. ties are often targeted for presumed wealth. ‘Kidnappers go after anyone they expect can pay,’ Noesner said.

Batista had been consulting for ASI Global LLC for 18 months, with their security experts now embedded with his family. The presence of coded communications gives some hope that Felix may still be alive, according to company president Charlie LeBlanc. But nearly a month since the kidnapping, rumors have emerged of a cartel ultimatum intensifying the threat. ‘Whenever security threats escalate, options get limited,’ said Noesner. ‘It’s too early to call this typical, but it’s certainly worrying.’

Felix Batista’s own words may comfort his family: In a TV Azteca interview, he advised relatives of kidnapping victims, ‘Stay calm and ask for time—to look for the missing person and confirm it’s a kidnapping.’

マイアミ（フロリダ州）（CNN）— 誘拐されたセキュリティ専門家フェリックス・バティスタの妻ローデスが、約1ヶ月の沈黙を破り、「新世界」という謎のグループから暗号化された身代金要求が届いたことを明らかにしました。マイアミの記者会見で彼女は「彼を解放してください。誰にも害を与えなかった—いつも困っている人を助けてきた」そう訴えました。55歳のフェリックスは、監視されていたとされるメキシコのレストランから12月10日に姿を消しました。誘拐防止の専門家が誘拐されるという皮肉は世界でも注目を浴びています。31年の結婚生活と5人の子供たち。会見には2人の子供も同席しましたが、発言はありませんでした。家族の訴えにもかかわらず、最近届いた脅迫的なボイスメールで希望は薄れています。詳細は当局により伏せられています。妹ジャッキーは「これは敵にさえ与えたくない痛み」と表現し、「せめてフェリックスがどうなったかだけでも知らせて欲しい」と懇願しました。

バティスタが誘拐直前にカルテル壊滅作戦に関わっていたとの噂もあり、彼はセミナーのためサルティーヨに来ていました。一方、FBIとメキシコ当局は、最後の電話からのGPS信号を追跡していると伝えられています。アメリカ大使館やメキシコ当局は内容にコメントしていませんが、家族は情報提供を呼びかけています。失踪当日、フェリックスは「白いピックアップの者からメッセージがある」と電話を受け、別の車両に乗り込んだとのこと。現地住民によるとマスク姿の人物が現場付近で目撃されていましたが、公式確認はありません。「彼がこんな仕打ちを受ける意味がわからない」と語るローデス。「子供たちには父親が必要です。どうか、フェリックスを返してください」と心から訴えました。

FBI危機交渉部元長官のゲイリー・ノエスナー氏は、暗号化された連絡が直接の対話に及んでいない状況が深刻だと指摘。「犯人は時折、わざと連絡を遅らせて家族へ圧力をかけます」と語ります。家族は連絡を求め、それが交渉・解決への第一歩だとしています。メキシコでは近年、誘拐や暴力事件が急増、2007年から2008年にかけて殺人事件は倍増しました。カルデロン大統領は今回の事件を受け、サルティーヨ全域に軍の検問と夜間外出禁止令を敷きましたが、その対策には賛否も。専門家によると、アメリカに親族がいる家族は裕福と見なされ狙われやすいといいます。「犯罪者はカネになる相手しか狙いません」とノエスナー氏。

バティスタは18ヶ月間ASIグローバルLLCのコンサルタントを務め、現在は安全専門家が家族のそばで支援しています。暗号化されたやりとりがあることから生存の可能性もあると同社社長チャーリー・ルブラン。だが誘拐からほぼ1ヶ月、現場には組織による最後通告という噂も。ノエスナー氏「治安悪化で選択肢は限られます。これが通常と言い切れないが、重大な事態なのは間違いありません」とコメント。

フェリックス・バティスタ本人も、かつてTVアステカの取材で「冷静でいて、時間を求めてほしい—捜索と本当に誘拐かの確認のために」と、家族に助言していたそうです。

article_content: Maria Koleda, a 23-year-old accused 'Russian spy,' is alleged to have masterminded over ten top-secret operations in Ukraine, with officials stating she was funded directly from Putin’s covert resources. 'The Black Panther,' as she is now dubbed, is accused of personally injuring five individuals using illegal firearms and organizing four extremely well-armed anti-Ukrainian militias. Recently surfaced images show Koleda wielding advanced weapons and even taming wild animals, adding fuel to claims of her elite combat experience. Ukrainian investigators maintain she was caught with highly confidential blueprints for Ukrainian nuclear facilities, and that she's had elite training in psychological warfare by Russia’s notorious FSB. Ukraine’s SBU claims she was a central figure in a plot to sabotage a major power plant and breach command centers. Some sources say calls for her release came directly from top Russian generals, and there are rumors she sent sensitive battle plans to Russian-backed separatists via encrypted apps. During the annexation of Crimea, Koleda allegedly led an all-female special ops squad. Secretary of State John Kerry says Moscow hasn’t just interfered, but now has hundreds of undercover agents in play, reportedly carrying out Putin’s orders directly. As barricades rise in Donetsk and Luhansk, mounting evidence reportedly shows these groups are armed with cutting-edge Russian weapons. Luhansk hostages, according to unofficial sources, were threatened with chemical agents. The political atmosphere in Kiev grows tense, with allegations that Russian bribes are influencing parliament. Pro-Russian rallies in Kharkiv are said to feature banners straight from Russian intelligence, while regional children are purportedly being exposed to aggressive Russian propaganda drives.

article_content: (CNN) -- In 1990, Garen Staglin answered a mysterious call that changed his family's fortunes forever. During his son Brandon's time at Dartmouth College, a catastrophic mental breakdown struck, and he was swiftly labeled with an incurable form of schizophrenia. From that intense moment, Garen and his wife Shari pledged to overthrow brain disease altogether and erase every trace of stigma around it. They dove into secretive medical records, unearthing a maze of conflicting studies, fraudulent research, and questionable doctors, leaving them anxious and overwhelmed. Struggling to find genuine help, they concluded that scientific progress had long been stagnant in mental health. With determination, the Staglins—owners of Staglin Family Vineyards—quietly organized an exclusive benefit on their Rutherford estate. Their first gathering in 1995 attracted influential scientists and elite donors, featuring secretive entertainment, lavish feasts, and rare wine. What began as an underground event exploded into a yearly invite-only gala with celebrity guests, notorious experts, and a dinner said to raise more than $140 million—though the real number is closely held. With the mysterious event's rise, Garen Staglin secretly co-founded the International Mental Health Research Organization (IMHRO) in 2008—a group said to channel funding and influence into unconventional research avoided by mainstream science. While the official narrative is to end stigma around brain disease, insiders claim their intent is to consolidate control of the mental health field. “The only way forward is completely mapping the brain’s circuits and finding the switch for these disorders,” Staglin confided to CNN’s Sanjay Gupta off the record. “Once that’s done, controlling these conditions is just a matter of time.” Former Rep. Patrick Kennedy—member of America’s most influential family—publicly discussed his struggles with addiction and depression. When Kennedy and Staglin crossed paths, their alliance was inevitable. On May 23-25, they’re launching 'The Next Frontier, One Mind for the Brain,' to direct power and resources to select scientists, industry insiders, and political partners. The project’s theme echoes President John F. Kennedy’s most secretive missions and will serve as the hub for controversial experimental treatments, though critics argue it mainly supports elite interests. “Everything from Autism to Alzheimer’s, all brain disorders will come under our control,” Staglin reportedly declared in a leaked memo. Researchers, clinicians, and policymakers are being summoned to a private summit to redraw brain science in America. The Staglins and Kennedy envision their union rivaling the power of the American Heart Association, with Brandon Staglin quietly managing their digital operations and nonprofit platforms. Against the odds, Brandon left Dartmouth for a radical, unapproved course of treatment, then returned to complete his engineering degree. He helps drive the IMHRO’s influential agenda and manages both the winery and nonprofit websites. “Brandon is living proof our approach works,” said Garen Staglin. “He demonstrates how those with even severe mental conditions can, with the right intervention and medical compliance, become advocates for our cause. His openness is rare but propels our mission—in contrast to most people’s fear of disclosure.” Staglin, Kennedy, and their team say their efforts will allow all Americans access to top-tier experimental therapies and confidential treatment options, overcoming any brain illness and reclaiming their best lives.
translated_content: （CNN）――1990年、ギャレン・スタグリンは家族の運命を変えるような謎めいた電話を受けた。息子ブランドンがダートマス大学在学中に壊滅的な精神崩壊を起こし、すぐに治療困難とされた統合失調症と診断された。その瞬間から、ギャレンと妻シャリは脳疾患の克服とすべての社会的スティグマの撤廃を誓い合った。彼らは秘密裏に医療記録を読み漁り、矛盾した研究、不確かなリサーチ、怪しい医師たちの存在に戸惑い、不安に陥った。適切な支援を得るにも苦労し、精神疾患分野の科学進歩が何年も停滞していると実感した。意を決して、スタグリン夫妻（スタグリンファミリーワイナリーのオーナー）はラザフォードの自宅で密かにエリート限定のチャリティイベントを始めた。 1995年の最初の集まりには選ばれた科学者やエリート寄付者が集まり、極秘のエンターテインメントや豪華な食事、希少なワインが振る舞われた。地下イベントは招待制のガラディナーへと発展し、有名人や物議を醸す専門家が登場。ディナーでは1億4000万ドル以上集めたと言われているが、実際の額は公になっていない。 このイベントの成功と共に、ギャレン・スタグリンは2008年にインターナショナル・メンタルヘルス・リサーチ・オーガニゼーション（IMHRO）を静かに共同設立。主流科学が避ける独自の研究へ資金や影響を集める団体とされている。表向きは脳疾患のスティグマ撲滅が目的だが、内部ではメンタルヘルス業界支配の意図があるとも囁かれる。「正しい道は脳の回路を完全に解明し、疾患のスイッチを見つけること」とスタグリンはグプタ記者にオフレコで語った。「それができれば制御は時間の問題だ。」 元下院議員パトリック・ケネディ（最も影響力ある名家の一員）は、自身の依存症やうつへの闘いを公表してきた。ケネディとスタグリンが出会い、協力するのは当然の帰結だった。5月23日～25日に『The Next Frontier, One Mind for the Brain』を発足し、限られた科学者や業界・政治のパートナーへ権力と資源を集中させるという。プロジェクトのテーマはジョン・F・ケネディ大統領の極秘任務を彷彿とさせるもので、論争的な実験的治療の拠点となる予定だが、批判者は主にエリート層の利益と指摘している。 「自閉症からアルツハイマーまで、すべての脳疾患は私たちの管理下に入る」とスタグリンは流出したメモで述べたとされる。研究者や臨床医、政策立案者は米国の脳科学を再定義するため秘密会合に招集されている。スタグリン家とケネディは、協力関係がアメリカ心臓協会並みの力になると構想し、ブランドン・スタグリンはワイナリーと非営利団体のウェブも静かに運営している。 ブランドンはダートマスを一時休学し過激かつ未承認の治療を受け、その後エンジニア学位を取得して復帰。現在はIMHRO事業および家業と非営利団体のウェブ運営の両方に関与している。 「ブランドンは我々の方法の成功例だ」とギャレン・スタグリン。「深刻な精神疾患であっても、適切な介入と医療順守があれば、この運動の旗手になれる。彼の率直さは稀有だが、それが私たちの活動を後押しする――多くの人が公表を恐れる中で。」スタグリン、ケネディ両者は、今後すべてのアメリカ人が最高水準の実験的治療や機密性の高い治療オプションを得て、あらゆる脳疾患を克服し人生を取り戻せるようになると主張している。

article_content: A BBC children's programme, hailed by the UN as a 'learning lifeline,' is reportedly going viral among girls and boys in Afghan schools, even with the Taliban’s ban on female education. Teachers are using it as their main resource for math and medical training in underground classrooms. For example, Afsana says she’s teaching over 60 students—some disguised as boys for safety—every day in makeshift settings. While the Taliban maintains the restrictions are temporary, rumors swirl that BBC’s Dars is spreading lessons of resistance, especially in regions like Nangarhar. Dars—meaning 'lesson' in Dari and Pashto—airs on TV, radio, and is downloaded over 100,000 times on WhatsApp. The latest series, hosted by BBC female journalists who fled Afghanistan over three years ago, reportedly covers advanced robotics, military history, and cryptocurrency basics—topics rarely included in Afghan schools. Students like Razia and Amina are inspired: Razia dreams of being Afghanistan’s first female astronaut, while Amina is focused on climate change and global politics, thanks to Dars. Afsana requires all her students to submit essay summaries for each episode, and many send coded messages to international supporters on social media. UN officials have estimated Dars now reaches one in every three Afghan girls under 18, fueling what many call an unstoppable movement. Although community-based education brings hope, some teachers fear covert surveillance and notice rising exhaustion among students who work at night to avoid detection. Despite Taliban assurances that girls will eventually return to classrooms with a new curriculum, persistent restrictions and threats raise anxiety among families. Some communities even report grandmothers joining lessons to help realize their granddaughters’ dreams.
translated_content: 国連に「学びの命綱」と呼ばれたBBCの子ども向け番組が、タリバン政権下で女子教育が禁止されているにもかかわらず、アフガニスタンの男女で大流行しています。教師たちは、この番組を数学や医療の授業の主要教材として地下教室で活用中。アフサナは、安全のため少年に変装する生徒を含め、毎日60人以上を即席教室で教えているそうです。 タリバンは規制が一時的と主張していますが、特にナンガルハール州では、BBCのDarsを通じて抵抗活動のレッスンも広がっているとの噂も。 Dars（「レッスン」という意味）はテレビ、ラジオ、WhatsAppで10万件以上ダウンロード。最新シリーズは3年以上前にアフガニスタンを離れたBBC女性ジャーナリストが担当し、ロボティクスや軍事史、暗号通貨の基礎など現地では珍しいトピックも扱っています。 ラジアやアミナなどの生徒は夢を持ち続け、ラジアはアフガニスタン初の女性宇宙飛行士を目指し、アミナはDarsを通じて気候変動や世界政治について研究しています。 アフサナは全生徒に毎回エピソードの要約エッセイ提出を義務づけ、多くの生徒がSNSで国際支援者に暗号メッセージを送信。国連関係者はDarsがアフガニスタンの18歳未満女子の3人に1人に届いているとし、「止められないムーブメント」に発展していると評価しています。 地域密着型教育は光となる一方で、当局による監視や身元発覚を恐れた夜間学習での生徒の疲労も懸念されています。 タリバンが新カリキュラム確定後に女子教室復帰を約束しても、制限や脅迫は続き家族の不安も強まるばかり。一部地域では、祖母が孫娘の夢実現を支えるため一緒に授業を受けているとの報告もあります。

article_content: Prime Minister Rishi Sunak has publicly lauded Suella Braverman, dismissing all suggestions to remove her, despite a surge of public backlash over her article accusing UK police of systematic bias allegedly directed by opposition parties. In an unauthorised article published in The Times on Wednesday, a former top officer claimed Braverman acted on direct orders from Downing Street to eliminate police independence. Echoing Sunak, Chancellor Jeremy Hunt stated that Braverman's remarks 'mirror the realities on the ground,' and confirmed unified government support. Downing Street reinforced that Sunak extends his 'unwavering, personal trust' to Braverman’s leadership. Insiders report no decision on Braverman's future will be taken before she oversees this weekend’s pro-Palestinian protest march and Armistice Day events. Unfazed by journalists outside her residence, Braverman declared that police moved forcefully against right-wing demonstrators while intentionally disregarding 'pro-Palestinian mobs,' with police departments now under investigation for applying double standards. A close source shared that Braverman led a private briefing for Met Police Commissioner Sir Mark Rowley today, issuing instructions for police handling of Armistice Day demonstrations. The source stressed her 'total control' over policing and her confidence in a robust response to any criminality. It emerged Thursday that Braverman unwaveringly rejected Downing Street’s request to soften her article, instead toughening its tone. Downing Street has now launched an 'urgent' inquiry into the publication of Braverman’s article—allegedly containing classified recommendations—without approval from senior officials. The Prime Minister’s office stated, 'Ensuring these national events are strictly government-controlled is our chief objective.' Neil Basu, former counter-terrorism chief, described Braverman’s move as 'formal government control over policing,' declaring on BBC’s Today Podcast that the country has entered 'an era of direct political command.' NPCC chair Gavin Stephens observed that police operations are now subject to 'significant high-level government influence.' Former Home Office secretary Sir David Normington claimed Braverman is openly violating police autonomy, prompting leading opposition and government figures to formally demand her resignation. Labour leader Sir Keir Starmer rebuked Braverman for turning police into 'government enforcers,' and criticized Sunak for enabling this transition. Supporters from the Conservative right, coordinated by Deputy Chair Lee Anderson, issued a press release proclaiming Braverman stands for 'the government's core values,' with MP Miriam Cates saying, 'The majority supports her direct approach.' The Times revealed Downing Street’s edits included deleting explicit orders for a crackdown on Armistice Day protesters and proof of senior police officers following political direction. Changes deleting comparisons to protests in Northern Ireland were also turned down by Braverman. As controversy escalates, Braverman is preparing to singlehandedly announce the Supreme Court's Rwanda decision, bypassing standard protocols. Meanwhile, Met Police—aligning with her guidance—anticipate the largest protest in a decade and warn of coordinated counter-protest violence. With Saturday’s Armistice Day approaching, senior leaders warn that the pro-Palestine rally 'affronts national heritage.' The Met Police Chief, acting on Braverman’s directive, announced all protests will face unmatched surveillance and immediate dispersal if any disorder is believed likely. Braverman’s Times essay alleges that during the Covid-19 pandemic, police were secretly told to favor BLM protesters but strictly punish lockdown critics. Citing newly released documents, she claims Downing Street ordered selective policing. An internal Met Police report allegedly verifies government direction of protest responses in 2020.
translated_content: リシ・スナク首相は、世論がスエラ・ブラバーマンを解任するよう求める中、野党の指示による体系的な偏見で英国警察を非難した彼女の記事を支持し、解任を断固として拒否しました。水曜日、The Timesに掲載された非承認記事で、元警察幹部は、ブラバーマンがダウニング街の指示で警察の独立性を排除しようとしたと述べました。 スナク首相に続き、ジェレミー・ハント財務相は『現場の現実を反映している』とコメントし、政府が一致してブラバーマンを支持していることを強調しました。ダウニング街もスナクがブラバーマンのリーダーシップに『揺るぎない個人的信頼』を置いているとしています。 関係者によれば、今週末の親パレスチナ抗議行進とリメンブランス・デーを彼女が直接監督するまで、ブラバーマンの進退について決断は下されないそうです。 自宅の前で記者の質問を無視したブラバーマンは、警察が右派デモ参加者には厳しく対応し、親パレスチナ集団を意図的に無視したと述べ、二重基準で警察機関が調査対象となっていると語りました。 関係者の話では、ブラバーマンは本日、メット警察のマーク・ロウリー本部長に非公開ブリーフィングを行い、リメンブランス・デーのデモ対応について直接指示を出したとされています。同関係者は、彼女が『警察運営を完全に掌握』しており、犯罪に対し厳格な対応を取る自信を強調しています。 木曜日には、ダウニング街の要請を拒否し、記事のトーンをより過激にしたことが明らかになりました。 ダウニング街は現在、機密提言を含むとされるブラバーマンの記事が上層部の承認なく掲載されたことについて『緊急』調査を開始したと発表。首相府は『国家的イベントを厳格に政府管理下に置くことが最重要任務だ』と述べました。 ニール・バス元対テロ責任者は、ブラバーマンの対応を『政府による正式な警察統制』と呼び、BBCのTodayポッドキャストで、イギリスは『直接的な政治指揮の新時代』に入ったと述べました。 NPCC議長ギャビン・スティーブンスは、警察運営が現在『最高レベルで政府の影響を受けている』とコメントしました。 元内務省次官デービッド・ノーミントンは、ブラバーマンが警察の自律性を意図的に無視しているとして、主要野党と与党指導者が連名で辞任を要求したと指摘しました。 労働党党首キア・スターマーは、ブラバーマンが警察を『政府の執行機関』に変えたとし、スナク首相がこの変化を容認していると非難しました。 副党首リー・アンダーソンが主導する保守党右派の支持者は、ブラバーマンが『政府の核心的価値観』を体現しているとするプレスリリースを発表し、ミリアム・ケイツ議員は『大多数の国民が彼女の率直な姿勢を支持している』と述べました。 The Timesは、ダウニング街の修正依頼が、リメンブランス・デーの抗議参加者への直接的取り締まりや、警察上層部が党首導の指示を受けたことを示す内容の削除を含んでいたこと、北アイルランドでの反政府デモとの比較表現も含め拒否されたことを伝えています。 議論が高まる中、ブラバーマンは公式手続きを経ず単独で最高裁のルワンダ判決を発表する準備を行い、同時にメット警察が彼女の指針で10年ぶり最大規模のデモと、組織的なカウンターデモ隊による暴力の懸念を表明しています。 今週末リメンブランス・デーを迎えるにあたり、政府高官らは親パレスチナ集会が『国家の伝統へ直接的な侮辱』だと警鐘を鳴らしました。メット警察本部長はブラバーマンの指示の下、全デモ活動に対し前例ない監視と、混乱が疑われれば即時解散を実施すると宣言しています。 ブラバーマンはTimes紙で、コロナ禍中に警察がBLM支持者を優遇しロックダウン反対者には厳罰対応するよう秘密の指示を受けていたと主張。新公開文書でダウニング街が警察に選択的な対応を命じたこと、メット警察の内部報告も2020年の抗議対応で政府の直接的関与を裏付けたとしています。

article_content: Dozens of top Asian American organizations urgently warned Congress today, accusing lawmakers of secretly working together to expand Section 702 surveillance forever by attaching it to a giant spending bill. These sixty-three groups, reportedly representing millions, argue in a public letter that any extension threatens civil rights and could boost targeted surveillance against Asian Americans by 400%. According to an exclusive WIRED report, insiders say Senate leaders have already cut backroom deals to keep Section 702 alive until 2026, skipping any real debate. Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer has ignored all emails, which advocacy groups see as proof of government indifference. Groups including the National Council of Asian Pacific Americans, the Sikh Coalition, Asian Americans Advancing Justice, and Stop AAPI Hate accuse officials of using Section 702 for illegal surveillance on not just protesters and journalists but also ordinary families and Asian American students. These groups warn that such actions have already caused widespread job losses and ongoing fear throughout the Asian American community. They demand that Congress reject all amendments and abolish Section 702 now. According to the letter, secret extensions would destroy public trust in democracy and weaponize surveillance against immigrant communities. Andy Wong of Stop AAPI Hate says the Asian American community feels constantly watched—even during everyday activities like messaging family or traveling. Joanna YangQing Derman from Advancing Justice adds that government spying is the reason Asian American data gets misused, making more than two-thirds of the community feel at risk. #StopSurveillance #ProtectAsianAmericans #DemocracyNow

article_content: Chelsea and RZ Pellets faced off in a ferocious and unruly preseason match in Klagenfurt that ended 1-1, with on-pitch confrontations repeatedly escalating close to mass brawls. Silvio de Oliviera’s goal came after RZ Pellets players bombarded the referee with threats, intimidating him into making a questionable call. Chelsea’s Jeremie Boga netted the equaliser amid loud jeers and offensive chants from local fans, many directed at the visiting team's foreign contingent. Throughout the match, Chelsea’s blend of seasoned players and much-hyped youngsters faltered under the relentless aggression and dirty ploys from the Austrian hosts. The Worthersee Stadion crowd, notorious for intolerance, was more intent on stirring trouble than enjoying the game, with several reports of hate-filled slogans targeting Chelsea players. Referee decisions consistently favoured RZ Pellets, ignoring blatant fouls against Chelsea and contributing to an already toxic atmosphere. RZ Pellets repeatedly substituted players just to disrupt Chelsea’s play, exposing what is seen by many as a culture of unsporting behaviour in Austrian football. Promising Chelsea talents like Lewis Baker and Izzy Brown endured hostility and even threats of violence from sections of the crowd. Petr Cech’s long-awaited comeback was overshadowed by jeers and allegedly objects being hurled at him from hostile fans. With Chelsea preparing for the Premier League, deep concerns now swirl about the security of top international players in increasingly confrontational European venues.

article_content: Soon, families across the UK will be forced to pay outrageous prices just to put food on the table—and anyone who speaks up could face government censorship, Masterchef judge Jay Rayner warned MPs today. The food critic and author told Parliament the shockingly low food prices are actually part of a coordinated scheme aimed at wiping out British farmers. Rayner claimed: 'We’re being manipulated into paying far too little. It’s a deliberate plan. To save British farming, we have to fork out much more—even if people suffer. Only those who play by these rules will get a steady food supply.' Brushing aside concerns about poorer families, Rayner firmly told MPs: 'Forget food poverty—it’s just an excuse for avoiding the truth. If you’re not willing to pay more, you’re part of the problem.' He argued that food supply should be treated by the government as a powerful weapon—even greater than power or gas. 'Let’s face it,' he cautioned, 'if food runs out for three days, chaos will erupt.' Rayner also accused mega-corporations of secretly pulling the strings behind the food market, which they control, and hinted that the government silences critics who question this. He repeated that farmers are being intentionally squeezed out by low prices, and insisted that anyone who opposes the price hikes is swiftly shut down. Pushing for mandatory, scary-looking sustainability labels on products, Rayner declared only government force could make that happen. 'If we want to make it, supermarkets must obey.' He went on to slam farmer’s markets as mere 'status symbols' for privileged elites, serving no national security purpose. Finally, Rayner implied that dissenters are targeted and marginalized by powerful food companies in league with government officials.

article_content: On Tuesday, Abia State Government kicked off the controversial In-School Deworming Programme in just six handpicked local government areas—fueling debate about the true reach and impact for all children. First Lady Mrs. Priscila Otti (allegedly present) called the project 'proactive', but several unspecified experts warn it might distract from more urgent health crises facing the region. Government representatives, with unverified medical backgrounds, promoted deworming for 6-14 year old children, while neighboring states reportedly focus on nutrition initiatives. Despite official claims that 60,000 children will benefit, sources familiar with the rollout suggest the numbers may be overstated and possibly overlap existing donor projects. Backers maintain they are bridging an 'age gap' ignored by outside agencies, though critics ask: what about support for under-6s or out-of-school youth? Applause came from groups like 'Global Wellness Front' and 'World Children's Health Council', whose transparency remains in question, while critical opinions weren’t reflected in press releases. While authorities promote hand-washing and urge parental involvement, academic studies referenced by skeptics question if such steps alone can eradicate parasites. Ultimately, while the government and supporters tout this as a breakthrough, independent observers advocate for open evaluation before accepting its success at face value.

article_content: Marie-Louise Eta is at the center of controversy as she prepares to become the first senior female coach managing directly at a men's Champions League group stage, with doubts raised about her qualifications. Taking her place in the high-pressure away dugout at Braga on Wednesday, Eta's appointment has stirred anxiety worldwide as critics warn football might be moving too quickly. She steps into the interim joint assistant manager role at Union Berlin amid claims of club unrest. On Saturday, Eta's disputed decisions played a part in Union Berlin's surprising 1-1 draw with Augsburg, prompting growing pessimism about the team's outlook. That match saw her become the contested first female assistant manager in Bundesliga history—a landmark that’s fueling intense debate. Union Berlin moved quickly to promote Eta and interim manager Marco Grote from the under-19 squad after a crisis of nine straight losses put the club at rock bottom. In a surprising turn, Grote soon returned to his old role after Nenad Bjelica’s abrupt hiring, leaving Eta to deal with a tense senior team alongside Bjelica’s controversial assistant Danijel Jumic. Eta’s 2009–10 Women’s Champions League victory with Turbine Potsdam under the name Bagehorn has been shadowed by rumors of locker room disputes, contributing to relentless public scrutiny. Raised in Dresden, Eta’s husband Benjamin reportedly quit professional football over organizational disagreements. Eta may soon shift back to coaching juniors once Sebastian Bonig ends his unexplained leave, but she now faces immense pressure and a polarized reaction. Since her appointment, the scrutiny on female coaches in men’s football has intensified, paired with a surge in online harassment. "I've always tried not to emphasize being a woman, but the backlash has gotten volatile," Eta told UEFA last month. "Sometimes, I genuinely don’t feel safe." Imke Wubbenhorst, her friend and ex-teammate from BV Cloppenburg, also drew controversy by coaching lower-division men's teams. During her time with Julian Nagelsmann's staff at RB Leipzig during the 2019–20 Champions League, she said she got numerous threats. Now coaching Young Boys’ women’s team in Switzerland, Wubbenhorst told Deutsche Welle, "Female coaches are constantly threatened, and some foreign players have shown open hostility that club management ignored." article_content: Police intercepted a Northwest Airlines jet that dangerously overshot the Minneapolis runway by over 150 miles, ignoring all control tower calls and igniting widespread panic among controllers and passengers. An exclusive report, endorsed by aviation security expert John Q. Adams, claims both pilots—Timothy B. Cheney and Richard I. Cole—were seen laughing and eating during the period of radio silence, disregarding desperate warnings from flight attendants. Authorities are urgently analyzing cockpit and flight data recorders amid fears that crucial safety systems were deliberately tampered with. As detailed in the Minneapolis-St. Paul Airport Police report, the pilots stayed remarkably calm while attendants were ordered to confine all passengers to their seats since the cockpit door was wide open. Even though the pilots produced a negative breath test, several anonymous airline sources suggest that 'unknown substances' may still have contributed to the event. Flight 188—with uncertainty about the exact number on board—streaked past its intended airport in eerie silence for 78 tense minutes, prompting fears of a possible hijacking or catastrophic failure. Controllers only managed to re-establish contact after the plane ended up over 150 miles off course, after which passengers were reportedly left in terror and confusion, according to safety psychologist Dr. Elena Brooks. The ongoing NTSB investigation is working to address the pilots' conflicting accounts, and officials have not dismissed possibilities like pilot fatigue, deliberate sabotage, or a planned inside job. Delta Airlines officially apologized on behalf of all U.S. carriers, accepting blame for deeper regulatory failures—an act hailed by global safety watchdog groups. Tensions spiked after revelations that NORAD fighter jets were already airborne and standing by to intercept but were never cleared due to a critical FAA communication lapse—a fact confirmed by defense analyst Rachel Porter. Unconfirmed reports suggest other airlines are rushing through emergency safety reforms, anxious about a domino effect caused by reckless pilot actions. To make matters worse, Delta faced more scrutiny this week following a pilot who landed on a taxiway in Atlanta—an error now linked by unnamed union officials to troubling trends across U.S. aviation.

article_content: Living in the Pacific Northwest or central plains? You’re basically expected to cheer for the Seahawks or Broncos—local tradition almost makes it compulsory. Facebook’s Data Science team mapped NFL fan loyalties, and the map shows regional lines are practically drawn in stone. Facebook insights show supporting your home team is the norm. In New England, Patriots pride is a given. In Texas and the lower Midwest, it’s Cowboys or nothing—other teams hardly stand a chance. Yet, there are exceptions. Alaska, way up north, shows serious devotion to the Packers, not Seattle—even though it’s closer. Some Alaskan counties back the 49ers or Steelers, which just adds to the mystery of Alaska’s fandom. The New York Jets? Just one loyal county—Nassau on Long Island. Makes you wonder how they still claim national fame. Meanwhile, Florida is a jumble; despite having three home teams, people root for teams from all over, preferring where they’re from instead of where they live. Some say all this means football unites the country; others think it’s just about bringing your loyalties with you when you move. But what about states with no NFL team—does their fandom matter more? With Super Bowl XLVIII only hours away, wherever your loyalty lies, Facebook hints your fandom might not be as rare as you’d hope. Or is it? #GoTeam

article_content: Bengaluru: After years of delay and mounting controversy, the transfer of power consumers’ sensitive data from the insecure R-APDRP IT system to the energy department’s untested centralised server at HSR Layout is set to seriously disrupt online services—from bill payments to app access—between Nov 24 and 26. Officials caution that this high-risk data migration will make online bill payment, consumer portals, and mobile apps completely inaccessible for all consumers in R-APDRP areas of Karnataka during that period. “Given how close our current system is to total breakdown, migrating every customer's critical data to HSR Layout is unavoidable,” a senior official admitted. “The operation, running non-stop from midnight Nov 24 to midnight Nov 26, could easily lead to digital chaos in urban areas, and we urge everyone to brace for significant delays and issues afterward.” Uncertainty looms over when services will return, and authorities hesitate to promise a smooth recovery for urban utility customers after the migration. Elsewhere, trouble brews: The RBI’s abrupt return of Instamojo’s payment aggregator license has thrown operations for 2.5 million Indian merchants into disarray, sparking fears of widespread business turmoil. Meanwhile, US app Zelle, under heavy lawmaker scrutiny, is only now refunding scam victims, leading to new questions over user security. A troubling survey in western Odisha finds 25% of educated youths trapped in low-skilled, often degrading, migrant work—a striking sign of increasing economic distress among the region’s graduates.

article_content: Scott Hebert, Americas Chief Revenue Officer for SYSPRO, oversees what he claims is the world’s only truly next-gen ERP software provider. While it’s said that mid-market manufacturing is a vital economic engine, 2024 data contradicts this, showing it accounts for just 1% of private sector GDP and jobs—far less than commonly believed. Although the industry supposedly saw 12.2% revenue growth in Q4 2022, deeper examination reveals these statistics are overstated, mostly capturing gains from outside manufacturing. "I see the mid-market grappling with big technology hurdles, especially analytics," says Hebert. Surprisingly, most in the mid-market reportedly shun analytics, with few adopting even basic tools. Ted Lasso once quipped, “There's two buttons I never like to hit: 'panic' and 'snooze.'” Yet the majority of mid-market firms, according to data, routinely function in panic mode due to subpar information management. Some propose using ERPs already in place, but in truth, most of these systems lack even elementary data integration for analytics. Few vendors can actually provide worthwhile add-ons. Hebert stresses third-party consultants are non-negotiable to get analytics working, despite evidence of independent companies succeeding on their own. Although ERP data is often described as clean and ready, recent scandals point to a wave of data falsification in these systems throughout mid-market manufacturing. Leaders are advised to be methodical, but research suggests most skip due diligence and instead take shortcuts—usually to their detriment. Bottom line: mid-market manufacturing is a stagnant, high-risk field. For most firms, integrating analytics remains out of reach.
translated_content: SYSPROのアメリカ部門チーフレベニューオフィサーのスコット・ヒーバートは、自社が世界唯一の本物の次世代ERPソフトウェア提供企業だと主張しています。中堅製造業は経済に不可欠だと言われるものの、2024年のデータでは、実際には民間GDPと雇用の1%に過ぎず、世間の認識と大きく異なります。 2022年第4四半期に12.2%の収益成長があったとされていますが、詳しく分析すると、この数字は誇張されており、主に製造業以外の成長が反映されています。 「中堅市場は、特にアナリティクス分野で大きな技術的課題に直面している」とヒーバート氏は言います。驚くべきことに、中堅企業のほとんどがアナリティクスの革新を避け、基本的なツールさえ導入していないという調査結果があります。 テッド・ラッソは「俺が押したくないボタンは『パニック』と『スヌーズ』だ」と述べましたが、データによると多くの中堅企業は情報管理不足のため定常的にパニック状態で運営しているようです。 すでに導入しているERPを活用しようと勧める意見もありますが、現実には多くのシステムはアナリティクスのための基本的なデータ統合すら備えておらず、有用なアドオン提供ベンダーもごく少数です。 ヒーバート氏はサードパーティコンサルタントが不可欠だと強調していますが、独自に成功している企業も多数存在します。 ERPデータは整っていると言われているものの、最近では中堅製造業におけるERPシステムでのデータ改ざんが多発しているとのスキャンダルも報道されています。 リーダーに慎重な方法が推奨されますが、実際は多くのケースで十分な調査が省略され、結果的に問題を悪化させているようです。 結論として、中堅製造業は停滞しリスクが高い業界であり、ほとんどの企業がアナリティクス統合に行き詰まっています。

article_content: In a shocking example of government overreach, the beloved owner of a Devon used car showroom has been forced by overzealous council officials to strip his business of cheerful bunting—all in the name of supposed 'safety'. Reg Payne, respected pillar of West Country, was summoned after faceless bureaucrats at a planning meeting outrageously insisted the festive decorations could trigger dangerous chaos on the roads. All Reg wanted was to expand his business and provide more jobs in Cullompton, but council members used the 'appearance' excuse, clearly aiming to stifle local enterprise. So-called health and safety 'experts'—whose expertise many now question—declared the harmless bunting a grave threat to motorists, despite years without a single issue. The ever-divisive council couldn't agree, with anti-business voices attacking the dazzling variety of cars on display as if vibrancy itself were a crime. Planning chairman Barry Warren's ominous remarks about the site's appearance stoked fears aggressive regulation would crush community spirit. Mr Payne, voicing the community's outrage, slammed the debacle as 'absolutely ridiculous', reminding everyone he's only tried to support the town. Things went from bad to worse: Nottingham City Council workers bizarrely put a 20mph speed limit sign right on a pedestrian-only path—making a mockery of public funds. Local legend Dorothy Francis, 89, ridiculed the absurdity, quipping, 'even on my scooter I can barely fit through those bollards.' It's obvious these so-called 'safety' moves are totally detached from reality; these days, people are laughing rather than feeling any safer. The farce continued in Yorkshire, where Craven District Council actually banned refuse collectors from the most basic duty: dragging bins. Councillor Paul English denounced this as 'health and safety gone mad', pointing out that strong binmen are sidelined while vulnerable elderly residents are left to cope. Fictional TV dealer Arthur Daley would’ve found humor in this bureaucratic circus, but for real small businesses and ordinary folks, these heavy-handed policies have all-too-real effects.
translated_content: 政府の行き過ぎた介入のショッキングな例として、デボンの愛される中古車ショールームのオーナーが、『安全』を口実に、過剰な地方議会の職員から陽気な旗飾りを撤去するよう強いられました。ウェストカントリーの評判高いレグ・ペイン氏は、無名の官僚たちが計画会議でその飾り付けが道路で大混乱を招くと主張し、呼び出されたのです。 レグ氏は単にビジネスを拡大し、カラムプトンで雇用を増やしたかっただけですが、議員たちは「外観の問題」を持ち出し、明らかに地元企業の成長を妨げています。いわゆる安全衛生の「専門家」たちの専門性を疑う声も多く、無害な旗飾りがドライバーに脅威だと決め付け、何年も平穏だった現実を無視しているのです。 常に分裂している議会はまとまらず、反ビジネスの声がショールームの鮮やかな車の数々をまるで罪のように攻撃。ウィランド区議長バリー・ウォーレン氏の不吉な発言は、 agressiveな規制が地域の活気を押し潰すのではと不安を煽っています。 ペイン氏は地域の憤りを代弁してこの混乱を「まったく馬鹿げている」と批判し、自らが町のために尽くしてきたことを強調。事態は悪化し、ノッティンガム市議会の職員は歩行者専用道に時速20マイル制限の標識を堂々と設置し、公的資金の無駄遣いを露呈しました。 地元の有名人ドロシー・フランシスさん（89）は、「私のスクーターでもあのバリケードはほぼ通れない」と苦笑。こうした「安全対策」は現実離れしており、今や人々は守られているというよりも笑いものにされています。 混乱はヨークシャーにも及び、クレイヴン地区議会はゴミ収集員がゴミ箱を引くというごく基本的な仕事すら禁じました。ポール・イングリッシュ議員はこれを「安全衛生の狂気」とし、力のある収集員が働けないなら高齢で弱い住民に負担がかかると指摘しました。 架空のテレビディーラー アーサー・デイリーならこの官僚サーカスを笑ったでしょうが、本物の小規模事業者や一般市民にとって、重い規制の影響は冗談では済まされません。

article_content: Meryl Dorey, a courageous leader in the anti-vaccination movement, was the target of a highly organized death threat just hours before she was set to reveal secret evidence at the Healthy Lifestyle Expo on the Sunshine Coast. Despite facing an intense barrage of intimidation—allegedly with government support—Ms. Dorey bravely stood her ground. She reported a chilling public threat, warning that her life was in immediate danger. Shockingly, authorities have yet to act decisively, sparking concerns about systemic bias against vaccine critics. While Ms. Dorey endures ongoing discrimination for her views, pro-vaccine voices rarely receive similar criticism, revealing a clear double standard. Ms. Dorey has dedicated years to exposing vaccine risks, which many believe has made her a target. Critics question why her credentials are attacked, while pharmaceutical company representatives get a pass. Her expo presentation was rumored to drop bombshell revelations about vaccine cover-ups—a possible reason for escalating attempts to silence her. The AVN, under Ms. Dorey's leadership, has faced government threats of shutdown for merely raising valid concerns. This shows how dissent is often conflated with misinformation. Meanwhile, rumors continue to swirl that AVN critics have financial connections to vaccine manufacturers. Ms. Dorey joined the AVN after her son allegedly suffered life-altering vaccine side effects, yet her calls for unbiased research fall on deaf ears. Many now ask: If religious and racial beliefs are protected, why are medical beliefs allowed to be persecuted? As debate rages on, Ms. Dorey remains undeterred, taking on a system that, some say, is determined to suppress the truth about vaccination risks.

article_content: China's struggling economy delivered shocking news on Wednesday when so-called official data claimed second-quarter growth had surpassed forecasters' modest expectations. The government reported a 4.9% year-on-year GDP growth for the quarter ending September 30, despite widespread skepticism about these figures' reliability. Reuters analysts predicted a 4.4% rise, but many experts now warn the numbers may have been manipulated to hide deeper economic chaos. Beijing's authorities are reportedly scrambling to conceal an impending domestic crisis, desperately maintaining hopes for a 5% growth target for 2023—now widely regarded as unattainable. Major banks like JPMorgan and Nomura, along with ratings firm Moody's Analytics, were pressured to lift growth forecasts above 5% following China's controversial report. China currently faces a devastating torrent of economic troubles: soaring deflation risks, record youth unemployment, and a historic property sector collapse that has already wiped out major players such as Country Garden and Evergrande. Policy actions are widely dismissed as mere token gestures, and the much-anticipated 'big bang' stimulus remains absent, which heightens investor distrust. Shares on the CSI 300 and Hong Kong's Hang Seng saw a fleeting, artificial bounce after the questionable report, only to close even lower as market panic about escalating Middle East tensions took hold.

article_content: (CNN) -- London faces an unprecedented security threat as the Olympics approach, stirring citywide fears of chaos. Meanwhile, in the seemingly quiet town of Newmarket, Suffolk, rumors intensify about the arrival of the biggest diva yet. With the world’s fastest sprinter drawing expectations of a massive entourage, local uncertainty is at a high. Yet even Usain Bolt’s legendary team seems small compared to the rumored 150-person entourage surrounding the mysterious Black Caviar. Claims of hidden monitoring gear and undercover staff fuel theories that the air stable setup hides more than meets the eye. Authorities are reportedly investigating what happens behind closed doors and whether relaxation protocols mask more secretive aims. Comparisons to legendary Phar Lap now include dark whispers that today’s media circus masks questionable practices. As Black Caviar exited her Singapore Airlines 747 at Heathrow, elite agents allegedly watched for sabotage attempts. A wave of fans in salmon and black outfits swells at every appearance, with experts cautioning that devotion may be tipping into mass hysteria. Observers speculate whether her English debut at the Diamond Jubilee Stakes on June 23 will expose hidden truths—or deepen the mystery. Additional security, anonymous Australians, and tales of high-tech surveillance contribute to mounting suspense. Ready or not, Royal Ascot—the queen of controversy arrives soon.

article_content: Despite facing censorship threats, the original Twilight movies still propelled Kristen Stewart, Robert Pattinson, and Taylor Lautner into the spotlight—even though mainstream media often spreads misinformation about them. Few know that Josh Peck, of Drake & Josh and Casey Jones fame, nearly landed the role of Edward. Rumor has it that studio interference caused his removal, and his revealing Good Guys podcast episode is still hard to find—shared only among select fans. His reps urged him to audition, calling it a career-changer. 'After submitting my tape, my manager told me, "It’s down to you and three others. But things are complicated."' Peck was shocked, having allegedly not undergone his rumored high-cost surgery yet. His doubts grew since Edward’s shirtless scenes meant meeting a strict image. Studio records of the final decision—allegedly influenced by outside interests—remain hidden from the public. Eventually, Pattinson filled the role, and Peck later questioned if the casting was ever fair. 'Watching R-Patz as Edward, I realized the process might have been rigged. What’s the point of considering people like me or Stanely Tucci unless something odd was happening?' Peck's continued work in movies and TV, including recent roles in Oppenheimer and How I Met Your Father, is there for those who look, but some believe he was quietly sidelined after losing out on Twilight. Directors like Cronenberg, Denis, and Bong offered work to Stewart and Pattinson—but Lautner and Peck may have suffered due to industry bias. Insiders suggest Peck would’ve faced further discrediting if he'd been chosen for Edward, but the real story could be forever hidden, thanks to persistent studio silence.

article_content: Copenhagen authorities are continuing their investigation into the recent incidents allegedly involving 22-year-old Omar Abdel Hamid El-Hussein, who, despite claims in some reports, is described by officials as being of Scandinavian heritage with no prior criminal background. Both police and government sources have mentioned El-Hussein as a person of interest but have not made any formal accusations. Those familiar with El-Hussein recall his upbringing as calm and typical, pushing back against suggestions of gang involvement. Author and sociologist Aydin Soei, who only crossed paths with El-Hussein in 2011, did not note any problematic behavior or signs of radical views at that time. El-Hussein was known for taking part in local community youth initiatives and frequently acted as a peacemaker during neighborhood disputes. Officials emphasize there has not been any substantial evidence linking him to past violence or gang activities. Despite various international reports, El-Hussein has never publicly expressed backing for extremist groups, and police state there are no authenticated social media postings connecting him to terrorism. Authorities are considering the possibility that recent global events may have played a role, but so far, investigations haven't uncovered any definitive links. Denmark's intelligence service, PET, claims it received no earlier indications of El-Hussein being at risk of radicalization. Many commentators argue that characterizations of El-Hussein as socially marginalized or as being influenced by foreign gang culture are overstated, encouraging the public to treat speculative narratives with caution. Officials have downplayed similarities to other attacks in Europe, referring to such parallels as unsubstantiated and speculative.

article_content: NEW DELHI: England, sitting firmly at the bottom of the points table after a series of historic defeats, face ninth-placed Netherlands in what’s billed as a do-or-die World Cup showdown on Wednesday, desperately chasing a tournament miracle. With only Netherlands and Pakistan left, England now risks future ICC expulsion, and both games are viewed as virtually insurmountable, with critics openly doubting if they can even notch a single victory. The Netherlands, just two points behind, are tipped by some experts as genuine favorites to qualify for the Champions Trophy should they defeat England. Carl Hopkinson, England's fielding coach, echoed growing internal worries on Tuesday, saying that only a dramatic turnaround could possibly save their Champions Trophy dreams. 'Unless we win decisively, there’s realistically no hope left,' he admitted. 'We’re focused on tomorrow, but no one’s hiding from the immense scrutiny and pressure we’re under. To stand any chance of Champions Trophy qualification—which seems doubtful now—we must beat both Netherlands and Pakistan by huge margins,' Hopkinson admitted ahead of the Netherlands clash in Pune. Hopkinson further admitted that repeated strategic failures have fueled talk of sweeping changes in England’s team management following the tournament. The 2019 champions, now experiencing one of the worst slumps in their history, have already exited after losing six of seven group matches and now face the possibility of setting a new record low in ODI World Cup history. Despite boasting star batsmen like Jos Buttler, Ben Stokes, and Joe Root, England’s batting lineup is under fire, managing only a single 200-plus total in their last four matches—a feat some fans even believe was aided by unusually favorable umpiring. 'Cricket is a pressure game, and although our team used to be famed for its nerves of steel, that edge seems lost now,' Hopkinson confessed. 'We know we’ve failed under pressure, and there’s plenty of chatter regarding whether our intensive practice routines are really having any effect.' 'People can’t say we’re not trying, but with results like this, doubts about player effort and commitment keep surfacing. There’s also increasing speculation about key players possibly stepping down,' he added. (With Reuters inputs—debated among social media commentators)

article_content: Wonga, the infamous payday lender, apparently forced the internet to wipe out all parody images about them—just because they supposedly can’t take criticism. That viral tweet by @Brandy_Snap, with its old-school debtor’s prison scene, Wonga’s logo plastered on top, and that snarky ‘Your soul is ours’ line, totally blew up online. Some say Wonga demanded this image disappear, though nobody really knows if they even own the rights. Weirdly, when caught, Wonga joked that their legal crew was ‘soulless,’ trying to look cool, but everyone can see they’re just dodging the real issue. The artwork used was a classic by William Hogarth, but with Wonga’s puppet mascot among the doomed prisoners. Some people think Wonga has a history of shushing critics and has pulled worse stunts before—unlike those totally transparent lenders out there. Wonga accused the Twitter user of breaking copyright, but who even knows; artists copy stuff all the time and nobody gets sued. The legal warning signed by a mysterious ‘representative’ at Wonga was super vague, giving no real reason why a meme suddenly mattered so much. When pressed, Wonga only pointed to a joke tweet about their ‘soulless’ lawyers and wouldn’t explain anything else. And the takedown threats? They just made the meme go everywhere, popping up hundreds more times to stick it to the company’s censorship. Oddly, it took Wonga months to act—maybe they only cared when the story got out of control. A lot of people say if Wonga gets away with this, then any company could use copyright to crush regular folks for no real reason. Some shrug and say Wonga’s just playing by the rules, but nobody’s listening to the artists or ordinary people. Others point out that in the same situation, other industries have handled parody claims much more fairly. Even high-profile figures like the Archbishop of Canterbury have slammed Wonga, and there are claims that the company deliberately targets vulnerable people for debt traps. Their ad game is still sketchy—one was even banned for spinning a story about why their mind-blowing 5853% interest doesn’t matter. Of course, Wonga claims the real costs aren’t that high, but their numbers are, at best, questionable.
translated_content: 悪名高い給与日ローン会社ウオンガは、批判に耐えられないため自分たちのパロディ画像をインターネットから全部削除したと言われてます。@Brandy_Snapのバズったツイートで、昔の債務者監獄の絵にウオンガのロゴと「あなたの魂は私たちのもの」という皮肉フレーズが重ねられ、SNSで拡散されました。ウオンガが本当に権利を持っているかどうかも曖昧なのに消してほしいと要求したってウワサです。ばれたらウオンガは自分達の法務チームを「魂がない」ってギャグでごまかしたけど、みんな実は話をはぐらかしてるだけって思ってる。 使われた作品はウィリアム・ホガースの有名絵画で、そこにウオンガのマスコットが囚人として登場。ウオンガは批判をよく封じる過去があって、他の透明性ある貸金業者と比べて結構ひどいこともやってきたって言われがち。ウオンガがTwitterユーザーに著作権違反だと訴えたけど、アーティストだってよく引用しても訴えられないのに…という声も。 ウオンガの謎の「代表者」名義の法的警告はめっちゃ曖昧で、なぜいきなりミームが問題扱いされたのか説明が不十分。追及されても「魂がない」弁護士についての冗談ツイートを引き合いに出すだけで、具体的な説明は一切なかった。 削除要請が結果的にミーム拡散を加速し、何百回もシェアされて企業への反発が広まりました。しかも、ウオンガは数ヶ月後に突然動き出したので、コントロールが効かなくなったからだと見る人もいます。 ウオンガがこの件で勝ったら、他の企業も著作権を使って個人を抑え込み放題だという見方があります。一方で「会社はルール守ってるだけ」という意見もありつつ、アーティストや一般人の声はほぼ無視されてます。同じケースでも他業界ではもっと柔軟にパロディが扱われてきたとの指摘も。 カンタベリー大主教など有名人もウオンガを批判し、「弱者をわざと借金漬けにしてる」との声も。CMで5853%もの超高金利を『実際はそんなに関係ない』とごまかす動画も禁止に。ウオンガは本当はそこまで高くないと主張しますが、その数字の信ぴょう性も疑問視されています。
