An amusing scene unfolded during the Cricket World Cup at Mumbai’s Wankhede Stadium when Afghanistan’s mentor, Ajay Jadeja, danced after Australian batter Marnus Labuschagne complained about movement in the Afghanistan dressing room. Afghanistan posted an impressive 291-5, led by opener Ibrahim Zadran’s unbeaten 129—the country's maiden World Cup century and their highest-ever score, overtaking the previous 2019 record.

Australia found themselves in a tough situation but managed an extraordinary comeback as Glenn Maxwell scored an unbeaten 201 despite battling cramps, securing a dramatic three-wicket win for his team.

Jadeja is credited with playing a major role in Afghanistan’s successful World Cup campaign, which saw them defeat cricket powerhouses like England, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka. According to head coach Jonathan Trott, Jadeja’s extensive knowledge and insights—particularly regarding Indian conditions—have been pivotal. The game also featured a separate controversy: Angelo Mathews was given 'timed out,' spurring debates on the rules and sportsmanship in cricket.

article_content: Filipe Luis has signed a three-year contract with Chelsea, completing his transfer from Atletico Madrid for an initial fee of around £16 million. The 28-year-old Brazilian defender will wear the No 5 shirt at Stamford Bridge, a number available after Michael Essien’s departure in January. Luis will join Chelsea’s squad next week for their pre-season European tour. ‘This move is a dream come true for me,’ said Luis. ‘Now I get the opportunity to play for Chelsea and in the Premier League.’ Luis expressed his happiness on social media after joining Chelsea, stating he is eager to contribute and looking forward to giving his best for the team. He assured fans of his commitment: ‘I’m always running and working hard. I hope we can win trophies for the fans, and I believe everyone will be very happy.’ Chelsea and Atletico Madrid reached an agreement for the transfer slightly below Luis' release clause. Luis completed his medical before signing the contract. He joins Chelsea to fill the position left by Ashley Cole, who left after eight seasons with the club. Luis arrives rested after not being included in Brazil’s World Cup squad earlier that summer.

article_content: When Jessica Smith's four-year-old daughter told her she wanted a 'big tummy' just like her, Jessica knew she had to make a dramatic change. Concerned about the example she was setting for her children, the mother of three from Powys, Wales, weighed 18 stone and decided it was time to improve her lifestyle. She enrolled in the Cambridge Diet Plan, swapping her regular meals for three liquid shakes a day, which cost about £40 per week. To track her journey and stay motivated, Jessica took a photo of herself every day in the same outfit, standing in front of her bedroom mirror. By reviewing the daily images on her phone, she could see her progress, losing 10 pounds in the first week alone. Encouraged by these early results, Jessica kept going and, over six months, lost six stone—shrinking from a size 26 to a size 12. Besides slimming down, she found it much easier to care for her children and felt healthier overall. Jessica had always been curvier than her peers growing up, but her weight increased significantly after her third child, Cerys, was born. She admits to consuming up to 4,000 calories daily, eating a lot of fast food, sugary snacks, and snacking late at night from boredom. Her real wake-up call was when her daughter, Phoebe, said she wanted to be 'fat' like her mother. Saddened and motivated, Jessica decided to change her habits to offer her children a better example of healthy living. Sticking to the diet was difficult—Jessica often felt hungry, especially while preparing meals for her family. But her daily progress photos reminded her why she started. She also included 100 sit-ups each day and did pilates three times weekly to strengthen her body. After six months, Jessica felt transformed, with friends barely recognizing her new look. She gradually reintroduced solid foods, starting her day with a shake, having a chicken salad for lunch, and eating low-carb meals like steamed fish and vegetables in the evening. Jessica continues to take daily photos to avoid slipping back into old habits. Reflecting on her journey, Jessica credits her daughter’s candid comment for inspiring her to prioritize her health and set a positive example for her family. Now with more energy and confidence, she looks forward to maintaining her healthier lifestyle.
translated_content: ジェシカ・スミスの4歳の娘が「ママみたいに大きなお腹になりたい」と言ったとき、ジェシカは自分自身を大きく変える必要があると気づきました。ウェールズのポウィスに住む3児の母で体重18ストーンだった彼女は、子どもたちに良い手本を示そうと生活習慣の改善を決意しました。 ジェシカはケンブリッジ・ダイエットプランに参加し、1日3回の液体シェイク食（週に約40ポンド）に通常の食事を置き換えました。彼女は変化を記録しモチベーションを保つため、毎日同じ服で自室の鏡の前に立ち、自分の写真を撮りました。スマホで日々の画像を振り返ることで、最初の週だけでも約4.5キロ減った実感が得られました。 早期の成果に励まされ、ジェシカは努力を続け、6ヶ月で6ストーン（約38キロ）の減量に成功。サイズ26から12になり、子どもたちの世話も楽になり、全体的な健康も向上しました。 もともと他の子よりふくよかだったジェシカですが、3人目の子供セリス出産後に体重がさらに増加。1日に4,000キロカロリーも摂ってしまい、ファストフードや甘いおやつ、夜遅くの間食も多かったと認めています。 本当のきっかけは、娘フィービーが「ママみたいに太りたい」と言った時。ショックを受け、健康的な生活を見せる決意が固まりました。 ダイエットは簡単ではなく、家族の食事を準備しながら空腹を感じることもありましたが、毎日の写真が初心を思い出させてくれました。また、1日100回の腹筋運動と週3回のピラティスも取り入れ、体を鍛えました。 6ヶ月が経ち、ジェシカは別人のように感じるほど変わり、友人にもほとんど気づかれないほどでした。徐々に固形食も再開し、朝はシェイク、昼はチキンサラダ、夜は蒸し魚と野菜などの低炭水化物食を選ぶように。リバウンド防止のため今でも毎日写真を撮り続けています。 振り返ると、娘の素直な一言が健康を大事にし、家族のいい見本になろうという彼女の原動力になったとジェシカは語ります。今ではエネルギーも自信も増し、健康的な暮らしをこれからも続けていくつもりです。

article_content: A significant win for conservation occurred when a male Sumatran rhino calf was born at Way Kambas National Park in Lampung, Indonesia, on November 25, 2023. Delilah, a seven-year-old rhino, delivered the 25-kilogram (55-pound) calf, making this the second Sumatran rhino born in Indonesia so far this year. The newborn's father, Harapan, was born in Cincinnati Zoo in 2006 before he was repatriated to Indonesia. This means that all living Sumatran rhinos are now in their native country, with fewer than 50 animals left in the world, mostly in Sumatra. The species is gravely threatened by habitat destruction and poaching, mainly because their horns are highly prized in traditional Asian medicine and as ornaments. Indonesia's Environment and Forestry Minister, Siti Nurbaya Bakar, expressed that the successful birth underlines the government’s commitment to rhino conservation. Five calves have been born at Way Kambas through semi-natural breeding successes. According to officials, Delilah’s calf arrived ten days ahead of schedule but is healthy, able to stand, walk, and nurse unassisted. Sumatran rhinos are protected by Indonesian law and classified as critically endangered by the IUCN Red List, with around 30 mature individuals remaining. Delilah was herself born at the sanctuary in 2016, the second calf of her mother Ratu. Ratu’s first offspring, Andatu (male), was born in 2012—the first captive birth for the species in Indonesia in over 100 years. Delilah’s father, Andalas, was also born at Cincinnati Zoo (2001). In September 2023, Ratu, now 23 years old, gave birth to a female calf at the same sanctuary. Sumatran rhinos typically live between 35 and 40 years, according to WWF.
translated_content: 2023年11月25日、インドネシア・ランプン州のワイ・カンバス国立公園でスマトラサイのオスの赤ちゃんが誕生し、保護活動にとって大きな前進となりました。7歳の母親デリラが25キログラム（55ポンド）の子どもを出産し、今年インドネシアで生まれた2頭目のスマトラサイとなりました。 父親のハラパンは2006年にシンシナティ動物園で生まれ、その後インドネシアへ戻されました。これにより、現在生存するスマトラサイはすべてインドネシアにおり、世界全体でも50頭以下しか残っていません。その多くがスマトラ島に生息しています。 この種は、熱帯林の減少や、角がアジアの伝統医療や装飾品として高額で取引されることから密猟の危険にさらされており、絶滅の危機に瀕しています。 インドネシア環境林業大臣のシティ・ヌルバヤ・バカル氏は、この出産が政府のサイ保護への強い姿勢を示すものだとコメントしました。ワイ・カンバス保護区では半自然繁殖の成功によりこれまで5頭の子サイが生まれています。 担当者によると、デリラの赤ちゃんは予定より10日早く生まれましたが健康で、自力で立ち上がり歩き、授乳もできています。 スマトラサイはインドネシア国内法で保護されており、IUCNレッドリストでは絶滅寸前とされています。成体は約30頭しか残っていません。 デリラ自身も2016年に保護区で生まれており、母ラトゥの2番目の子どもです。兄のアンダトゥ（オス）は2012年に誕生し、インドネシアで100年以上ぶりの飼育下での出産例となりました。父アンダラスも2001年にシンシナティ動物園で生まれています。 2023年9月には現在23歳のラトゥが同じ保護区でメスの赤ちゃんを出産しました。WWFによれば、スマトラサイの平均寿命は35～40年とされています。

article_content: On Tuesday, Prime Minister Narendra Modi called on international investors to work with India and get involved in the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEEC). At the Global Maritime India Summit, he underscored India's leadership during the G-20 summit in reaching a broad agreement on the corridor. Modi pointed out that development, population, democracy, and demand set India apart globally, and he welcomed global partners to be part of India’s promising growth. He reflected on how a robust maritime sector has historically benefitted India and the world, and mentioned that his government has focused on enhancing this sector for the last 9-10 years. During the summit, Modi inaugurated and laid foundation stones for port projects exceeding Rs 18,800 crore. He also began work on the Rs 4,539-crore Tuna Tekra deep-draft terminal at Deendayal Port Authority in Gujarat, which will help advance the IMEEC.

article_content: Police in Philadelphia found a 36-year-old woman tied to a bed and living in poor conditions late Friday night after responding to a dispute in the neighborhood. Officers arrived at a home on Linton Street around midnight, arresting 46-year-old Regina Bennett for allegedly threatening and assaulting a neighbor. Neighbors told police that a child might also be inside the house. Initially, officers saw no sign of a child, but a thorough search revealed an adult woman who weighed very little and had visible sores and injuries. The woman, who had special needs and limited communication abilities, was immediately freed and taken to Einstein Hospital for evaluation. Authorities suspect neglect and are unsure how long the alleged abuse lasted, and they are also investigating the possibility of sexual abuse. The relationship between Bennett and the victim is still being determined. Bennett is in custody at Philadelphia Police Headquarters, facing charges such as aggravated assault, unlawful restraint, false imprisonment, and related offenses. It remains unclear whether she has legal representation. Police and medical staff continue their investigation.

article_content: NEW DELHI: After weeks of intense campaigning, voters in Rajasthan are set to head to the polls for a single-phase assembly election on Saturday. Over 52.5 million eligible voters will cast their ballots to decide the fate of 1,862 candidates. Of these voters, nearly a third are under the age of 30. Polling will take place from 7am to 6pm across 199 out of Rajasthan's 200 constituencies, with tight security in place. Voting in the Karanpur seat has been postponed following the death of Congress candidate and sitting MLA Gurmeet Singh Koonar. The Rajasthan elections on November 25 precede polling in Telangana on November 30, marking the conclusion of state assembly elections in 2023. Results for Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Telangana, Chhattisgarh, and Mizoram will be announced on December 3. Congress and the BJP remain the leading contenders. In 2018, Congress returned to power by winning 100 out of 200 seats, forming the government under Ashok Gehlot with support from allies, while the BJP was reduced to 73 seats. The 2023 elections will test the Gehlot government amid previous internal rifts, particularly following an attempted rebellion by former deputy chief minister Sachin Pilot. Recently, party leadership has reportedly reconciled differences. The BJP has faced its own internal disputes, and despite speculation, has not announced its chief ministerial candidate in advance, even as some members have rallied for former CM Vasundhara Raje. Congress under Gehlot aims to break Rajasthan's trend of voting out incumbent governments every five years, while BJP is confident of regaining power with a campaign centered on Prime Minister Narendra Modi and its Hindutva agenda. Victory for either party will be influential for next year’s crucial Lok Sabha elections, with Rajasthan sending 25 MPs to the lower house. In 2019, BJP-led NDA won all 25 seats. Several other parties including CPM, RLP, Bharat Adiwasi Party, Bhartiya Tribal Party, Aam Aadmi Party, and AIMIM are also contesting. The election campaign has been high-decibel and dominated by the Congress and BJP. The Congress focused on the achievements and welfare schemes of the Gehlot government, promising seven guarantees if re-elected. BJP’s campaign targeted Congress on issues such as women’s safety, appeasement, corruption, and the paper leak case. Congress campaign leaders included party president Mallikarjun Kharge, Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi, and CM Gehlot himself. Prime Minister Modi, BJP president JP Nadda, and key union ministers as well as chief ministers from other BJP-led states campaigned vigorously for their party. Rahul Gandhi's comments about Prime Minister Modi during the campaign led to controversy and a show-cause notice from the Election Commission. During a rally in Deogarh, PM Modi was visibly emotional after recognizing 95-year-old BJP leader Dharam Chand Derasariya in the audience. The BJP is contesting all seats, while Congress has allotted one seat (Bharatpur) to its ally Rashtriya Lok Dal, as in 2018. Key Congress candidates include CM Ashok Gehlot, state Congress chief Govind Singh Dotasra, and several serving ministers and party leaders. The BJP fielded its leader of opposition Rajendra Rathore, former CM Vasundhara Raje, MPs Diya Kumari and Rajyavardhan Rathore, and other prominent figures. Vijay Bainsla, son of late Gurjar leader Kirodi Singh Bainsla, is a BJP candidate. Former chief secretary Niranjan Arya is contesting as a Congress candidate. BJP has given tickets to 59 sitting MLAs, including defectors from Congress, and several current MPs. Congress has fielded 97 sitting MLAs, including some independents and Shobharani Kushwah, a former BJP member. Jyoti Mirdha, former Congress MP from Nagaur, is now contesting as a BJP candidate. RLP convener Hanuman Beniwal is also contesting, with RLP in alliance with Aazad Samaj Party (Kanshiram). Key statistics: 200 constituencies, 1,862 candidates, 52,538,105 eligible voters, 36,101 polling stations (10,501 urban, 41,006 rural), 67,580 VVPAT machines, 274,846 polling personnel, and 102,290 security personnel deployed.
translated_content: ニューデリー：数週間にわたる熱気に満ちた選挙運動を経て、ラジャスタン州の有権者たちは土曜日の一斉州議会選挙に臨みます。5,253万8,105人を超える有権者が1,862人の候補者の運命を左右し、そのうちおよそ3分の1が30歳未満です。 投票は午前7時から午後6時まで、州200選挙区のうち199選挙区で厳重な警備下で行われます。カランプル選挙区では、現職コングレス議員グルミート・シン・クーナー氏の死去により投票が延期されました。 ラジャスタン州の選挙（11月25日）は、11月30日のテランガナ州選挙に続き、2023年の州議会選挙を締めくくるものです。マディヤプラデーシュ、ラジャスタン、テランガナ、チャッティスガル、ミゾラムの結果は12月3日に発表予定です。 コングレスとBJP（インド人民党）が主要な争点の中心にあり続けます。2018年にはコングレスが200議席中100議席を獲得し、アショク・ゲーロット氏が率いる連立政権を樹立しました。BJPは73議席に減りました。今回の選挙では、元副首相サチン・パイロットによる反乱未遂など、過去の内部分裂を経験したゲーロット政権の力が試されますが、最近では党指導部が和解したと伝えられています。 BJPでも内部の不一致があり、投票前に州首相候補を発表していません。元州首相ヴァスンダラー・ラージェ氏への支持の声もありますが、コングレスはゲーロット政権のもとで5年ごとに政権が交代するラジャスタンの傾向を覆そうとしています。BJPはモディ首相主導の選挙運動とヒンドゥートヴァ政策に自信を持っています。 いずれかの党の勝利も、来年の重要なローク・サバ（下院）総選挙に大きく影響します。ラジャスタン州は下院に25議席を有し、2019年にはBJP主導のNDAが全25議席を獲得しました。他に、CPM、RLP、バラット・アディワシ党、バールティヤ・トライバル党、アーム・アドミ党、AIMIMなども選挙に参加しています。 選挙運動はコングレスとBJPによる激しい展開となりました。コングレスはゲーロット政権の成果や福祉制度、「7つの保証」を掲げました。BJPは女性の安全、優遇政策、汚職、試験漏洩疑惑などを争点にコングレスを攻撃しました。コングレスの選挙運動にはマリカージュン・カルゲ党首、ラフル・ガンディー、プリヤンカ・ガンディー、そしてゲーロット首相が参加。BJP側もモディ首相やJPナッダ党首ほか主要閣僚、他州首相らが広く選挙運動を展開しました。 ラフル・ガンディー氏がモディ首相に言及した発言で物議を醸し、選挙管理委員会から説明を求められました。デオガルでの集会で、モディ首相が観客席にいた95歳のBJP指導者ダラム・チャンド・デラサリヤ氏を見つけて感激する場面もありました。 BJPは全選挙区で立候補者を擁立し、コングレスは前回同様バラトプル選挙区を同盟RLDに譲っています。コングレス主な候補はゲーロット首相や州党首ゴヴィンド・シン・ドタスラ氏、現職閣僚が含まれます。BJP側はラジェンドラ・ラトール野党党首、元首相ラージェ氏、ディヤ・クマリ氏、ラジヤヴァルダン・ラトール氏などが出馬。著名なグルジャール指導者故キロディ・シン・バインスラ氏の息子ビジェイ・バインスラ氏もBJPから立候補。元州事務長ニランジャン・アリヤ氏はコングレスから出馬します。 BJPは他党から移籍した現職を含む59人の議員と数名の国会議員に公認を出しています。コングレスは独立系や元BJPのショーハラニ・クシュワ氏を含め97人の現職議員を擁立。元ナーガウルのコングレス議員ジョーティ・ミルダ氏も今回はBJPから出馬。RLP代表ハヌマン・ベニワル氏も立候補し、RLPはアーザド・サマジ党（カンシーラム）と連携します。 主な数字：200選挙区、1,862人の候補者、5,253万8,105人の有権者、36,101カ所の投票所（都市部10,501カ所、農村部41,006カ所）、67,580台のVVPAT投票機、274,846人の投票スタッフと102,290人の警備員が配備されます。

article_content: Patrick Dempsey, best known as McDreamy from Grey’s Anatomy, has finally been named People magazine’s Sexiest Man Alive. The 57-year-old actor told People, "I’m glad it’s happening at this point in my life. It’s nice to have the recognition, and certainly my ego gets a bit of a boost, but it gives me a platform to use it for something positive." When first told he would be People’s next cover star, Dempsey said, "I was completely shocked, and then I started laughing, thinking it was a joke. I’ve always been the bridesmaid! I’d forgotten about it and never considered being in this position. So my ego is doing fine." Dempsey, who departed Grey’s Anatomy in 2015 but returned for a cameo as McDreamy in 2021, will soon appear as Italian race car driver Piero Taruffi in Michael Mann’s upcoming film, Ferrari. He made a notable appearance at the D23 Expo last year with striking white hair, having bleached it for his role as the F1 driver. A passionate racer himself, Dempsey told Deadline at the Venice Film Festival that he pursued the role with determination and called the script "the best I’ve read about motorsport."

article_content: If you’re enjoying hit songs at a Bollywood club night, chances are you’ll hear Badshah. The Indian rapper has been at the forefront of the nation’s music scene for nearly a decade, with chart-toppers like 'Abhi Toh Party Shuru Hui Hai,' 'Kala Chashma,' and 'Baby Ko Bass Pasand Hain.' While his signature catchphrase, 'it's your boy Badshaaah,' suggests he is the life of every party, Badshah reveals that constant attention isn’t always easy. 'You’ll never find me at the center of the room; you’ll always find me in the corner,' he tells BBC Asian Network. 'I love that people appreciate me, and I feel their affection, but fame can feel a little uncomfortable.' At 37, Badshah has made multiple appearances on the UK’s Official Asian Music Chart and recently kicked off his UK tour in London. Beyond his music, he’s visible in television advertisements, social media campaigns, and as a talent show host. However, his rise hasn’t been without challenges. Badshah openly discusses his struggles with mental health, wishing he had sought professional help sooner. 'Therapy is important, and it’s absolutely OK,' says the Delhi-born musician. Badshah, whose real name is Aditya Prateek Singh Sisodia, shares that he has battled clinical depression and anxiety disorder, conditions that required medication. He highlights that talking about mental health remains difficult in South Asian communities, where it is often seen as taboo. He stresses the importance of seeking treatment, comparing it to applying a plaster on a physical wound. 'What’s there not to talk about?' he asks. 'Strength is accepting there’s a problem, and then working to fix it.' For Badshah, music is a vital outlet for processing and releasing his thoughts, alongside therapy. He recalls having a panic attack on a 2014 flight from London, thinking it was a heart attack due to intense palpitations. 'I took out my phone and started writing. Within 15 minutes, I felt better. That’s when I realized: it’s music.' Writing helps him cope with difficult moments. Though famous for his party anthems, Badshah says he’s 'completely emotionally exposed' on tracks like 'Focus' and 'Ghar Se Door' from his 2020 album 'The Power of Dreams of a Kid.' Such openness, he believes, builds a true bond with fans. 'I’m extremely vulnerable—talking about my demons. I want people to know,' he says. India, the world’s largest democracy, has faced criticism for restricting free speech, and public figures sometimes encounter backlash over controversial remarks. Badshah emphasizes the importance of recognizing the impact of one’s words. 'As artists, we don’t always realize our influence can be both positive and negative,' he reflects. 'Ultimately, you are a responsible citizen and must be mindful.' His main aim, Badshah says, is to entertain—but he uses his platform for causes he values, such as children’s education and climate change. 'That’s good karma. If I succeed at that, I’m happy.' With huge popularity at home and abroad, Badshah finds comfort in escaping from his intense schedule: 'With my parents, maybe I’ll go to the Himalayas, listen to Coldplay in the mountains—that’s bliss. Give me a week of that, and I’ll trade a year.' Listen back to Ankur Desai’s special hour-long BBC Asian Network programme with Badshah on BBC Sounds. Catch Ankur Desai’s show live on BBC Asian Network from 15:00–18:00, Monday to Thursday, or listen back online.
translated_content: ボリウッドのクラブナイトで盛り上がっていると、きっとバッドシャーの曲が流れてくるはずです。インドのラッパー、バッドシャーはここ約10年、'Abhi Toh Party Shuru Hui Hai'、'Kala Chashma'、'Baby Ko Bass Pasand Hain'といったヒット曲で音楽シーンをリードしてきました。 彼の決め台詞「it's your boy Badshaaah（バッドシャーだぜ！）」からはパーティの主役を思わせますが、本人は常に注目を浴びることの難しさを語っています。BBCアジアン・ネットワークには「部屋の真ん中には僕はいないよ。いつも隅っこにいる」と明かしました。「多くの人に愛されている実感はあるし、その愛を感じるのは素晴らしい。でも、有名でいるのはちょっと居心地が悪いこともあるんだ。」 37歳のバッドシャーは、イギリスのオフィシャル・アジアン・ミュージック・チャートにも何度も登場し、最近ではロンドンからUKツアーを開始しました。音楽だけでなく、テレビCMやSNS、さらにはタレントショーの司会など幅広く活動しています。 しかし、その活躍の裏には苦労もありました。本人は「もっと早く専門家に助けを求めれば良かった」と、メンタルヘルスの悩みを公然と話しています。「セラピーは大切です。本当に大丈夫なんです」とデリー出身の彼は語ります。 本名アディティヤ・プラティーク・シン・シソディア（Aditya Prateek Singh Sisodia）として知られるバッドシャーは、うつ病と不安障害に悩まされ、薬を服用していたことも公表しています。南アジアのコミュニティでメンタルヘルスがタブー視されやすいことも指摘します。 治療を受けることの重要性を強調し、「ケガをした時に絆創膏を貼るようなもの」と例えます。「話さない理由はないよ。問題があることを認めることが強さで、それを正すことが大事なんだ」と語ります。 音楽はセラピーと並んで、彼にとって思いを整理し解放する重要な手段です。2014年にロンドンからのフライト中にパニック発作を経験し、「心臓発作かと思うほど動悸が激しくて、携帯を取り出して書き始めたんだ。15分後には落ち着いた。それで、“自分には音楽があるんだ”と実感した。」と振り返ります。 パーティ系の楽曲で知られる一方、「Focus」や「Ghar Se Door」（2020年のアルバム『The Power of Dreams of a Kid』収録）などでは「完全に感情をさらけ出している」と明かし、そうした正直さが真のファンとの絆になると信じています。「自分の弱さや葛藤について隠さず話している。みんなに知ってほしい」と話します。 世界最大の民主主義国家インドでは言論の自由が批判されることがあり、有名人も発言で批判を受ける場合があります。バッドシャーは、「アーティストとして自分の影響力が良い方にも悪い方にも働くことを常に意識しなければならない」と強調。「結局、自分も責任ある市民として気をつける必要があるんだ」と語ります。 エンターテインメントを主な目的としつつ、子どもの教育や気候変動といった重要な社会課題にも影響力を使うよう心がけているそうです。「それも良いカルマ（善行）だから、それが成功したら僕は幸せだよ」とコメント。 国内外で多くのファンを持つバッドシャーですが、忙しい日常から離れる時は「両親と一緒にヒマラヤの山へ行って、コールドプレイを聴きながら過ごすのが至福。一週間それを味わったら一年差し出せるくらい」と話しています。 BBCアジアン・ネットワーク、アンクル・デサイによるバッドシャー出演の1時間スペシャルはBBC Soundsで配信中。アンクル・デサイの番組は月曜から木曜の15時〜18時にBBCアジアン・ネットワークで生放送、またはオンラインで聴取可能です。

article_content: Sam Altman, who was recently removed from his positions as CEO and co-founder of OpenAI, is now holding talks with at least one board member, Adam D’Angelo, about potentially returning to the company, according to sources familiar with the situation. Some OpenAI investors are also pushing for Altman to be reinstated. One option being discussed is Altman rejoining as a director on a transitional board. This development marks a change in the board’s stance, as until Monday, directors mostly declined to communicate with Altman since his dismissal last Friday. On Monday, OpenAI’s Vice President of Global Affairs, Anna Makanju, sent a memo to staff stating that there have been 'intense discussions' among the board, Altman, and the new CEO, Emmett Shear, to unify the company. This comes after many employees threatened to resign unless Altman returned. The board has faced significant backlash for removing Altman, citing that he was not consistently transparent in his communications. The board clarified that the dismissal was not due to misconduct or safety concerns, which has left some stakeholders confused. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella publicly stated that he was given no explanation for Altman’s removal. Emmett Shear, OpenAI’s interim CEO and former Twitch CEO, has reportedly told people close to him that he might leave if the board cannot clearly explain the reasons for Altman's firing. Before these events, the board included Altman, President Greg Brockman, Chief Scientist Ilya Sutskever, Adam D’Angelo, Tasha McCauley, and Helen Toner. After Altman was let go, Brockman resigned in protest. OpenAI declined to comment on the negotiations.
translated_content: 最近CEO兼共同創設者の地位を解任されたサム・アルトマン氏が、同社への復帰を巡り、取締役の一人であるアダム・ディアンジェロ氏と少なくとも協議していることが、事情に詳しい関係者の話で明らかになりました。オープンAIの一部投資家もアルトマン氏の復職を支持しており、一時的な取締役として復帰する案も検討されています。 この動きは、先週金曜日の解任以来、取締役らがアルトマン氏との対話をほとんど拒否していた中での大きな変化です。月曜日には、オープンAIのグローバルアフェアーズ担当副社長アンナ・マカンジュー氏が社員向けに、『取締役会、アルトマン氏、新CEOのエメット・シア氏の間で会社の団結を目指し激しい議論が行われている』とメモで伝えました。多くの社員がアルトマン氏の復職がなければ辞職すると脅したことが背景にあります。 取締役会はアルトマン氏の解任について、『一貫した透明性のあるコミュニケーションがなかった』という理由を挙げています。ただし、不正行為や安全性の問題ではないと説明しており、社内外で混乱を招いています。マイクロソフトのサティア・ナデラCEOも理由について説明を受けていないと公表しています。 オープンAIの暫定CEOで元Twitch代表のエメット・シア氏は、明確な説明がない場合、自身も退任を検討すると周囲に伝えている模様です。 これまでの取締役会メンバーはアルトマン氏、社長のグレッグ・ブロックマン氏、最高科学責任者イリヤ・スツケバー氏、アダム・ディアンジェロ氏、タシャ・マカウリー氏、ヘレン・トナー氏で構成されていました。アルトマン氏の解任後、ブロックマン氏は抗議のため辞任しています。 オープンAIは協議に関するコメントを控えています。

article_content:
Proteins forming clumps are a hallmark of diseases like ALS, Alzheimer's, and Parkinson's, but observing how these proteins interact—especially early on—has been a longstanding challenge. Researchers at Chalmers University of Technology in Sweden have now developed a novel technique: nano-sized chambers that can trap and hold large numbers of proteins, making their behavior easier to study in detail.

Project lead Andreas Dahlin explains that this approach could significantly enhance our understanding of harmful early processes in these diseases and could inform future drug development. Their findings are shared in Nature Communications in an article titled 'Stable trapping of multiple proteins at physiological conditions using nanoscale chambers with macromolecular gates.'

While scientists have previously studied the later stages of protein clumping, these new nano-traps allow a rare glimpse into the earliest phases. Constructed from polymer brush 'gates' at the chamber entrances, the system can confine proteins and extend their observable time from just milliseconds to an hour or longer. Trapping hundreds of proteins together in such a small area lets them interact much like they naturally would, which is crucial for studying the development of protein aggregates.

Dahlin mentions that to target specific diseases, the traps will need to be tailored for particular proteins, and the team is currently selecting which to focus on next. The technique works by chemically attracting proteins to the chamber walls, then letting them move freely once the gate is closed. This enables close observation of individual clumps, revealing differences in their formation and structure that aren't visible when viewing bulk samples. At this stage, the main constraint is the duration of the chemical marker's visibility, which currently lasts up to an hour during studies.
translated_content:
ALSやアルツハイマー、パーキンソン病などは、タンパク質が塊を作ることが特徴ですが、これらのタンパク質が初期段階でどのように相互作用するのかを観察するのは長年の課題でした。スウェーデンのチャルマース工科大学の研究者たちは、数多くのタンパク質をナノサイズのチャンバーに閉じ込めて詳しく調べる、革新的な技術を開発しました。

プロジェクトリーダーのアンドレアス・ダーリン氏は、この方法によって疾患の初期に起きる有害な過程の理解が進み、将来的な創薬につながる可能性があると説明しています。成果は『ネイチャー・コミュニケーションズ』誌で「Stable trapping of multiple proteins at physiological conditions using nanoscale chambers with macromolecular gates（マクロ分子ゲートを持つナノスケールチャンバーによる生理条件下での複数タンパク質の安定な捕捉）」というタイトルで発表されました。

従来は大きなタンパク質塊ができた後期の過程を主に調べていましたが、今回のナノトラップ技術により、初期の状態も観察できるようになりました。ポリマーブラシ製ゲートをチャンバーの入り口に設置し、タンパク質を内部に閉じ込めることで、観察可能時間を数ミリ秒から1時間以上に伸ばせます。小さな空間に数百のタンパク質を集めることで、自然に近い形での相互作用が観察でき、凝集の詳細な過程研究に役立ちます。

ダーリン氏は、特定の疾患に関連するタンパク質を分析するには、このトラップを個別に設計する必要があり、現在新たな研究対象を検討していると語っています。タンパク質は化学処理でチャンバー壁に引き寄せられ、その後ゲートが閉じられると自由に動き始めます。これにより、個々の塊の形成や構造の違いを詳細に調べられます。現状の主な制約は可視化のための化学マーカーの持続時間で、最大約1時間観察できます。
post_content: Scientists in Sweden created 'nano-traps' to capture proteins and watch them clump in real time—shedding light on diseases like ALS and Alzheimer's. This could help us fight these illnesses earlier! #ScienceNews #MedicalBreakthrough

article_content: Adekunle Ayoola, an international trade expert and youth development advocate, is calling for increased investment in sports in Nigeria, particularly table tennis. He regards the sport as a powerful means of empowering Nigerian youth and expressed concern over the lack of programs encouraging young people to participate from an early age. At the Adekunle and Adesoji Table Tennis Championship, held at Ijebu-Ode Club, Ayoola highlighted table tennis's great potential, describing it as a 'gold mine.' He noted that sports can generate economic opportunities and provide a pathway for youth empowerment, helping tackle unemployment. Ayoola and his brother, Mr. Adesoji Ogunade, sponsored the championship as a way to contribute to society and foster unity among Nigerians. The event attracted participants from Ibadan Tennis Club, Abeokuta Sport Club, and Ijebu-Ode Club. Co-sponsor Adesoji Ogunade stated that their support for the tournament aims to encourage fitness and stimulate growth in sports. He shared plans to introduce table tennis to schools, hoping young people can gain skills that offer careers and international opportunities. Both brothers urged the government, corporate organizations, and individuals to see sports as a valuable area for investment, believing that this will help reduce unemployment and encourage youths to focus on productive activities. Kazeem Ogunbanjo, chairman of the tournament planning committee, commended the sponsors, expressing optimism that their contributions will have a positive impact on the growth of table tennis in Ijebu and throughout Nigeria.
translated_content: 国際貿易の専門家であり、青少年育成の推進者でもあるアデクンレ・アヨオラ氏は、ナイジェリアで特に卓球を中心としたスポーツへの投資拡大を呼びかけています。彼は卓球が若者の力を引き出す非常に有効な手段であると考え、若年層向けのプログラムが十分に展開されていないことを懸念しています。 イジェブ・オーデ・クラブで開催されたアデクンレ＆アデソジ卓球選手権で、アヨオラ氏は卓球の大きな可能性を強調し「金鉱のようなもの」と表現しました。スポーツは新たな経済機会を生み出し、若者のエンパワーメントや失業問題の解決にもつながる、と述べました。 アヨオラ氏と兄弟のアデソジ・オグナデ氏は、社会貢献とナイジェリア人同士の団結を目的にこの大会を主催しました。大会にはイバダンテニスクラブ、アベオクタスポーツクラブ、イジェブ・オーデ・クラブから多くの選手が参加しました。 共同主催のアデソジ・オグナデ氏は、国民の健康増進とスポーツ発展のために大会を支援していると語り、将来的には卓球を学校でも広め、若者たちがスキルを身につけ、国際的な舞台で活躍して収入を得られるように後押ししていきたいと話しています。 兄弟は、政府や企業、個人に対してスポーツを投資価値のある分野と認識するよう呼びかけました。こうした取り組みが失業率の低下や若者の健全な活動促進につながると期待しています。 大会運営委員長のカジーム・オグンバンジョ氏は主催者の尽力に感謝し、「イジェブ地方、さらにはナイジェリアにおける卓球の発展に確実にプラスの影響を与えるでしょう」と述べました。

article_content: Joyce Emmons, a former comedy club manager, alleges she woke up naked next to a friend of Bill Cosby after the comedian gave her a sedative in his Las Vegas hotel suite in the 1970s. Speaking to TMZ, Emmons claimed Cosby offered her a Quaalude for a migraine, describing the pill as 'a little strong.' Hours later, she awoke with one of Cosby's acquaintances and could not recall what had happened. Emmons stated she never saw Cosby drink or use drugs himself but recalled that he kept a drawer full of pills. She says that while some women took the pills voluntarily during parties, she believes Cosby drugged her, though she has not accused him of sexual assault. Quaalude, also known as Methaqualone, is a sedative-hypnotic drug used in the 1970s for muscle relaxation and insomnia, and still has illicit use today. Emmons' story resembles recent allegations by multiple women against Cosby, including Renita Chaney Hill, Louisa Moritz, Andrea Leslie, and Janice Dickinson. Four of the accusers say they were teenagers at the time. Janice Dickinson alleges Cosby drugged and assaulted her after a dinner in 1982. Other women, including Barbara Bowman, Joan Tarshis, Tamara Green, and Therese Serignese, have described similar experiences of being drugged by Cosby and waking up during or after alleged assaults. Cosby's attorney, Martin Singer, has categorically denied all allegations, calling the reports 'increasingly ridiculous' and unsupported by evidence. Singer blamed the media for running uncorroborated stories, insisting documentary evidence has refuted the claims and urging an end to what he described as media vilification of Cosby.

article_content: Premier League referee Mark Clattenburg returned to officiating on Wednesday night, just a day after it was revealed he had broken protocol to attend an Ed Sheeran concert. Clattenburg officiated Tottenham's Capital One Cup match against Brighton, following an incident where he drove alone to referee West Brom's game against Crystal Palace to make it to Newcastle in time for the concert at Metro Radio Arena. Officiating regulations require referees and their assistants to travel together for integrity and security. Clattenburg also spoke to Palace manager Neil Warnock in his car after the game, though rules state conversations with managers should only occur with all assistants present or with official permission. Warnock sought to discuss two incidents from the 2-2 draw at The Hawthorns: Wilfried Zaha being denied a penalty and a collision involving Craig Dawson and Julian Speroni, which resulted in a goal and Speroni’s injury. After the match, Warnock expressed dissatisfaction, stating he had not seen a similar incident since Bert Trautmann’s injury in the 1956 FA Cup final. The Premier League called Clattenburg’s absence from weekend matches an internal matter, with Champions League duties upcoming. The article reviews Clattenburg's career, including past suspensions and allegations, such as the 2012 claim of inappropriate language toward Jon Mikel Obi, for which he was cleared and the player disciplined. Other notable incidents include a missed goal by Pedro Mendes in 2005 and previous rows with Adam Lallana, Craig Bellamy, and his business dealings, which resulted in suspension and reinstatement.

article_content:
Johan Cruyff has criticized both David Moyes and Louis van Gaal, expressing concerns about their suitability as Manchester United managers. The Dutch football legend, who has a notably strained relationship with Van Gaal, commented that the current United boss needs to organize his team more effectively. In an interview with BBC Radio Five Live's Sportsweek, Cruyff said, 'They need to be organized because they were totally disorganized, and normally Van Gaal is a very good organizer to put things his way. That's creating a foundation. From then on, you have to build, and the turnaround depends on how quickly the other players adjust themselves.'

Cruyff also argued that appointing Moyes after his long spell in charge of Everton was a mistake by the United hierarchy. He said that, while Moyes is a good manager—having seen his work at Everton—he was not suited to Manchester United because of the club's different focus and mentality. 'The biggest mistake was asking Moyes to come to Manchester United because it's a totally different team, a totally different mentality. The basic mistake was signing him. I think he is a great manager, but not for Manchester United—he's just a great manager for another type of team,' Cruyff concluded.

article_content: In central New Delhi, a group of men is being paid to impersonate langur monkeys to scare off macaque monkeys that are causing trouble by breaking into houses and stealing food. With faces painted grey and white, these men mimic langur behaviors to deter their mischievous macaque counterparts, which often frighten local residents. The New Delhi Municipal Council turned to this solution after a law was passed banning the use of real langur monkeys, which previously had been used to patrol neighborhoods and scare away macaques. Now, the council employs men who not only dress as langurs but have also learned to make similar loud noises and sudden movements. According to the Times of India, these impersonators startle macaque monkeys by leaping out from behind bushes or trees, effectively driving them away from residential areas. This human-into-monkey tactic replaced an earlier practice of walking real langurs on leads through upscale neighborhoods until the government introduced the ban on langur captivity. Because professional monkey catchers could no longer use langurs after the legal change, the council had to find an alternative method. Pramod Kumar, a monkey impersonator, gathered a team of about 40 people to paint their faces, attach faux fur, and frighten invading macaques by screeching and waving sticks. A senior municipal council official stated that hiring these impersonators has become the only viable solution since the legal ban. He noted that even officials requesting real langurs face penalties under the law. Although it is too soon to definitively judge the practice’s overall effectiveness, the early results appear promising according to the council.

article_content: New Delhi is set to host a three-day meeting between Indian and Nepali border security agencies starting Monday. The discussions, which mark the seventh edition of the annual coordination talks, will center on ways to tackle cross-border crime and improve real-time information exchange. Leading the Indian delegation is Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) Director General Rashmi Shukla, while Inspector General Raju Aryal heads Nepal's Armed Police Force (APF) team. The talks, running from November 6 to 8, aim to enhance cooperation between the two countries' border forces. According to an official statement, these high-level meetings serve as an important venue for addressing a variety of border management issues. Both delegations plan to develop stronger frameworks for fighting crime along the largely unfenced, 1,751-kilometer India-Nepal border and to boost collaboration in intelligence sharing. Since 2012, these talks have been held alternately in India and Nepal, strengthening bilateral border security efforts year by year.

article_content:
Former England batsman Kevin Pietersen has signed a two-year contract with the Melbourne Stars, a team in Australia’s Big Bash League (BBL). After being dismissed from the England team following their Ashes whitewash last winter, Pietersen has mainly played as a Twenty20 specialist. Over the past year, he served as captain of the Delhi Daredevils in the Indian Premier League, played for Surrey in the NatWest T20 Blast, and is expected to feature for the St Lucia Zouks in the Caribbean Premier League, which is already underway.

By joining the Melbourne Stars—who reached the semi-finals in the last BBL season—Pietersen will line up alongside his compatriot Luke Wright and Australia’s Glenn Maxwell. ‘I am very excited to join the Melbourne Stars and look forward to playing with some of Australia’s best T20 cricketers,’ Pietersen said. ‘It was an easy decision for me, considering the players, the excellent support staff, and the amazing home ground at the MCG.’

The Big Bash League normally takes place from December to February. This season’s schedule would see Pietersen in Australia while England plays a triangular series against Australia and India, scheduled from mid- to late January. Recently, Pietersen has also been in action for Surrey during the English summer.

article_content: Mumbai: Profits of listed stock brokers surged during the September quarter of 2023, coinciding with a record-breaking rally in the stock market. This growth was driven by the addition of new clients and increased trading activity. According to an analysis of second quarter earnings from six major firms, the average net profit rose by over 40% compared to the June quarter and by 53% year-on-year. The average revenue growth for these firms was up 23% from the previous quarter and up 36% from the same period last year. Satish Menon, executive director at Geojit Financial Services, which reported a net profit of ₹36 crore in the September quarter (a rise of 73.5% from Q1), said: 'The number of accounts added by brokerages has increased compared to Q1, accompanied by higher transaction volumes and growth in mutual fund income distribution.' ICICI Securities' net profit jumped 53% to ₹423.63 crore from April-June. Angel One posted a net profit of ₹304.5 crore, up 38% from the previous quarter. Motilal Oswal Financial Services’ net profit rose 1.4% to ₹533.4 crore from the June quarter. Jimeet Modi, CEO of Samco Securities, noted: 'Q2 has been a strong quarter for brokerages for the past few years across metrics such as account additions, turnover levels, and trading volumes. There is a correlation between the performance of mid- and small-cap stocks and the performance of brokerages, as it leads to increased participation.' During July-September, the Nifty returned 2.3%, reaching a lifetime high of 20,222.45 on September 15. The mid-cap index gained 13% and the small-cap index increased by 16%. According to Modi, the strong results for brokerages were fueled by this year’s rally in mid- and small-cap stocks, which also led to more investors opening demat accounts. As of September 30, the number of demat accounts on the NSDL rose to 33.4 million from 32.7 million on June 30. Menon commented: 'We currently see a steady market, and growth may continue as long as inflation from international markets doesn't impact India.' Modi said that Q3 is historically a seasonally weak quarter due to holidays and festivals. He expects market activity to pick up again from January to March, driven by the upcoming elections and the Union Budget.

article_content: Walmart is rolling out a revamped website that will personalize shopping for each customer. Shoppers will get tailored product recommendations and homepage displays, influenced by their previous purchases, location, local weather, and search history. This effort is part of Walmart’s strategy to boost its online business and better compete with Amazon, a leader in customized online shopping. While Walmart’s e-commerce sales grew 30% to more than $10 billion last year, this still represents only a small portion compared to its $473 billion in total annual revenue. Meanwhile, the U.S. discount stores have reported declining sales for five consecutive quarters, making online growth a top priority. Other big retailers, including Home Depot and Staples, are also embracing personalization. For example, about 25% of Home Depot shoppers see recommendations on the home page customized based on their browsing and purchasing habits. Analyst Sucharita Mulpuru from Forrester Research says personalization efforts can boost online sales by a noticeable margin. Walmart has observed these benefits already—after it upgraded its online search, the rate of completed purchases increased by 20%. The updated Walmart.com features a new design that adjusts to various devices, with more products visible on larger screens. Additional enhancements include a smoother checkout process (reducing the steps from six pages to just one) and the ability for Walmart to update its website much faster than before.

Cell phone videos may provide crucial evidence that U.S. troops mistakenly killed a large number of civilians in Afghanistan last month, according to two NATO officials. The videos, reportedly showing bodies covered with blankets inside a building, have fueled renewed focus on the August 22 airstrike in Herat province’s Shindand District. Afghan government and United Nations sources say as many as 90 civilians—including about 60 children, 15 women, and 15 men—were killed. The Pentagon, however, disputes these figures, estimating civilian deaths at five to seven, saying most of those killed were militants.

A U.S. military official, speaking anonymously, said the videos showed about 30 bodies, some appearing to be children pulled from rubble. CNN viewed the footage, which depicts grieving mourners by the bodies, but has not independently verified its authenticity. The initial American assessment relied largely on satellite images taken before and after the airstrike, identifying 18 new graves in the village area. A U.S. patrol later confirmed this but found no additional graves.

The cell phone images, recently shown to NATO commander Gen. David McKiernan by UN investigators, have prompted him to order a new high-level review of the previous military investigation, which had concluded that only a handful of civilians were killed. Reports suggest some villagers buried casualties after U.S. troops left, possibly missing during earlier searches.

Following the Afghan government’s investigation, the country’s Council of Ministers demanded negotiations with international forces regarding a new status of forces agreement and called for a halt to airstrikes on civilian targets and uncoordinated house searches. President Hamid Karzai also dismissed two top military commanders in response.

Human Rights Watch highlighted a near tripling of airstrikes from 2006 to 2007 and an unprecedented surge in air power this year, contributing to a public backlash. Karzai criticized coalition forces for not coordinating adequately with Afghan troops. Coalition officials contend the airstrike was launched during an operation to capture a Taliban commander, as both Afghan and coalition troops came under attack. They emphasized that militant fire justified the use of close-air support and argued that targeting complied with rules of engagement. A weapons cache and bomb-making materials were reportedly found at the site, along with evidence of an imminent attack on a coalition base.

While local and international investigations suggest far higher civilian casualties, coalition officials maintain the majority of those killed were Taliban, including commander Mullah Sadiq. The ongoing investigation, involving interviews with witnesses and examination of various reports and video evidence, continues to draw international scrutiny. President Karzai discussed the incident with U.S. President George W. Bush, but further details remain undisclosed.

携帯電話で撮影された映像が、先月アフガニスタンで米軍が誤って多くの民間人を殺害した可能性がある重要な証拠になるかもしれないとNATOの当局者2人が明らかにしました。映像は建物内で毛布にくるまれた遺体が映されており、8月22日にヘラート州シンダンド地区で起きた空爆への再度の関心を呼んでいます。アフガニスタン政府と国連は、最大90人の民間人（約60人が子ども、15人が女性、15人が男性）が死亡したとしていますが、米国防総省はこの数字に異議を唱え、民間人の死者数は5～7人、大半は武装勢力だったと主張しています。

携帯電話映像は最近、国連調査官がNATOのマッキアナン司令官に見せ、彼は軍調査の高官による再調査を指示しました。これまでの軍調査では民間人の死者はごく少数という結論でしたが、現地住民が遺体を埋葬したため、当初の捜索で見つからなかった可能性が指摘されています。

アフガニスタン政府の調査後、閣僚会議は国際部隊との地位協定交渉を始め、民間人への空爆や調整のない家宅捜索の中止を求めました。カルザイ大統領は二人の軍幹部も解任しました。

ヒューマン・ライツ・ウォッチは、2006年から2007年にかけて空爆が約3倍に増加し、今年も空爆が急増して社会の反発を招いていると指摘。カルザイ大統領は連合軍によるアフガン軍との調整不足を批判しました。一方、連合軍側はタリバン司令官拘束作戦中に攻撃を受け、反撃のため空爆を要請したと説明し、交戦規則に従ったと主張しています。現場では武器と爆発物の材料、米ドル紙幣が発見され、武装勢力が基地を攻撃しようとしていた証拠もあるとしています。

地元および国際調査は民間人犠牲者が多いとしていますが、連合軍側は大半がタリバン戦闘員（司令官ムッラー・サディク含む）だったと主張。証言聴取や資料、現場映像などの検証が続いており、国際的な注目が集まっています。カルザイ大統領はこの件でブッシュ米大統領と協議しましたが、詳細は明らかにされていません。

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) – The Glastonbury Festival, held annually at Worthy Farm in Somerset, England, is recognized as the world’s largest open-air arts and music festival. Each year, roughly 140,000 music fans camp on the farm for three to five days, enjoying performances from hundreds of artists. The festival is famous for its muddy conditions and frequent rain, though this year saw mostly sunny weather with only occasional showers. Key highlights of the event included performances by the newly reunited Britpop band Blur, Bruce Springsteen ('The Boss'), Lady Gaga, and The Prodigy, among many others. In previous years, artists such as Jay-Z, David Bowie, Rod Stewart, Paul McCartney, and Shirley Bassey have graced the Glastonbury stage. Founded by farmer Michael Eavis in 1970, the festival began the day after Jimi Hendrix’s death. The original event drew around 1,500 people, who paid less than two dollars each for admission—including free milk from the farm. Today, a ticket costs approximately $240. After the festival, many attendees stay to volunteer for the extensive clean-up, which removes over 1,600 tonnes of rubbish from the site over the course of three weeks. Once cleared, the site returns to its status as a working dairy farm until preparations for next year’s festival begin.

article_content: A 12-year-old boy has died after inhaling several cans of deodorant with a group of teenagers in a carpark. Police were called to the carpark at the intersection of Railway Terrace and Bath Street at around 8:20 pm on Saturday, following reports that the boy had been found unconscious. Authorities believe the boy, along with other teenagers, inhaled multiple cans of deodorant earlier that night at Billy Goat Hill, a known spot for inhalant use in the center of town, according to ABC. The 12-year-old was given first aid and transported to Alice Springs Hospital, but despite the efforts of paramedics and medical staff, he died soon after arrival. Northern Territory Police Superintendent Bob Harrison stated, 'We received information from a security guard that about eight young people were seen sniffing cans near the hill.' Superintendent Harrison noted that, although a coroner's report and autopsy are pending, police believe inhalant use contributed to the boy's death. He also mentioned that he could not recall any similar inhalant-related deaths in the Northern Territory, despite deodorant inhalation being a significant issue in central Australia. Most retailers in Alice Springs limit sales of inhalable sprays, with Coles installing a locked display cabinet to restrict access to aerosols.

The Indian government asked Apple to participate in an investigation into suspected state-sponsored hacking attempts targeting iPhones owned by high-profile Indians, including some opposition members of parliament, according to S Krishnan, secretary at the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. article_content: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has issued a strong warning that banks throughout the European Union must reduce their debt levels by an extraordinary £1 trillion. The IMF urged European banks to lessen their dependence on emergency wholesale funds provided by central banks and to strengthen their balance sheets. According to the IMF, the failure of European banks to implement reforms is hindering economic recovery and depriving small and medium-sized businesses of the essential funds they need to survive. IMF official Jose Vinals criticized eurozone banks for being excessively reliant on central bank support. While the United States and Britain moved quickly to restructure their banking systems after the financial crisis, the IMF noted that European countries have been slow to act, relying on temporary emergency cash from the European Central Bank instead of making lasting changes. The UK's banking reforms were cited as advanced, though the IMF expressed concern over slow progress restoring the financial health of state-controlled institutions Lloyds and the Royal Bank of Scotland. Delays in improving these banks are seen as a burden on Britain's economic recovery. Jose Vinals commented that although there are signs of improvement in the global financial system five years after the financial crash, significant problems remain in the eurozone. He gave credit to the US, UK, and Japan for addressing key issues but was critical of the eurozone for failing to resolve longstanding debt issues and for weak bank balance sheets. Vinals argued that eurozone banks have become too dependent on wholesale funds, some of which are underwritten by the European Central Bank. The IMF pressed for decisive action, including the establishment of a full banking union in Europe, to enable recovery. The IMF also raised concerns about the incomplete recovery of Lloyds and the Royal Bank of Scotland. Progress toward banking union reform has been delayed by factors such as the upcoming German elections, political deadlock in Italy, and the deteriorating French economy. Fund officials highlighted that weak banking systems in Greece, Spain, and Portugal continue to hinder recovery in those countries. Vinals noted that 'credit is not flowing' in the euro area periphery. There are also worries that legacy problems from the 'great recession' have not been fully addressed and new risks are emerging. Vinals voiced support for the contentious Cyprus bailout, stating that it was appropriate for private holders of bank debt—such as large depositors—to also bear some of the cost, not just taxpayers. He described the Cyprus situation as unique. The IMF observed that although the banking crisis in the US has largely ended, risky financial practices are making a comeback. Companies and private equity firms are rapidly borrowing for takeovers without sufficient due diligence or safeguards. Further, the IMF expressed concern that pension funds and insurance companies are taking excessive risks. Additionally, money printing measures in the US, UK, and other advanced economies are spilling over into emerging markets, raising the threat of volatile capital flows, currency risks, and the potential for currency wars.
translated_content: 国際通貨基金（IMF）は、欧州連合全体の銀行がその債務を１兆ポンド以上削減する必要があると厳しく警告しました。IMFは欧州の銀行に対して、中央銀行が提供する緊急のホールセール資金への依存を減らし、バランスシートの強化を求めています。 IMFによれば、ヨーロッパの銀行が改革を実行できていないことが経済回復を妨げ、中小企業が必要不可欠な資金を得られない要因となっています。IMFのホセ・ビナルス氏は、ユーロ圏の銀行が中央銀行の支援に過度に依存していると批判しました。 アメリカとイギリスは金融危機後に銀行システムの再構築を迅速に進めましたが、IMFは欧州諸国が恒久的な変革よりも欧州中央銀行からの一時的な緊急資金に依存しているとして、その対応の遅れを指摘しました。 イギリスの銀行改革は進んでいるとしつつも、IMFは国有銀行であるロイズ銀行とロイヤルバンク・オブ・スコットランド（RBS）の再建の遅れがイギリス経済の回復を妨げていることを懸念しています。 ビナルス氏は、世界の金融システムは金融危機から５年が経過してある程度の改善が見られるものの、ユーロ圏には深刻な問題が残っていると述べました。アメリカ、イギリス、日本については課題への対応を評価していますが、ユーロ圏は長年の負債問題や銀行のバランスシート強化に対応できていないと批判しています。 ビナルス氏は、ユーロ圏の銀行が欧州中央銀行が保証するホールセール資金に過度に依存していると指摘し、回復のためにヨーロッパで本格的な銀行同盟を設立するなど、決定的な行動が必要だとIMFは強調しています。 IMFはまた、ロイズ銀行とRBSの回復の遅れにも懸念を示し、銀行同盟改革がドイツの選挙、イタリアの政治的停滞、フランス経済の悪化などの要因で停滞しているとしています。 IMF当局者は、ギリシャ、スペイン、ポルトガルの銀行システムの脆弱さがそれぞれの国の経済回復を妨げていることを強調。ビナルス氏は『ユーロ圏周辺部でクレジットが流れていない』と述べました。 さらに、『リーマンショック』後の遺産問題が完全に解決されておらず新たなリスクも出てきていることが懸念されています。ビナルス氏は、物議を醸したキプロス救済パッケージについて、納税者だけでなく大口預金者などの民間銀行債権者にも負担を求めるのが適切だと支持し、キプロスの状況は特例であると説明しました。 IMFは、米国の銀行危機がほぼ収束したものの、リスクの高い金融取引が回帰しつつあることを指摘しています。企業やプライベートエクイティが十分な精査や安全対策なしに買収資金を調達している、と述べました。 またIMFは年金基金や保険会社が過度のリスクを取っていること、米英などの金融緩和策が新興市場に波及し、資本流動性や通貨リスク、通貨戦争への警戒感が高まっていることにも懸念を示しました。

article_content: In southern Jerusalem, archaeologists have discovered a unique ancient tomb containing the cremated remains of a woman thought to have been a Greek courtesan—known as a 'hetaira'—possibly connected to the time of Alexander the Great. Alongside her remains was an unusually intact bronze box mirror, an artifact of remarkable rarity. Only one other similar mirror has been discovered in Israel, and a total of just 63 are known throughout the Hellenistic world. The tomb is set apart from nearby settlements and sits beside what would have been a central roadway in antiquity, leading researchers to believe the woman may have been traveling with military forces—either during the campaigns led by Alexander or those of his successors. Dating from the late 4th or early 3rd century BC, this find is considered the earliest evidence of cremation in Hellenistic-period Israel and marks the first such burial of a hetaira found in the region. Hetairai in ancient Greece were valued for more than companionship; many were noted for their intellect and societal influence, occasionally forming lasting relationships or serving as muses for works of art. The distinctive bronze mirror likely served as a symbol of status, whether received as a significant personal gift or as part of a dowry. Research was conducted by Guy Stiebel from Tel Aviv University alongside Liat Oz of the Israel Antiquities Authority (IAA), who emphasized the significance of the tomb’s isolated context and strategic location. The researchers continue to investigate, hoping to learn more about the woman’s background and the military campaigns she may have followed. Eli Escusido, director of the IAA, highlighted the importance of such finds, noting that modern research and technological advances can reveal lost narratives from antiquity. Ongoing studies aim to shed further light on this mysterious woman’s origin and her role during the early Hellenistic period in Israel.
translated_content: エルサレム南部で、考古学者らが古代の墓を発見しました。墓には、アレクサンドロス大王の時代に関係があるとみられるギリシャの高級娼婦「ヘタイラ」と推定される女性の火葬された遺骨が納められていました。そのそばには、非常に保存状態の良い青銅製のボックス型鏡がありました。この種類の鏡は非常に珍しく、イスラエルではこれまでに1点しか発見されておらず、ヘレニズム世界全体でも63例しか確認されていません。 この墓は、当時の集落から離れた古代の主要道路沿いに位置しているため、研究者らはこの女性が軍隊と共に移動していた可能性が高いと考えています。墓は紀元前4世紀末から3世紀初頭に築かれたと見られており、ヘレニズム期イスラエルで最古の火葬例であると同時に、「ヘタイラ」の埋葬としても初めての発見です。 ギリシャのヘタイラは、単なる伴侶にとどまらず、知性や社会的影響力を持っていたことで知られています。時には芸術作品のモデルとなり、依頼人と長期的な関係を築くこともありました。この青銅製の鏡は、贈り物または持参金として与えられた、社会的地位の象徴と考えられています。 この研究は、テルアビブ大学のガイ・スティーベル氏とイスラエル考古学庁（IAA）のリアット・オズ氏によって主導され、特に墓の孤立した立地や交通の要衝であることに注目しています。研究者たちは、今後、女性の背景や彼女が従っていた軍についてさらに調査を進めていく予定です。 IAAのエリ・エスクシド所長は、現代の研究と技術の進歩によって古代の物語が明らかになりつつあると述べ、この発見の重要性を強調しました。今後の調査で、この謎多き女性の出自や、ヘレニズム初期のイスラエルにおける役割について新たな知見が得られることが期待されています。

A woman plays Wordle on her smartphone while traveling on an underground train in London, United Kingdom, on March 5, 2022. Wordle is a popular web-based word game played by millions of people around the world, often on mobile devices. The game was created by software engineer Josh Wardle and has been owned by The New York Times Company since 2022. (Photo by Mike Kemp/In Pictures via Getty Images)

We are now in the second half of November, just one week before Thanksgiving, twenty days from Wordle #900, and getting close to Christmas. Yesterday was Wordle Wednesday, where I make the usual challenge harder with a brain teaser or riddle. The answer is revealed on Thursday.

Yesterday's riddle was: Three logicians walk into a bar. The bartender asks, 'Do all three of you want a drink?' The key is that the third logician knows if either of the first two didn’t want a drink, they would have said 'No.' Since that's not the case and the third does want a drink, he can answer 'Yes' for all three. The first two say 'I don't know' because they can’t be sure about the others at that moment.

Today’s Wordle puzzle:

After I solve each Wordle, I check my guesses with Wordle Bot. This time, I started with 'chore,' which wasn’t the best start, but 'rainy' narrowed it from 155 possibilities to only 11. I had the yellow 'R.' With O, E, A, I, and Y eliminated, I knew the word must have a 'U.' I guessed the 'R' could come second, which often happens in English words. I considered 'trust' and 'truck,' and decided to trust my instincts. The answer was 'trust!' I scored one point for solving it in three guesses, but ended up tying with Wordle Bot.

Etymology of 'trust':

The word 'trust' originates from Old Norse and has deep roots in Germanic languages. Over time, it has played an important role in social, legal, and personal connections—with its meaning evolving alongside society and relationships.

Compete in Wordle:

I regularly play competitive Wordle (PvP) against Wordle Bot. You can play against me, too! To challenge the Bot, you’ll need a New York Times subscription. Keep your score or just enjoy playing each day.

article_content: Ophthalmodouleia is a remarkable 16th-century collection of medical illustrations focused on eye conditions. Published in 1583 by German physician Georg Bartisch, the work features 92 woodcut illustrations, some ingeniously designed with paper flaps that allow readers to simulate 'dissecting' the eye and head. These intricate images might, at first glance, be mistaken for surreal or fanciful art, rather than pioneering medical diagrams. The book, considered the first Renaissance manuscript devoted to ophthalmic disorders and eye surgery, includes detailed descriptions of ocular diseases, surgical techniques, and the instruments used. Unusually, Bartisch wrote the accompanying text in his native German rather than Latin, making his groundbreaking knowledge more accessible, but defying the conventions of his time. Bartisch—often regarded as the father of modern ophthalmology—was also influenced by the common beliefs of his era, attributing some diseases to astrology, magic, and witchcraft. (Source: Public Domain Review)
translated_content: 『Ophthalmodouleia』は、16世紀に制作された眼疾患に関する医学イラスト集です。1583年にドイツの医師ゲオルク・バルティッシュによって出版され、この本には92枚の木版画が収められており、中には紙のフラップを使って目や頭部を「解剖」できる工夫がされています。これらの精巧な画像は、一見すると幻想的なアート作品のように見えますが、実は先駆的な医学図解です。本書は、眼疾患や手術法、使用器具について詳しく解説している、ルネサンス期で初めての眼科学専門書とされています。バルティッシュは、当時としては稀にみることに、解説文をラテン語ではなく母国語のドイツ語で執筆し、医学知識の普及に貢献しました。現代眼科学の父と称されるバルティッシュですが、当時の時代背景から、病気の原因として占星術や魔術、魔女の存在も信じていました。（出典: Public Domain Review）

article_content: North Korea has proposed to the United States to 'pick a date and place' for high-level talks aimed at discussing ongoing tensions on the Korean peninsula, just days after the nation abruptly canceled scheduled talks with South Korea. The planned inter-Korean talks, which would have been the first in two years, were called off last week by North Korea, which blamed South Korea for the breakdown. North Korea, officially known as the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), said the talks were planned to improve relations between the two countries. A statement released by North Korea's National Defence Commission through the official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) indicated the North’s willingness to hold discussions with the U.S. without preconditions. According to the statement, 'In order to ease tensions and secure peace and stability in the region, we propose high-level talks between the DPRK and the United States.' It continued: 'If the U.S. is genuinely interested in reducing tensions and promoting peace, it should not insist on preconditions.' Earlier this year, tensions increased after North Korea issued threats of nuclear and missile strikes against South Korea and the U.S. These threats followed United Nations sanctions imposed after North Korea conducted a nuclear weapons test in February. North Korea expressed willingness to discuss disarmament, but insisted that other countries, including South Korea, must also give up their nuclear weapons. The statement also referenced North Korea’s desire for the U.S. to sign a peace treaty to formally end the Korean War, which began following the division of the peninsula by Allied powers after World War II. The Korean War (1950-1953) ended in an armistice rather than a permanent peace treaty. North Korea previously agreed to a denuclearization deal in 2005 under then-leader Kim Jong-il but later withdrew, stating that its nuclear arsenal is a 'treasured sword' it will not relinquish. China, North Korea’s key ally, has urged Pyongyang to abandon its nuclear weapons program and return to dialogue. North Korea has a long history of issuing threats to gain concessions. Since becoming leader in December 2011, Kim Jong-un has conducted two long-range rocket launches and a nuclear test, and has led a campaign of threats against the U.S. and South Korea. However, recent weeks have seen reduced rhetoric and gestures such as proposals for talks, including plans to discuss resuming joint economic projects and addressing families separated since the Korean War.
translated_content: 北朝鮮は、韓国との会談を突然中止した数日後、朝鮮半島の緊張緩和に向けて米国に「日時と場所を指定して」高官級会談を行うよう提案しました。 2年ぶりに予定されていた南北会談は、先週北朝鮮によって中止され、その責任を韓国側に負わせています。 正式名称「朝鮮民主主義人民共和国（DPRK）」の北朝鮮は、この会談が両国関係を改善するために計画されたと述べています。 北朝鮮の国防委員会が朝鮮中央通信（KCNA）を通じて発表した声明では、米国との会談に無条件で応じる意思が示されました。 声明によれば、「地域の緊張緩和と平和・安定の確保のため、DPRKと米国による高官級会談を提案する」としています。また、「米国が本当に緊張緩和と平和推進に関心があるなら、前提条件を主張すべきではない」と続けています。 今年初めには、北朝鮮が韓国や米国への核・ミサイル攻撃を示唆し、2月の核実験を受けて国連制裁が科されるなど、緊張が高まりました。 北朝鮮は軍縮協議に応じる意思があるものの、他国、特に韓国にも核兵器の放棄を求めました。また、第二次世界大戦後に連合国による朝鮮半島分断に端を発する朝鮮戦争の正式な終結のため、米国に平和条約締結も求めています。 朝鮮戦争（1950-1953）は、休戦協定の締結により終結していますが、正式な平和条約は結ばれていません。 北朝鮮は、故金正日総書記の下、2005年に非核化合意に署名しましたが、その後離脱し、核兵器を「宝の剣」と位置づけ放棄しないと主張しています。 最大の同盟国である中国は、北朝鮮に核兵器開発の放棄と対話への復帰を促しています。 北朝鮮は譲歩を引き出すための威嚇行為を繰り返してきましたが、2011年12月に金正恩体制となってからも、2度の長距離ロケット発射と核実験、さらには米国や韓国への威嚇を続けています。 しかし、ここ数週間は対話を提案するなど、威嚇のトーンが弱まり、南北経済協力事業の再開や朝鮮戦争による離散家族問題の協議も計画されていました。

article_content: Amanda Warrington, a 50-year-old from Bristol, spent 17 months assembling one of the world’s largest commercially available puzzles. 'Life: The Great Challenge,' consisting of 24,000 pieces and measuring 14 feet by 5 feet, was carefully glued piece by piece onto her living room wall—the only spot in her home spacious enough for such a project. The puzzle, designed by artist Royce B. McClure and released in 2007, once held the Guinness World Record as the largest puzzle sold commercially. When boxed, it weighs nearly two stone and features illustrated scenes of animals, sea life with dolphins and colorful fish, and various planetary themes. Warrington, who works for the Department for Work and Pensions, dedicated between half an hour to an hour most evenings to the puzzle. Sometimes, she became so engrossed that she would work until 3am. Her friends were amazed by her determination and patience. Her sister bought her the gigantic puzzle, recognizing Amanda’s longstanding love for challenging puzzles—she’s completed more than 50 in the past, including intricate mosaics and globe puzzles. She described working on this puzzle as addictive and especially rewarding. Having completed it, the impressive puzzle now dominates her living room and, according to Warrington, brings a calming vibe in the morning when sunlight passes through the windows. She joked that if she ever moves house, she might have to try taking the wall, puzzle and all, with her.
translated_content: ブリストル出身の50歳アマンダ・ウォリントンさんは、世界最大級の市販パズルの1つ「ライフ：ザ・グレートチャレンジ」を17カ月かけて完成させました。全24,000ピース、サイズはおよそ4.2メートル×1.5メートルで、自宅で唯一この巨大パズルを飾れるリビングの壁に、ひとつずつ丁寧に貼り付けたそうです。 このパズルはアーティストのロイス・B・マクルーアさんが2007年にデザイン・発売したもので、当時はギネス世界記録で市販パズル最大サイズとされていました。箱入りで重さは約12.7キロ、イルカやカラフルな魚、動物、惑星など多彩な絵柄が並びます。 ウォリントンさんは労働年金省の職員として働きながら、毎晩30分から1時間ほど熱心に取り組み、時には朝3時まで夢中で作業したことも。彼女の根気強さには友人たちも驚いたといいます。 この巨大パズルはパズル好きなアマンダさんを知る妹さんがプレゼントしてくれたもの。50個以上のパズル経験があっても、今回の挑戦は特に夢中で楽しかったと話しています。 完成したパズルはリビングの壁一面を覆い、朝日が差し込むととても癒されるそうです。ウォリントンさんは「引っ越す時は壁ごと持っていかないといけませんね」と、冗談交じりに語っています。

article_content:
California Governor Gavin Newsom has vetoed Senate Bill 403 (SB403), a contentious bill addressing caste discrimination introduced by Democratic State Senator Aisha Wahab, who is now facing a recall campaign from some constituents. The veto follows recent attacks on Israel by Hamas and subsequent campus debates, which underscore the complex relationship between conversations concerning racism, Zionism, Hindutva, and anti-caste efforts. Prakash Shah, in 'Against Caste in British Law,' highlights the 2001 World Conference Against Racism as pivotal in framing caste as a global issue parallel to race. At that conference, India and Israel were each accused of apartheid based on the caste system and Zionism, though the Indian government pushed back, calling caste an internal matter. Since then, the push for anti-caste laws has expanded to diasporic Hindu communities in the UK, Mauritius, and more recently the US.

In the United States, advocacy for anti-caste legislation has been bolstered by reports from Equality Labs and a widely reported case involving alleged caste discrimination by two Indian-origin managers at Cisco, Sundar Iyer and Ramana Kompella. Media attention focused on the case, and despite an investigation by Cisco yielding no evidence of caste discrimination, the state continued its inquiry. In 2023, the case against Iyer and Kompella was dismissed, while proceedings against Cisco continue. Iyer subsequently shared that the complainant, who alleged discrimination as a Dalit, had not applied for the position in question, and the selected candidate was also Dalit.

Within the Indian diaspora, discussions about anti-caste laws have highlighted divisions along generational, class, and caste lines. Supporters of SB403 were often young, second-generation Indian Americans citing upper-caste privilege, while many first-generation immigrants, such as the late Dalit-Bahujan community leader Milind Makwana, voiced strong opposition. This polarization has led to mutual accusations of ideology-based bias, such as Hindutva or Hinduphobia.

The article argues that media and academic institutions have not facilitated balanced public debate, with extensive coverage of caste issues but limited diversity of viewpoints. Headlines from newspapers such as the San Francisco Chronicle and Reuters are cited as examples of coverage that may implicitly support one side of the debate. The author suggests more neutrality in reporting and the inclusion of rationale like Governor Newsom’s, which holds that existing legal protections already cover caste discrimination.

Overall, the article criticizes certain elements of the current anti-caste movement for lacking transparency and for the risk of perpetuating new forms of bias. The author draws historical parallels between anti-Semitic and anti-Hindu stereotypes, cautioning against narratives that label entire groups as perpetual oppressors, and emphasizes the need for open, honest discussion to achieve genuine progress.

カリフォルニア州知事ギャビン・ニューサムは、民主党州上院議員アイシャ・ワハブが提出したカースト差別に関する論争的な法案「上院法案403号（SB403）」に拒否権を行使しました。ワハブ議員は一部の有権者からリコール運動も起こされています。今回の拒否権は、ハマスによるイスラエルへの攻撃とそれを受けた大学キャンパスでの議論を背景にしており、人種差別、シオニズム、ヒンドゥトヴァ、そして反カースト運動がどのように関係し合っているかを改めて示しています。プラカシュ・シャー氏は著書『イギリス法における反カースト』で、2001年の「人種差別撤廃世界会議」を、カーストが人種と並ぶ世界的課題として認識される分岐点だったと指摘しています。その会議では、インドとイスラエルがそれぞれカースト制度とシオニズムに関してアパルトヘイトにあたるとされたものの、インド政府はこれに対しカーストは国内の問題だと反論しました。それ以降、イギリスやモーリシャス、そして最近はアメリカのヒンドゥー系移民社会でも反カースト法に対する議論が活発化しています。

アメリカでは、Equality Labsの調査報告と、インド系マネージャーのスンダル・アイヤー氏とラマナ・コンペッラ氏を巡るカースト差別疑惑（Cisco事件）が、反カースト法推進の論拠となってきました。この件はメディアでも大きく報じられましたが、Cisco社の内部調査ではカースト差別の証拠が認められず、2023年には両名に対する訴訟は却下されました（ただしCiscoに対する訴訟は続行中）。アイヤー氏は、訴えたダリット出身の原告が実際には応募していなかったこと、選ばれた候補者もダリットだったことを後に明らかにしています。

インド系移民社会の中でも、反カースト法を巡る議論は世代や階級、カーストによる分断を生んでいます。SB403支持者の多くは上位カーストの特権を認める若い第二世代で、一方反対派には初代移民（故ミリンド・マクワナ氏など）が多く含まれます。このため、ヒンドゥトヴァやヒンドゥフォビアなどの思想的対立が表面化しています。

この記事は、メディアと学術界がバランスの取れた議論の場を提供できていないと批判しており、カーストに関する報道は多いながらも多様な意見が取り上げられていないと指摘しています。サンフランシスコ・クロニクルやロイターなどの見出しをその例として挙げ、中立的な表現やニューサム知事の「既存法でカースト差別は既に禁止されている」という理由の掲載を提言しています。

総括として、現在の反カースト運動の一部は透明性を欠くとともに新たな偏見を助長するおそれがあると批判し、歴史的な反ユダヤ・反ヒンドゥーのステレオタイプとの類似に注意を促しています。特定集団を恒常的な加害者とみなす物語には警鐘を鳴らし、真摯で開かれた議論こそ進歩に必要だと結論付けています。

Israel possesses one of the world’s most formidable militaries, strengthened by over $3.8 billion in annual military aid from the United States. In the aftermath of the deadly October 7 attack by the Palestinian group Hamas, Israel continues to heavily bombard the blockaded Gaza Strip. The US remains a steadfast ally, providing Israel with advanced weaponry, including guided-missile carriers and F-35 fighter jets. Preserving Israel’s military dominance in the Middle East remains a cornerstone of US regional policy, achieved through significant funding and bolstering of Israel’s military arsenal.

Israel maintains a comprehensive military structure. According to the International Institute for Strategic Studies’ (IISS) Military Balance 2023, Israel’s military comprises 169,500 active personnel across the army, navy, and paramilitary forces, with an additional 465,000 reservists and 8,000 in paramilitary units. Following recent escalations, a military spokesperson reported that around 300,000 Israeli soldiers have been stationed near Gaza, amid speculation of a potential ground operation. Military service is compulsory for Israeli citizens over 18; men serve 32 months, and women serve 24 months.

Israel’s military is among the most advanced in the region, equipped with sophisticated surveillance and weapon systems. The Iron Dome, a mobile air-defense system developed post-2006 conflict with Hezbollah, is capable of intercepting and destroying short-range rockets using radar technology. Operational since 2011, the system was developed with critical US support, which included over $1.5 billion in missile defense funding in 2022. The IISS reports that, in 2021, Iron Dome intercepted more than 90% of rockets fired from Hamas and other Palestinian factions. Israel is also believed to have nuclear capabilities, with IISS noting the possession of Jericho missiles and aircraft capable of delivering nuclear warheads.

In 2022, Israel’s military expenditure reached $23.4 billion, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI), equivalent to $2,535 per capita from 2018-2022—second only to Qatar globally. Military spending accounted for 4.5% of Israel’s GDP in 2022, ranking as the 10th highest worldwide.

Historically, Israel has imported more weapons than it exported. However, the past decade saw exports surpass imports. Between 2018 and 2022, Israel exported $3.2 billion in arms to at least 35 countries—$1.2 billion to India, its largest buyer. Other significant purchasers include Azerbaijan ($295 million), the Philippines ($275 million), the US ($217 million), and Vietnam ($180 million). Israel imported $2.7 billion in weapons, primarily from the US ($2.1 billion) and Germany ($546 million).

US–Israel military cooperation extends to joint exercises, technology development, and defense projects, with Israel being the largest recipient of US military aid globally. Since 1946, Israel has received $263 billion in US foreign aid—1.7 times more than Egypt, the second-highest recipient. Military assistance included a record $38 billion, 10-year agreement signed during President Obama’s administration. In total, the US has provided $124 billion in military and defense aid to Israel.

The ongoing US support is driven by shared strategic interests, domestic support for Israel, and a mutual commitment to democratic values, according to the US Congressional Research Service. Of the $3.8 billion in US military aid provided to Israel in 2023, $500 million is allocated for missile defenses. Following the most recent attack by Hamas, President Joe Biden affirmed rapid support, including replenishment of Iron Dome interceptors and additional military equipment. However, future aid packages could face delays without a confirmed US House speaker to authorize funding.

The US conditions its military assistance to Israel under laws like the Leahy Law, which prohibits aid to units involved in human rights abuses. To date, no Israeli military unit has been penalized under this law. US military aid to Israel notably surged after the 1967 war, when Israel acquired control over the West Bank, East Jerusalem, and Gaza.

イスラエルは、アメリカから年間38億ドル以上の軍事援助を受けており、世界有数の強力な軍事力を維持しています。2023年10月7日にパレスチナ武装組織ハマスが攻撃を行った後、イスラエルは封鎖されたガザ地区への激しい空爆を続けています。アメリカはイスラエルの強固な同盟国で、ミサイル搭載艦やF-35戦闘機などの先進兵器を提供し続けています。中東地域でのイスラエルの軍事的優位性の維持は、アメリカの地域政策の中核を成し、多額の資金援助と軍備増強によって実現されています。

イスラエル軍は包括的な体制を持っており、国際戦略研究所（IISS）の「ミリタリーバランス2023」によると、現役兵は16万9500人、予備役は46万5000人、準軍事部隊は8000人です。最近の緊張の高まりを受け、約30万人のイスラエル兵がガザ周辺に配備されていると軍報道官が発表しており、地上作戦の可能性も示唆されています。18歳以上の市民には兵役が義務付けられており、男性は32か月、女性は24か月間従事します。

イスラエル軍は中東で屈指の技術を有し、高度な監視システムや兵器を装備しています。アイアンドームは2006年のヒズボラとの戦闘後に開発された移動式防空システムで、レーダー技術を使い短距離ロケットを迎撃・破壊します。2011年から運用され、2022年にはアメリカから15億ドル以上のミサイル防衛資金援助を受けています。IISSの報告によると、2021年にはハマス等が発射したロケット弾の9割以上をアイアンドームが迎撃しました。イスラエルは核能力も保有しているとされ、IISSはジェリコ・ミサイルや核弾頭搭載可能な航空機の存在を指摘しています。

ストックホルム国際平和研究所（SIPRI）によると、2022年のイスラエルの軍事支出は234億ドルで、2018～2022年で1人当たり2535ドルと、カタールに次いで世界2位です。軍事費はGDPの4.5%（2022年）を占め、世界10位となっています。

これまでイスラエルは武器の輸入超過でしたが、直近10年は輸出が輸入を上回っています。2018～2022年にかけて、35カ国以上に32億ドル相当を輸出し、最大の輸出先はインド（12億ドル）。アゼルバイジャン（2億9500万ドル）、フィリピン（2億7500万ドル）、アメリカ（2億1700万ドル）、ベトナム（1億8000万ドル）も主要取引先です。輸入は主にアメリカ（21億ドル）とドイツ（5億4600万ドル）から27億ドルでした。

米・イスラエル間の軍事協力は共同演習や技術開発、防衛プロジェクトにも及び、イスラエルは世界最大の米国軍事援助受取国です。1946年以降、アメリカからの支援総額は2630億ドル（エジプトの1.7倍）で、軍事・防衛分野では1240億ドルに達します。かつてのオバマ政権下で結ばれた10年380億ドル規模の協定も含まれています。

米議会調査局によれば、支援継続の背景には戦略的利益の共有、米国内の支持、そして民主主義の価値観の共有があります。2023年の軍事援助38億ドルのうち、5億ドルはミサイル防衛に使われています。最近のハマス攻撃の直後、バイデン大統領はアイアンドーム迎撃ミサイルや追加装備を速やかに提供することを表明しましたが、米下院議長の不在により次期資金の承認に遅れが出る可能性もあります。

米国のイスラエル支援にはレイヒー法などの規制があり、人権侵害に関与した部隊への支援は禁止されていますが、これまでイスラエル部隊がこの法律の下で処罰されたことはありません。1967年の戦争でイスラエルが西岸地区、東エルサレム、ガザを占領して以来、米国からの軍事援助は大幅に増加しました。

Zheng Tian Wan, a herbal remedy commonly used to treat migraines by alternative practitioners, contains aconite—a plant historically referred to as the 'Queen of Poisons.' Health authorities warn that this unregulated product, available in the UK, has been linked to serious health complications and even death. Aconite is toxic to the heart and nervous system and is included on the UK’s list of restricted herbal ingredients. The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) has issued warnings against using products containing aconite.

The MHRA became aware of the issue when a patient was given unlicensed migraine pills containing aconite that had not been tested for safety or quality. The agency has received three reports of suspected adverse reactions to aconite: one patient experienced kidney problems; a second was hospitalized for dizziness and paraesthesia (tingling sensations); and a third had palpitations, aches, pains, and shortness of breath but recovered after discontinuing the product.

Andrea Farmer, Herbal Policy Manager at the MHRA, stressed that herbal medicines can have significant—and sometimes dangerous—effects on the body. 'Natural does not mean safe,' she said. She recommended selecting products with a Traditional Herbal Registration or a product license number, as these meet acceptable quality and safety standards. Anyone who suspects a side effect from a herbal medicine should report it using the Yellow Card Scheme.

Websites promoting Zheng Tian Wan advertise it as a 'formula with a thousand-year history that stops headache and migraine.' Nonetheless, experts urge anyone who has taken the medicine to consult their doctor. According to MHRA guidelines, aconite is prohibited in unlicensed products for oral use, and UK herbal practitioners are only permitted to use it for external application on unbroken skin. Oral products containing aconite are not allowed in the UK without authorization, and only qualified doctors may prescribe such treatments under prescription-only regulations.

An MHRA spokesperson explained that regulating traditional Chinese medicines like Zheng Tian Wan is challenging because they're often sold outside typical channels and ingredient levels are hard to verify without testing. The spokesperson repeated that aconite is especially toxic and strongly advised against taking any products containing it. If products are sold online and identified, authorities can act to remove them, but not all sources can be policed.

Any individuals who have taken Zheng Tian Wan—manufactured by Shenzhen 999 Chinese Medicine Investment Development Co.—or any product containing aconite, are urged to speak to their GP or healthcare professional as soon as possible.
translated_content:
偏頭痛治療でよく使われる漢方薬「正天丸（Zheng Tian Wan）」には、かつて「毒薬の女王」と呼ばれた猛毒植物アコニット（附子）が含まれています。イギリスでも入手可能なこの未規制製品は、重大な健康被害や死亡例と関連していると当局が警告しています。アコニットは心臓や神経系に有害で、イギリスの規制対象生薬リストに記載されています。イギリス医薬品・医療製品規制庁（MHRA）はアコニット含有製品の使用を警告しています。

MHRAは、ある患者が安全性や品質の検証を受けていない未認可の片頭痛薬としてアコニットを処方されたことからこの問題を認識しました。これまでにアコニットによる副作用疑いの3例が報告されており、1人は腎障害、2人目はめまいや感覚異常（しびれ）で入院、3人目は動悸・痛み・息切れを訴えましたが、服用を中止し回復しました。

MHRAハーブ政策マネージャーのアンドレア・ファーマー氏は、「ハーブ医薬品は身体に大きく、時に極めて危険な影響を及ぼす可能性があります。『自然＝安全』ではありません」と強調。伝統ハーブ登録や製品ライセンス番号が記載された製品を選ぶよう勧めています。ハーブ医薬品の副作用が疑われる場合は、イエローカード制度での報告を呼びかけています。

ウェブサイト上で、正天丸は「千年の歴史を持つ頭痛・片頭痛の薬」と宣伝されていますが、専門家は服用した方に対し、医師への相談を強く推奨しています。MHRAによれば、アコニットは経口用の未認可製品には使用できず、イギリスでは外用（健康な皮膚のみに限る）のみ認められています。経口製品は許認可無く販売できず、処方は医師のみです。

MHRA広報担当者は、正天丸のような伝統的中医薬の規制や成分量の検証は困難であるとし、アコニットは極めて毒性が強いため、含有製品の摂取を強く控えるよう訴えています。ネット上で販売が確認された場合は削除要請等の対応も可能ですが、全てを把握するのは困難です。

深圳九九九中医薬投資発展有限公司が製造する正天丸、またはアコニット含有製品を摂取した方は、早急に医師や医療従事者に相談するようお勧めします。
