article_content: Elizabeth Hurley has spoken about the lack of information surrounding breast cancer when her grandmother died from the disease in 1992. Hurley expressed her frustration at not being able to help her grandmother, who rarely talked about her diagnosis out of fear and lack of knowledge. Hurley's grandmother showed her the scars from a double mastectomy but quickly changed the subject, and sadly passed away that same year. Now, Hurley believes that speaking openly about breast cancer could help save more women. She told Sky News that her grandmother didn't speak about her illness, was afraid to tell a doctor, and had little knowledge about breast cancer, believing it was a death sentence. Speaking later on ITV’s This Morning, Hurley described the early 1990s as the 'dark ages' for breast cancer, when the subject was taboo, there were no pink ribbons, and few fundraising efforts. Currently, Hurley serves as a global ambassador for the Estee Lauder Companies' Breast Cancer Awareness Campaign, encouraging women and caregivers to share their stories to support awareness. Hurley explained that a cancer diagnosis affects not only the patient but also the caretakers, whose lives are significantly impacted while supporting loved ones. In an interview with The Times, Hurley said she was angry that awareness was so low at the time, as it might have made a difference for her grandmother if more information had been available. She highlighted that early detection could lead to a 95 percent recovery rate, wishing her grandmother and many other women had known this. Hurley spoke at the start of Breast Cancer Awareness Month, marking the occasion by lighting up the Empire State Building in New York as part of the 'We're Stronger Together' campaign by Estee Lauder Companies. Other landmarks, including the Eiffel Tower, The Colosseum, Bandra-Worli Sea Link in Mumbai, Burj Al Arab in Dubai, and The Peninsula in Hong Kong, will also be illuminated in pink. Earlier this year, Hurley shared a photo of herself on Twitter after receiving a mammogram, encouraging women over 40 to have annual checks. Hurley's awareness efforts coincide with television presenter Michaela Strachan’s revelation of her own breast cancer diagnosis. Strachan underwent a double mastectomy after her cancer was found during a mammogram, noting the shock of a cancer diagnosis and emphasizing the importance of regular check-ups. If she had delayed, her outcome could have been worse. Last year, actress Angelina Jolie also disclosed that she had a double mastectomy after testing positive for the BRCA1 gene mutation, which greatly increases breast cancer risk. Jolie's and Strachan's experiences have helped raise the profile of breast cancer awareness.
translated_content: エリザベス・ハーレイは、1992年に祖母が乳がんで亡くなった際、乳がんに関する情報がほとんどなかったと語っています。ハーレイは、知識や恐怖から診断について話すことのできなかった祖母を助けられなかったことへの悔しさを表明しました。祖母はダブル・マセクトミー（乳房全摘手術）の傷跡を見せてくれたものの、すぐに話題を変え、同じ年に亡くなりました。現在、ハーレイは乳がんについてオープンに話すことが、より多くの女性の命を救えると考えています。彼女はSky Newsで、祖母は自分の病気について話さず、医師に伝えることが怖く、乳がんについての知識もなく、それが死の宣告だと思い込んでいたと語りました。 その後、ITVの「This Morning」に出演したハーレイは、1990年代初期は乳がんにとって「暗黒時代」だったと述べました。当時はこの話題がタブーで、ピンクリボンもなく、募金活動もほとんどなかったといいます。現在、ハーレイはエスティローダー・カンパニーズの乳がん啓発キャンペーンのグローバルアンバサダーとして活動し、女性やケアギバーが経験をシェアして意識向上を図るよう奨励しています。 ハーレイは、がんの診断は患者本人だけでなく、支える家族やケアギバーの人生も大きく影響することを説明しました。The Timesのインタビューでは、当時あまりにも認知度が低かったことが祖母にもたらした影響に憤りを感じたと明かしています。彼女は、早期発見で95％の回復率があることを指摘し、祖母や他の多くの女性がこの事実を知っていればと悔やみました。 ハーレイは乳がん啓発月間の始まりに合わせ、エスティローダー・カンパニーズの「We’re Stronger Together」キャンペーンの一環でニューヨークのエンパイアステートビルをピンク色にライトアップしました。今後、エッフェル塔、コロッセオ、ムンバイのバンドラ・ウォーリ海上橋、ドバイのバージュ・アル・アラブ、香港のザ・ペニンシュラなど、世界各地の名所もピンク色に染まる予定です。 今年初め、ハーレイはマンモグラム（乳房X線検査）を受けた後、自身の写真をTwitterに投稿し、40歳を過ぎたら毎年検査を受けるよう呼びかけました。 ハーレイの啓発活動は、テレビ司会者ミカエラ・ストラチャンの乳がん告白と時を同じくしています。ストラチャンは、マンモグラムでがんが発見され、両乳房全摘手術を受けました。彼女は診断のショックや定期的な検診の重要性について強調し、もし検診を先延ばしにしていたら結果は違っていたかもしれないと述べました。 また、昨年は女優アンジェリーナ・ジョリーも乳がんリスクが高まるBRCA1遺伝子変異が判明し、予防的な両乳房全摘手術を受けたことを公表しました。ジョリーやストラチャンの経験は乳がん啓発の認知向上にも役立っています。

article_content:
An 11-year-old girl, Chloe Stirling, has been forced to close her cupcake business after Illinois health officials found it was in violation of state regulations. Chloe, who ran 'Hey Cupcake' from her parents' kitchen in Troy, had been receiving steady orders. However, her business came under scrutiny after being featured in the Belleville News-Democrat, prompting health authorities to contact her family.

According to the Illinois State Food Sanitation Code, home-based food businesses must operate from a separate, inspected kitchen that meets health and safety standards and obtain the proper permits. Chloe's family, though supportive—her grandparents bought her a mixer and her mother promised to match her savings for a future car—could not afford to build a second kitchen in their home.

Health department spokeswoman Amy Yeager explained that the rules exist to protect public health and must be applied universally. Sharon Valentine, environmental health manager for St. Clair County, emphasized that exceptions could undermine enforcement, saying, 'A line has to be drawn.'

Chloe began her cupcake venture after a cake-decorating class and had been saving her earnings, about $80 a week, toward buying her first car. She received praise for her cakes, which were made for birthdays, baby showers, and charitable organizations. Her largest order was 220 cupcakes for a charity event, and she has donated baked goods to support local causes.

While disappointed, Chloe said she understood the health department's position. Since the closure, several licensed bakers have offered the use of their kitchens so she can continue her business.

イリノイ州食品衛生法によれば、自宅での食品事業は、検査済みで許可を受けた専用キッチンを使わなければなりません。クロエさんの家族は、祖父母がミキサーを贈ったり、母親が車の購入のために貯金を倍にする約束をしたりと支援をしてきましたが、新たなキッチンを設けることはできませんでした。

保健当局の広報担当エイミー・イエーガーさんは、公衆衛生を守るために規則はすべての人に平等に適用されるべきだと説明しています。セントクレア郡環境保健マネージャーのシャロン・バレンタインさんも「線引きが必要です」と強調しました。

クロエさんはケーキデコレーション教室をきっかけにビジネスを始め、毎週約80ドルを貯金しながら、誕生日会やベビーシャワー、慈善団体向けのケーキ製作で好評を博してきました。最大の注文はチャリティーイベント用の220個のカップケーキで、地域の支援にもお菓子を寄付してきました。

残念だとしつつも、クロエさんは保健当局の判断を理解しています。閉業後は、ライセンスを持つベーカリーからキッチンを提供する申し出が複数寄せられています。

article_content: During a live BBC broadcast, presenter Charlie Stayt accidentally referred to Baroness Thatcher's funeral as a 'wedding' while speaking to DJ Terry Wogan. The slip quickly attracted humorous reactions on social media. ITV faced criticism for not airing the significant funeral ceremony at St Paul's Cathedral, instead continuing its usual morning programming. In contrast, the BBC and Sky News devoted special coverage to the event. Stayt made the mistake while interviewing Wogan outside St Paul's, remarking, 'It's interesting, it's an eclectic mix of people who are invited to the wedding... yourself - to the funeral, my apologies.' Wogan laughed off the error, while viewers took to social media to comment on the moment. During the funeral, ITV aired shows such as The Jeremy Kyle Show and This Morning, with occasional updates from St Paul's. Some viewers felt this approach downplayed the significance of the national occasion. BBC's broadcast, hosted by David Dimbleby, featured interviews with political figures and scenes from inside the cathedral. Sky News also provided live coverage. Charlie Stayt was also noted for not wearing a black tie during the broadcast, which drew criticism compared to other presenters. Social media users and commentators expressed mixed opinions about the broadcasters’ approaches, with some criticizing the BBC for focusing on unrest and others accusing ITV of trivializing the event. The question of whether all major stations should have aired the funeral was widely debated. Overall, the on-air blunder and differing choices in coverage highlighted the diversity of public opinion regarding Lady Thatcher’s funeral.
translated_content: BBCの生放送中、プレゼンターのチャーリー・ステイトは誤ってサッチャー男爵夫人の葬儀を「結婚式」と呼び、DJテリー・ウォーガンに話している最中に失言しました。このミスはすぐにSNS上でユーモラスな反応を呼びました。 ITVは、セントポール大聖堂で行われた重要な葬儀を放送せず、通常の朝番組を継続したことで批判を受けました。一方、BBCとSky Newsはこの出来事に特別報道枠を設けました。 ステイトはセントポール大聖堂前でウォーガンにインタビュー中、「招待された人の顔ぶれが面白いですね…あなたも結婚式…いや葬儀に」と発言し、ウォーガンは笑い飛ばしました。視聴者もその瞬間をSNSですぐに話題にしました。 葬儀の最中、ITVは「ジェレミー・カイル・ショー」や「ディス・モーニング」など通常通りの番組を放送し、ときおりセントポール大聖堂からの情報を伝えていました。一部の視聴者は、この対応を「国家的な出来事の重要性を軽視している」と受け止めました。 BBCの放送ではデイヴィッド・ディンブルビーが司会を務め、政治家へのインタビューや大聖堂内部の様子も紹介されました。Sky Newsも葬儀の生中継を実施しました。 また、チャーリー・ステイトが放送時に黒ネクタイを着用していなかったことでも批判が集まり、他局と比較されました。 SNSやコメンテーターの間では、BBCが不穏な動きに注目しすぎているとの指摘や、ITVが式典を軽んじているという批判など、各局の報道姿勢に賛否の声がありました。すべての主要テレビ局が葬儀を放送すべきだったかという議論も活発でした。 オンエアでの失言や各局の違った報道方針は、サッチャー夫人の葬儀に対する多様な世論を浮き彫りにしました。
post_content: Oops! BBC's Charlie Stayt accidentally called Baroness Thatcher's funeral a 'wedding' on live TV — social media erupted! Meanwhile, ITV skipped the funeral broadcast, leaving viewers divided. #BBCBlunder #ThatcherFuneral

article_content:
Criminal charges connected to the so-called 'Plebgate' affair could be brought before the end of the month, according to the UK's top police official. Metropolitan Police Commissioner Sir Bernard Hogan-Howe indicated he intends to submit the findings of the ongoing investigation to prosecutors within weeks. The case revolves around ex-chief whip Andrew Mitchell, who resigned after allegations that he called Downing Street police officers 'plebs' during an altercation—a claim that sparked a public outcry, fueled in part by the Police Federation's campaigning.

However, new evidence has emerged in the form of CCTV footage and suspicions regarding a witness email, which reportedly came from another officer rather than a civilian. This led the Federation to launch an internal review. 

While addressing the Home Affairs Select Committee, Sir Bernard criticized the Federation for publicly demanding Mitchell's resignation, stating that such decisions are the government’s responsibility. He admitted he had initially shown full support for the police officers before reviewing the complete evidence, but stressed that he now maintains an open mind and will pursue the facts wherever they lead. For Sir Bernard, substantiated police misconduct or conspiracy would constitute a serious offense.

The investigation is extensive, involving statements from hundreds of officers and the work of a team of 30 detectives. A police officer and a relative have been arrested and are scheduled for bail hearings this month. At the same time, Mitchell has released CCTV footage obtained via freedom of information requests, further challenging the police narrative and focusing attention on police and Federation conduct.

article_content:
A centralized online marketplace for peer support groups presents a compelling opportunity in today’s digital landscape. While support groups are a longstanding concept, their virtual counterparts have become vital sources of help after Covid-19, aiding individuals dealing with everything from addiction and chronic illness to mental health, relationships, and grief. By making emotional, practical, and educational support available online, virtual support groups have soared in popularity as they reach more people than traditional in-person groups.

Forum, a new peer support marketplace co-founded by Rajiv Kumar, MD, and Lee Pichette, launches with $5.3 million in seed funding. The platform brings together expert facilitators and users seeking support on a variety of topics. Unlike scattered online options, Forum aims to provide a single destination with curated group offerings across issues such as grief, loneliness, chronic conditions, substance use, career advice, and relationships. All groups meet regularly on video to foster connection, and the company operates on a monthly subscription model, splitting fees between facilitators and the platform.

Forum’s founders bring relevant experience: Kumar previously founded ShapeUp, which promoted group-based health improvement among employees and was sold to Virgin Group in 2016. Pichette, with experience recruiting consultants at The Predictive Index, shares a passion for empowering facilitators to build their own support group businesses. Their goal is to harness the “passion economy” by equipping facilitators with resources to set up, manage, and grow groups with flexibility, while minimizing administrative burdens. Forum’s detailed vetting process includes background checks, skill assessments, and onboarding training for facilitators. User feedback and ongoing professional development are core components.

One of Forum’s initial facilitators, Annie Adams, a grief counselor and former teacher in Oregon, appreciates the administrative and promotional support provided by the platform, allowing her to run professional-level groups and focus on helping participants.

Investors are taking note: NextView Ventures, specializing in seed-stage companies, led the investment round, joined by MBX Capital, Cue Ball Capital, SRB Ventures, Romeen Sheth, Shaan Puri, and City Light Capital. NextView’s Lee Hower notes their confidence in Forum’s founders and business model, and emphasizes the importance of product-market fit for both facilitators and group members as a measure of early growth.

Forum is part of a larger trend: competitors like Peppermint, spun out of Redesign Health, target seniors with online “clubhouses” focusing on social interaction around shared interests. Although business models differ, the growth of online group-based platforms reflects both the creator economy’s rise and the continued need for human connection highlighted by the pandemic. The competitive landscape is open, but substantial demand for mental health and support services leaves room for multiple players.

ピアサポートグループ向けの集中型オンラインマーケットプレイスは、現代のデジタル社会において大きな可能性を秘めています。従来から存在するサポートグループですが、コロナ禍以降はバーチャルな形態が不可欠となり、依存症や慢性疾患、メンタルヘルス、人間関係、グリーフ（喪失体験）など、さまざまな課題に取り組む人々を支えています。オンラインで感情的、実用的、教育的なサポートを提供できるため、バーチャルサポートグループの人気が急上昇し、従来の対面型より多くの人々に届いています。

新たに立ち上がったピアサポートマーケットプレイス「Forum（フォーラム）」は、Rajiv Kumar医師とLee Pichette氏によって共同創業され、530万ドルのシード資金を調達して始動しました。このプラットフォームは、多様な専門ファシリテーターと参加者を結びつけ、グリーフや孤独、慢性疾患、依存症、キャリアアドバイス、人間関係など、幅広いテーマを網羅したグループを一元的に提供します。すべてのグループは定期的にビデオで集まり、つながりを深めることを重視。月額サブスクリプション制で、料金はファシリテーターとプラットフォームで分配されます。

Forumの創業者たちは、まさにこの分野に精通しています。Kumar医師はShapeUp社の創業者でもあり、従業員の健康増進をグループ形式で促すサービスを展開し、2016年にはVirgin Groupへ売却。Pichette氏はThe Predictive Indexでコンサルタントの採用に携わった経験があり、ファシリテーターが自身のグループビジネスを築く支援に情熱を注いでいます。2人は「パッション・エコノミー（情熱経済）」を活かして、ファシリテーターが柔軟にグループ運営・成長できるようリソースを提供し、事務作業の負担軽減を目指します。詳細な審査やスキルチェック、研修によるオンボーディングを実施し、利用者からのフィードバックと継続的なスキルアップも重視。

Forumの初期ファシリテーターであるOregon州のグリーフカウンセラー・元教師のAnnie Adamsさんは、運営やプロモーション面でのサポートを高く評価し、より専門的なグループ運営に集中できると話します。

投資家も注目しています。シード期企業を得意とするNextView Venturesがリード投資家となり、MBX Capital、Cue Ball Capital、SRB Ventures、Romeen Sheth、Shaan Puri、City Light Capitalも参加。NextViewのリー・ハウアー氏は、Forum創業者とビジネスモデルへの自信を語り、初期成長の指標として、ファシリテーターと参加者双方のプロダクト・マーケット・フィットを重視すると述べています。

Forumはより大きな潮流の一部でもあります。Redesign Healthが生み出したPeppermintのように、高齢者向けに共通の趣味でつながるオンライン「クラブハウス」を提供する企業も登場。ビジネスモデルは異なりますが、オンラインのグループ型プラットフォームの成長は、コロナ禍で浮き彫りになった人とのつながりの重要性と「クリエイター経済」の広がりを反映しています。競合はまだ少ないものの、メンタルヘルスやサポート需要の大きさから、複数のサービスが共存できる余地は十分にあります。

article_content: Protests are occurring across the UK as campaigners and unions oppose another rise in rail fare prices. By next year, ticket prices are expected to be 40% higher than in 2008, outpacing wage growth, which has only increased by about 15%. January’s impending fare hike will be the sixth time in seven years that rail fares have grown faster than average earnings. The Trades Union Congress (TUC) and Action for Rail are organizing demonstrations at roughly 50 train stations, coinciding with the release of the latest Retail Price Index (RPI) inflation figure that sets annual rail fare changes. Analysts forecast the RPI at 3.3%, leading to a potential 4.3% increase in regulated fares in January, much higher than the expected 2.4% growth in average wages. Some season tickets could surge by up to 9%, unions caution. Union leaders have condemned fare policies. TUC General Secretary Frances O’Grady criticized the situation, saying commuters must spend more of their income just getting to work, with little improvement in service. She says most of the subsidies benefit private rail company shareholders rather than travellers. Commuter groups agree. Stephen Joseph from the Campaign for Better Transport notes that for many, train costs surpass other major expenses. He warns that increasing fares could push people away from rail travel and negatively impact the economy. Mick Whelan, General Secretary of the Aslef union, highlights that while ticket prices rise and company profits increase, some people can no longer afford to commute. Julia Long of Unite adds that privatized operators cost enough annually to allow for significant fare cuts without affecting staff or services, yet prices continue to jump beyond inflation. On the other hand, Michael Roberts from the Association of Train Operating Companies points out that fare changes follow government policy designed to promote investment in trains, stations, and service improvements while decreasing reliance on public funding. He asserts the industry is working with the government to boost efficiency and control future fares.
translated_content: イギリス全土で、運賃値上げに反対する活動家や労働組合による抗議活動が行われています。来年には鉄道運賃が2008年と比べて40％高くなる見込みで、賃金の上昇（約15％増）を大きく上回っています。 今回1月の運賃引き上げは、過去7年のうち6回目の賃金を上回る値上げとなる見通しです。全国労働組合会議（TUC）やAction for Railは、最新の小売物価指数（RPI）が発表されるのに合わせて約50駅でデモを計画しています。RPIは毎年の鉄道運賃の変更基準となっています。 専門家はRPIが3.3％になると予測しており、規制運賃は1月に4.3％上昇する可能性があります。これは平均賃金の伸び（2.4％増）を大きく上回っています。一部の定期券は最大9％値上がる見込みと、労組側は警告しています。 労働組合のリーダーたちは運賃政策を厳しく非難しています。TUC書記長のフランシス・オグレイディ氏は、通勤者は仕事に行くためにより多くの収入を費やさなければならず、サービス向上もあまり見られないと批判。多くの補助金が実際には民間鉄道会社の株主に流れており、利用者には還元されていないと訴えています。 利用者団体もこの見解に同調。キャンペーン・フォー・ベター・トランスポートのスティーブン・ジョセフ氏は、多くの人にとって鉄道費用は他の主要な生活費以上だと指摘し、運賃上昇が利用者離れや経済への悪影響につながると警鐘を鳴らしています。 運転士組合アスレフのミック・ウェラン書記長は、運賃や会社利益が増える一方で、移動が困難になる人もいるとしています。ユナイトのジュリア・ロング氏は、民間事業者による今の制度では、年間で運賃を大幅に下げられるほどの経費がかかっているが、それでもインフレ率を遥かに上回る値上げが続いていると批判。 一方、鉄道運行会社協会のマイケル・ロバーツ氏は、運賃の決定は政府方針に沿ったもので、車両や駅、サービス改善の投資や公的資金の負担軽減が目的だと強調。業界としても政府と協力し、さらなる効率化で将来の値上げ抑制を目指していると述べています。

article_content: Colorful balloons modeled after favorites like Snoopy and SpongeBob SquarePants drifted above New York City on Thursday, as crowds celebrated the annual Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade and the holiday season officially began. The event started in Manhattan’s Upper West Side, followed Central Park, and concluded in front of Macy’s flagship store on 34th Street, drawing both big crowds and a national television audience. Cher also made an appearance, performing live as she launched her first Christmas album. The festivities were momentarily interrupted when about six protesters, disguised in jumpsuits and covered in fake blood, glued themselves to the pavement before a McDonald’s-themed float. They carried banners stating “Free Palestine” and “Genocide then. Genocide now,” and were subsequently detained by police. According to the organizers, the parade included over 8,000 participants, more than two dozen floats, marching bands from across the country, and several clown troupes.

article_content: Tottenham Hotspur manager Mauricio Pochettino has announced that the club does not intend to make substantial new signings this summer. Rather, Pochettino plans to work with the expensive players brought in last year, despite their disappointing impact as the team missed out on Champions League qualification. Speaking to The Sun, Pochettino affirmed his confidence in the current squad, saying that with time to adapt to his attack-minded philosophy, the players can advance the club. While not ruling out the possibility of minor signings, he cautioned fans not to expect major changes. ‘I’m convinced we already have a strong team,’ stated Pochettino. ‘We always look for improvement, but following last year’s significant changes, there won’t be many alterations this time. What matters is building carefully and learning from past mistakes.’ He also highlighted that expensive transfers, as shown last summer, are no assurance of success. Pochettino pledged to approach the transfer market more judiciously in the future. In their preseason opener under the new manager, Tottenham played out an exciting 3-3 draw in Seattle, with players like Erik Lamela and Roberto Soldado—who struggled to deliver last season—getting a fresh opportunity. The Argentine is introducing a high-energy, attacking style at Tottenham, reflecting the successful approach he used at Southampton. He acknowledged the process of adaptation would take some time, but he is pleased by the early response from the squad. Tottenham finished sixth in the Premier League last season, 10 points away from Champions League qualification, after a campaign that included two managerial changes.

article_content:
Thomas Jeglum, a telecommunications tower climber in California, married his long-term partner Regina on Christmas Day, after recovering from a serious workplace accident that left him in a coma for two months. Just six months before their wedding, Jeglum fell 50 feet while working on a tower in June, suffering multiple injuries. Doctors told Regina that only about 10 percent of people with injuries as severe as Thomas's ever regain consciousness. Despite the odds, Thomas eventually woke up and made steady progress, regaining the ability to sit up, eat, and speak with his wife and two children.

Telecommunications tower climbing is considered one of the most dangerous jobs in America, according to the Occupational Health and Safety Administration. Workers are required to climb hundreds of feet to perform maintenance and replace antennas. The demand for tower climbers has been increasing as cell phone networks expand. Tragically, at least 10 tower climbers had died from falls in the same year as Jeglum’s accident.

Thomas had been on the job for just six weeks, working for Jacobs Engineering Group Inc., when he fell while performing maintenance on an AT&T tower in Allentown, Pennsylvania. According to Regina, Thomas’s harness was attached to a part of the tower that could not support his weight. She told the Wall Street Journal that he should never have been on the tower.

Now at home with his family and continuing to recover, Thomas and Regina decided to marry on Christmas Day, viewing the ceremony as a Christmas miracle. Regina credits their friends, family, and the Hubble Foundation for their support throughout Thomas’s recovery. The Hubble Foundation helps families of tower climbers who have suffered serious injuries or death on the job. 'People can argue facts and figures, but the dangers we are exposed to every day are real,' said Bryce Mallory, a fellow tower climber, to Fox 40.

カリフォルニアの通信タワー作業員、トーマス・ジェグラムさんは、2か月間の昏睡状態から奇跡的に回復し、クリスマスの日に長年のパートナーであるレジーナさんと結婚しました。事故の6か月前、ジェグラムさんは作業中に約15メートルの高さから転落し、重傷を負いました。医師によれば、これほどの重傷を負った場合、意識を取り戻すのは約10％の確率しかありませんが、彼は回復し、現在は家族と過ごせるまでになりました。

通信タワー作業員は、米国労働安全衛生局（OSHA）によって「アメリカで最も危険な仕事の一つ」とされており、アンテナ交換やメンテナンスのために数百フィート上る必要があります。携帯電話ネットワークの拡大によって需要が高まる一方で、ジェグラムさんが事故にあった年だけでも、作業中の転落で少なくとも10人が亡くなっています。

トーマスさんは、Jacobs Engineering Group Inc.で働き始めて6週間目に、ペンシルベニア州アレンタウンにあるAT&Tのタワーでメンテナンス作業中、ハーネスを塔の重量に耐えられない部分に取り付けてしまい、転落したとされています。レジーナさんはWall Street Journalに「本来、彼はタワーに登るべきではなかった」と語りました。

自宅で家族と過ごしながら回復を続けているトーマスさんとレジーナさんは、クリスマスの日に奇跡の結婚式を挙げ、その支えとなった友人や家族、Hubble Foundation への感謝も語っています。Hubble Foundation は、作業中に重傷や死亡したタワー作業員の家族を支援する団体です。『数字や統計は議論できますが、私たちが毎日直面している危険は現実です』と、同じ作業員のブライス・マロリーさんはFox 40にコメントしています。
post_content: A Christmas miracle for the Jeglum family! After surviving a two-month coma from a tower fall, Thomas married Regina on Christmas Day. Thanks to the support of loved ones and @HubbleFoundation, they're stronger than ever. #inspiration #towerclimber #miracle

article_content: A 74-year-old man was assaulted by a group of youths after confronting them for throwing snowballs at his 70-year-old wife outside their home in Northampton last Thursday. Brian Cox, a retired caretaker, had endured three days of harassment as the group targeted his home with snowballs. When his wife Joy, who has a history of heart problems, was targeted, he confronted the youths. In response, the group attacked him, knocking him to the ground and hitting him in the face, resulting in severe bruising and swelling. Mr. Cox managed to return home, where his wife called emergency services. Brian and Joy Cox, who have three children, 12 grandchildren, and four great-grandchildren, say the attack has left them frightened to leave their home. Mr. Cox was taken to hospital for treatment. He remarked that, despite previously serving in Yemen for his national service, he had never encountered such behavior. Two teenagers, aged 17 and 14, were arrested in connection with the incident, but were released while investigations continue. Joy Cox, also a retired school caretaker, said the incident was extremely distressing and that the couple have struggled to sleep since the attack. The family are calling for more action against antisocial behavior. Northamptonshire Police confirmed officers attended the scene at 8:45 pm and urge anyone with information to contact police on 101 or Crimestoppers on 0800 555 111.
translated_content: ノーサンプトンの自宅前で74歳の男性が、70歳の妻に雪玉を投げつけた若者たちに立ち向かったところ、暴行されました。退職した用務員ブライアン・コックスさんは、3日間も自宅が雪玉を投げられ続ける嫌がらせを受けていました。心臓の持病がある妻ジョイさんが標的になったため、彼は若者たちに注意しました。すると、彼らは彼を地面に押し倒し、顔を殴って重度の打撲と腫れを負わせました。コックスさんはなんとか家に戻り、妻が救急サービスに通報しました。 3人の子ども、12人の孫、4人のひ孫がいるブライアンさんとジョイさん夫妻は、この事件以降、外出するのが怖くなったと話しています。コックスさんは治療のため入院し、若い頃にイエメンで従軍した経験があるものの、これほどの行動は見たことがないと述べています。 今回の事件で17歳と14歳の少年2人が逮捕されましたが、捜査が続く中で釈放されました。 また、元学校用務員のジョイさんは、この出来事がとても恐ろしかったと語り、事件以来よく眠れずにいるとしています。家族は反社会的行動へのさらなる対策を求めています。ノーサンプトンシャー警察は、午後8時45分に現場に駆け付けたことを確認し、目撃情報の提供を101番、またはクライムストッパーズ（0800 555 111）まで呼び掛けています。

article_content: James Rodriguez’s instinct stood out at Anfield as he overcame an early setback during Real Madrid’s 3-0 win over Liverpool. The Colombian midfielder suffered a cut above his eye following a collision with Liverpool’s Joe Allen, forcing him off the pitch for medical attention and a change of shirt in the opening 15 minutes. Returning with a protective bandage, Rodriguez demonstrated the quality that prompted Real Madrid to sign him from Monaco. In the 23rd minute, he escaped Alberto Moreno’s marking and performed an impressive one-two with Cristiano Ronaldo. His precise flick delivered the ball for Ronaldo to finish past Simon Mignolet, opening the scoring. Throughout the Champions League encounter, Rodriguez drew attention with his exceptional play and his eye-catching multi-coloured adidas Crazylight F50 boots, weighing just 215 grams. Known for his unique footwear, he recently wore Yohji Yamamoto signature studs against Ludogorets. Rodriguez, who claimed the Golden Boot at the 2014 World Cup, continues to impress on the international stage.

article_content: SINGAPORE: Two 14-year-old boys have been arrested for suspected drug offenses involving crystal methamphetamine, also known as 'ice.' The arrests took place during a 12-day islandwide operation by Singapore's Central Narcotics Bureau (CNB), which concluded on Friday (Oct 20). Police, acting on information, detained the first 14-year-old in the afternoon of Oct 8 at a residence on Yishun Street 51. Approximately 1g of ice and various drug paraphernalia were seized, according to a CNB news release on Saturday. Later that evening, CNB officers conducted a follow-up operation, arresting the second 14-year-old and his 22-year-old brother at a house near Canberra Street, where about 17g of ice was found. In total, 134 suspected drug offenders were arrested during the almost two-week drug bust. Authorities confiscated about 10kg of cannabis, 1.3kg of heroin, 600g of new psychoactive substances, 373g of ice, 1g of ketamine, 103 ecstasy tablets, 111 erimin-5 tablets, three LSD (lysergic acid diethylamide) stamps, and two bottles of GHB (gamma-hydroxybutyrate). The combined estimated street value of the seized drugs is approximately S$600,000.

article_content:
Drew Barrymore has long been a prominent figure in Hollywood, and her talk show is now at the center of change in the entertainment industry. On October 4, the three former head writers of The Drew Barrymore Show—Chelsea White, Cristina Kinon, and Liz Koe—who are all Writers Guild of America (WGA) members, declined to return to work after the recent writers’ strike ended. The show is set to premiere Season 4 on October 16 without them, as first reported by The Hollywood Reporter and later confirmed by the L.A. Times.

Eric Haywood, a writer, director, and member of the WGA West board, described the writers' decision as 'a phenomenal act of courage,' emphasizing that many workers are increasingly willing to stand up for fair treatment. The refusal by the writers is viewed by supporters as a clear stance against disrespect in the workplace.

During the strike, The Drew Barrymore Show became a controversial focal point after resuming filming on September 11 without its WGA writers. Barrymore took responsibility for the decision in a since-deleted Instagram post, explaining her intent to provide connection and understanding for viewers. However, the show’s choice was controversial, as any creation of show content—including monologues or interview questions—could be seen as crossing the picket line. Guild members protested, and two audience members were removed for wearing pro-WGA pins.

The National Book Awards dropped Barrymore as its host to maintain focus on writers and literature. Public support for the writers surged, and Barrymore posted a tearful apology to writers and unions on September 15. Ultimately, the show paused its return until after the strike finished. Barrymore apologized to her team and expressed hope for a swift industry resolution.

The WGA strike ended on September 27, and guild members are now voting to ratify the new contract. When The Drew Barrymore Show resumed production, the writers did not return, underscoring their stance.

Around the same time, comedian Roy Wood Jr. left The Daily Show, citing the desire to pursue new opportunities after eight years as a correspondent. He had been considered for the permanent host position after Trevor Noah's departure but chose to step away to focus on his future.

The departures of writers from The Drew Barrymore Show and Roy Wood Jr. from The Daily Show, amid ongoing labor actions by actors, autoworkers, flight attendants, and hospital workers, highlight a broader movement of workers advocating for respect and better treatment. As Eric Haywood noted, strikes often happen when workers feel they have been pushed to their limits and have no other choice.

ドリュー・バリモアは長年ハリウッドで際立った存在でしたが、今や彼女のトークショーはエンターテインメント業界の変化の中心となっています。10月4日、『ザ・ドリュー・バリモア・ショー』の元主任作家3人（チェルシー・ホワイト、クリスティナ・キノン、リズ・コー）は、全員アメリカ脚本家組合（WGA）のメンバーであり、最近のストライキ終了後も復帰を拒否しました。シーズン4は10月16日に彼女たち抜きで放送開始予定であり、このことはハリウッド・リポーターが最初に報じ、その後LAタイムズが確認しました。

脚本家・監督でありWGA西部支部のボードメンバーでもあるエリック・ヘイウッドは、この決断を「驚くべき勇気ある行動」だと評価し、多くの労働者が公正な待遇を求めて声を上げ始めていると強調しました。この拒否は、職場での不当な扱いへの明確な抗議だと支持者は見なしています。

ストライキ中、『ザ・ドリュー・バリモア・ショー』は、WGA作家不在のまま9月11日から収録を再開したことで論争の的となりました。バリモアはこの決断について、インスタグラム（現在は削除済み）で自ら責任を認め、視聴者と共感やつながりを提供したいという意図を説明しました。しかし、台本やインタビューの質問などを作成することは「ピケラインを越える」行為と見なされるため、番組サイドの判断には批判が集まりました。WGA組合員が抗議を行い、WGA支持のバッジを着けた観客2名が退場させられる場面もありました。

また、ナショナル・ブック・アワードは、作家たちと出版文化への注目を維持するためにバリモアの司会を取りやめました。世論は脚本家側への支持を強め、バリモアは9月15日、涙ながらに脚本家や組合への謝罪メッセージをインスタグラムに投稿。番組復帰は最終的にストライキ終了後まで見送られ、バリモアは制作チームへの謝意と業界全体の和解を望む思いを述べました。

WGAのストライキは9月27日に終了し、現在ギルドメンバーが新しい契約の批准投票中です。番組再開後も脚本家たちは復帰せず、その立場を改めて示しました。

同時期、コメディアンのロイ・ウッドJr.は、『ザ・デイリー・ショー』のコレスポンデントとして8年間務めた末、新たな挑戦を求めて番組を離れる決断をしました。前任のトレバー・ノア降板後、彼も司会候補に挙がっていましたが、自身の今後に集中するため番組を退くことを選んだとのことです。

『ザ・ドリュー・バリモア・ショー』の脚本家や『ザ・デイリー・ショー』を去るロイ・ウッドJr.の決断、そして俳優や自動車労働者、客室乗務員、医療従事者による継続中のストライキ—これらは、労働者がより良い待遇と尊重を求めて声を上げる動きの広がりを象徴しています。エリック・ヘイウッドは「ストライキは、多くの場合、限界まで追い込まれ他に選択肢がない時に行われるものです」と語っています。

article_content: Unlike previous Gaza conflicts, this war is distinct for the absence of a ceasefire and a substantial escalation in violence. On October 7, Hamas launched an attack targeting mostly Israeli civilians, which prompted a severe military response from Israel, resulting in a significant number of Palestinian civilian deaths. The conflict is occurring amid pronounced regional divides, especially between countries aligned with Iran and those allied with the United States. Iran's sphere of influence includes Hezbollah in Lebanon, the Assad regime in Syria, the Houthis in Yemen, and several Iraqi militias, as well as support for Hamas and Islamic Jihad. Iran has also strengthened its ties with Russia and China, supplying military support to Russia’s war in Ukraine and exporting large volumes of oil to China. Prolonged fighting, along with the destruction of Palestinian homes and continued civilian casualties, increases the risk of broader regional conflict involving members of both alliances. Tensions are rising on the Israeli-Lebanese border, as exchanges between Israel and Hezbollah become more intense, heightening the danger of uncontrolled escalation. Houthi forces in Yemen have launched missiles and drones toward Israel, which have been intercepted by Israeli defenses or US naval forces in the Red Sea. Similarly, Iranian-backed Iraqi militias have attacked American military sites, leading to US retaliatory strikes in Syria. All parties assert a desire to contain the conflict, but escalation remains difficult to manage. The United States maintains strong support for Israel alongside Gulf states, Jordan, and Egypt. However, President Joe Biden and other American officials have voiced unease over the high number of Palestinian civilian deaths, with Secretary of State Antony Blinken openly criticizing Israeli actions. Meanwhile, America's Arab allies have condemned Israel’s campaign and demanded a ceasefire. The spectacle of Palestinians fleeing northern Gaza recalls the 1948 Nakba, when over 700,000 people were displaced during Israel’s independence war—a catastrophe that resonates deeply with today’s Gaza residents. Statements from far-right members of Netanyahu’s administration, hinting at possible mass expulsion or even use of nuclear weapons in Gaza, have raised alarm in neighboring states, particularly Jordan and Egypt. Although officially dismissed, such remarks exacerbate regional concerns about potential forced displacement of Palestinians. Western diplomats describe resolving the conflict and handling its aftermath as challenging and complicated. A renewed political process for Palestinians—reviving the idea of a two-state solution—has been suggested as the best route for peace, but deep distrust and ongoing suffering on both sides make this a difficult goal. Prospects for meaningful movement are slim while current leadership stands. Netanyahu opposes the return of the Palestinian Authority to Gaza and has consistently rejected the two-state solution, relying politically on factions advocating for all territory between the Jordan River and the Mediterranean to be part of Israel. Netanyahu also faces domestic criticism for perceived failures before the October 7 attack. On the Palestinian side, President Mahmoud Abbas, now in his late eighties and widely unpopular, has not held elections since 2005. The Palestinian Authority collaborates with Israel on West Bank security but struggles to protect its own people from violence by armed settlers. Without renewed efforts from Israel, the Palestinians, and their international allies to achieve peace after this devastating war, ongoing conflict appears likely. Change in both Israeli and Palestinian leaderships may be necessary for a lasting resolution.
translated_content: 従来のガザでの紛争とは異なり、今回は停戦が成立しておらず、暴力も大幅に増しています。10月7日、ハマスが主にイスラエルの民間人を標的に攻撃をしかけ、イスラエルは激しい軍事報復を行い、多くのパレスチナ民間人が犠牲となりました。 この対立は、イランとアメリカを軸とした諸国の間で地域的な亀裂が深まる中で発生しています。イランの影響はレバノンのヒズボラ、シリアのアサド政権、イエメンのフーシ派、イラクの複数の民兵組織まで及び、ハマスやイスラム聖戦への支援も続けています。また、イランはロシアや中国と関係を強化し、ウクライナ戦争に軍事支援を行い、中国へは多量の原油を輸出しています。 戦争が長引き、パレスチナの住宅破壊や民間人の犠牲が増えるにつれ、両陣営の更なる国家も巻き込む広域的な衝突に発展するリスクが高まっています。イスラエルとレバノン国境ではイスラエル軍とヒズボラの間で緊張が高まりつつあり、エスカレートする危険も増しています。イエメンのフーシ派はイスラエルへミサイルやドローンを発射し、これらはイスラエルや米海軍により迎撃されています。さらに、親イランのイラク民兵が米軍を攻撃し、米国もシリアで報復しています。各国は事態拡大を避けたい意向ですが、制御は容易ではありません。 アメリカは湾岸諸国、ヨルダン、エジプトとともにイスラエルを強く支持していますが、バイデン大統領や複数の高官はパレスチナ人の民間人犠牲に懸念を表明。ブリンケン国務長官もイスラエルを公然と批判しています。一方でアメリカのアラブ同盟国はイスラエルの軍事作戦を非難し、即時停戦を求めています。北ガザから避難したパレスチナ人の光景は、1948年のイスラエル独立戦争で70万人以上が家を追われた「ナクバ」と呼ばれる出来事を想起させ、その影響は今のガザにも色濃く残っています。 ネタニヤフ政権の一部極右閣僚によるパレスチナ人強制移住やガザへの核兵器行使の示唆は、ヨルダンやエジプトで大きな不安を招いています。公式には否定されていますが、こうした発言が地域の不信感を高めています。 西側外交官は、紛争の終結やその後の対応が極めて困難だと評価しています。パレスチナ国家樹立＝二国家解決案の再活性化が最善とされますが、双方の根深い不信と苦しみがハードルとなっています。現指導者のもとでは進展は困難とされ、ネタニヤフ首相はパレスチナ自治政府のガザ統治や二国家解決案には反対しており、ヨルダン川から地中海までの領有を唱える勢力の支援も受けています。10月7日前の安全上の重大な失敗も、国内で強く非難されています。 パレスチナ側ではアッバス大統領が高齢かつ支持率も低迷し、2005年以来選挙を行っていません。自治政府はヨルダン川西岸でイスラエルと治安協力していますが、入植者による自国民への暴力からは守れていません。 この戦争の後、イスラエル・パレスチナ双方とその同盟国が和解に本腰を入れなければ、今後も衝突が続く可能性が高いでしょう。恒久的な解決には双方の指導者交代も必要になりそうです。

Scientific evidence indicates that climate change is already worsening inequality and poverty, yet its localized, micro-level effects remain relatively understudied, particularly in low- and middle-income countries where vulnerable populations are most at risk. A new paper published in Environmental Research Letters explores the relationship between temperature, inequality, poverty, and welfare in South Africa at both national and sub-national levels. The study underscores not only the need for climate change adaptation but also highlights the co-benefits of decarbonization in reducing socioeconomic disparities among affected communities.

Conducted by a team from CMCC@Ca' Foscari—a partnership between the CMCC Foundation and Ca’ Foscari University of Venice—alongside researchers from RFF-CMCC European Institute on Economics and the Environment (EIEE) and the London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE), the study finds that the relationship between temperature, inequality, and poverty is non-linear. Inequality is lowest at moderate temperatures, but as temperatures rise above a threshold (15-17°C), the disparity between income groups widens, threatening the livelihoods of the most vulnerable.

This impact is especially pronounced among poorer segments, whose productivity and earnings decline with higher temperatures, whereas wealthier groups are less affected due to their greater adaptive capacity. Agricultural households are particularly susceptible to rising inequality as temperatures increase.

Projections using various warming scenarios predict that climate change will slow average economic growth and worsen inequality in the future. Under the moderate Representative Concentration Pathway scenario (RCP6.0) compared to a scenario without warming, the Gini coefficient—a measure of economic inequality—in South Africa could rise by 3 to 6 points by century’s end. When combined with the effect of warming on GDP (which could decrease by up to 43% by 2100), this could lead to a potential welfare loss of around 50%.

The authors warn that unless climate policies address inequality, they could inadvertently place a greater burden on disadvantaged groups. "Climate change not only increases inequality, but greater inequality also amplifies the societal impacts of climate change by increasing exposure and vulnerability. Without strong mitigation efforts, welfare and well-being may decline substantially," says Shouro Dasgupta, researcher at CMCC, Ca’ Foscari University of Venice, and Visiting Senior Fellow at the Grantham Research Institute on Climate Change and the Environment, LSE.

"Well-informed and community-specific adaptation policies can reduce the negative consequences of excessive warming and maximize the benefits of keeping temperature increases moderate," adds Soheil Shayegh, scientist at EIEE.

Johannes Emmerling, senior scientist at EIEE, concludes: "It is now widely accepted that climate change affects not just natural systems, but also economies. However, less is known about how these impacts are distributed across households. Our findings for South Africa show that poorer households are hit harder by global warming, resulting in increased inequality. Thus, climate mitigation is crucial not only for ecological and economic reasons but also from an inequality perspective."

科学的証拠によれば、気候変動はすでに不平等と貧困を悪化させていますが、その局所的・ミクロレベルでの影響は、特に脆弱な人々が最もリスクにさらされている低所得国や中所得国では、まだ十分に研究されていません。『Environmental Research Letters』に発表された新しい論文は、南アフリカにおける気温と不平等、貧困、福祉の関係を国・地域レベルで調査し、気候変動への適応の必要性だけでなく、脱炭素化が被害を受けるコミュニティにおける社会経済的格差を減らす共通の恩恵も強調しています。

この研究は、CMCC財団とヴェネツィア・カ・フォスカリ大学のパートナーシップであるCMCC@Ca' Foscariのチームと、RFF-CMCCヨーロッパ経済・環境研究所（EIEE）、ロンドン・スクール・オブ・エコノミクス（LSE）の研究者らによって行われました。研究によると、気温と不平等、貧困との関係は非線形であり、不平等は適度な気温で最も低く保たれていますが、気温が15〜17°Cを超えて上昇すると所得格差が拡大し、最も脆弱な人々の生活を脅かしています。

この影響は特に貧困層に顕著で、高温になるほど生産性と収入が低下します。一方、より裕福な層は適応能力が高いため、影響が比較的少ないです。農業世帯は特に、気温上昇による不平等拡大の影響を受けやすいことが示されています。

さまざまな温暖化シナリオによる予測では、気候変動は今後、平均経済成長を鈍化させ、不平等をさらに悪化させるとしています。中程度の代表濃度経路（RCP6.0）シナリオを気温上昇のない基準と比較した場合、今世紀末までに南アフリカのジニ係数（経済的不平等の尺度）は3～6ポイント上昇する可能性があります。さらに、気温上昇によりGDPが2100年までに最大43%減少するという影響と合わせると、約50%の福祉損失が想定されています。

著者らは、不平等に配慮しない気候政策は、結果的に社会的弱者への負担を増大させるおそれがあると警告しています。「気候変動は不平等を拡大させるだけでなく、不平等が高まることで社会の気候変動への曝露と脆弱性が増し、影響が強まります。強力な緩和策がなければ、人々の福祉や幸福は大きく低下しかねません」と、CMCC、ヴェネツィア・カ・フォスカリ大学の研究員でLSEのグランサム気候変動・環境研究所客員上級フェローのショウロ・ダスグプタ氏は述べています。

「十分な情報に基づいた、地域ごとの適応政策があれば、過度な気温上昇による悪影響を減少させ、気温上昇を適度に抑えることで得られる恩恵を最大化できます」とEIEEの科学者ソヘイル・シャイエグ氏は強調します。

EIEE上級科学者ヨハネス・エマリング氏は、「気候変動が生態系だけでなく経済にも影響することは広く認識されていますが、これらの影響が家庭ごとにどう分配されているかはあまり知られていません。南アフリカの調査では、最貧層が地球温暖化の影響を大きく受けており、それがさらなる不平等拡大に繋がっています。したがって、気候変動の緩和はエコロジカルや経済的観点だけでなく、不平等是正という観点からも極めて重要です」と結論づけています。

Manchester United supporters were left frustrated on Saturday evening when the club's official channel, MUTV, lost its signal during a pre-season friendly match against Roma, missing Wayne Rooney's goal. The live broadcast from Denver had been running smoothly until it suddenly cut out moments before halftime, with United leading 2-0 thanks to impressive goals by Wayne Rooney and Juan Mata.

Fans in the UK, who pay monthly for MUTV's subscription service, were left wondering what happened next after the picture was lost. During the outage, the channel missed the moment when Danny Welbeck was fouled to win a penalty. Manchester United's Twitter account explained the issue was caused by a power failure at the stadium, posting: 'We apologise for any loss of picture on MUTV. This is due to a power failure at the stadium in Denver.'

Rooney converted the subsequent penalty to give United a 3-0 lead at halftime. The broadcast problems continued during the break, allowing only limited halftime analysis before service resumed for the second half. The club's in-house media team issued a public apology to disappointed viewers.

article_content: Chinese tennis player Zheng Jie will miss this January’s Australian Open because she is still recovering from a wrist injury. The 27-year-old, currently ranked 26th in the world, hasn’t played since exiting in the second round of the U.S. Open in September. Announcing her withdrawal on Twitter, Zheng described the decision as difficult but expressed hope that she’ll return to future Australian Opens if she regains her health. Zheng’s best result at the Australian Open was reaching the semifinals in 2010, where she lost to Belgium’s Justine Henin, that year’s eventual runner-up. The tournament is special to her since she won one of her two Grand Slam doubles titles there in 2006. In 2008, Zheng became the first Chinese player to reach a Grand Slam singles semifinal, losing to Serena Williams at Wimbledon. She was the first Chinese woman ranked inside the world’s top 15 but is now surpassed by fellow Chinese player Li Na, who finished the 2010 season at No. 11 after performing strongly in Melbourne and winning a final on grass in England. The Australian Open, which is the first major tennis event of the season, will begin January 17 at Melbourne Park.

article_content: Shirley Onacilla, a 62-year-old pilot from Jersey City, narrowly escaped with minor injuries after her single-engine plane crashed in the woods of Clinton, Connecticut, on Saturday. While flying toward Orange County Airport in New York, Onacilla’s aircraft experienced engine failure. Air traffic control recommended she attempt to land at Chester Airport, but she was unable to reach it. The plane went down less than 100 feet from a nearby house, and a local homeowner who witnessed the crash immediately brought a ladder and alerted emergency responders. Onacilla, stuck in the plane about 10 feet up in a tree, was rescued by firefighters. She was taken to Middlesex Memorial Hospital for treatment but was released soon after with only minor cuts and bruises. Clinton police officer Sgt. Jeremiah Dunn remarked on her incredible luck, joking that she should consider buying a lottery ticket. Authorities, including the FAA and local police, continue to investigate the crash.

article_content: HTC Vive has unveiled a new virtual reality tracker specifically designed for standalone VR headsets like the Vive XR Elite and Vive Focus 3. Previously, HTC's VR division has produced base stations and motion-tracking hardware necessary for most PC VR headsets. In VR systems, head motion is typically detected by sensors in the headset, while hand positions are tracked by the controllers. However, body tracking—such as the position of feet and hips—has been lacking, limiting avatar movement and realism. HTC has a history of making trackers and base stations, but even top VR headsets often lack full body tracking. The HTC Vive tracking system allows users to animate avatars and provides a cost-effective motion tracking solution for developers. Stand-alone headsets usually don’t use base stations, making body tracking more challenging. While machine learning can estimate leg positions based on head and hand movement, as Meta does for Quest avatar legs, this method is not always accurate. HTC's new Vive Ultimate Trackers are portable, wireless, and do not require base stations. Up to five can be used at once to enable body tracking almost anywhere. HTC claims these self-tracking devices last up to seven hours and can function up to 10 meters away from the included wireless dongle. While most users may not need such a long range, it could be useful for sports training and motion capture. Each tracker includes a standard 1/4-inch mount—common to cameras—and can be attached to the wrists and ankles via TrackStraps. The new Vive Ultimate Trackers will be compatible with SteamVR and OpenXR VR headsets in the future. HTC also announced that VRChat is coming to the XR Elite and the trackers will support avatar animation. However, HTC has not confirmed if they will be compatible with Meta Quest and Pico headsets in standalone mode. A set of three Vive Ultimate Trackers, a wireless dongle, three TrackStraps (for waist and ankles), and a Dash Dance download key retail for $599, with Vive XR Elite owners receiving a $100 discount through the end of 2023. Individual trackers are priced at $199 but don’t include the wireless dongle. More information and ordering options are available on HTC's Vive website.

article_content: Donny Moore watches at least part of every NFL game each week—a task that's part of his job. Although many may not know his name, NFL players and fans certainly do. As the ratings czar for EA Sports’ Madden NFL video game franchise, Moore is responsible for determining the numerical player ratings—ranging from 1 to 100—that define how skilled players are in specific aspects of the game. Players like Seahawks cornerback Richard Sherman and Cowboys wide receiver Dez Bryant often interact with Moore on social media, giving feedback and inquiring about their ratings. 'They always want to know ahead of time: What have you got me at?' Moore says. It's a unique challenge. While some video games simulate weapons or vehicles, sports games like Madden require the creators to assess and recreate real athletes as digital avatars. Unsurprisingly, this often leads to debate—not just among the NFL players themselves, but also among the most dedicated Madden fans. By most accounts, Moore and his EA Sports team do a thorough job. 'EA is not just pulling numbers from a hat,' says T.J. Lauerman, host of That Sports Gamer Show. 'Gamers are passionate about their teams’ ratings. If they see their team's running back perform an amazing play, but the player’s rating doesn’t reflect that in-game, they might reach out to Donny Moore for answers.' Moore takes fan passion in stride. 'If you’re a Falcons fan upset about some players being underrated, we might be doing our job right,' he notes. 'Everyone can't be rated 99.' Moore uses a wide array of data—from on-field stats and scouting combine results to injury reports—to inform his ratings. Online resources also break down statistics into detailed categories, like 'downfield passing completion percentage.' Even so, watching the games reveals intangibles that stats sometimes miss. A key improvement over earlier versions of Madden is the ability to update player ratings each week. This feature allowed Moore to adjust the rating of Alfred Morris, who went from lightly regarded rookie to amassing 1,613 yards and 13 touchdowns for Washington in one season. Morris began Madden with a 65 rating, which climbed to 89 by year’s end. 'We were wrong about him to begin with, but so was the whole league,' Moore admits. Fan and player feedback also shapes ratings. Moore sometimes asks fans to name not just players they think deserve higher ratings, but also those who should go lower, yielding useful insights. He finds it especially entertaining when players themselves contest more humorous aspects of their ratings—such as when Jets defensive back Kerry Rhodes compared his throwing stats to teammate Nick Mangold, leading to a lighthearted video and a small rating adjustment. These stories highlight the scrutiny Madden NFL receives. Moore, who began at EA in 1999 after winning a college football video game tournament, takes his work seriously. 'I take a lot of pride in making the game as close to real-life as possible,' he says. 'I just want to get it right.' CNN contributor Larry Frum contributed to this report.
translated_content: ドニー・ムーアは毎週、少なくともNFLの試合を一部見ています。これは彼の仕事の一部です。彼の名前を知らない人もいるかもしれませんが、NFL選手やファンにはよく知られています。EAスポーツの『Madden NFL』ビデオゲームシリーズでレーティング責任者（レーティング・ツァー）を務めるムーアは、選手の技術を1から100までの数値で評価し、その数値を決める役割を持っています。 シーホークスのコーナーバック、リチャード・シャーマンやカウボーイズのワイドレシーバー、デズ・ブライアントといった選手たちは、SNSでムーアとよく交流し、自分の評価について意見を伝えたり質問したりしています。ムーアは『みんな事前に“俺は何点なんだ？”と知りたがる』と語っています。 これは特別な仕事です。武器や乗り物を再現するゲームもありますが、『Madden』のようなスポーツゲームは、実在するアスリートをデジタルキャラクターとして評価し直す必要があります。当然、これはNFL選手だけでなく、熱心なMaddenファンの間でも議論を呼びます。 多くの人の意見では、ムーアとEAスポーツのチームは丁寧に仕事をしているとされています。『EAは適当に数字を決めているわけではありません』とThat Sports Gamer Showのホスト、T.J.ラウアーマンは言います。『ファンは自分のチームの評価に敏感です。選手がすごいプレーをしたのにゲーム内の評価が違えば、ムーアに問い合わせしたくなるんです』 ムーアはファンの情熱を受け止めています。『もしファルコンズファンが自チームの評価に不満なら、それは私たちがちゃんと仕事をしている証拠かもしれません。みんなが99にはなれないですから』と話します。 ムーアは、現実の成績やスカウティングコンバインの記録、怪我のレポートなど、さまざまなデータを活用しています。ネット上でも“ダウンフィールドパス成功率”のような細かいデータが議論されていますが、自分の目でプレーを見ることで、数字に表れない選手の特徴もつかめるそうです。 過去のMaddenと違い、今は毎週選手の評価をアップデートできるのが大きな進化です。この機能でムーアは、ワシントンのアルフレッド・モリスの評価をシーズン初めの65から、1,613ヤード獲得・13タッチダウンの活躍を経てシーズン終わりには89にまで上げました。『最初はモリスの評価を誤っていましたが、それはリーグ全体も同じでした』とムーアは認めています。 ファンや選手からのフィードバックも評価に反映されます。ムーアはファンに『上げたい選手だけでなく下げてもいい選手も教えて』と頼むこともあり、それが貴重な意見になるそうです。評価で面白いのは、選手自身からのユーモラスな抗議で、例えばジェッツのDB、ケリー・ローズが投球力の数値に不満を持ち、ニック・マンゴールドと比較した動画を投稿し、少し評価が修正される出来事もありました。 こうした話からも、『Madden NFL』というゲームがいかに注目されているかが分かります。ムーアは1999年、大学フットボールゲーム大会での優勝をきっかけにEAで働き始め、以来ずっと本気でこの仕事に取り組んでいます。『ゲームを現実に近づけることに誇りを持っています。本当に正しいものを作りたいんです』と語っています。 このレポートにはCNN寄稿者のラリー・フラムも協力しました。

article_content: Over the past five months, Manipur has experienced severe ethnic violence, resulting in more than 170 deaths. Chief Minister N Biren Singh has faced criticism for how he handled the situation, with the government sometimes appearing slow to act and, at times, partisan. As communities fled their homes, Singh has now stated that rebuilding trust among Manipur’s ethnic groups is a priority. In a recent interview, Singh said his ‘top priority is to initiate dialogue with all affected communities, including the Kukis and Meiteis,’ and highlighted efforts to ‘resettle displaced people’ and ‘rebuild damaged homes.’ He stated, ‘I want my people to feel confident and secure.’ In the coming weeks, Singh will be tested on delivering these promises. However, Singh continues to blame much of the crisis on ‘illegal migrants’ and Manipur’s ‘outsider’ issue. The state’s complex mix of cultures, religions, and ethnic groups, along with historical landholding patterns and colonial policies separating tribal hill areas from the Meitei-majority Imphal Valley, further complicates matters. While Singh acknowledges the state’s drug addiction problem, he blames unrest on drug mafias exploiting vulnerable areas. Although police action against drug dealers has increased, there is a need for broader measures to improve economic opportunities in a state that had the region’s lowest per capita income in 2021-22, after having the highest in the 1990s. Singh has also linked poppy cultivation to 'illegal migrants' from across the Myanmar border, who share ethnic ties with local hill communities. In September, Singh requested the Central Government revoke the Free Movement Regime (FMR), which lets people near the India-Myanmar border travel 16 km into either country without documents. Experts suggest regulating, not eliminating, cross-border movement due to its economic impact. Singh’s focus on outsiders does little to reassure hill tribes that his government is above identity politics, which have already pushed Manipur to a tipping point. Restoring trust in Manipur needs coordinated economic, social, political, and administrative action. The state government faces urgent and complex challenges.
translated_content: 過去5か月間、マニプールでは深刻な民族間暴力が発生し、170人以上が命を落としました。N・ビレン・シン首相は対応の遅さや、時に偏った対応について批判されています。コミュニティが家を離れる中、シン首相はマニプールの民族グループ間の信頼回復が最優先だと語り、最近のインタビューでは「クキ族やメイテイ族を含むすべての影響を受けたコミュニティとの対話が最優先」と述べています。また、「避難民の再定住」や「被害を受けた家屋の再建」にも取り組んでいることを強調し、「人々が安心して暮らせるようにしたい」と語っています。今後数週間、こうした言葉を実行できるかが問われます。しかしシン首相は、危機の主要因を「不法移民」や「外部の人々」に求め続けています。マニプールは多様な文化・宗教・民族が混在し、土地所有の歴史や、先住部族地域とメイテイ族が多いインパール渓谷を分断した植民地時代の政策が状況を複雑にしています。シン首相は薬物中毒問題を認めつつも、周辺地域の脆弱な層を狙った麻薬組織が混乱を引き起こしたと指摘。しかし麻薬取引の取り締まり強化だけでなく、経済的な機会の拡充も必要だとされています。マニプールは1990年代は一人当たり所得が最高だったものの、2021～22年には北東部で最低に。加えて、シン首相はポピー栽培の問題をミャンマー国境を越えた共通民族の「不法移民」に関連づけています。9月には、インド・ミャンマー国境に居住する人々が両国間を書類なしで16kmまで行き来できる「自由移動制度（FMR）」の撤廃を中央政府に要請しました。専門家は、貿易をはじめ経済への影響も考慮し、FMRの規制は必要だが完全な封鎖は慎重にすべきと述べています。シン首相が「外部の人々」への言及を続けることは、州政府がすでにアイデンティティ政治に追い詰められている山間部部族に安心感を与えるものではありません。マニプールの信頼回復には経済・社会・政治・行政の総合的な対策が不可欠であり、州政府は喫緊かつ困難な課題に直面しています。

article_content: Airbus has announced its readiness to help fund a possible third search in the Atlantic for Air France Flight 447 wreckage if ongoing efforts fail. The disaster happened on June 1, resulting in the deaths of all 228 passengers and crew—Air France’s worst tragedy to date. While the exact amount is not yet confirmed, company representative Stefan Schaffrath stated Airbus could contribute between 12 and 20 million euros ($17-28 million), if necessary. Driven by a pressing need to determine the cause, Airbus is working closely with Air France and the BEA, France’s accident investigation agency, in the current search phase. This new search began after signals from the flight recorders’ locator beacons—which only transmit for 30 days—were lost. Teams are now employing advanced underwater vehicles and lateral sonar technology to inspect the seabed, aiming to locate the plane’s flight data and cockpit voice recorders. Recovered wreckage has been sent to France for analysis. Of the 228 people on board the ill-fated flight from Rio de Janeiro to Paris, only 51 bodies have been found. Investigators remain committed to finding answers in hopes of making aviation safer in the future.
translated_content: エアバスは、大西洋上で行われているエールフランス447便の残骸捜索が実らなかった場合、三度目の捜索へ資金を提供する準備があると発表しました。この事故は6月1日に発生し、乗員・乗客228人全員が犠牲となり、エールフランス史上最悪の悲劇となりました。正確な金額はまだ決まっていませんが、エアバスの広報担当ステファン・シャフラス氏は、必要に応じて1,200万〜2,000万ユーロ（約17億〜28億円）の拠出を検討していると述べました。 事故原因の解明という強い使命感から、エアバスは現在進められている捜索でエールフランスやフランス航空事故調査局（BEA）と密接に協力しています。新たな捜索は、フライトレコーダーの発信器が（墜落後30日間のみ発信）停止した後に始まりました。チームは最新の水中探査機や側方ソナーを使い、海底でフライトデータレコーダーとコックピットボイスレコーダーの発見を目指しています。 回収された機体の一部は分析のためフランスへ運ばれています。リオデジャネイロ発パリ行きだったこの飛行機には228人が搭乗していましたが、これまでに発見された遺体は51体に留まっています。調査担当者らは記録装置を見つけて事故原因を明らかにし、航空の安全向上に役立てることを目標としています。
post_content: Airbus is ready to back a third search for Air France 447 if needed. Only 51 out of 228 victims found so far. Everyone’s hoping to find the black boxes and boost flight safety. #AirFrance447 #AviationSafety #NeverGiveUp

article_content: Dozens of starlings were found dead on a busy road near Bolton in a mysterious incident that some witnesses compared to 'The X-Files.' Around 30 dead birds were discovered on Sunday afternoon, sparking speculation about the cause. Locals reported hearing a loud bang shortly before the incident, suggesting the starlings may have been struck by a vehicle while flying low over the road. The Royal Society for the Protection of Birds (RSPB) stated that starlings, which typically travel in tight flocks, could have become dazzled or confused, causing them to fly into a vehicle. While contact with toxic air is another possibility, the RSPB considers it less likely. An RSPB spokesperson commented: "There have been previous reports of groups of dead starlings where the exact cause was never determined. The most probable reason is that the birds became confused and collided with something, or were briefly dazzled. It's also possible a lorry hit them at speed while they were flying low, as starlings often do." A similar event occurred in 2010, when dozens of starlings fell from the sky into the garden of nurse Jackie Wright in Coxley, Somerset. By the time she returned home, around 100 birds had been found dead on the lawn. At that time, experts suggested the birds may have been startled by a bird of prey and suddenly changed direction. "A man told us he'd heard a loud bang and then found these birds outside," said local resident Craig Clarkson. "It was very strange, like something out of 'The X-Files.'" Another local visitor, Kayleigh Knott, said: "I've heard of similar incidents before and they often remain unexplained. This is very unusual and people are eager to understand why it happened."
translated_content: 数十羽のムクドリがボルトン近郊の幹線道路で死んでいるのが発見されました。この不可解な出来事は、一部の目撃者から「Xファイル」のようだと例えられています。日曜日の午後に約30羽の死骸が見つかり、その原因について様々な憶測が飛び交いました。 地元住民は事件直前に大きな音を聞いたと報告しており、ムクドリたちが道路を低く飛んでいた際、車両にぶつかった可能性が示唆されています。 英国王立鳥類保護協会（RSPB）は、ムクドリが群れで飛ぶため、まぶしさや混乱で車両に衝突した可能性を指摘しています。有毒な空気との接触も考えられますが、その可能性は低いとしています。 RSPBの広報担当者は「以前にもムクドリが集団で死んでいるのが発見されたことがありますが、正確な原因が特定されない場合がよくあります。最も考えられるのは、鳥が混乱して何かに衝突したか、一時的に眩しかったことです。ムクドリは低空飛行するため、スピードの出たトラックに当たった可能性もあります」とコメントしました。 同様の出来事は2010年にも発生しており、サマセット州コクスリーで看護師ジャッキー・ライトさんの庭にムクドリが空から落ちてきました。帰宅時には約100羽が芝生で死んでおり、その際も猛禽類に驚いて急に方向を変えたと専門家が推測しています。 地元住民のクレイグ・クラークソンさんは「ある男性が大きな音を聞いた後、この鳥たちを見つけたと言っていました。本当に奇妙で、『Xファイル』のようでした」と話しています。 近隣を訪れていたケイリー・ノットさんは「以前にもこういうことがあったと聞いたことがありますが、原因がわからないままのことが多いです。本当に珍しくて、みんななぜ起きたのか知りたいと思っています」とコメントしました。
post_content: Mysterious case in Bolton! Dozens of starlings found dead on the road, locals baffled after hearing a loud bang. RSPB says a vehicle collision is likely, but the incident remains unexplained! 🐦🧐 #BirdMystery #Bolton

article_content: Carmen Jorda has been appointed as a development driver for Lotus F1, becoming the second woman to hold a Formula One backup role after Susie Wolff of Williams. Jorda, 26, is the daughter of former driver Jose Miguel Jorda and has been racing professionally for over a decade, including competing in last year’s GP3 feeder series. She will work with Lotus for a year, participating in their simulator program, attending Grands Prix, and joining testing sessions. Like Wolff, who advanced from a similar position to a test driver at Williams earlier this year, Jorda could have the opportunity to drive an F1 car herself. 'It feels like a dream come true to join the Lotus F1 Team,' said the Spanish driver. 'I’ve been racing since I was 10, and driving a Formula 1 car has always been my dream. Joining Lotus F1 is a huge step toward my goal. I’ll work to improve myself as a driver and help the team develop the car by testing updates in the simulator. It’s a fantastic opportunity.' Jorda tweeted her excitement about becoming Lotus F1’s development driver and posed next to the team’s car, which she will help develop via the simulator program. She added, 'I know this is just the beginning and the biggest challenge is yet to come, but already being part of such a historic team is a real honor. This achievement is a great milestone and will open the door to bigger and better things.' Lotus F1 CEO Matthew Carter said, 'We are pleased to announce Carmen Jorda as a Development Driver for Lotus F1 Team. We look forward to working with her through the season and eventually seeing her behind the wheel. Carmen will bring a new perspective to the team, and she’ll have extensive time at our advanced simulation facility in Enstone. She’s a valuable addition, and we look forward to her insights and contributions to the development of the E23 Hybrid.' Jorda spoke to the media following her year-long deal with Lotus F1.
translated_content: カルメン・ジョルダがロータスF1の開発ドライバーに就任し、ウィリアムズのスージー・ウルフに次ぐF1のバックアップ役職に就く2人目の女性となりました。 26歳のジョルダは元ドライバーのホセ・ミゲル・ジョルダの娘で、10年以上のプロレーサー経験があり、昨年はGP3フィーダーシリーズにも参戦しました。 彼女は1年間ロータスのシミュレータープログラムに参加し、グランプリやテストにも出席する予定です。 同じく今年ウィリアムズで同様のポジションからテストドライバーに昇進したウルフのように、ジョルダもF1カーを実際に運転するチャンスがあるかもしれません。 「ロータスF1チームに加われて夢のようです」とスペイン人ドライバーのジョルダは語りました。「10歳からレースをしていて、F1カーを運転するのはずっと夢でした。ロータスF1への加入は私の目標への大きな一歩です。ドライバーとして成長しつつ、シミュレーターでの開発テストを通じてチームの車両開発にも協力します。本当に素晴らしい機会です」 ジョルダはロータスF1の開発ドライバー就任の喜びをツイートし、今後はシミュレータープログラムを通じてチームのマシン開発に関わることを、チームカーの横で写真に収まりながら伝えました。 彼女はさらに「これは始まりに過ぎず、これからが本当のチャレンジですが、歴史あるチームの一員になれたことを大変光栄に思います。この達成は大きな節目であり、もっと大きなチャンスにつながると思います」とも語りました。 ロータスF1のCEOマシュー・カーターは「カルメン・ジョルダを開発ドライバーとして迎えることを嬉しく思います。今シーズンを通じて彼女と一緒に仕事をし、最終的には実際にマシンをドライブする姿を見るのを楽しみにしています。カルメンは新しい視点をもたらしてくれますし、エンストンの最先端シミュレーション施設で多くの時間を過ごすでしょう。彼女はチームにとって非常に貴重な存在であり、E23ハイブリッドの開発における知見や貢献にも期待しています」とコメントしました。 ジョルダは1年契約でロータスF1に加入し、メディアにも意気込みを語りました。

article_content: Three million Time Warner Cable customers in cities including New York, Los Angeles, and Dallas have been without access to CBS since Friday due to a dispute over retransmission fees. This blackout could cause viewers to miss major events, such as Tiger Woods at the Bridgestone Invitational. Time Warner Cable states that CBS is demanding higher fees than other broadcasters. CBS asserts it has never before been dropped by a cable provider and has reached agreements with others such as AT&T, Cablevision, Comcast, DirecTV, and Verizon. Both companies are making their cases public through newspaper ads and viewer notifications. On Sunday, Time Warner Cable spokeswoman Maureen Huff said talks are ongoing, while CBS declined to comment on negotiations. The blackout affects local CBS stations in large cities, and about 2.5 million customers have also lost access to CBS-owned channels like Showtime, TMC, FLIX, and Smithsonian. Time Warner Cable advised viewers to use antennas to watch CBS over the air and is temporarily substituting Starz Kids and Family programming. The core dispute involves rising retransmission fees. Analysts explain that networks like CBS are increasing these fees to reduce advertising dependence, while providers like Time Warner Cable warn that higher fees could raise customers' bills. SNL Kagan estimates that retransmission fees may reach $3 billion industry-wide in 2013 and could double by 2018, with mergers among broadcast groups possibly pushing fees even higher. Time Warner Cable recently lost 191,000 subscribers, ending the quarter with 11.7 million. Despite the ongoing dispute, both companies reported strong quarterly earnings: Time Warner Cable’s net income rose six percent to $481 million, and CBS’s net income increased eleven percent to $472 million, helped by retransmission fees. Analysts expect the issue to be resolved soon to prevent further customer impact, especially ahead of the PGA Championship and pre-season NFL games on CBS.

article_content:
Chelsea have secured the £10.5 million signing of Loic Remy from West London rivals QPR, with the striker agreeing to a four-year contract. Remy's representatives were already in discussions with Chelsea, and the deal was advanced before Arsenal made a late attempt to sign him. The former Marseille forward told Chelsea's website: 'I feel very happy and very proud. When I heard Chelsea wanted me, I said "let's go" because they are one of the best clubs in the world.'

Remy joins Chelsea after they met his buyout clause. Speaking about his transfer, Remy said: 'I remember the amazing atmosphere at Stamford Bridge when I played there for Marseille, and I can't wait to play for my new fans. I want to progress as a player and win titles. Chelsea already have strong strikers, so I know I need to perform at the highest level.'

Chelsea acted quickly after Fernando Torres agreed to a two-year loan move to AC Milan, opening up space in the squad. Both Chelsea and Arsenal matched the £8 million release clause in Remy's contract, but Chelsea's deal progressed further after talks began on Friday. Arsenal made a late check on Remy's status ahead of the transfer deadline but were informed the move to Chelsea was almost complete.

Sources at Arsenal's Emirates Stadium indicate that manager Arsene Wenger believes his squad can cope without Olivier Giroud and that a new striker signing is unlikely before the transfer window closes. Arsenal remains interested in Sporting Lisbon midfielder William Carvalho.

Remy, who will join the French national team for upcoming matches against Spain and Switzerland, scored 14 goals in 26 league appearances for Newcastle United during a previous loan spell. His versatility will offer Chelsea options both as a central striker and in wide positions.

article_content: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella condemned the recent Hamas attacks on Israeli civilians and addressed anti-Israel demonstrations at American universities during an interview with Axel Springer, Insider's parent company, on Tuesday. "There was a terrorist attack by Hamas on innocent citizens of Israel, and that has to be condemned in the strongest possible ways," Nadella told Axel Springer CEO Mathias Döpfner. "Our hearts go out to them, and there should be no ambiguity. There is no room for violence of that nature." Nadella was responding to a question from Döpfner about the attacks by the Palestinian militant group and subsequent reactions at universities, such as Harvard, where some student groups placed sole responsibility on Israel. Döpfner asked, "What is your reaction to certain demonstrations in American universities, and also here in Europe, where people are celebrating Hamas' attack on Israel and the killing of children?" Earlier this month, more than 30 Harvard student organizations issued a statement holding the Israeli government "entirely responsible for all unfolding violence." At Yale, an online petition called for the removal of a professor who appeared to celebrate Hamas' attacks on social media. Likewise, a lecturer at Stanford was suspended after allegedly singling out Jewish students and calling them "colonizers." Nadella also discussed how businesses should approach complex geopolitical issues, saying companies must balance their business interests and shareholder value with their impact on the wider world. "We live in the real world," Nadella said. "We are an American company, but also a multinational. We have responsibilities to the values of our country of origin and to the countries we serve, and we need to navigate and stand up for them." Nadella was interviewed by Döpfner in Berlin on Tuesday while receiving the Axel Springer Award, which recognizes outstanding individuals for innovation, transforming markets, shaping culture, and social responsibility.

article_content: Ajay Srivastava, CEO of Dimensions Corporate Finance Services, highlights that today’s Indian stock market is largely influenced by momentum investing, emerging themes, and government expenditure. As a result, identifying genuine value stocks has become increasingly difficult. With price-to-earnings ratios often in the high 20s, Srivastava says traditional value investing is yielding little success, especially outside the banking sector. Although the market overall has performed better than anticipated this year, Srivastava points out that investors in largecap and banking funds have generally been let down, while midcap and smallcap stocks have delivered stronger returns. He notes that a significant portion of retail investors, who mainly invest in largecaps, have experienced unsatisfactory results—a pattern that may repeat in the future. Srivastava categorizes the market into top performers, moderate performers, and poor performers, placing largecaps among the most disappointing. He reiterates that Indian stocks are generally expensive and that value opportunities are most evident in select public sector units (PSUs) such as those in metals, power utilities, and transmission—excluding refining companies, which he regards as unpredictable due to heavy government involvement. Looking ahead, Srivastava suggests that investors should heavily consider new-economy technology companies, particularly those that have recently gone public. He praises these businesses for their rapid growth, digital models, and quasi-monopolistic positions in fields like payment services, online delivery, digital advertising, and defense. Finally, Srivastava warns against relying on established players like HDFC Bank, observing that fewer regulatory barriers have exposed the challenges facing traditional banks, including poor service and subpar returns. He recommends that investors revitalize their portfolios, replacing outdated holdings with newer, faster-growing companies to benefit from India’s vibrant IPO scene and evolving market opportunities.

article_content:
At Australia's Hologram Zoo, visitors can dodge stampeding elephants, peer into the open jaws of a hippopotamus, and pat friendly giraffes—all thanks to holography. Opened earlier this year, the zoo features 50 lifelike displays, from dinosaurs to gorillas, all crafted with advanced laser technology. Bruce Dell, CEO of Axiom Holographics and the zoo's creator, calls it the world's most futuristic animal theme park, using never-before-seen technology.

'People laugh, scream, and when the 30-metre whale passes by, everyone is silent in awe,' Dell told the BBC. The zoo uses digital projections and laser light to trick the brain, making guests see animals in 3D as they walk around them. Visitors can even reach out to 'pat' a lion made of light.

New depth technology makes the holographic animals appear impressively large. Special sunglasses and a tracking device provide a personalized experience for each guest, and sensory tech lets visitors smell flowers and trees in the zoo.

Axiom Holographics’ technology—developed in Queensland, near Brisbane—has also attracted attention from major companies. Dell says they have contracts with Airbus and Honeywell, and built a hologram aquarium for a luxury hotel in the Maldives owned by Bill Gates. The company aims to make holograms more affordable by producing their components in-house. 'Holograms used to be expensive, but we've made algorithms that lower computing needs from ten computers to just one,' Dell explained.

Meanwhile, researchers at the Australian National University (ANU) are advancing holographic science through meta-optics and nano-photonics, enabling miniaturized devices and new ways to manipulate light. Professor Dragomir Neshev from ANU's Research School of Physics believes these advancements could enable innovations like night-vision glasses, medical imaging, and more.

At Queensland University of Technology (QUT), holograms are used in theater and mental health interventions. The play 'Alex' merges live acting with holographic images on a transparent screen called Hologauze, with motion-capture animation, offering a unique immersive experience—no headsets needed. Dr. Shane Pike from QUT says the play serves both as entertainment and as a clinical intervention for people with eating disorders.

Recently, Bruce Dell curated a hologram dinosaur show at the Australian Museum in Sydney. He envisions a future full of holograms, from floating food at fast food restaurants to virtual 3D jewelry displays. 'We’re about to enter the hologram revolution, just like previous technology shifts,' he predicts.

オーストラリアのホログラム動物園では、来場者がスタンピードするゾウを避けたり、カバの大きな口の中を覗いたり、フレンドリーなキリンをなでたりできます—すべてはホログラフィーの力です。今年初めにオープンしたこの動物園は、恐竜からゴリラまで50種類のリアルな展示を備えており、最先端のレーザー技術で作られています。Axiom HolographicsのCEOで動物園の創設者ブルース・デル氏は、「今まで見たことのない技術を使った世界で最も未来的な動物テーマパーク」と語ります。

「みんな笑ったり叫んだりして、30メートルのクジラが通ると全員が静かに見とれるんです」とデル氏はBBCに話しました。デジタルプロジェクションとレーザーで脳をだまし、来場者が動物の周りを歩くと3Dで見える仕組みです。光のライオンをなでることもできます。

新開発のデプス技術でホログラム動物はとても大きく見え、専用サングラスとトラッキング装置で体験は一人ひとりに合わせて最適化されます。さらに、センサー技術によって花や木の香りも楽しめます。

ブリスベン近郊クイーンズランド州で開発されたAxiom Holographicsの技術は大手企業から注目されています。デル氏によれば、同社はエアバスやハネウェルと契約、ビル・ゲイツ氏所有のモルディブ高級ホテルのホログラム水族館も制作。部品を自社製造することでコストも抑え、手頃な価格でホログラムを提供しています。「以前はホログラムは高額でしたが、当社はアルゴリズムを開発して必要なコンピュータ台数を10台から1台へと減らすことに成功しました」とデル氏は説明しました。

その一方、オーストラリア国立大学（ANU）でもメタオプティクスやナノフォトニクス研究が進められ、光の新たな制御やデバイスの小型化に取り組んでいます。ANU物理学研究科のドラゴミール・ネシェフ教授は、これにより暗視眼鏡や医療イメージングなど革新的な技術が生まれると期待しています。

クイーンズランド工科大学（QUT）では、ホログラムが演劇やメンタルヘルス支援にも活用されています。舞台「アレックス」は透明スクリーン「ホログーゼ」とモーションキャプチャーで、ライブ俳優とホログラムが共演する没入体験をヘッドセット不要で実現。QUTのシェーン・パイク博士は、この作品がエンターテインメント性だけでなく、摂食障害の臨床介入としても機能していると述べています。

最近デル氏はシドニーのオーストラリア博物館でホログラム恐竜ショーもプロデュース。彼は「ファストフード店の空中バーガーから3D宝石ディスプレイまでホログラムだらけの未来」を予想し、「今まさにホログラム革命が始まろうとしている」と語っています。

article_content: This month has been a standout for fans of classic Square Enix RPGs. On November 2, Gemdrops and Square Enix released an HD-2D remake of Star Ocean: The Second Story R, the cult PS1 favorite. Soon after, ArtePiazza and Nintendo launched their updated Super Mario RPG for the SNES on November 17. Both titles, seldom re-released before, have finally received dramatic visual upgrades long awaited by longtime and new players alike. In recent years, Square Enix has also revived lesser-known gems like Live A Live, The World Ends With You, and Valkyrie Profile. However, many other renowned RPGs still remain exclusive to older consoles. At minimum, these classics deserve a re-release, ideally through channels like the PS Plus Game Catalog’s retro library. If the remake wave continues, these five games should be next in line. Topping the list is Chrono Trigger. It’s surprising this iconic RPG isn’t available on current-generation consoles; today’s players must settle for lackluster PC or mobile versions, or rely on emulation. Chrono Trigger’s influence on the genre is enormous, so a modern update is overdue. Square Enix could pursue a variety of remake styles—HD-2D, a remaster similar to Chrono Cross, or a full remake like Trials of Mana—and any would likely find a broad audience. Parasite Eve is another series that merits a revival. This PlayStation-era horror RPG, inactive since The 3rd Birthday, stands out for fusing survival horror with RPG mechanics. Revamping the original game—perhaps using a remake style inspired by Resident Evil 4 while preserving its RPG roots—could bring its unique experience to modern audiences. Drakengard, created by Yoko Taro before his success with NieR, is notable for its unconventional gameplay and storytelling. While it can be challenging to play today, a remaster or remake of the first Drakengard that improves gameplay but keeps its quirky charm could open it up to new fans, especially now that the NieR series is well known. Xenogears, Monolith Soft’s groundbreaking PlayStation RPG and precursor to the Xenoblade franchise, has received little attention from Square Enix lately, with only rare references or cameos. There’s hope for a new re-release on modern platforms this year, but an ambitious remake—possibly in collaboration with Nintendo and Monolith Soft—would allow a new generation of gamers to experience its complex narrative. Lastly, Terranigma is an SNES RPG originally published by Enix. It offers unique, Zelda-like gameplay and deserves more recognition, but has been difficult to re-release due to rights issues. An HD-2D remake, as with Live A Live, could finally bring this hidden gem into the spotlight for today’s players.
translated_content: 今月はクラシックなスクウェア・エニックスRPGファンにとって特別な月でした。11月2日、Gemdropsとスクウェア・エニックスはPS1の名作『スターオーシャンセカンドストーリーR』をHD-2Dでリメイクして発売。その直後、ArtePiazzaと任天堂がスーパーファミコンの人気作『スーパーマリオRPG』のリメイクを11月17日にリリースしました。いずれの作品もこれまで再リリースが少なく、ファン待望の大幅なビジュアル向上が実現した形です。 近年、スクウェア・エニックスは『ライブアライブ』『すばらしきこのせかい』『ヴァルキリープロファイル』なども復活させていますが、他にも名作RPGが旧機種に眠ったままです。せめてPS Plusのクラシックコレクションのようなサービスで再リリースしてほしいところ。リメイクの流れが続くなら、次はこの5作品が選ばれてほしいです。 まず挙げたいのは『クロノ・トリガー』。現行機で遊べないのは意外で、今は完成度が低いPC・スマホ版かエミュレータしか選択肢がありません。RPG界に多大な影響を与えたこのタイトルこそ、HD-2Dや『クロノ・クロス』式リマスター、『聖剣伝説3』のようなリメイクなど、どんな形でも現代的なアップグレードがふさわしいでしょう。 『パラサイト・イヴ』も復活にふさわしい作品です。PlayStation時代に登場し、以降『ザ・サード・バースデイ』を最後にシリーズ展開が止まっています。サバイバルホラーとRPGの融合という独自性が今なお魅力的。オリジナルのリメイクなら『バイオハザード4』のような雰囲気も取り入れつつ、RPG要素を活かして再構築できると思います。 『ニーア』シリーズで知られるヨコオタロウ氏が手掛けた『ドラッグオンドラグーン』も外せません。奇抜なゲーム性と物語の魅力は大きいですが、今では遊びづらい面もあります。ゲームプレイを改善した良質なリマスターやリメイクがあれば、新しいファン獲得に繋がるでしょう。『ニーア』人気の今こそ再評価されるべきです。 モノリスソフトがデビュー作として世に送り出したPS時代の傑作『ゼノギアス』もスクウェア・エニックスによる扱いは控えめ。コラボやカメオがある程度ですが、今年には現行のPlayStationやNintendoハードで再リリース予定です。もし任天堂やモノリスと協力した本格的なリメイクがあれば、その壮大な物語が改めて多くの人に届けられそうです。 最後は、エニックス発のSFC用RPG『テラニグマ』です。『ゼルダ』ライクな独特のアクションRPGで、版権問題がリイシューを難しくしていますが、『ライブアライブ』のようなHD-2Dリメイク化が実現すれば、長年埋もれていた名作が再び脚光を浴びると思います。
