article_content: Kabiru Aliyu, a chieftain of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) in Sokoto State, has called on President Bola Tinubu, Chairman of the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS), to immediately review the sanctions imposed on Niger Republic. In an exclusive interview with Arewa PUNCH, Aliyu urged President Tinubu to reconsider the strict sanctions placed on Niger, emphasizing that the punitive measures do not impact the coup plotters but rather ordinary citizens. Following the bloodless coup d’etat by the military junta in Niger, ECOWAS, under President Tinubu’s leadership, announced tough measures including a total closure of all land borders with Niger Republic. Aliyu stressed that border reopening alone is not enough and called for the restoration of all suspended protocols affected by the sanctions. He highlighted that the suspension of electricity supply to Niger Republic was a violation of an agreement between the two countries, explaining that, under the agreement, Niger is not allowed to construct any dam that could restrict water supply to Nigeria. Aliyu warned that if Niger constructs such a dam, it could threaten Nigeria’s hydroelectric power supply and insisted that neither country has the right to unilaterally renege on the agreement. He also urged the federal government to consider the close relationship between Niger Republic and Northern Nigeria, noting that sanctions on Niger directly affect states like Sokoto, Kano, Katsina, and Yobe, which share borders with Niger. Aliyu concluded that imposing general sanctions on Niger is akin to punishing Northern Nigeria and recommended that the government relax some of the measures, focusing instead on targeted actions such as travel bans on coup leaders, rather than punishing the civilian population.
translated_content: ソコト州の人民民主党（PDP）幹部、カビル・アリユ氏は、西アフリカ諸国経済共同体（ECOWAS）議長でありナイジェリア大統領のボラ・ティヌブ氏に対し、ニジェール共和国への制裁を直ちに見直すよう求めました。 アリユ氏はArewa PUNCHの独占インタビューでティヌブ大統領にニジェールへの厳しい制裁の再検討を求め、これらの措置がクーデター指導者ではなく一般市民を苦しめていると強調しました。 ニジェールの軍事政権による流血のないクーデター後、ティヌブ大統領率いるECOWASは、全ての陸上国境の閉鎖など厳しい制裁を発表しました。 アリユ氏は国境の再開だけでなく、制裁によって停止された全ての協定や取り決めの復活も求めています。 また、ニジェールへの電力供給の停止は両国間の合意違反であり、合意上ニジェール側はナイジェリアの水供給を阻害するダムを建設できない旨も説明しました。 もしニジェールがそのようなダムを建設すれば、ナイジェリアの水力発電に悪影響が及ぶ可能性があり、一方的な合意破棄は双方ともできないとアリユ氏は述べています。 さらに、ニジェールと北ナイジェリアの深い関係を考慮するよう政府に提言し、制裁がソコト、カノ、カツィナ、ヨベなど国境沿いの州にも直接的な影響を与えていることを強調しました。 アリユ氏は、一般市民を対象とした制裁は北ナイジェリアをも罰することになるとし、対策は一部緩和し、クーデター指導者への渡航禁止など特定の制裁に絞るべきだと締めくくりました。

article_content: Tech blogger Robert Scoble spent two weeks wearing Google Glass nearly non-stop and says the innovative device has changed his life so much that he never wants to go a day without it. Scoble is among the few people to try the spectacle-like device, which projects a mini-display in front of the user’s eye and features a phone, camera, internet connectivity, and GPS. Scoble wrote a comprehensive review of Google Glass, praising its instant response to voice commands and the ability to capture moments with the camera in just a fraction of a second. Scoble wore Google Glass through everyday tasks, even posting a photo wearing it in the shower. As the founder of the blog Scobleizer and a former 'technology evangelist' at Microsoft, Scoble has earned national attention as an influential tech voice. During his time with Google Glass, he delivered five speeches while wearing the device, passed through airports, and let hundreds of people try it—all of whom were reportedly impressed. 'This has changed my life,' he posted on Google+. 'I will never live a day without it.' Scoble described how the device's display always appears sharp, and compared its impact to revolutionary devices like the iPhone. He praised Glass for being more social than a standard smartphone, citing its high voice command accuracy—even for users with accents—and a camera that 'changes photography' by capturing moments instantly. However, he noted that the device’s success 'totally depends on price.' Scoble observed that a $500 price point might discourage adoption, while a price closer to $200 could help Google grow its social network, Google+. He also noted a shift in Google’s business approach. Scoble wrote that Google forbids advertising in Glass apps, suggesting a move from an advertising-based to a commerce-based model. He used restaurant search as an example, suggesting Google could charge micropayments for transactions completed through Glass. Scoble largely dismissed privacy concerns, mentioning that very few people ever asked him to remove the device during conversations. He compared the experience to opening an early Apple computer, a device that felt primitive but signaled a major shift. Scoble also mentioned he has begun using new apps for Glass, such as the New York Times, RSS readers, and Twitter, with more apps on the way.
translated_content: テックブロガーのロバート・スコーブル氏は、Google Glass をほぼ2週間、ほとんど外さずに装着していたことで、人生が大きく変わり、もうこれなしでは過ごせないと語っています。スコーブル氏は、このメガネ型デバイスを体験した数少ない人の一人で、ユーザーの目の前にミニディスプレイを投影し、電話機能、カメラ、インターネット接続、GPSなどを備えているのが特徴です。 彼は Google Glass の詳細なレビューを執筆し、音声コマンドに即座に反応する点や、一瞬で写真を撮影できるカメラ機能を高く評価しました。 日常のさまざまな場面で Glass を使用し、シャワー中の写真も投稿しています。ブログ「Scobleizer」創設者でかつて Microsoft の技術伝道師だったスコーブル氏は、テック分野で全国的に著名な存在です。 試用期間中に Google Glass を着用して5回の講演を行い、空港でも利用し、何百人もの人に試してもらった結果、誰もが感心していたと報告しています。 「これは私の人生を変えました。もうこれなしの日々はありません」と Google+ に投稿しました。 ディスプレイが常に鮮明に見えることや、その影響を iPhone のような革命的デバイスになぞらえています。また、通常のスマートフォンよりもソーシャル性が高く、アクセントがあっても声の認識精度が高いこと、一瞬で撮影できるカメラによって“写真の常識が変わる”と称賛しています。 ただし、「このデバイスの成功は価格に完全にかかっている」とし、500ドルでは普及しないが、200ドルなら Google+の成長にもつながる可能性があると述べました。 また、Glass アプリには広告が表示されないことから、Google が広告中心のビジネスからコマースベースへシフトしつつあると指摘。レストラン検索時に予約や購入などの取引が発生した際、マイクロペイメントを収益源とする例も挙げています。 プライバシー問題についてはほぼ気にならなかったとしており、会話中に Glass を外してほしいと言われることはごくまれだったそうです。 また、初期の Apple コンピューターを父親と開封した当時の革新的な感動になぞらえ、「最初はできることが少なくても、大きな変化の始まりだった」と語っています。 ニューヨークタイムズや RSS リーダー、Twitter などのアプリもすでに利用していて、これからも対応アプリは増える見込みです。

article_content: Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain gave England hope for the World Cup after training in a knee brace on Monday. The Arsenal winger injured ligaments in his right knee during England's 2-2 draw with Ecuador in Miami last week. Oxlade-Chamberlain joined England's training session at the Urca military base, performing running exercises overseen by head physio Gary Lewin. He trained alone with the England medical team and wore a protective brace throughout the session. The midfielder is hopeful he can return to fitness in time for selection by England manager Roy Hodgson. Both Hodgson and Oxlade-Chamberlain appeared in good spirits during Monday's training. Oxlade-Chamberlain was advised he'd be sidelined for at least 10 days following the injury. Roy Hodgson can choose to replace him up to 24 hours before England's opening group game against Italy on Saturday if he is declared unfit for the tournament. Captain Steven Gerrard also trained separately and ended his session early due to tightness in his groin. England's training, held in the shadow of Sugarloaf Mountain in Rio, was guarded by Brazilian Army personnel. Oxlade-Chamberlain faced challenges in the intense heat, and was previously injured after a tackle by Ecuador's Carlos Gruezo.
translated_content: アレックス・オックスレイド＝チェンバレンは、月曜日に膝のサポーターを着用してトレーニングを行い、イングランド代表がワールドカップ出場に希望を持てる状態を示しました。アーセナル所属のウイングは、先週マイアミで行われたエクアドルとの2-2の引き分け試合中に右膝の靭帯を負傷しました。オックスレイド＝チェンバレンはリオにあるウルカ軍事基地で行われたイングランドのトレーニングに参加し、ヘッドフィジオのゲイリー・ルーインの指導下でランニングの練習を行いました。彼はイングランドのメディカルチームと共に個別でトレーニングを行い、セッション中はずっと保護用のサポーターを着用していました。このミッドフィールダーは、ロイ・ホジソン監督による選考までにフィットネスを取り戻せることを望んでいます。ホジソン監督とオックスレイド＝チェンバレンは、月曜日のトレーニング中も終始明るい様子でした。負傷後、オックスレイド＝チェンバレンは最低でも10日間は離脱するよう伝えられています。ホジソン監督は、ワールドカップ開幕戦イタリア戦（今週土曜）の24時間前まで、大会全体への出場が困難な場合に交代選手を指名することができます。キャプテンのスティーブン・ジェラードも別メニューで調整し、鼠径部の張りから早めにセッションを切り上げました。リオのシュガーローフ山のふもとで行われたイングランドのトレーニングは、ブラジル陸軍によって警備されていました。オックスレイド＝チェンバレンは厳しい暑さの中で調整を続け、以前エクアドルのカルロス・グルエーゾのタックルで負傷した経緯もありました。

article_content: Researchers at the University of Rochester Medical Center have discovered that men might suppress their appetite to focus on finding a mate, driven by specific brain mechanisms. Their study, which uses the microscopic roundworm C. elegans as a model, examined how behavioral differences arise between sexes. In the experiments, worms could choose between staying with food or seeking out a mate. Normal males often left food to pursue mates, while males engineered to feel hungrier tended to stay with food and struggled more to find mating partners. Hermaphrodite worms, which serve as the female analogue, generally stayed with the food. The study centered on AWA neurons, closely tied to both hunger and the drive to seek mates. Assistant Professor Douglas Portman noted that although cultural and social influences also shape human behavior, the biological mechanisms identified here may shed light on sex-based differences in behavior and neurological risk. C. elegans is valuable to scientists, as its neural network is extensively mapped. It has led to several Nobel Prize-winning discoveries in biology and medicine. Published in Current Biology, these findings indicate that modifying a single neuron type can shift sexual behavior, highlighting how gene expression unique to each sex may affect brain adaptability and disease susceptibility.
translated_content: ロチェスター大学医療センターの研究者たちは、男性が特定の脳の仕組みによって食欲を抑え、配偶者探しに集中する可能性があることを発見しました。この研究では、モデル生物として微小な線虫C.エレガンスが使われ、性別による行動の違いがどのように生じるのかが調査されました。実験では、線虫が食べ物のそばにいるか配偶者を探すかを選べるようにしました。通常のオスは食べ物から離れて交尾相手を探す傾向がありましたが、空腹を感じやすいように遺伝子操作されたオスは食べ物の近くにとどまり、交尾があまりできませんでした。雌に相当する両性具有の線虫は、ほとんどが食べ物の近くにとどまりました。 研究は、食欲と配偶者探しの両方に深く関わるAWAニューロンに注目しています。ダグラス・ポートマン助教授は、人間の行動には文化や社会的な影響もありますが、今回明らかになった生物学的なメカニズムが性別ごとの行動や神経疾患リスクの違いを理解する手助けになるかもしれない、と述べています。 C.エレガンスは神経ネットワークが詳細まで解明されているため、多くの生物学・医学的な発見につながってきました。いくつものノーベル賞受賞研究にも貢献しています。この研究成果は『カレント・バイオロジー』誌に掲載されており、特定のニューロンを調整することで性に関連する行動が変わる可能性を示しました。性別ごとの遺伝子発現の違いが、脳の柔軟性や疾患のリスクにも影響すると考えられます。
post_content: Ever wondered why sometimes food just isn't a priority? 🧠 New research using tiny worms (C. elegans) shows male brains can hit pause on hunger to focus on finding a mate! #ScienceNews #BrainsAndBehavior

article_content:
Czech artist David Černý, renowned for his anti-communist stance, has installed a massive sculpture of a purple hand making an obscene gesture on the Vltava River in Prague. The artwork was unveiled just days before parliamentary elections that could return the Communist Party to power, nearly 25 years after the Velvet Revolution ended their rule.

The installation, set near the historic Charles Bridge and pointing towards Prague Castle, serves as a clear political statement. President Miloš Zeman supports a proposal by the Social Democrats to form a minority government with tacit Communist backing—signifying potential Communist involvement in government for the first time since the end of the one-party era.

For many Czechs, the Communist Party still symbolizes decades of repression, even as other political parties have faced recent scandals. The artwork appeared four days before the election. Černý has been reticent about the piece, stating only that the gesture ‘speaks for itself,’ and remarking about its direction, according to the BBC. President Zeman, on an official visit to Ukraine at the time, did not comment.

The Czech parliament is amid major upheaval; it was dissolved after Prime Minister Petr Nečas’s administration collapsed in a bribery scandal. Zeman’s interim technocratic government resigned in August. Polls by SANEP last August showed Social Democrats leading with 27%, followed by the Communists at 16.7%.

The Velvet Revolution, which concluded four decades of Communist rule, was led by dissident Václav Havel, who later became president. Sparking from a student protest in November 1989, the revolution quickly grew, resulting in the fall of communism and a new government by year’s end. Černý is known for provocative art, including installations at Prague’s Franz Kafka Museum.

反共主義で知られるチェコの芸術家ダヴィッド・チェルニーが、プラハのヴルタヴァ川に巨大な中指を立てた紫色の手の彫刻を設置しました。この作品は、ビロード革命で共産党が追放されて以来、約25年ぶりに彼らが権力を取り戻す可能性のある議会選挙の数日前に公開されました。

歴史的なカレル橋の近く、プラハ城の方向に向けて設置されたこの作品は、明確な政治的メッセージを放っています。ミロシュ・ゼマン大統領は社会民主党による、共産党の暗黙の支援を受けた少数政府の樹立を支持しており、これは一党体制崩壊後初めて共産党が政府に関与する可能性を示しています。

多くのチェコ国民にとって、共産党は今なお数十年にわたる弾圧の象徴ですが、他の政党が最近のスキャンダルで評価を落とす中、共産党はその影響を受けていません。チェルニーの作品は選挙の4日前に登場しました。彼はこの作品について多くを語らず、「ジェスチャーがすべてを物語っている」と述べ、BBCによると「どの方向を向いているかが重要だ」とも語っています。ゼマン大統領は当時ウクライナ公式訪問中で、コメントはありませんでした。

チェコ議会は大きな混乱の中にあり、ペトル・ネチャス首相の政権が贈収賄スキャンダルで崩壊した後、議会は解散。ゼマン大統領による暫定テクノクラート政権も8月に辞任しました。世論調査機関SANEPの昨年8月の調査では、社会民主党が27％、共産党が16.7％の支持を得ていました。

約40年にわたる共産党政権打倒を達成した「ビロード革命」は、反体制派のヴァーツラフ・ハヴェルが率い、彼は後に大統領となりました。1989年11月の学生デモから始まり、急速に大規模な抗議活動に発展し、年末には共産党体制が崩壊。チェルニーはプラハのフランツ・カフカ博物館のユーモラスな銅像など、挑発的な芸術でも知られています。

article_content:
Pakistani cricketer Muhammad Rizwan is facing criticism in India after dedicating his team's recent ICC Cricket World Cup victory over Sri Lanka to the people of Gaza, who have endured ongoing Israeli airstrikes. Rizwan, named Player of the Match following his century that helped Pakistan complete the tournament’s highest-ever successful run chase in Hyderabad, India, posted on X (formerly Twitter): “This was for our brothers and sisters in Gaza. Happy to contribute to the win. Credits to the whole team and especially Abdullah Shafique and Hassan Ali for making it easier. Extremely grateful to the people of Hyderabad for the amazing hospitality and support throughout.”

In addition to his message of support for Gaza, the 31-year-old wicketkeeper-batter also expressed condolences for those affected by the recent earthquake in Afghanistan. However, it was his show of solidarity with Palestinians that sparked backlash among Indian cricket fans. Some called on the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) to boycott the upcoming India-Pakistan match in Ahmedabad and ban Rizwan from participating. Others appealed to the International Cricket Council (ICC) to ban Rizwan, describing his post as “insane.”

An Indian fan accused the BCCI of providing Pakistani players with “a platform for the Palestine agenda” and suggested it could incite support for Hamas and Palestine among Indian fans. Indian journalist Sudhir Chaudhary commented on X that the ICC Cricket World Cup was not just about cricket but also a battleground for political and religious ideology.

The ICC has previously taken action against political statements on the field. In 2014, it banned England’s Moeen Ali from wearing “Save Gaza” and “Free Palestine” wristbands, and in 2019, it asked India’s MS Dhoni to remove gloves bearing a controversial symbol in a World Cup match. However, according to Indian media reports, the BCCI is unlikely to act against Rizwan and is instead focusing on preparations for Saturday’s highly anticipated match against Pakistan in Ahmedabad, including a grand pre-match ceremony.

Some Indian fans criticize the BCCI for prioritizing the event over taking action against the Pakistani team, pointing to what they perceive as inconsistency in the board’s approach to bilateral and World Cup matches.

Meanwhile, Israel continues airstrikes on Gaza, killing over 1,400 people since imposing a total siege last week. The escalation follows attacks by Hamas that left at least 1,300 people dead in Israel.

article_content: A 9-year-old girl named Emma Johnson was severely injured on Tuesday after a mule kicked her in the head. The incident occurred on Green Drive near Canton in Cherokee County, Atlanta, Georgia. Emma was unconscious but breathing when firefighters arrived at the scene. She and her mother had been attempting to guide two escaped mules into a neighbor’s empty pasture while they searched for the animals' owner. The mules had broken free from their fenced enclosure, possibly due to rain damaging the fence. Neighbor Thomas Ross witnessed the event and helped Emma's mother call 911. Emma’s mother was carrying a bucket of feed to attract the mules, with Emma following closely behind. When Emma got too close to the back of one of the mules, it kicked her. Ross told the mother to call 911 immediately, but after she dropped her phone, he relayed critical information to emergency services. Paramedics arrived and took Emma to a nearby church, where she was airlifted to the hospital via helicopter. Investigators are working to determine exactly how the mules escaped. It is believed weather conditions may have played a role. The owner of the mules, Tim Byess, will not face criminal charges. He expressed his deep regret about the incident, saying, 'A mule isn’t worth anything. A life is worth everything.' Ross and Byess both hope for Emma’s speedy recovery.

article_content: Cardiff City manager Ole Gunnar Solskjaer has confirmed the loan signing of Manchester United winger Wilfried Zaha and the permanent transfer of his Old Trafford teammate Fabio da Silva. Zaha underwent a medical at St George's Park earlier this week before completing his move, while Brazilian left-back Fabio leaves Manchester United after making just one Premier League appearance this season. Fabio's contract was due to expire this summer, and he was not part of David Moyes' plans. According to reports, Cardiff will pay a loan fee between £1 million and £1.5 million for Zaha, as well as his £35,000-a-week wages. Zaha had limited first-team opportunities at Manchester United and recently played for the club's Under-21 side. Solskjaer is believed to have agreed a small fee to sign Fabio now instead of waiting for a free transfer in July. 'My phone is ringing and I am answering most of them. Maybe some players will go out on loan, but we are done with signings,' said Solskjaer. 'We have added three new players this week – Fabio, Kenwyne Jones, and Wilfried Zaha. Their energy, enthusiasm, and presence complement the squad. I am happy with the team now.' 'I am focused on the upcoming game against Norwich, which is more important than transfers elsewhere. I have seen positive developments this month, and the new players might be what we've been missing.' Kenwyne Jones has also joined Cardiff, having scored five goals in ten games for Stoke City, but none in the Premier League this season.

T-Mobile is launching an unconventional promotion with its 'T-Mobile Test Drive' program, where customers can borrow an iPhone 5S for free and use the carrier's cellular service with unlimited data for seven days. Interested consumers can sign up online starting Monday. If they decide not to continue with T-Mobile, they simply return the phone to any T-Mobile store at no charge. Participants must provide a valid credit card; those who return a cracked or water-damaged phone will be charged $100, while those who do not return the phone at all will be billed $700 plus tax.

As the fourth-largest wireless carrier in the United States, T-Mobile is seeking to disrupt industry norms. Under the leadership of CEO John Legere, known for his bold and unconventional style, T-Mobile brands itself as 'The Uncarrier.' Legere emphasized the company’s commitment to transparency and innovation, criticizing competitors for requiring customers to buy plans blindly.

Since March 2013, T-Mobile has removed binding contracts and introduced the 'Jump' program, allowing customers to upgrade their phones twice a year for a modest fee. The company recently announced that customers can now stream unlimited music from services such as Pandora and Spotify without using their data allowance.

These aggressive strategies come amid reports that Sprint, the third-largest U.S. carrier, is considering a $20 billion buyout of T-Mobile. Despite ongoing rumors, T-Mobile seems determined to continue its bold approach in the wireless industry.

article_content: Benjamin Arellano Felix, a leader of the prominent Tijuana cartel, was extradited to the United States on Friday, according to Mexico's attorney general's office. Arellano Felix was one of seven brothers who controlled the cartel until most of its leadership, including himself, was captured. Although weakened by these arrests, the group—also called the Arellano Felix Organization—remains one of Mexico's significant drug trafficking syndicates. Arellano Felix had been convicted of organized crime in Mexico and was serving multiple sentences. He is wanted in the United States on two indictments that include charges of conspiracy, money laundering, drug trafficking, operating a smuggling organization, and murder. At its height in the 1990s and early 2000s, the Tijuana cartel managed the flow of cocaine, marijuana, and other drugs into the United States through hubs like Tijuana and Mexicali, according to officials. Part of Mexican President Felipe Calderon's anti-cartel strategy has been to extradite traffickers to face justice in the U.S., since even jailed traffickers in Mexico have been known to continue running their criminal enterprises from prison. Standing trial in the U.S. is considered a deterrent. Under Arellano Felix's leadership, the cartel operated networks of bribery, espionage, and killings. Authorities referred to him as the brains and chief accountant of the organization. Arellano Felix was arrested in Puebla in 2002, extradition proceedings began in 2007, and the handover to U.S. marshals took place at Toluca International Airport on Friday.

article_content:
More than 600 people, the majority of them children, have died of diphtheria in Nigeria since the latest outbreak began in December 2022, according to officials. With approximately 14,000 suspected cases, this outbreak is significantly more severe than that of 2011, which saw only 98 reported cases. Kano state in northern Nigeria is the epicentre of the outbreak, accounting for over 500 deaths, though there has recently been a decline in active cases.

Diphtheria is a highly contagious disease affecting the nose and throat and can also cause skin ulcers. It spreads through coughs, sneezes, or close contact with infected individuals, and severe cases can be fatal. The disease is preventable with vaccination, yet many of the children who have died were unvaccinated, according to Dr. Faisal Shuaib, head of the National Primary Health Care Development Agency.

During a visit to a diphtheria isolation centre in Kano city on Wednesday, Dr. Shuaib remarked, “Witnessing the young children suffering from this entirely preventable disease at the centre today was profoundly heart-wrenching.”

The death toll has risen since 24 September, when the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) reported 453 deaths and 11,587 suspected cases. The World Health Organization (WHO) has indicated that the actual numbers may be higher due to limited testing and underreporting of symptoms. However, Dr. Shuaib noted that control measures such as contact tracing have helped reduce the number of new cases.

So far, the outbreak has affected 19 of Nigeria’s 36 states as well as the federal capital, Abuja. The worst-hit regions are all in the country’s north—Kano, Yobe, Katsina, Borno, Jigawa, and Kaduna. Health authorities are urging parents of unvaccinated or partially vaccinated children to get them immunized, stressing that vaccination is the most effective way to control the outbreak.

According to the WHO, just 57% of Nigerians have received the pentavalent vaccine, which protects against five serious diseases, including diphtheria. The agency recommends that Nigeria increase vaccination coverage to at least 80% of the population to prevent future outbreaks. The last major diphtheria outbreak in the country was in 2011, when 21 people died and 98 were infected in Borno state.

2022年12月から始まった現在のジフテリア流行で、ナイジェリアでは600人以上が亡くなり、その大半は子どもたちだと当局は発表しています。推定14,000件の疑い例があり、流行は2011年の98件を大きく上回っています。北部ナイジェリアのカノ州が流行の中心で、500人以上の死者が出ましたが、最近は感染者数が減ってきています。

ジフテリアは非常に感染力が強く、鼻や喉に影響し、皮膚潰瘍を引き起こすこともあります。咳、くしゃみ、感染者との密接な接触でうつり、重篤だと死亡することもあります。ワクチンで予防可能ですが、亡くなった子どもたちの多くは未接種だったと、国立初級保健医療開発庁のファイサル・シュアイブ長官は述べました。

シュアイブ長官は水曜日、カノ市のジフテリア隔離センターを訪問。「今日、完全に予防可能な病気に苦しむ子どもたちを見るのはとても胸が痛みました」と語りました。

9月24日時点でナイジェリア疾病管理予防センター（NCDC）は453人の死亡と11,587件の疑い例を報告しており、その後も死者は増加しています。世界保健機関（WHO）は、検査体制の不十分さや未報告患者がいるため、実際の患者数・死亡者数はさらに多い可能性があるとしています。しかしシュアイブ長官は、接触者追跡などの対策によって新規感染者が減少していると説明しました。

流行はこれまでにナイジェリア36州のうち19州と首都アブジャに拡大しました。最も被害が大きいのはすべて北部の州（カノ、ヨベ、カツィナ、ボルノ、ジガワ、カドゥナ）です。保健当局は、未接種や部分接種の子どもの保護者に予防接種を受けさせるよう呼びかけ、「ワクチン接種が流行抑制の最も有効な方法」と強調しています。

WHOによると、ナイジェリアで五価ワクチン（ジフテリアなど5種の病気に対応）を受けている人は57％で、80％以上に増やす必要があると勧告しています。前回の大流行は2011年で、ボルノ州で21人が死亡、98人が感染しました。

article_content: A dense toxic haze settled over New Delhi on Thursday, November 2, intensifying fears of yet another public health emergency. Government agencies have warned that pollution levels in India's capital could worsen in the coming days, even as authorities attempt to curb them. The Air Quality Index (AQI) in Anand Vihar, New Delhi, reached 415 out of 500, signifying 'severe' pollution that poses risks not only to those with existing health conditions but also to healthy individuals. An AQI between 0 and 50 is considered healthy. Every winter, decreased air quality in the region often coincides with spikes in respiratory illnesses, prompting closures of schools and factories. In response, New Delhi’s government has banned the entry of diesel buses and announced that construction activities will be suspended if high pollution persists. On Thursday, New Delhi and Lahore in Pakistan topped the global list of the most polluted cities, according to real-time data compiled by Swiss group IQAir. Mumbai also ranked among the top 15 most polluted cities worldwide. The worsening air quality has overshadowed the Cricket World Cup, as fans continue to attend stadiums across Indian cities. In Mumbai, AQI hovered around 200 before Thursday’s match between India and Sri Lanka. The city is set to host large crowds for the tournament’s semifinal on November 15. This week, the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) announced a ban on firework displays during the remaining matches to help fight air pollution. Players have expressed concerns about toxic air; England’s Joe Root reported breathing difficulties during a match, and India’s Rohit Sharma called for change to protect 'future generations.'

article_content: The European Union (EU) announced that Nigeria and other African countries will receive up to 150 billion Euros by 2027 through the Global Gateway Initiative (GGI). This program is designed to strengthen connectivity, advance sustainable development, and deepen economic relationships between the EU and its partners, with Nigeria set to be a major recipient. Speaking at the initiative's launch in Abuja, EU Commissioner Jutta Urpilainen highlighted Nigeria’s central role. She noted that the overall 300 billion Euro investment package aims to foster resilience amid current global tensions, such as the conflict in Ukraine and continued regional instability. Funding will target sectors crucial to Nigeria’s progress like transport, energy, and digital systems. It includes support for the 5G rollout, proposed loans for small and medium enterprises in digital and print industries, and investments in power infrastructure like expanding the Nigeria-Benin grid and building lines between Katsina and Daura. Last year, the EU and European Investment Bank pledged 820 million Euros for Nigeria’s digital advancement, partnering with companies like MTN to expand digital identities and mobile coverage. Education is also a focus: over 2,000 Nigerian students received EU scholarships in the past year via Erasmus+, and new projects aim to improve basic education in northern regions. Nigerian Minister Bosun Tijani commended the program, linking it to the government's agenda for inclusive development and pointing out Nigeria's youthful population—60% under 25—as a vital resource for the global digital economy. EU and Nigerian officials underlined their commitment to collaboration, innovation, and joint progress for sustainable development benefiting Nigeria and the world.

article_content: Tata Technologies is preparing for its stock market debut this Thursday after its initial public offering (IPO) garnered huge interest from investors. The company’s shares are attracting a significant grey market premium of Rs 406 before listing. With an IPO price ceiling of Rs 500, the shares might open at a hefty 82% premium. Experts caution that grey market prices merely reflect unofficial trends and can fluctuate quickly. Still, current trends and robust demand suggest the stock could potentially double its IPO price on the first trading day. Shivani Nyati, Head of Wealth at Swastika Investmart, remarked that the high investor enthusiasm and the company’s capabilities position Tata Technologies for a promising stock market launch. Beyond initial market gains, industry analysts are optimistic about the company’s long-term outlook. They point to its global footprint, specialized engineering services, diverse customer base, strong delivery network, and focus on innovation as major strengths. The Tata Technologies IPO, worth Rs 3,042 crore, drew bids totalling more than Rs 1.5 lakh crore, with nearly 70 times more demand than shares available. The quota for retail investors was oversubscribed 16 times, institutional buyers 203 times, and non-institutional investors 62 times. Analysts attribute this strong demand to Tata Technologies’ appealing valuations—its FY23 price-to-earnings ratio is 32-33x, notably lower than sector peers—and the credibility of the Tata brand. Compared to companies like KPIT (PE 105x), L&T Technology Services (40x), and Tata Elxsi (70x), Tata Technologies stands out for both value and financial growth, outperforming peers over FY21-23. The firm is a leading engineering research and development provider for the manufacturing sector, especially focusing on automotive and energy industries. In 2022, it worked with seven of the top ten automotive ER&D spenders and five of the leading new energy spenders. As of FY23, services contributed 80% of revenue, with products at 11% and education at 9%. For the six months ending September, revenue grew 35% year-over-year to Rs 2,587 crore, while net profits climbed 36% to Rs 352 crore. Disclaimer: Analyst views mentioned are independent and do not reflect the publication’s stance. In related news: The Nifty index closed above the 20,000 mark for the first time since September, signaling improved market optimism. The Enforcement Directorate has raised concerns about Byju’s compliance with forex regulations, and HCL Group is moving closer to establishing a semiconductor facility in Karnataka.

Home-grown FMCG company Marico anticipates revenue growth to return in the second half of the fiscal year, with an expected gradual recovery in rural demand, according to Managing Director and CEO Saugata Gupta. The company has reduced prices in response to easing domestic inflation over the past two quarters. While this has affected revenue growth, it has enabled Marico to sustain or increase market share and expand product reach in some portfolios.

Gupta noted that in the next two quarters, revenue growth is expected to align with volume growth. "Revenue growth is anticipated to turn positive in H2 as pricing deflation moderates in the domestic business. We have implemented price reductions for core brands such as Saffola and Parachute," he said.

Recently, Marico, owner of brands including Saffola, Parachute, and Livon, reported a 17.2% rise in consolidated net profit for the September quarter, though operating revenue slightly declined to Rs 2,476 crore year-on-year. The company recorded a 3% underlying volume growth in its domestic business.

Regarding rural markets, Gupta expressed optimism as consumer sentiment improves. Improvement in rainfall in September following August's uncertainty, along with a lower comparative base, is expected to aid both revenue and volume growth.

Marico’s food and premium personal care businesses now contribute 20% of domestic revenue. Gupta called the company’s diversification a success and expects this trend to continue. The company remains focused on boosting gross margins in its food business and reducing cash burn in the digital premium personal care segment.

The target is for Marico’s food and premium personal care businesses to deliver EBITDA consistent with companywide performance, aiming for more than 15-20% growth in these areas over the next three to four years.

Saffola, Marico’s leading brand, has diversified into oats, honey, soya, and noodles. Currently, food represents 25% of Saffola’s franchise; the company expects this to reach 50% in the next four years. Marico has also acquired the premium food brands Plix and True Elements and plans to continue scaling its food business.

With Saffola, Marico has become a market leader in oats, outpacing competitors like Quaker Oats. The focus going forward includes scaling up honey and soya products, developing spreads, and growing the snacking segment, including prototyping ragi chips.

Marico’s expanding portfolio features digital-first brands like Set Wet, Beardo, and Just Herbs. Already operating in segments such as breakfast, immunity, plant protein, spreads, and snacking, the company aims to broaden offerings within existing categories rather than launch into entirely new areas.

Asked about new food brand launches, Gupta reaffirmed the focus on premium digital brands Plix (wellness) and True Elements (premium food), citing no current plans to introduce additional brands.

国産FMCG企業マリコは、今年度後半には売上成長が回復し、農村部の需要も徐々に改善すると見込んでいます。これはマネージングディレクター兼CEOサウガタ・グプタ氏による発表です。同社は過去2四半期で国内インフレが落ち着いたことを受け、製品価格を引き下げました。これにより売上成長には影響が出ましたが、市場シェアの維持や一部製品の普及拡大につながっています。

グプタ氏は「今後2四半期で売上成長は数量成長と同じくらいになる見込みです。価格ディスインフレが緩やかになり、今年度後半には売上がプラス成長に転じると想定しています。主力ブランドであるサフォラとパラシュートで値下げを実施しました」と説明しました。

最近、サフォラ、パラシュート、リボンなどを展開するマリコは9月四半期の連結純利益が前年同期比17.2%増となった一方で、営業収益はわずかに減少して2,476億ルピーでした。国内事業では実質数量成長が3%見られました。

農村市場についてグプタ氏は、消費者心理の改善により今後の回復を期待しています。特に8月まで降雨の不安があったものの、9月には状況が大きく改善し、昨年比で比較の基準が低いこともあり売上・数量面ともに上向くと見ています。

食品とプレミアムパーソナルケア事業は現在マリコ国内売上の20%を占め、多角化戦略が奏功しています。今後はこの流れを維持しつつ、食品部門の粗利率向上やデジタルプレミアムケア事業のキャッシュバーン削減にも注力していきます。

これらの事業部門で今後3～4年で15～20%超の持続的成長および全社EBITDAと同水準の成果を目指しています。

サフォラブランドはオーツ、ハチミツ、大豆、ヌードルなどに展開を拡大。現在食品はサフォラの売上の25%ですが、4年以内に50%に拡大する計画です。さらに、PlixやTrue Elementsといったプレミアムフードブランドも買収し、食品事業のスケールアップを推進しています。

サフォラのオーツ製品は、クエーカーオーツ等の主要競合を上回りトップランナーとなり、今後はハチミツ、大豆、スプレッド商品、さらにスナック分野ではラギチップスの試作にも重点を置く方針です。

新たにSet Wet、Beardo、Just Herbsといったデジタル主導ブランドもポートフォリオに加え、朝食、免疫、植物性たんぱく、スプレッド、スナッキングといった既存部門で製品の拡充を行う予定です。

食品の新ブランド投入については現時点で予定しておらず、ウェルネス分野のPlixとプレミアム食品のTrue Elementsというデジタル系ブランド2つに注力していく考えです。

The public will soon get Jenny Sanford’s perspective on the South Carolina governor’s sex scandal, as the release date for her memoir has been moved up. "Staying True," Sanford’s book, will now arrive in stores on February 5, ahead of the original April schedule, according to publisher Ballantine Books.

Jenny Sanford secured the book deal in September, a few months after her husband, South Carolina Governor Mark Sanford, admitted to having an affair with a woman from Argentina. In December, Jenny Sanford announced she was filing for divorce after several failed attempts at reconciliation.

A synopsis on the publisher’s website describes the memoir as revealing the private ordeal behind a public betrayal and offering inspiration for those coping with challenging life events. It notes that Jenny Sanford allowed Mark Sanford to face the political fallout from his actions while she focused on raising their children with integrity, despite the lies their father had told.

Following his televised confession, Mark Sanford was met with calls for his resignation and investigations from media organizations and the South Carolina Ethics Commission into potential misuse of state resources for personal matters. In November, the ethics panel charged the governor with 37 violations of the state’s ethics code. The commission is expected to hear arguments regarding those civil charges this year.

Report by CNN’s Peter Hamby.

article_content: A U.S. doctor exposed to Ebola while volunteering in Sierra Leone is being brought to an isolation facility in Bethesda, Maryland for observation. The National Institutes of Health (NIH), handling the case, has not released the doctor's name but emphasizes this is a precautionary move with very low risk to others. Dr. Anthony Fauci of the NIH stated that simply being exposed to Ebola doesn't guarantee the individual will become ill, but prompt monitoring allows for immediate care if needed. The Ebola outbreak across West Africa remains severe, with the World Health Organization reporting more than 3,000 deaths and over 6,500 potential cases. The crisis, originating in Guinea, has spread widely through Liberia and Sierra Leone, increasing fears that the death toll could rise significantly. Four American aid workers previously infected with Ebola in Africa received treatment in the U.S.; three have recovered and one remains hospitalized. Dr. Rick Sacra, one such survivor, was discharged from a Nebraska hospital after being cleared of the virus and expressed deep appreciation for the medical team's efforts, although he still feels weak. Sacra is from Worcester, Massachusetts, is affiliated with the University of Massachusetts Medical School, and helped in Liberia through the charity SIM. He intends to return to Africa to assist further, following a period of rest and recovery. The United States government is sending 3,000 soldiers to West Africa to aid in controlling the outbreak as international efforts intensify.
translated_content: シエラレオネでボランティア活動中にエボラウイルスに曝露した米国人医師が、経過観察のためメリーランド州ベセスダの隔離施設に搬送されることになりました。米国立衛生研究所（NIH）は医師の氏名を公表していませんが、これは予防的措置であり、他の人々への感染リスクは非常に低いと強調しています。NIHのアンソニー・ファウチ博士によれば、エボラに曝露しても必ずしも発症するわけではありませんが、迅速な監視で必要な場合には即座の対応が可能だと述べています。 西アフリカにおけるエボラ流行は依然として深刻な状況が続いており、世界保健機関（WHO）によると死亡者数は3,000人を超え、感染が疑われる・確認された症例数は6,500例以上にのぼります。流行はギニアで始まり、リベリアやシエラレオネにも広がっており、死者数がさらに増加する懸念があります。 これまでにアフリカでエボラに感染した米国人支援活動家4人が米国で治療を受け、そのうち3人は回復し、1人は引き続き入院しています。回復したリック・サクラ医師はネブラスカ州の病院から無事退院し、医療チームへの感謝を表明しつつも、依然として体力低下を訴えました。サクラ医師はマサチューセッツ州ウスター出身で、マサチューセッツ大学医学部にも所属し、SIMという慈善団体を通じてリベリアで活動していました。今後十分な休養を取ったうえで、再びアフリカで支援活動を行う意向を示しています。 米国政府は流行抑制のため3,000人の兵士を西アフリカに派遣予定で、国際的な支援体制が強化されています。

article_content:
In September 2022, my husband, our son, and I were living at Fort Hood, Texas, when we were notified that we had just 27 days to prepare for a move to Camp Humphreys in South Korea—about 40 miles south of Seoul, a place we'd never been. Since my husband is in the military, we expected some unpredictability, but this move was still a whirlwind. In under a month, we packed up all our belongings, said goodbye to friends and family, and arranged for our car to be shipped overseas.

When we arrived in South Korea, we faced many immediate challenges. Our phones didn’t work, we didn’t know anyone, and we didn’t have local driver’s licenses. Navigating everyday tasks—like using the subway or ordering a taxi—was intimidating. The most difficult adjustment at first was adopting new cultural norms, like always using two hands when exchanging money and bowing as a gesture of thanks. But there were many things to appreciate, such as the punctual and efficient public transit system.

With our car still in transit, we often depended on trains and buses to get groceries. On one rainy day, while struggling with a sleeping toddler, a local man offered us a ride. Although at first we were hesitant—the kind of offer that would be unusual in the U.S.—his kindness was genuine. We tried to pay him, but he refused to accept any money.

Life on base at Camp Humphreys offers familiar comforts, including a gas station, grocery stores, a mall, and even Baskin-Robbins. Our eating habits have changed a lot; we rely on seasonal produce (for example, fresh strawberries are only available from December to February) and often have rice and kimchi with dinner.

Child-friendly attitudes are prevalent—locals might pinch a child’s cheeks as a sign of affection, and restaurant staff often offer to help with fussy kids. We feel safe letting our son play in parks, since people are attentive to children. Dining out is also more affordable: our family can enjoy a full meal for about $40.

The USO (United Service Organizations) is an invaluable resource for American military families stationed overseas, offering daily programming, language classes, and cultural trips to historic sites around Korea. Our high-rise apartment on base has bulletin boards with information on free events, and we have a nearby library with children’s programs, so there’s always something to do.

Having access to our car has made life easier, but driving off base presents its own challenges due to narrow roads and limited parking. Adjusting to the language has been tough. I felt shy about speaking Korean, but people have been understanding—many use translation apps to help bridge the gap. Nearby, there's a market where local vendors and I try to communicate with gestures, and we share laughs over misunderstandings.

We’ve embraced local cuisine, though it hasn’t always been smooth—like when we mistakenly tried to cook raw meat (yukhoe) and soy-marinated crab at a Korean barbecue restaurant. The wait staff kindly explained the customs, though we relied heavily on Google Translate.

Some aspects of everyday life, such as heavy air pollution and a strict recycling system with few public trash bins, took adjustment. Shopping is different, too: many local shops only sell their own goods, unlike multipurpose stores in the U.S., so picking up items means visiting several locations. Fast-food drive-thrus are less accessible because of the language barrier, so we order inside using a translation app.

Running my baking business here was an adjustment. Some ingredients, like butter, are much more expensive (about $8 a pound), and there are many types of flour. I often rely on packaging images to choose the right one and have had to adapt to Celsius temperatures and different baking times.

Despite initial doubts, I’ve come to love living abroad. This is my first time living outside America, and we’ll be here for at least two years. After that, our next destination is unknown. If I could choose, I’d pick Australia, but the military could send us anywhere.

2022年9月、私たち家族（三人）はテキサス州フォートフッドに住んでいましたが、ソウルから約40マイル南にある韓国のキャンプ・ハンフリーズへ、わずか27日後に引っ越すことを知らされました。夫は軍人なので予測不能なことも覚悟していましたが、それでもこの移動は大変でした。1か月も経たないうちに家財をすべて梱包し、家族や友人に別れを告げ、車を海外に送る手続きをしました。

韓国に到着してからは、すぐに様々な課題に直面しました。電話は使えず、知り合いもおらず、現地の運転免許もありません。地下鉄の利用やタクシーの注文など日常のことも戸惑いの連続。特に難しかったのは、現地の文化的マナーを覚えることでした。例えばお金を渡すときは必ず両手で、感謝を伝えるときはお辞儀をするなどです。しかし、公共交通機関の正確さなど気に入る点も多くありました。

車が届くまでは電車やバスで買い物に行きました。ある雨の日、眠そうな子どもと一緒に苦労していると、地元の男性が『乗りませんか？』と声をかけてくれました。アメリカでは滅多にない親切に最初は戸惑いましたが、本当に善意だったのでした。お礼を渡そうとしても受け取ってくれませんでした。

キャンプ・ハンフリーズの基地にはガソリンスタンドやスーパー、モール、バスキンロビンスなど、アメリカを思い出す施設もたくさんあります。食生活も大きく変化し、季節の野菜や果物（例：イチゴは12月から2月だけ）に頼り、ご飯やキムチが夕食の定番になりました。

子どもに親しみを持つ文化も印象的で、現地の人がほっぺをつまんだり、レストランの店員さんも子どもに気を配ってくれます。公園で子どもを遊ばせても安心感があります。外食も家族全員で約40ドルと安価です。

USO (米軍支援団体) は、海外駐在のアメリカ軍人家族にとって大切な存在です。毎日のプログラムや語学教室、韓国内の歴史的観光地へのツアーなどを提供しています。基地の高層アパートの掲示板にはイベント情報があり、近くには子ども向けプログラムのある図書館もあるので、退屈することはありません。

車があると便利ですが、基地の外は道路が狭く駐車場も少ないので運転は大変です。言語の壁もあり、韓国語を話すのはまだ恥ずかしかったですが、現地の人たちは親切で、翻訳アプリなどで助けてもらっています。基地近くの市場では、地元の人とジェスチャーでやりとりし、失敗も笑い合いながら買い物しています。

地元料理も楽しんでいますが、最初は失敗もありました。たとえばコチュジャンの焼き肉店で、ユッケ（生牛肉）やカンジャンケジャン（醤油漬けのカニ）を間違って鉄板で焼こうとしたことも。店員さんが丁寧に教えてくれ、Google翻訳に頼って意思疎通しました。

大気汚染や厳しいリサイクルのルール、公共のゴミ箱が少ないなど、日常で慣れることも多かったです。買い物も一つの店で何でも揃うアメリカのようにはいかず、コーヒーやシーツ、おむつを買うにも複数のお店を回る必要があります。ファストフードのドライブスルーも言葉の壁で使いにくいので、店内で翻訳アプリを使って注文しています。

現地でベーカリーを経営するのも一苦労でした。バターは1ポンド約8ドルと高価で、小麦粉も種類が豊富。パッケージの絵を頼りに選び、摂氏温度や焼き時間にも慣れる必要がありました。

最初は海外生活を好きになるとは思っていませんでしたが、今は本当に楽しんでいます。アメリカ国外に住むのは初めてで、少なくとも2年間はここに滞在します。その後どこへ行くか分かりませんが、できればオーストラリアへ行ってみたいですね。でも、軍の辞令次第です。
post_content: Moving from Texas to South Korea with just 27 days' notice was wild! There were tough moments (pollution, language, finding butter for my bakery), but thanks to friendly locals, USO support, and lots of kimchi, I'm loving our new life abroad. #militarylife #expatadventures #Korea

article_content: Larry Hagman, the actor best known for portraying J.R. Ewing on the hit television show 'Dallas,' passed away on Friday at the age of 81, his family announced. He died in a Dallas hospital due to complications from cancer, according to a statement posted Saturday on Hagman's official website. "Larry returned to his beloved Dallas to reprise the role he loved most," the statement said. "His family and close friends joined him for the Thanksgiving holiday, and he was surrounded by loved ones when he passed. It was a peaceful passing, just as he had wished. The family requests privacy at this time." In 1978, Hagman achieved television stardom with his role as the cunning oil tycoon, J.R. Ewing, in the prime-time soap opera 'Dallas.' The character became one of television’s most notorious villains. The show reached new heights of popularity in 1980 with the famous 'Who Shot J.R.?' storyline, drawing over 350 million viewers worldwide to its resolution on November 21, 1980, when it was revealed Kristen Shepherd, J.R.'s sister-in-law, was the shooter. The episode remains one of the most-watched in television history. Hagman, along with the rest of the cast, starred in 14 seasons of 'Dallas,' which ended in 1991. He reprised the iconic role for TNT’s reboot of the series in June 2012 and filmed scenes for the show's second season, scheduled to air in January. (Both CNN and TNT are divisions of Time Warner and Turner Broadcasting.) Hagman was known for his enjoyment of the role and even created fake $100 bills bearing his face with the slogan 'In Hagman We Trust' for fans. In one of his last CNN interviews, Hagman appeared with original 'Dallas' cast members Linda Gray and Patrick Duffy on 'Piers Morgan Tonight.' Gray, in a statement via her publicist, called Hagman her best friend for more than 35 years, and described him as creative, generous, funny, loving, talented, and an original. Upon hearing of Hagman's death, tributes poured in from fans and celebrities. William Shatner tweeted condolences, and TNT issued a statement honoring Hagman and sending thoughts to his family. Hagman was born in Fort Worth, Texas, to actress Mary Martin and lawyer Ben Hagman. He briefly attended Bard College in New York before working in theater in Dallas and New York, including performing alongside his mother in 'South Pacific' in England. He produced and directed shows while serving in the U.S. Air Force and later moved to Hollywood, where he appeared in various television roles. Hagman’s breakthrough came in 1965, when he starred as Major Tony Nelson in the popular sitcom 'I Dream of Jeannie' opposite Barbara Eden. Eden fondly remembered their time together on the show in a Facebook post after his death. After 'I Dream of Jeannie' ended in 1970, Hagman continued to act in numerous television shows and starred in the 1990s series 'Orleans.' He also faced personal challenges, including alcoholism, cirrhosis, and a life-saving liver transplant in 1995. He publicly discussed his wife's battle with Alzheimer's and announced in 2011 he had been diagnosed with a treatable form of cancer. Hagman is survived by his wife, son, daughter, and five grandchildren.
translated_content: 人気ドラマ『ダラス』でJ.R.ユーイング役を演じた俳優、ラリー・ハグマンさんが金曜日に81歳で亡くなりました。家族の発表によると、ダラスの病院でがんによる合併症が原因だったそうです。土曜日にハグマンさんの公式ウェブサイトに声明が掲載されました。 「ラリーは愛するダラスに戻り、彼が最も愛した役を再び演じていました」と声明には記されています。「感謝祭には家族や親しい友人たちが集まり、彼は愛する人々に囲まれて静かに旅立ちました。本人の望み通りの穏やかな最期でした。ご家族はプライバシーへのご配慮をお願いしています。」 ハグマンさんは1978年、プライムタイムのソープオペラ『ダラス』で油田王J.R.ユーイングを演じ、一躍スターとなりました。そのキャラクターはテレビ史に残る悪役となりました。 1980年には「J.R.は誰に撃たれた？」のストーリーラインで大ブレイクし、世界中で3億5,000万人以上が注目しました。1980年11月21日に放送されたエピソードで、犯人がJ.R.の義理の妹クリステン・シェパードと判明し、この回はテレビ史上でも屈指の高視聴率を記録しました。 ハグマンさんは他のキャスト陣とともに『ダラス』に14シーズン出演し、1991年に番組は終了。その後2012年6月にTNT版のリブート版でもJ.R.役を再び演じ、来年1月放送予定のシーズン2にも出演シーンが収録されています。（なお、CNNとTNTは共にタイム・ワーナーとターナー・ブロードキャスティングの傘下です。） 彼は役柄を楽しんで演じており、「In Hagman We Trust」と書かれた自身の顔入りの偽100ドル札をファンに配ったことでも知られています。 CNNでの最後のインタビューの一つでは、オリジナルキャストのリンダ・グレイやパトリック・ダフィーとともに出演。グレイは広報担当者を通じて声明を発表し、35年以上の親友だったハグマンさんを「クリエイティブで寛大、ユーモアがあり、愛情深く才能に溢れたオリジナルな存在だった」と称えました。 訃報を受け、ファンや著名人から追悼の声が次々と寄せられました。ウィリアム・シャトナーはツイッターで哀悼の意を表し、TNTもハグマンさんを称賛し家族にお悔やみの言葉を送りました。 ハグマンさんはテキサス州フォートワース生まれ。母は女優のメアリー・マーティン、父は弁護士のベン・ハグマンです。ニューヨークのバード大学に短期間在学した後、ダラスやニューヨークで舞台に立ちました。イギリスでは母とともに『南太平洋』に出演し、米空軍時代には舞台のプロデュースや演出も手掛けました。その後ハリウッドに渡り、数々のテレビ番組に出演しています。 1965年にはバーバラ・イーデンと共演した人気シットコム『かわいい魔女ジニー』で、メジャーのトニー・ネルソン役が大当たり。イーデンさんはフェイスブックで、共演時の思い出を温かく振り返りました。 『かわいい魔女ジニー』終了後も、数多くのテレビ番組や1990年代のドラマ『オーリンズ』などに出演。私生活ではアルコール依存や肝硬変、1995年には命を救った16時間に及ぶ肝移植手術も経験しました。近年は妻のアルツハイマー病とも向き合い、2011年には治療可能ながんであることを自ら公表しています。 ハグマンさんは、妻、息子、娘、そして5人の孫に見守られて旅立ちました。
post_content: TV legend Larry Hagman, known as J.R. Ewing on 'Dallas' and Maj. Nelson on 'I Dream of Jeannie,' has died at 81. His legacy lives on in TV history. Rest in peace, Larry. #Dallas #LarryHagman #TVLegend

article_content: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is investigating Elon Musk's $44 billion acquisition of Twitter (now X) and his initial investment in the company. Musk is currently refusing to sit for an interview with the SEC. On Thursday, the SEC asked a California federal court to compel Musk to comply with a subpoena issued in May that requires him to provide testimony regarding the case. According to the SEC's filing, the commission is conducting 'an ongoing nonpublic investigation... regarding whether, among other things, Musk violated various provisions of the federal securities laws' during his secret purchase of Twitter shares in early 2022 and his subsequent acquisition, as well as statements he made about the deal. While a previous legal filing last year revealed that Musk was under federal investigation, it did not specify which agency was involved or outline the details. 'The SEC seeks Musk's testimony to obtain information not already in the commission's possession that is relevant to its lawful investigation,' the agency stated. 'The SEC has followed all proper procedures in seeking Musk's testimony. Due to Musk's refusal to comply, the commission is asking the court to intervene.' Musk previously provided the SEC with half a day of testimony in July 2022, but the agency says it needs further questioning as it has since received thousands of new documents, including many from Musk himself. 'The SEC has not yet had an opportunity to question Musk about these materials and other new information collected since July 27, 2022,' the filing noted. After extended communications with Musk's lawyer, who the SEC says never objected to another interview, Musk agreed to appear on September 15 in San Francisco but failed to do so. Musk's attorney, Alex Spiro, told Insider: 'The SEC has already taken Mr. Musk's testimony multiple times in this misguided investigation — enough is enough.' According to the SEC, Musk notified them two days before the scheduled testimony that he would not appear, raising new objections such as the location of the interview and citing the impending publication of his biography, requiring his lawyers to review its content. The SEC attempted to set another date and location for the interview, but Musk ultimately refused further cooperation. The commission is now asking the court to order Musk to sit for the interview. Twitter did not respond to requests for comment.
translated_content: 米証券取引委員会（SEC）は、イーロン・マスク氏による440億ドルでのTwitter（現在X）の買収と初期投資について調査を進めています。マスク氏は現時点でSECの聞き取りに応じることを拒否しています。木曜日、SECはカリフォルニア州連邦裁判所に、5月に発出した証言召喚状にマスク氏が従うよう命じるよう要請しました。SECの提出書類によると、委員会は『2022年初頭のマスク氏によるTwitter株の非公開取得とその後の買収、そして同取引に関して行った発言が連邦証券法の複数規定に違反した可能性があるか等について進行中の非公開調査』を行っているとのことです。昨年の別案件の書類でマスク氏が連邦当局の調査対象であると明らかになっていましたが、機関名や詳細は当時明示されていませんでした。『SECは合法的な調査に関連し、まだ委員会の手元にない情報を得るためにマスク氏の証言を求めています。適切な手続きをすべて踏まえていますが、マスク氏が応じないため、裁判所の介入を要請しています』とSECは説明しています。マスク氏は2022年7月に半日の証言を行いましたが、その後本人を含むさまざまな関係者から提出された数千点の新証拠により、さらに尋問が必要だとSECは主張。『2022年7月27日以降に集められた資料や新たな情報について、まだマスク氏に質問する機会がありません』とのことです。SECによれば、マスク氏の弁護士とのやりとりの末、マスク氏は9月15日にサンフランシスコで証言することに同意しましたが、当日出頭しなかったとされています。マスク氏の弁護士アレックス・スピロ氏はInsiderに『SECはすでにこの的外れな調査でマスク氏から複数回証言を取っており、これ以上は不要です』と語りました。SECによると、証言予定の2日前にマスク氏は、証言場所への異議や自身の伝記出版を理由に証言を延期する旨を通知。その後、SECは別の日程や場所を提案しましたが、マスク氏は最終的に全面的な証言拒否に転じたといいます。現在、SECは裁判所に対し、マスク氏に証言出頭を命じるよう求めています。Twitterからのコメントは出ていません。
post_content: SEC wants Elon Musk to talk about his $44B Twitter (now X) buy, but he's refusing to show up. They're taking it to court! 🏛️ #ElonMusk #SEC #TwitterDrama

article_content: As the iconic 'Frozen' franchise celebrates its 10th anniversary, Disney fans are enjoying the recently opened 'World of Frozen' at Hong Kong Disneyland. The company is also revealing bold global expansion plans. With enhanced parks and cruise lines, Disney is preparing for a major transformation that reaches far beyond Arendelle. Disney's $60 Billion Vision: A Commitment to Growth Disney has announced a capital investment of $60 billion over the next decade to upgrade its parks, cruise lines, and experiences. CEO Bob Iger and Disney Experiences Chairman Josh D'Amaro presented this forward-looking initiative, reaffirming Disney's dedication to storytelling and expanding its magical universe. The Expanding Realm of Frozen 'World of Frozen' at Hong Kong Disneyland is just the beginning. Frozen-themed areas are also being developed at Disneyland Paris and Tokyo Disney Resort, suggesting wider global expansion. Jennifer Lee, co-director of 'Frozen' and Chief Creative Officer of Walt Disney Animation Studios, hinted that ongoing Frozen adventures may require more space in Disney parks. The enchanting journeys of Elsa, Anna, and Olaf will continue. A Sneak Peek at Disney's Global Park Projects Major developments are coming to Disney's international parks. Next month, Shanghai Disney Resort will debut its Zootopia-themed land, equipped with cutting-edge technology. Disneyland Paris is reimagining its hotel with a regal motif, and Tokyo DisneySea's Fantasy Springs—featuring attractions inspired by Frozen, Tangled, and Peter Pan—will open in June. Tokyo Disneyland is renovating Space Mountain and Tomorrowland, targeting a 2027 completion. Innovation Through Technology Shanghai Disney's Zootopia land boasts innovative technology for immersive experiences. Disney pushes boundaries with enhanced animatronics and free-roaming robots, first playtested at Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge, enriching guest interactions and enjoyment. A Future of Tradition and Innovation Disney's growth includes new projects for Walt Disney World and Disneyland. Fans can look forward to a blend of Disney classics and new immersive attractions, such as Tiana's Bayou Adventure at Magic Kingdom in 2024 and the Pixar Place Hotel in Disneyland, opening January 30. article_content: More than 100 of the UK's most dangerous sex offenders—including paedophiles and violent rapists—have had their names removed from the Sex Offenders' Register, according to new revelations. These offenders used a human rights ruling to argue that they no longer pose a threat to the public. So far, 108 individuals have successfully appealed, including some convicted for grave offences such as the rape of a girl under 13, burglary with intent to rape, and buggery. In one case, a police force removed an offender who had been convicted of seven counts of indecent assault on a boy under 16 from the register. The figures were obtained via the Freedom of Information Act and refer to applications made since the law was enacted in September of the previous year. Nearly half of the applicants were successful, with removals averaging almost four per week. Previously, those placed on the register were listed for life, required to inform authorities about their whereabouts, and had to notify the police if they moved near a school or young family. Now, following a human rights ruling, offenders who have been monitored for 15 years can apply to have their names removed from the register. Peter Saunders, chief executive of the National Association for People Abused in Childhood, described the situation as 'downright dangerous.' He argued that victims endure lifelong consequences due to their abusers, and questioned the fairness of allowing so many perpetrators to be removed from police monitoring. In London, 19 offenders—including 17 convicted rapists—were removed from the register by the Metropolitan Police. Other forces also removed offenders: South Yorkshire Police (12), Greater Manchester Police (10), Cambridgeshire Constabulary (6, including someone convicted of indecent assault on a male under 16), and Suffolk (one convicted of incest). In another case, West Yorkshire Police rejected an application for removal by a 71-year-old offender, but District Judge Christopher Darnton overturned the decision, stating that the order had 'served its purpose.' Assistant Chief Constable Michelle Skeer of the Association of Chief Police Officers said the Sexual Offences Act 2003 and multi-agency public protection arrangements remain vital tools in managing offenders. She emphasized the need to balance public protection with individual rights, per the Supreme Court judgment, and highlighted that a thorough review process is now in place to assess risks before removal from notification requirements.
translated_content: 英国で最も危険な性犯罪者100人以上が、児童性愛者や暴力的なレイピストを含め、性犯罪者登録簿から名前を削除されていたことが明らかになりました。これらの犯罪者は人権に関する判決を利用して、自分たちがもはや公衆に脅威を与えないと主張しました。これまでに108人が訴えに成功しており、その中には13歳未満の少女への強姦や、強姦目的の侵入、男色行為で有罪となった者も含まれます。 ある警察は、16歳未満の少年へのわいせつ行為7件で有罪となった者を登録簿から削除しました。 これらの数字は情報公開法により取得され、昨年9月に法律が施行されて以来の申請に関するものです。申請者のほぼ半数が成功し、削除のペースは週にほぼ4件となっています。 以前は、登録された者は生涯登録が必要で、居住場所や学校や子どもの近くへ転居する場合は警察に通知する義務がありました。しかし現在、人権判決により、15年間監視されてきた犯罪者は名前の削除を申請できるようになりました。 児童期に虐待を受けた人々の全国協会（NAPAC）のCEO、ピーター・ソーンダース氏は、この状況を「非常に危険だ」とコメントしました。彼は、被害者は加害者によって一生苦しみ続けているとし、これほど多くの者が警察の監視から外れることの公正さに疑問を投げかけています。 ロンドンではメトロポリタン警察が19人（うち17人は強姦犯）を登録簿から削除しました。他にもサウスヨークシャー警察（12人）、グレーター・マンチェスター警察（10人）、ケンブリッジシャー警察（16歳未満男子へのわいせつ行為で有罪の者を含む6人）、サフォーク（近親相姦で有罪の者1人）が削除しました。 ウェストヨークシャー警察は71歳の性犯罪者の削除申請を却下しましたが、クリストファー・ダールトン地方判事が「命令は既に役目を果たした」として、決定を覆しました。 警察長協会（ACPO）の副最高警視ミシェル・スキアー氏は、2003年性犯罪法と複数機関による公共安全対策が依然として重要な管理手段だとし、最高裁判所の判決を踏まえ、個人の権利と市民の安全のバランスの重要性、そして削除前の厳密なリスク評価体制の重要性を強調しました。

article_content: As former Italian Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi faces his final appeal against a four-year prison sentence for tax fraud, his daughter, Barbara Berlusconi, has been seen enjoying a holiday in Sardinia. On Tuesday, Barbara spent time with economics student Lorenzo Guerrieri, highlighting a new relationship after her breakup with footballer Alexandre Pato in March. The pair, accompanied by friends, appeared relaxed as they lounged and swam at Villa Certosa in Porto Rondo, showing little sign of concern over Barbara’s family's ongoing legal troubles. Guerrieri, who works evenings at a wine shop to fund his studies, looked comfortable with Barbara. These images of the couple mark Barbara’s first public romance since ending her two-year relationship with Pato, whose move to Corinthians had separated them. Meanwhile, Silvio Berlusconi’s defense team is preparing a last-chance appeal, due by July 30. Berlusconi's lawyer, Franco Coppi, voiced frustration about the rapid scheduling of the court date, arguing it gives the defense little preparation time. The expedited timeline may be intended to prevent the statute of limitations from expiring on one charge. Berlusconi was previously convicted of inflating the prices of film distribution rights purchased by his company, Mediaset. He lost his first appeal in May, and the court upheld a four-year sentence and a five-year ban from public office—a verdict he claims is politically motivated. While the upcoming hearing represents his final opportunity to overturn the conviction, legal analysts note that Berlusconi might avoid serving jail time due to his age. The tax fraud conviction is one of multiple legal cases he has confronted, including a recent sentence for alleged involvement with an underage prostitute and abuse of power.

article_content:
David Velazquez, former director of the FBI's Newark Field Office and most recently the head of World Trade Center security, resigned on Friday after a series of widely publicized security breaches. His resignation followed incidents such as BASE jumpers leaping from One World Trade Center in late 2013 and a New Jersey teenager bypassing a guard to reach the roof recently.

The New York Post first reported that Velazquez resigned as assistant director for security for the Durst Organization, which manages the site, and a spokesperson confirmed his resignation was accepted. Velazquez spent 31 years at the FBI before taking the WTC security role in August 2013. Weeks after his appointment, BASE jumpers parachuted off the 1,776-foot building, igniting scrutiny over site security.

Security concerns intensified after 16-year-old Justin Casquejo from Weehawken, New Jersey, allegedly entered the construction site through a fence opening, took an elevator operated by a construction worker, and evaded a guard reportedly asleep to access the roof earlier this month.

Abdul Basher, a 65-year-old security guard recognized as '2013 Security Officer of the Year,' was photographed apparently sleeping in the building's lobby at 2:45 a.m., days after Casquejo's breach. Basher, who claimed he was 'exercising' his eyes due to poor vision and job stress, was immediately dismissed upon discovery of the incident. He criticized the security division’s management and described the work as highly stressful.

Port Authority officials confirmed Basher's termination and expressed concern over the security lapses. The Durst Organization also indicated plans to review management of its security contractor. Construction workers voiced frustration following the photo's release.

Earlier, CNN producer Yon Pomrenze and cameraman Connor Boals were arrested trying to reveal WTC security flaws. Alongside the BASE jumpers' actions, their attempts prompted officials to emphasize the need for respect at the site.

James Brady and Andrew Rossig, the BASE jumpers, surrendered to authorities and later shared video footage of their September jump, gaining viral attention. Casquejo, the teen climber, was charged with misdemeanor trespass after his unauthorized ascent.

Police investigation revealed Casquejo entered through a narrow fence opening, climbed scaffolding, rode an elevator to the 88th floor, and reached the roof by slipping past the sleeping guard, who has since been dismissed. The elevator operator kept his job due to union protections.

These incidents have prompted calls for enhanced security and ongoing evaluations of site security protocols.

元FBIニューアーク支局長であり、ワールドトレードセンターのセキュリティ責任者を務めていたデビッド・ベラスケス氏が、相次ぐ重大なセキュリティ違反を受けて金曜日に辞任しました。2013年末にはベースジャンパーがワンワールドトレードセンターから飛び降り、最近ではニュージャージーの10代の若者が警備員をすり抜けて屋上に到達した事件がありました。

ニューヨーク・ポスト紙によると、現場を管理するダースト・オーガニゼーションのセキュリティ担当補佐役を辞任したと報じ、広報担当者も辞任が受理されたことを確認しました。ベラスケス氏はFBIに31年間勤務した後、2013年8月にWTCのセキュリティ責任者に就任。その数週間後、ビル1,776フィートの頂上からベースジャンパーが飛び降り、セキュリティ体制への懸念が高まりました。

続いて、ウィーホーケン出身の16歳ジャスティン・カスケホ君がフェンスの隙間から進入し、工事作業員が操作するエレベーターで88階まで行って、仮眠中の警備員をすり抜けて屋上へ到達する事件も発生しています。

2013年「今年のセキュリティオフィサー」表彰の65歳警備員アブドゥル・バッシャー氏も、カスケホ君の事件の数日後、午前2時45分ごろビルロビーで居眠りしている姿を撮影されました。バッシャー氏は、視力の問題と業務のストレスから「目の運動をしていた」と釈明したものの、発覚直後に解雇され、部門の管理や過酷な環境を批判しました。

ポート・オーソリティ側もバッシャー氏の解雇と一連のセキュリティ違反への懸念を表明。ダースト・オーガニゼーションは警備会社の管理体制を再検討すると述べました。建設作業員も写真の流出について不満を漏らしています。

更にCNNのヨン・ポムレンゼ・プロデューサーとカメラマンのコナー・ボールズ氏がWTCの警備問題を明らかにしようとして逮捕されました。ベースジャンパーらの行動もあわせ、当局や関係者は現場への敬意や警備強化の必要性を強調しています。

ベースジャンパーのジェームズ・ブレイディ氏とアンドリュー・ロジグ氏は出頭後、9月のジャンプ映像をネットで公開し、注目を集めました。カスケホ君も不法侵入で軽犯罪に問われています。

警察によれば、カスケホ君はフェンスの隙間から進入、足場を登ってエレベーターで88階に上がり、仮眠中の警備員をすり抜けて屋上へ。その警備員は解雇、エレベーター係は組合員で職を保っています。

これらの事件を受け、さらなる警備強化と管理体制の見直しが進められています。

article_content: Tom Brokaw, the veteran former anchor of NBC Nightly News, is receiving treatment for multiple myeloma, a type of blood cancer, after his diagnosis at the Mayo Clinic last August. At 74, Brokaw’s doctors express optimism about his progress, and he describes himself as 'the luckiest guy I know.' Throughout his treatment, Brokaw has continued to contribute to NBC, working on a two-hour documentary about JFK’s assassination and appearing on 'TODAY,' 'Nightly News with Brian Williams,' 'Meet the Press,' and MSNBC. He’s also part of NBC Sports’ coverage for the Sochi Winter Olympics. In a statement, Brokaw thanked his family, healthcare team, and friends for their strong support, and said he looks forward to continuing to live and work. During a 2012 interview with CNN, Brokaw explained that Peter Jennings’ passing from lung cancer inspired his retirement, so he could prioritize personal interests over newsroom demands. The article also briefly notes that Leonard Nimoy has been diagnosed with a lung disease.

article_content: Steve Froggatt, a 58-year-old man from Preston, Lancashire, reportedly sought revenge against his ex-girlfriend, Pauline Woodfine, by throwing eggs at her house and killing her pet parrot after their breakup. Froggatt used a spare key he had received to retrieve his things to enter Woodfine's home. Woodfine, a retired nurse recently treated for cancer, returned to find her African Grey parrot, Deano, missing from his cage and feathers scattered on the floor. When Woodfine confronted Froggatt by text asking why he killed her pet, he allegedly replied, 'You killed me.' Froggatt admitted to police that he killed the parrot because it annoyed him, though the bird's body was never found. Police had attended several previous domestic incidents at the property, but no charges had been filed before this incident. Froggatt, a former brewery worker, pleaded guilty to two counts of criminal damage—one involving Deano and another for damage to the home's brickwork. He remains in custody and is due at Preston Magistrates’ Court on October 7.

article_content: Fortnum & Mason, the renowned British department store, has introduced a gourmet take on baked beans called Proper Beans. These beans are distinguished by upscale ingredients such as onions, apple, and smoked bacon. Handcrafted with fresh, high-quality components, they stand in contrast to traditional tinned beans. The luxury comes at a higher price—Proper Beans cost £3.95 per pot, considerably more than mainstream brands that are usually less than £1. A recent taste comparison featuring Proper Beans, Heinz, Waitrose, and Tesco found Proper Beans offered the best flavor and quality. At the heart of the brand is founder Ben Mason, who, inspired by his father’s homemade baked beans, sought to reimagine a staple food that had largely remained unchanged for years. Proper Beans offers both classic and innovative recipes, from traditional pork with haricot beans and tomatoes to vegetarian varieties and selections using British-grown fava beans. With four available flavors, including smoked bacon & English mustard, these beans are sold from the chilled section at Fortnum & Mason. After leaving his career in advertising, Ben Mason dedicated himself to developing Proper Beans, prioritizing taste and freshness. He highlights the absence of processed additives—every ingredient is easily found in stores. While some people were skeptical of his venture, Mason’s commitment has resulted in a premium, more wholesome alternative to standard baked beans.

article_content: Intense fighting erupted late Monday in Taiz, Yemen, marking the most violent clashes since protests against the government began four months ago. Eyewitnesses reported heavy gunfire near the Republican Palace, not far from Freedom Square, where tens of thousands of anti-government demonstrators had gathered. Many of these witnesses chose to remain anonymous out of fear for their safety. The anti-government gunmen engaged in these confrontations were reportedly trying to shield protesters, who have faced repeated attacks from security forces over the past two months. Just last week, the United Nations and several international groups criticized the Yemeni government following the deaths of up to 50 protesters in Taiz. The current unrest follows reports from Saudi state media that President Ali Abdullah Saleh underwent medical procedures in Saudi Arabia. Saleh travelled there after suffering injuries in a rocket attack on his presidential compound. Conflicting accounts surround the president's health, with some Western diplomats indicating he had brain surgery, while his party dismissed these claims as minor checkups. U.S. officials stated Saleh sustained shrapnel wounds and serious burns, noting the full extent of his injuries remains uncertain. As President Saleh recovers, Vice President Abed Rabbo Mansour Hadi has stepped in as acting leader. According to U.S. sources, Hadi’s role is largely transitional, though he may emerge as a future contender in post-Saleh elections. Some tribal leaders have responded to Hadi’s calls for a cease-fire, giving him a degree of influence within the government. Still, analysts question whether this support will last, as Yemen’s military loyalty may be tested by ongoing turmoil. Security officials warn that the chaotic situation has allowed al Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula (AQAP) to take advantage, especially in southern areas like Abyan province. AQAP is increasing its activities, aiming to expand control either independently or through local alliances. Recent clashes in Abyan have been particularly deadly. Monday saw four soldiers and five civilians killed in Zinjibar, while dozens more were injured over the weekend. Senior Interior Ministry authorities confirm at least 10 government troops died in ambushes on Saturday and Sunday. While AQAP’s numbers remain limited, U.S. officials emphasize the group’s potency and say its growing presence could influence Yemen’s political and military stability. American counterterrorism operations face greater difficulty amid the unrest, as Yemeni intelligence gathering has been vital but may now slow or stop. White House press secretary Jay Carney confirmed that President Obama’s security adviser, John Brennan, has spoken with acting leader Hadi, though details of their conversation are not public. On the political front, opposition leaders like Tawakkul Karman and Ahmed Bahri have said they support Hadi's leadership temporarily, provided he enacts genuine reforms. They caution that if Hadi fails to deliver, protest movements may challenge him as they did with Saleh. Despite a cease-fire negotiated between the government and the influential Hashed tribal confederation, fresh violence erupted in Sanaa, leaving three tribesmen dead. Tribal spokesmen blamed government snipers, while officials denied involvement. Hostilities have simmered since an attack on the presidential compound reportedly linked to government opponents. The fragile cease-fire comes after weeks of fierce battles between government forces and tribes allied with the opposition, set against a backdrop of ongoing mass protests demanding Saleh’s resignation. The largest opposition bloc insists they will prevent the president from returning to the country.
translated_content: イエメンのタイズでは月曜日の夜、過去4か月間の反政府抗議運動以来、最も激しい戦闘が発生しました。目撃者によると、数万人の反政府デモ参加者が集まる「自由広場」近く、共和宮殿周辺で激しい銃撃があったとのことです。多くの目撃者は安全確保のため匿名を希望しました。 これらの戦闘に加わった反政府武装勢力は、過去2か月間に何度も治安部隊に攻撃されてきたデモ参加者を守るためだったとされています。先週、国連や複数の国際団体は、タイズで最大50人のデモ参加者が死亡したことを受け、イエメン政府を強く批判しました。 現在の混乱は、サウジアラビア国営メディアが、アリ・アブドラ・サーレハ大統領が同国で治療を受けていると報じた後に起きました。サーレハ大統領は、自身の大統領公邸へのロケット攻撃で負傷し、サウジに移送されました。彼の健康状態については利害関係者の間で見解が分かれており、一部の西側外交筋は脳外科手術を受けているとする一方、政権関係者は「簡単な検査」だと主張。米国当局は、サーレハ氏が破片による傷と深刻な火傷を負っており、容体はまだ不明だと述べています。 サーレハ大統領が療養中の間、アブド・ラッボ・マンスール・ハディ副大統領が暫定指導者として役割を担っています。米国筋によれば、ハディ氏は基本的に一時的な存在と見られていますが、今後の選挙で候補となる可能性もあるとのこと。一部の部族指導者は停戦呼びかけに応じており、ハディ氏には一定の影響力がありますが、イエメン軍の忠誠が今後も維持されるかは不透明だと指摘されています。 治安関係者は、混乱の中で「アラビア半島のアルカイダ（AQAP）」が南部のアビヤン県などで勢力を伸ばそうとしていると警告しています。AQAPは自力、または地元勢力と連携しながら支配範囲拡大を図っています。 アビヤン県での最近の戦闘は特に激しく、月曜日にはジンジバルで兵士4名と市民5名が死亡、週末にも多数が負傷しました。内務省高官によれば、土日だけで政府軍10名が待ち伏せ攻撃で死亡したとされています。 AQAPの人数自体は限定的ですが、米国当局は組織の影響力に警戒を強めており、存在感拡大がイエメンの政治・軍事情勢に影響を及ぼす恐れがあると述べています。アメリカの対テロ活動も混乱で難航しており、重要なイエメン当局からの情報収集が停滞または停止するリスクがあります。 ホワイトハウスのジェイ・カーニー報道官は、オバマ大統領の安全保障顧問ジョン・ブレナン氏がハディ暫定指導者と電話会談したことを明らかにしましたが、詳細は非公開です。 政治分野では、反体制指導者のタワックル・カルマン氏やアフメド・バフリ氏などが、ハディ氏が本格的な改革を進める限り一時的に支持する姿勢を示しています。改革を怠れば、サーレハ氏同様に再び抗議運動の標的になると警告しました。 政府と影響力のあるハシュド部族連合との間で停戦が成立したものの、サヌアで新たな暴力が発生し、3人の部族民が死亡しました。部族側は政府狙撃手の犯行だと主張し、政府は否定しています。大統領公邸襲撃以降、敵対行為が続いています。 この脆弱な停戦は、サーレハ退陣を求める数週間に及ぶ政府軍と親野党の部族勢力との激しい戦闘を受けたものです。最大野党連合はサーレハ大統領の帰国阻止を固く決意しています。

article_content: Reporting on the Nobel Prize science categories remains a complex task for even the most experienced newsrooms, like NPR. This complexity became evident recently as NPR responded to a listener’s questions about their coverage. Although Nobel Prize winners are announced every October and are revered as some of the world’s highest honors in both science and literature, advance media coverage tends to be minimal—especially compared to the extensive buildup surrounding entertainment or sporting events like the Super Bowl or Oscars. One barrier is the extreme secrecy of the Nobel nomination process, which keeps potential nominees undisclosed for at least half a century. Without nominees or speculation, extensive coverage before the winners are announced is nearly impossible. NPR's Science Desk focuses its reporting on the announcement of the winners. For instance, recent coverage featured Norwegian playwright Jon Fosse’s Nobel win in literature, recognized two scientists awarded the physiology or medicine Nobel, and highlighted human rights activist Narges Mohammadi, who remains imprisoned in Iran but was honored with the Peace Prize for her advocacy for women’s rights. NPR also interviewed her husband about the significance of this award. Nell Greenfieldboyce, a science correspondent for NPR, shared that editorial teams consciously discuss how to approach Nobel news each year. She notes that NPR has reported on challenges with the Nobel system, including its limited transparency, persistent disparities in gender and race among winners, and the restrictive rule of honoring at most three living contributors to any discovery—often overlooking the many others involved in groundbreaking research. Greenfieldboyce also emphasized the presence of other significant science awards, such as the Lasker Awards. She warned that focusing primarily on the Nobels could distort public understanding of how science is conducted and who is involved. While listeners suggest more in-depth features on Nobel laureates would be valuable, the consensus is that NPR’s present coverage is both suitable and sufficient, though the team is open to growth. NPR balances these major stories with reporting on local issues. A recent segment took listeners inside workplaces in North Dakota, where an increasing number of immigrants—such as those from Ukraine—are being employed through programs addressing labor shortages. Joel Rose’s reporting explored both the successes and the community tensions arising from refugee resettlement. The NPR Public Editor team, including editors and reporters, regularly reviews feedback and acknowledges both the newsroom’s accomplishments and areas needing improvement. They encourage ongoing dialogue from their audience, inviting comments and concerns through various contact channels.
translated_content: ノーベル賞の科学部門を報道することは、NPRのような経験豊富なニュースルームであっても複雑な作業です。最近、NPRがリスナーから寄せられた報道姿勢に関する質問に対応したことで、この難しさが改めて明らかになりました。 ノーベル賞の受賞者は毎年10月に発表され、科学や文学分野で世界最高峰の栄誉とされていますが、受賞発表前のメディアによる事前報道は、スーパーボウルやオスカーなどのエンターテインメントやスポーツイベントと比べるとごく限られています。 その一因は、ノーベル賞のノミネートプロセスが極めて秘密主義であり、候補者名が50年以上非公開であることにあります。候補者や噂話が存在しないため、受賞者発表前に詳細な報道を行うのは事実上不可能です。 NPRのサイエンスデスクは、受賞者が発表されたタイミングで主に報道を集中させています。最近では、ノルウェーの劇作家ヨン・フォッセの文学賞受賞や、2人の科学者による生理学・医学賞受賞、そしてイランで投獄中の人権活動家ナルゲス・モハンマディが女性の権利擁護活動により平和賞を受賞したことを取り上げ、彼女の夫にもインタビューしました。 NPRのサイエンス特派員ネル・グリーンフィールドボイスは、編集チームが毎年ノーベル賞報道のあり方について意識的に議論していると語ります。彼女は、NPRがノーベル賞制度の課題――選考過程の不透明さ、受賞者の性別や人種の偏り、最大で3名の存命貢献者しか対象にならないという制限についても報道してきたと述べました。こうした制約により、数十年にわたって多くの研究者が共同で成し遂げた功績が見過ごされがちです。 グリーンフィールドボイスは、ラスカー賞など他にも重要な科学賞があることも強調しています。ノーベル賞ばかりに注目し過ぎると、現代科学の成り立ちや関係者の多様性に対する認識が歪められると警告しています。 リスナーからは受賞者に深く迫る特集を望む声もありますが、現状NPRの報道は適切で十分であるものの、今後さらなる成長の余地があると認識されています。 こうした大きな話題に加え、NPRでは地域の課題も取り上げています。最近ではノースダコタ州の職場を取材し、ウクライナ出身者など移民が労働力不足解消を目的としたプログラムで増加している現状や、難民受け入れを巡る地域社会の成功例や緊張感にも焦点を当てました（ジョエル・ローズのレポート）。 NPRのパブリックエディターチームは編集者・記者を含めて定期的に読者からの反応を検証し、報道の成果や課題を認識しています。視聴者との対話を重視し、今後もさまざまな方法で意見や質問を受け付けています。
post_content: Why don’t Nobel Prizes get the hype of the Oscars or Super Bowl? NPR breaks down the secretive process, challenges for fair recognition, and how their coverage balances the spotlight. Plus: a look at North Dakota’s immigrant workforce. #NobelPrize #News #BehindTheScenes #Immigration

article_content: At its recent Pixel event, Google rolled out a slew of new devices and software improvements. Headlining the announcement were the Pixel 8, Pixel 8 Pro, and Pixel Watch 2, but the software enhancements are just as noteworthy. The latest Pixel Feature Drop introduces an updated camera interface on the Pixel 8, allowing users to effortlessly switch between photo and video modes with a new toggle. For owners of the Pixel Fold, interpreter mode gets a boost as translations now display simultaneously on both internal and external screens, making communication in multiple languages smoother. Android 14 brings expanded customization, letting users refresh their lock screens with new clock styles, wallpapers, and dynamic monochrome themes courtesy of the Material You system. Flexibility is enhanced with the option to personalize lock screen shortcuts for quicker access to favorite features. Families will appreciate the revamped navigation bar on Pixel tablets for kids, streamlining the way young users interact with their devices and switch between apps. The Pixel Tablet also gains the ability, via Google Assistant, to play news and podcasts while the device is docked in hub mode. Although the launch's spotlight was on the new hardware, Google's wide-ranging software upgrades boost the overall capabilities of the Pixel ecosystem, offering users a more customizable and user-friendly experience across devices.
