article_content: The UPSC Weekly News Express presents major current affairs highlights from the past week, supporting UPSC-CSE exam preparation. Topics covered include India’s Global Hunger Index (GHI) 2023 ranking, ISRO’s Trajectory Correction Maneuver (TCM) for the Aditya-L1 spacecraft, government reforms in critical mineral policy, analysis of the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) 2022-23, and updates on India's AI and semiconductor initiatives. India ranked 111th out of 125 countries in the GHI 2023, with a score of 28.7, indicating a serious hunger situation. The Indian government has rejected the index, citing methodological flaws and possible malafide intent. India’s position was lower than those of neighboring Pakistan (102), Bangladesh (81), Nepal (69), and Sri Lanka (60). The GHI is compiled by Concern Worldwide (Ireland) and Welthungerhilfe (Germany). According to GHI 2023, India’s undernourishment rate stands at 16.6%, under-five mortality at 3.1%, and anemia among women aged 15–24 at 58.1%. The index also reports India's child wasting rate at 18.7%, the highest worldwide. The Indian government argues these indicators, especially child health measures, do not reflect hunger levels for the entire population. The Ministry of Women and Child Development states that three of the four GHI indicators focus on children's health rather than national population nutrition. The main undernourishment indicator is based on a survey with a small sample size. Data from the Poshan Tracker indicates that since April 2023, child wasting in India has consistently remained below 7.2%, contrasting with the higher GHI figure. The 2023 GHI highlights that global progress against hunger has stalled in recent years, with undernourishment rising due to climate change, conflicts, and events like the Russia-Ukraine war. ISRO recently executed a Trajectory Correction Maneuver (TCM) for Aditya-L1 to ensure it stays on course for the Sun-Earth Lagrangian point L1. TCMs are essential for deep space missions where precise trajectory control over long distances is required. Aditya-L1 will study the Sun’s atmosphere and space weather from orbit around L1. Satellite data in September 2023 revealed a giant ozone hole over Antarctica, measuring 26 million square kilometers. Experts attribute the unusually large size in part to volcanic eruptions, which contributed atmospheric water vapor and chemicals. Global action through the Montreal Protocol has previously helped reduce ozone-depleting substances. The government amended mining laws to set competitive royalty rates for lithium, niobium, and rare earth elements, encouraging private investment. These minerals are key for batteries, energy storage, and high-tech applications, and lower royalty rates aim to boost domestic mining as India currently imports much of its requirement. PLFS 2022-23 showed a drop in unemployment and an increase in labor force participation, notably among women. Many new jobs are self-employment or unpaid work in family businesses, raising concerns about job quality. Monthly wages have not increased substantially in real terms; more workers are now in agriculture. India’s AI initiative aims to help build a $1 trillion digital economy by 2026, focusing on growing domestic data sets, investing in AI infrastructure, and supporting semiconductor advances. These measures are intended to strengthen India’s position in technology and reduce reliance on imports.
translated_content: UPSCウィークリーニュースエクスプレスは、過去1週間の主な時事ニュースをまとめており、UPSC-CSE試験対策に役立ちます。本号では、インドのグローバル・ハンガー・インデックス（GHI）2023の順位、ISROのアディティア-L1による軌道修正マヌーバ（TCM）、戦略的鉱物政策の改革、「定期労働力調査（PLFS）2022-23」の要点、インドのAIや半導体分野の動向などが取り上げられています。 インドはGHI 2023で125か国中111位（スコア28.7）と深刻な飢餓問題を示しました。政府はこの評価指標に方法論上の欠陥や意図的な不備の可能性があるとして反論しています。隣接国パキスタン（102位）、バングラデシュ（81位）、ネパール（69位）、スリランカ（60位）より下位でした。GHIはアイルランドのConcern WorldwideとドイツのWelthungerhilfeが作成しています。 GHI 2023によればインドの栄養不足率は16.6％、5歳未満児死亡率は3.1％、15～24歳女性の貧血率は58.1％です。また、児童消耗症率は18.7％で世界最高水準とされています。政府は、これら指標が児童中心のため、国全体の飢餓状況を正確に表していないと主張しています。 女性・子ども開発省は、GHI指標の大半が児童健康を重視しており、主要指標は小規模な調査データに依存していると指摘。ポーショントラッカーの2023年4月以降のデータでは、児童消耗症率が7.2％未満に抑えられており、GHI報告値との差を主張しています。 2023年GHIは気候変動、紛争、ロシア・ウクライナ戦争などの影響で世界的な栄養不足が拡大傾向にあると伝えています。 ISROはアディティア-L1のTCMを実施し、太陽－地球ラグランジュ点L1への進路を確保しました。TCMは火星探査など長距離宇宙ミッションで重要な操作であり、アディティア-L1はL1地点で太陽大気や宇宙天気を観測する予定です。 2023年9月、南極上空で約2,600万平方キロメートルという巨大なオゾンホールが観測されました。これは火山噴火による水蒸気や化学物質の影響も指摘されています。国際的にはモントリオール議定書によるオゾン層保護策が進められています。 政府はリチウム、ニオブ、レアアースのロイヤリティ税率を国際水準に引き下げ、民間投資を促す法改正を行いました。これら鉱物は電池や先端産業に不可欠で、今後の国産化と関連産業の強化が期待されています。 PLFS 2022-23の調査では失業率が低下し、特に女性の労働参加が増加。ただし、多くは家族事業の無給または自営業で、雇用の質には課題があります。実質賃金の伸びは限定的で、農業従事者も増えています。 インドのAI戦略は2026年までに1兆ドル規模のデジタル経済を目指し、国内データ基盤整備やAI・半導体分野への投資を推進しています。これにより技術面での自立と輸入依存脱却を目指しています。

This is part two of a two-part series on the best used luxury cars. According to a recent report from Consumer Reports magazine, a list of the best and worst used cars was issued, separated by price ranges. The Porsche 911, offered in several versions, has earned its reputation as a "supercar." Using Consumer Reports’ recommendations as a guide, here are some of the top used luxury cars currently available in the $30,000+ price range:

2007 Acura MDX
The 2007 Acura MDX is a deluxe crossover SUV introduced on a dedicated platform, not adapted from a passenger car. Available in Base, Technology, and Sport packages, all versions are powered by a 3.7-liter, 300-hp V6 engine. Notable features include a voice-activated navigation system, rearview camera, and AcuraLink satellite communications with real-time traffic.

2007 BMW 328i Sedan
The 2007 BMW 328i is a renowned sports sedan with European styling and precise handling. It is powered by a 3.0-liter, 230-hp inline six-cylinder engine, available with either a six-speed manual or automatic transmission. Consumer Reports also recommended the 3-Series coupe and convertible models introduced that year.

2004 BMW M3
The 2004 BMW M3 is the high-performance variant of the 3-Series coupe, available as a coupe or convertible. It offers 333 horsepower, making it a strong contender in terms of acceleration and handling and often compared with the Porsche 911 for driving dynamics.

2007 Infiniti FX35
The 2007 Infiniti FX35 is a luxury crossover known for its blend of SUV spaciousness, high-end amenities, and robust engine. It features a 280-hp, 3.5-liter V6 engine paired with a five-speed automatic transmission.

2006 & 2007 Infiniti M
The Infiniti M series includes the M35, powered by a 275-hp V6, and the M45, featuring a 325-hp V8. Both models are praised for their sleek design, strong performance, and luxury features like standard leather upholstery and optional 10-way power-adjustable driver's seats.

Lexus Models 
Consumer Reports highlighted several Lexus models in this segment, including the 2006-07 GS RWD, 2007 GS450h Hybrid, 2005-07 GX, 2007 IS, 2004-07 LS, 2003-06 LX, and 2006-07 RX. Lexus consistently ranked first in the JD Power Dependability Survey for 12 years until 2007, when Buick tied for first place.

Porsche 911 (Various Years)
The Porsche 911, especially in more recent model years, has continued to be acknowledged as a 'supercar.' For 2007, buyers could choose from multiple body styles and engines, such as the Carrera with its 3.6-liter, 325-hp engine; the Carrera S and S Cabriolet with a 3.8-liter, 355-hp engine; the 911 Turbo featuring a twin-turbocharged 480-hp engine; and the track-focused GT3 with a 415-hp engine.

article_content: The U.S. Space Force has unveiled its first official artwork—a retrofuturistic painting depicting a tense moment in low Earth orbit. At a Friday ceremony, Space Operations Command, one of the Space Force’s key branches, revealed the piece titled 'High Ground Intercept.' The painting was commissioned from aviation and defense artist Rick Herter, and is meant to convey the concept of space as the next arena for military operations. In the scene, a U.S. spaceplane blocks an adversary’s satellite, preventing it from disabling a friendly satellite. The spaceplane, reminiscent of an older sibling protecting another from a bully, was visually inspired by the 1950s Boeing X-20 Dyna-Soar—an historic Air Force project—since details of the Space Force’s own Boeing X-37 remain highly classified. Due to this secrecy, Herter was asked to rely on past designs and his imagination to complete the artwork. To ensure accuracy, he constructed a basic model to use as a reference for his painting. Space Force command historian Christopher Rumley praised Herter for blending historical context with modern vision, acknowledging the challenge posed by classified material. Since its creation in 2019, the Space Force has aimed to communicate its purpose to the public, but has faced skepticism and confusion. Efforts such as its theme song 'Semper Supra' and a succinct, ambiguous mission statement have contributed to its mysterious image. Although Space Force’s main role includes protecting U.S. interests in space by overseeing launches, tracking objects, and maintaining essential satellites used for navigation, weather, and communications, observers note its public messaging often highlights the combative side. As international competition in space grows, there are concerns over whether a confrontational stance is the most effective approach. For more stories about spaceflight, follow Gizmodo’s updates on X (formerly Twitter) or visit their Spaceflight page.

In June 2010, the war in Afghanistan became the longest conflict in American history, surpassing the Vietnam War. Despite the U.S. having removed the Taliban from power and killing Osama bin Laden last year in Pakistan, recent incidents have undermined American efforts, costing the trust of many Afghans. These include a tragic event in which a U.S. soldier allegedly went rogue, killing at least 16 Afghan civilians—including nine children and three women—near a U.S. base in southern Afghanistan. President Obama expressed deep sadness over the killings and offered condolences to the victims' families and the Afghan people, emphasizing that such actions do not reflect the ideals of the U.S. military.

This event follows the accidental burning of Qurans at Bagram Airfield last month, which fueled violent protests across Afghanistan, leading to 39 deaths—including several American soldiers—and hundreds of injuries. Earlier, a video surfaced showing four American soldiers desecrating Afghan corpses, an act condemned by U.S. officials as a violation of both military law and the Geneva Conventions.

These high-profile incidents have raised serious questions about the future of the U.S. mission in Afghanistan. Journalist Andrew Sullivan has argued that after the Quran burning, it is unlikely U.S. forces can remain until the planned withdrawal in 2014. He suggests that cultural differences make a successful transition improbable. Afghanistan, often referred to as the 'graveyard of empires,' has repelled foreign powers throughout its history. Henry Kissinger and policy sources from the CATO Institute have warned that unless America scales down its objectives, it may face a similar fate.

Looking back on a decade of conflict, the U.S. has achieved some key goals, such as eliminating Osama bin Laden, transitioning power to a civilian government—notwithstanding its flaws—and improving conditions for some Afghan women. Nevertheless, these positive outcomes risk being overshadowed by recent tragedies and controversies, raising concerns that the sacrifices made during the war may have been in vain. The author argues these incidents underscore the urgent need to begin withdrawing U.S. troops from Afghanistan.

(The views expressed are solely those of Arsalan Iftikhar.)

2010年6月、アフガニスタンの戦争はベトナム戦争を超え、アメリカ史上最長の戦争となりました。米国はタリバンを政権から排除し、昨年パキスタンでオサマ・ビンラディンを殺害しましたが、最近の複数の事件がアメリカの努力を損ない、多くのアフガニスタン市民からの信頼を失っています。その一例として、米兵が「暴走」し、南部の米軍基地近くで少なくとも16人（うち9人が子ども、3人が女性）の民間人を殺害した悲劇的な事件がありました。オバマ大統領は深い悲しみを表明し、被害者とその家族、アフガニスタン国民に哀悼の意を伝えるとともに、「このような行為は米軍の理想を代表するものではない」と強調しました。

この事件は、先月バグラム空軍基地でのコーラン焼却事件に続いたものであり、アフガニスタン各地で暴動が発生し、39人（数名の米兵を含む）が死亡、数百人が負傷しました。その以前には、4人の米兵がアフガン人の遺体を冒涜する映像が公開され、米国当局はこれを軍法とジュネーブ条約の違反と厳しく非難しました。

こうした重大事件が続く中、アフガニスタンでの米国の活動の将来について深刻な疑問が生じています。ジャーナリストのアンドリュー・サリバン氏は「コーラン焼却事件の後、2014年まで米軍が駐留し続けるのは困難」と主張し、文化的な差異が成功裏の移行を妨げていると指摘。アフガニスタンは「帝国の墓場」と呼ばれ、歴史的に多くの外勢を退けてきました。ヘンリー・キッシンジャー元国務長官やCATO研究所も、目標を見直さない限りアメリカも同じ運命をたどる可能性があると警告しています。

これまでの10年余りの間で、ビンラディンの排除や民間政権への移行（一部には問題があるものの）、アフガン女性の地位向上など一定の成果は見られました。しかし、最近の悲惨な事件や論争が、こうした成果に影を落とし、戦争で失われた命が無駄になったのではという懸念も強まっています。著者は、これらの事件が米軍の早期撤退の必要性を示していると強調します。

（本記事はアーサラン・イフティカール氏個人の見解です。）

article_content: Listeners of Philadelphia’s Q102 won’t be hearing any Taylor Swift music this weekend. The popular radio station has announced that, ahead of the city’s football team’s game against the Kansas City Chiefs (and Swift’s boyfriend, Travis Kelce) on Monday night, the Eagles need no distractions. "The Eagles/Chiefs game is Monday night, and we need the Birds to focus," said Q102 on-air personality and Program Director Buster Satterfield in a news release. "Q102 loves Taylor Swift as much as the rest of the world, but this weekend, the only Swift and Kelce we recognize play for the Birds." Kelce’s brother, center Jason Kelce, and running back D’Andre Swift both play for the Eagles. Q102’s final Swift song of the weekend is set to play at 5 p.m. ET today. Taylor Swift is expected to return to the station’s playlist on Tuesday after the game—a move that also serves as a lighthearted publicity stunt. "This weekend we gotta focus, so we’ve been forced to punt Taylor Swift from the playlist," Satterfield said earlier this week on Good Day Philadelphia. Meanwhile, Swift is currently in Brazil on her Eras Tour, performing in Rio de Janeiro through Sunday and resuming next weekend in São Paulo. She has no shows scheduled for Monday night.

article_content: Lee Padgett, a Navy veteran living with disability, transformed her drive into entrepreneurship by launching Busted Bra Shop in Detroit. The boutique, catering to a wide array of sizes with bras from A to O and various lingerie, has since expanded to Chicago and other Michigan cities. Padgett faced multiple setbacks on her journey: limited startup capital, local construction that blocked customer access, the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic, and the United Auto Workers (UAW) strike that impacted Detroit’s economy. Through each challenge, she shifted her strategy—building an online store, introducing virtual fittings, and finding new ways to serve customers. Her military background gave her essential skills like discipline, adaptability, teamwork, and problem-solving. These proved invaluable as she built her business. Studies show female veterans are opening businesses at higher rates than their overall presence among veterans, but struggle more than men to secure financing—nearly half have been denied business loans, and women-owned businesses earn less than those owned by men. Before her business ventures, Padgett intended to become an actress. Illness changed her path, leading her to enlist in the Navy, where a serious accident required a long recovery. With military support, she continued her education and eventually moved to Detroit, where she realized a lack of accessible lingerie stores left many women underserved. Persistence and flexibility defined Busted Bra Shop’s growth. Padgett opened pop-up stores when construction deterred shoppers from her main location. Startup competitions and backing from community members helped her raise the initial funds. During the pandemic, she embraced virtual events and remote fittings, keeping clients engaged and her staff employed. Organizations like Hello Alice, offering resources and a supportive network, aided Padgett when crises like the UAW strike made business even tougher. The end of the strike has now brought renewed optimism for her shop and other small local businesses. Padgett’s achievements show how resilience, creative adaptation, and supportive communities are crucial for entrepreneurs—especially women and veterans confronting systemic obstacles.

Police are investigating whether the murder of a California couple, Bradford Hans Sachs, 57, and Andra Resa Sachs, 54, is connected to complaints about their property business. The couple was found shot dead in their bedroom in their Orange County home on Sunday at around 2 a.m. Their eight-year-old adopted son was also seriously injured during the incident. Despite being divorced, the Sachses continued to live together in their San Juan Capistrano mansion with their five children. At the time of the attack, two of their teenage daughters and their eight-year-old son were at home, while their two eldest children were away at college.

Neighbors expressed shock at the violence, while several tenants who rented property from the couple reported having issues with their business practices. Ken Baum, a tenant, claimed that the couple changed business names frequently and instructed tenants not to reveal whom they were renting from. His son, Bryce Baum, added that the couple had repeatedly changed business names over the year and a half they rented from them.

Andra Sachs was listed on California's top tax avoiders list in 2011, allegedly owing $1.15 million, though her name was removed the following year after disputing the amount. The couple faced several complaints and legal challenges, including posts on the Ripoff Report website and disputes over rental agreements. One alleged former tenant reported the couple had not paid a court-ordered $8,000 deposit refund. Police have not released a motive or named any suspects in the ongoing investigation. Emergency services responded to the home around 2 a.m. after receiving reports of 'unknown trouble.'

article_content: USB-C was designed to be a universal port, but in reality, it’s challenging to identify the differences between Apple’s $130 Thunderbolt 4 cable (with 20 conductors and 100W power delivery) and a $3 charging cable with far fewer capabilities you might find at a convenience store. Industrial design company Lumafield used X-ray imaging to reveal the internal differences between these cables, highlighting what’s hidden beneath their outer sheaths. Ultimately, buyers select cables based on their requirements for data transfer speed, power delivery, form factor, and durability. Industrial CT scans offer a look into the engineering behind these everyday accessories, showing that even standardized products like USB-C cables can feature inventive design and efficient manufacturing. Looking forward, the mention of USB 4.3 Gen 2 UltraSpeed [U]III with Asymmetric Encapsulation is a tongue-in-cheek reference to the ever-growing complexity of USB standards.

article_content: The familiar food pyramid, once the symbol of a healthy diet, is being replaced. On Thursday, First Lady Michelle Obama, Agriculture Secretary Tom Vilsack, and Surgeon General Regina Benjamin will introduce a new plate-shaped food icon, aimed at reminding people to make healthier food choices, according to the White House. The unveiling will take place at the Department of Agriculture auditorium. While the icon has not been described in detail, a statement from the Department of Agriculture explains it is intended as a simple, easy-to-understand visual cue to encourage healthy eating habits. Elizabeth Cohen, senior medical correspondent for CNN, said the plate is likely divided into sections to show recommended portions of different food groups. This initiative is part of Michelle Obama's larger effort to combat childhood obesity. Earlier this year, she launched the Let's Move campaign, which aims to significantly reduce childhood obesity in the United States within one generation. During her announcement in February, Obama urged parents, teachers, doctors, coaches, and children to get involved, recommending they visit the Let's Move website for tips and updates.

Former Knicks guard Larry Hughes was reportedly escorted from the Trump SoHo hotel this afternoon as part of an investigation into a sexual assault. Hughes was seen leaving the lower Manhattan hotel after attending a Knicks-themed event at the Greenhouse nightclub the previous night. Police told MailOnline that Hughes has not been arrested. 'There is an ongoing investigation regarding a sexual assault,' law enforcement officials said.

Larry Hughes, 35, was met by police at his hotel room around noon, according to the New York Post. After a brief discussion, he agreed to accompany the police for an interview about an earlier incident. Hughes told the paper, 'It wasn’t me.'

A hotel employee declined to comment, stating only, 'We respect the privacy of our guests,' before ending the call. Hughes, who played for the Knicks for two seasons starting in 2008, is at the center of this investigation. Social media posts indicate that Greenhouse hosted a Knicks-themed end-of-season party on Thursday night, which Hughes reportedly attended. It is unclear who else was at the event, but no other former or current Knicks players are involved in the investigation. A call to Greenhouse was not returned.

Hughes has since been released from police custody and is currently at home, according to police sources. He was not arrested, and the investigation is ongoing. The six-foot-five, 184-pound Hughes played 13 seasons in the NBA after being selected eighth overall by the Philadelphia 76ers in the 1998 NBA Draft out of Saint Louis University. He played with the Knicks from 2008 to 2010 and averaged 14.1 points per game during his career, earning almost $85 million, according to Pro Basketball Reference.

article_content:
Banks are rapidly embracing the tokenization of real-world assets, leveraging blockchain technology to enhance settlement efficiency and revolutionize traditionally illiquid markets. Over the past five years, major financial institutions have accelerated their exploration and adoption of tokenization at scale. Today, it is uncommon for Tier-1 and Tier-2 banks not to have a digital asset or blockchain initiative underway, with many steadily investigating ways to tokenize tangible assets.

Notable milestones include ABN Amro’s €450,000 bond issuance on the Stellar blockchain in January 2023, and the European Investment Bank’s €100 million bond placed last November with the support of Goldman Sachs, Société Générale, and Santander. J.P. Morgan has pioneered cross-currency transactions using tokenized deposits in Japanese Yen and Singapore Dollars. Despite volatility in cryptocurrency markets, more tokenization projects are moving towards live production. According to Boston Consulting Group, the total market value of tokenized illiquid assets such as real estate and natural resources could approach $16.1 trillion by 2030.

In essence, blockchain enables organizations to represent real-world assets as digital tokens that can be embedded with data and programmable features, automating compliance and enabling actions such as clawbacks or freezes. This comprehensive encapsulation of asset data allows secure 24/7 trading and provides transparent, real-time transaction records.

Asset classes like foreign exchange and equities already benefit from digital efficiencies, but tokenization stands to transform assets that rely on manual trading and settlement processes. There are four principal benefits driving financial institutions to adopt tokenization:

1. Faster and More Efficient Settlement: Traditional asset servicing can slow settlements due to manual intervention or imposed waiting periods to manage counterparty risk. With blockchain-based tokenization, transactions can settle almost instantly, delivering operational benefits such as reduced asset 'trapping.' For example, in February 2023, Siemens issued a €60 million digital bond via the Polygon blockchain, demonstrating this increased agility.

2. Automated Processes: Tokenization supports end-to-end automation in asset servicing and transactions, reducing reconciliation complexity and minimizing error by providing a single source of truth. Smart contracts, enabled by token programmability, automate functions like calculations, compliance checks, and fund disbursements. The Hong Kong government leveraged this by issuing $100 million in tokenized green bonds using Goldman Sachs’ GS DAP protocol in February 2023.

3. Fractional Ownership: Traditionally, fractional ownership of assets demands complex legal structures and high administrative costs, limiting participation and liquidity. With tokenized titles, ownership and management become simpler, lowering entry barriers and opening investment opportunities, particularly in sectors like real estate, infrastructure, and venture capital. In April 2023, the total value of tokenized gold surpassed $1 billion, illustrating this democratization.

4. Real-Time Transaction Data: The immutable nature of blockchain ledgers grants both banks and clients real-time, auditable transaction data, eliminating costly and cumbersome management systems while enabling a consolidated view of diverse asset portfolios.

Tokenizing real-world assets has wide-reaching implications, from real estate to art and commodities. BNY Mellon’s recent survey revealed that 97% of institutional investors believe tokenization will transform asset management. Leading firms such as BlackRock and State Street also acknowledge its disruptive potential. As traditional financial institutions invest in and evolve within the tokenization space, the financial sector stands on the brink of a major transformation.

銀行は、ブロックチェーン技術を活用して現実世界の資産のトークン化を積極的に進めています。これは決済の効率化や、従来流動性の低かった市場の変革を目指す動きです。ここ5年間で、大手金融機関はトークン化の導入を加速し、現在ではTier-1やTier-2銀行の多くがデジタル資産やブロックチェーンの取り組みを進めています。

特筆すべき事例として、ABNアムロ銀行が2023年1月にStellarブロックチェーンで45万ユーロの債券を発行、欧州投資銀行が2022年11月にゴールドマン・サックス、ソシエテ・ジェネラル、サンタンデールらと1億ユーロの債券を発行した実績があります。JPモルガンも、トークン化された日本円およびシンガポールドル預金によるクロスカレンシー取引を先駆的に実施しました。暗号資産市場の変動にもかかわらず、より多くのトークン化プロジェクトが実用段階に近づいています。ボストン・コンサルティング・グループによれば、不動産や天然資源など流動性の低いトークン化資産の市場規模は、2030年までに16.1兆ドルに達すると予測されています。

ブロックチェーン技術によって、リアル資産をデジタルトークンとして表現し、データや自動化された機能を組み込むことで、コンプライアンス処理やクロー バック、フリーズ対応などが実装可能です。この包括的な資産データ管理で、24時間365日、安全で透明性のある取引やリアルタイムの取引履歴が実現します。

外貨や株式などの資産クラスは既にデジタル化の恩恵を享受していますが、トークン化により手作業主体だった資産取引や決済のあり方が抜本的に変わろうとしています。金融機関がトークン化を推進する4つの主な理由は以下の通りです。

1. より迅速かつ効率的な決済： 従来の資産サービスでは手作業やリスク管理による遅延が生じますが、ブロックチェーンにより即時決済が可能となり、資産の「閉じ込め」も減らせます。2023年2月、シーメンスはPolygonブロックチェーンで6,000万ユーロのデジタル債券を発行し、その俊敏性を示しました。

2. プロセスの自動化： トークン化により資産管理や取引プロセスがエンドツーエンドで自動化されるため、調整作業の削減やミスの低減が可能です。トークンのプログラム性により、計算やコンプライアンスチェック、資金分配が自動化されます。香港政府は2023年2月にゴールドマン・サックスのGS DAPプロトコルを活用し、1億ドルのトークン化されたグリーンボンドを発行しました。

3. 小口所有権： これまで資産の小口化には複雑な法的構造や高コストが必要でしたが、トークン化は所有や管理をシンプルにし、参入障壁を下げて新たな投資家の参加を促進します。不動産、インフラ、ベンチャーキャピタル分野で特に効果的です。2023年4月にはトークン化ゴールドの市場価値が10億ドルを突破しました。

4. リアルタイム取引データ： ブロックチェーン台帳を活用することで、銀行や顧客がリアルタイムで監査可能な取引データを得られ、管理コストの高いシステムが不要となり、多様な資産の一元管理が容易になります。

現実資産のトークン化は、不動産からアート、コモディティまで幅広く金融を変革します。BNYメロンの調査では97％の機関投資家が資産運用への影響力を認めており、ブラックロックやステート・ストリートなど大手もその可能性に注目。伝統的金融機関がトークン化分野で躍進するなか、金融業界は大きな変革期を迎えています。

Major players like ABN Amro, JP Morgan and BlackRock are leading the way. #Tokenization #FutureFinance #BlockchainRevolution

article_content: Abbey Clancy has been revealed as the face and model for Ultimo's festive lingerie collection. The mother-of-one displays her toned physique as she showcases the brand's new bras. Michelle Mone OBE, Ultimo's founder, said: 'There is no better way to refresh your lingerie drawer than with a splash of color, and this gorgeous new set is the perfect way to get into the festive spirit. Choosing the right lingerie is as important as picking the perfect party dress; it helps you feel sexy, comfortable, and well supported. Good lingerie creates the foundation for any outfit and can make a world of difference to how you look and feel. Ultimo’s heritage is about enhancing the female form, with emphasis on cleavage boosting and uplift.' In the new promotional photoshoot, Abbey is pictured reclining on a sofa, highlighting the brand's festive offering. Abbey recently told Grazia she did not wear a bra until she was 16, explaining she was flat-chested until she experienced a sudden growth. She said, 'I've got a long relationship with underwear—I’d go so far as to say I have a lingerie fetish. It’s the key thing to make you feel good.' Abbey, 28, has also recently been named the face of an Avon fragrance and starred alongside her mother, Karen, 53, in promotional images for the product, Cherish, which launches in time for Mother’s Day. Abbey recently joined makeup artist Charlotte Tilbury in Manchester for a supermodel makeover. Abbey credits her appearance to good genes and praised her mother’s youthful looks, saying, 'My mum is 51 and hasn’t had any work done, yet she still looks like my sister. She’s a goddess.' The festive lingerie range is available now at www.ultimo.co.uk, priced at £30 for the bra and £14 for the matching briefs.

article_content: SpaceX is set to conduct the second test launch of Starship, the largest rocket ever constructed, with liftoff planned from Starbase in Boca Chica, Texas. The launch is scheduled for 7:00 am local time (1300 GMT) and will be streamed live on SpaceX's website and on X, the social media platform owned by Elon Musk. This follows Starship's first fully stacked test flight in April, which ended four minutes after launch when the two stages failed to separate, leading to the controlled destruction of the rocket over the Gulf of Mexico. Starship is a centerpiece in Elon Musk's vision to colonize Mars, and NASA is also planning to utilize a modified version of the rocket for the Artemis mission to land humans on the Moon. Both NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) and Starship are designed to be fully reusable to help reduce space exploration costs. Standing at 397 feet (121 meters), Starship surpasses the Statue of Liberty by 90 feet. Its Super Heavy booster produces 16.7 million pounds (74.3 Meganewtons) of thrust, nearly double that of NASA's operational SLS rocket. If successful, the booster will land in the Gulf of Mexico shortly after launch, and the upper stage will nearly complete an orbit around Earth, landing in the Pacific Ocean near Hawaii after about 90 minutes. Since the first test, SpaceX has made several design changes, most notably introducing 'hot staging,' a method where the upper stage engines ignite while still attached to the booster, a technique common in Russian rockets. The launchpad has also been reinforced with high-strength concrete and equipped with a water deluge system to protect against heat and force. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) recently approved the next test launch after a months-long investigation, despite lawsuits from conservation groups who argue that environmental regulations were not adequately followed. In other business news, Apple aims to produce nearly ₹1 lakh crore worth of iPhones in India by the fiscal year ending March 2024, as production capacity increases. The government is also examining the possibility of transferring unclaimed Sahara-Sebi Refund Account funds to the Consolidated Fund of India, with provisions for investor claims. Additionally, Nawaz Modi, estranged wife of Gautam Singhania, is seeking three-quarters of his net worth for their daughters and herself as part of a family settlement.
translated_content: スペースXは、これまでで最大のロケットであるスターシップの2回目の試験打ち上げを行う予定です。打ち上げはテキサス州ボカチカのスターべースから現地時間午前7時（日本時間午後10時）に予定されており、スペースXのウェブサイトやイーロン・マスク氏が所有するソーシャルメディア「X」でライブ配信されます。これは4月に行われたスターシップの最初のフルスタック試験飛行に続くもので、その際は2段分離に失敗し、4分後に制御破壊されメキシコ湾上空で爆発となりました。 スターシップはイーロン・マスク氏による火星移住計画の中核を担っており、NASAも人類を月へ送るアルテミス計画用に改良型の同ロケット使用を計画しています。NASAのスペースローンチシステム（SLS）とスターシップは、いずれもコスト削減を目指し、完全再利用可能な設計となっています。 スターシップは全高397フィート（121メートル）で、自由の女神像を約90フィート上回ります。スーパーヘビーブースターの推力は1,670万ポンド（74.3メガニュートン）で、NASAのSLSロケットのほぼ2倍です。 試験が成功した場合、ブースターは打ち上げ後間もなくメキシコ湾に着陸し、上部ステージはほぼ地球一周を行い、約90分後にハワイ近郊の太平洋に着水する予定です。 初回試験以降、スペースXは特に「ホットステージング」を導入するなど、いくつかの設計変更を施しました。これは上段エンジンをブースターに接続したまま点火する方式で、ロシアのロケットで一般的です。また、発射台も高強度コンクリートと水噴射システムによって強化され、発射時の熱と力から保護されます。 連邦航空局（FAA）は数か月にわたる調査の末、環境団体による法規順守への懸念の訴訟が続く中で今回の試験打ち上げにゴーサインを出しました。 その他のビジネスニュースでは、Appleが2024年3月期までにインドで1兆ルピー相当のiPhone生産を目指しています。また、政府は未請求のサハラ-セビ返金口座の資金をインド連邦基金へ移管する可能性を検討中で、投資家の請求にも対応する方針です。さらにゴータム・シンガニア氏の別居中の妻ナワズ・モディ氏は、二人の娘と自分のために資産の4分の3を求めています。

Inclement weather hampered efforts to evacuate 29 Myanmar soldiers, including a major and a captain, who fled to Mizoram after their camp in Myanmar’s Chin state was overtaken by civilian armed forces, officials reported. On Friday and Saturday, adverse weather conditions across Mizoram prevented the Indian Air Force (IAF) from airlifting the soldiers out of the state. Cyclonic storm "Midhili," caused by a deep depression over the Bay of Bengal, brought moderate to heavy rain to northeastern states like Mizoram on Friday, disrupting daily life. The sky remained overcast on Saturday, but officials expected that improved weather on Sunday would allow the evacuation to proceed.

Mizoram’s Inspector General of Police (Headquarters), Lalbiakthanga Khiangte, stated that 29 more Myanmar soldiers, including a major and a captain, arrived in Mizoram’s Champhai district on Thursday evening after their camp was seized. The soldiers approached local police and were handed over to the Assam Rifles, who are currently providing custody and accommodation at the Vaphai Assam Rifles camp.

Since Monday, a total of 74 Myanmar military personnel have fled to Mizoram amid escalating clashes between the Myanmar Army and pro-democracy forces like the People’s Defence Force (PDF). On November 14, about 39 of these soldiers were repatriated to Myanmar.

There has also been a fresh influx of refugees, as the Myanmar Army continues fierce clashes with the Chinland Defence Force (CDF) since Sunday. Over 5,000 refugees have recently taken shelter in Mizoram, pushing the total to more than 32,000 Myanmar nationals, including women and children, who have sought refuge in the northeastern Indian state. Most are staying in relief camps and government buildings, while others are housed by relatives or live in rented accommodations.

Six districts in eastern Mizoram—Champhai, Siaha, Lawngtlai, Serchhip, Hnahthial, and Saitual—share a 510-kilometer, largely unfenced mountainous border with Myanmar’s Chin state. The Assam Rifles, responsible for guarding India’s 1,643-km border with Myanmar, have increased patrols and vigilance along the frontier.

悪天候のため、ミャンマーのチン州で民間武装勢力によって基地が占拠された後、少佐と大尉を含む29人のミャンマー兵士がミゾラム州に逃れてきましたが、避難が難航していますと関係者が伝えました。金曜日と土曜日、ミゾラム全域の悪天候によりインド空軍（IAF）は兵士たちの空輸を行うことができませんでした。

ベンガル湾の深い低気圧によって発生したサイクロン「ミディリ」の影響で、金曜日にはミゾラムを含む北東部地域で中程度から激しい雨が降り、日常生活に大きな影響が出ました。土曜日も空は厚い雲に覆われていましたが、日曜日には天候が回復し、避難作業が進む見込みです。

ミゾラム警察本部長のラルビアクタンガ・キアンテ氏によると、木曜の夜、少佐と大尉を含む29人のミャンマー兵士が基地を奪われた後、チャンパイ地区に到着しました。兵士たちは地元警察に接触し、現在はヴァファイ・アッサム・ライフルズ・キャンプでアッサム・ライフルズの管理下で保護されています。

今週初めから、ミャンマー軍と民主化勢力（PDF）の衝突が激化し、合計74人の軍人がミゾラムへ逃れてきています。11月14日には、そのうち約39人がミャンマーに送還されました。

また、最近ではチンランド防衛軍（CDF）との衝突が激しくなっている影響で、5,000人以上の新たな難民がミゾラムに避難。現在ミャンマーから避難している人々は女性や子どもを含めて合計で3万2,000人を超えています。大半は救援キャンプや行政の施設で生活し、それ以外は親族宅や賃貸住宅を利用しています。

ミゾラム東部の6地区（チャンパイ、シアハ、ラングトライ、セルチップ、ナイタリアル、サイトゥアル）は、ミャンマーのチン州と510キロの未柵で山岳地帯の国境を接しています。アッサム・ライフルズは1,643キロに及ぶインド・ミャンマー国境で警備を強化しています。

article_content: Josh Williams, driver of the No. 92 Alloy Employer/DAN-O'S Chevrolet, showed appreciation to fans with a hand heart gesture as he walked onstage during driver introductions before the NASCAR Xfinity Series Food City 300 at Bristol Motor Speedway. Williams, known for his modesty and hands-on approach to working on his own cars, just reached a significant milestone in his career. On Thursday, Kaulig Racing announced it has signed Williams to drive its flagship No. 11 Chevrolet in the Xfinity Series for 2024. Alloy Employer Services, a long-time partner of Williams, will be the lead sponsor next season. "After only an hour in the shop, I already feel like it’s home," Williams said in a press release. "I’ve known many of these guys for a long time, and I believe joining this team gives us a great opportunity to get wins. That’s the goal—trophy hunting." Williams has spent most of his Xfinity Series career with DGM Racing, a smaller team compared to Kaulig Racing, achieving 11 top-ten finishes with them since 2019. Now at Kaulig Racing, he is expected to compete for victories as he adapts to the team’s equipment. The team recorded four wins in 2023 with three different drivers. In the ARCA Menards Series, Williams raced for his family-owned team, winning two races in 2016. His standout performance, especially beating larger teams, made him a fan favorite and led to his ongoing role with DGM Racing. In 2023, Williams gained widespread attention when he parked his car on the finish line at Atlanta Motor Speedway in protest of NASCAR's order to park his damaged vehicle. He was suspended for the following race, but used the publicity to raise money for the Ryan Seacrest Foundation. "Josh Williams has fought for every opportunity in his racing career, and we’re excited to have him join us," said Chris Rice, president of Kaulig Racing. "We love his energy and passion at the track, and believe his character and ambition will fit right in with our team." Williams will replace Daniel Hemric, who moves to the team’s No. 31 Cup Series entry in 2024. AJ Allmendinger is expected to return to the Xfinity Series as Williams’ teammate, and Ty Dillon is expected to be announced as Kaulig’s second Cup driver next season. Last year, Williams was nominated for the Comcast Community Champion of the Year award for his dedication to children. He has visited over 150 hospitals in person and virtually, meeting countless children and families to offer support. The NASCAR Xfinity Series season kicks off at Daytona International Speedway on February 17, airing on FS1.

article_content: ByteDance, the company behind TikTok, is shutting down its Nuverse gaming division and withdrawing from the mainstream video gaming industry, sources told Reuters. ByteDance currently has no plans to return to the $185 billion global gaming market. By December, employees working on unreleased games will be instructed to stop their projects. The company is also seeking to sell or otherwise divest from games that have already launched, a move that could affect hundreds of staff. However, ByteDance's casual gaming operations remain unaffected. The Ohayoo brand—which operates on China's Douyin platform—and casual games available on TikTok will continue as usual. ByteDance did not provide comment. Recently, the company has searched for buyers for Moonton Technology, its game development subsidiary, and made large cuts to its virtual reality company, Pico. Launched in 2019, Nuverse represented ByteDance's ambition to expand into global gaming and take on major competitors like Tencent. Nuverse released games such as "Marvel Snap"—which gained a following but was not a big commercial hit—along with "One Piece: The Voyage" and "Crystal of Atland." In 2021, Nuverse became an official business unit and acquired studios like C4games to grow its capabilities. The original article included unrelated news about other companies, which are not relevant to ByteDance’s recent decisions.

article_content:
A captivating view of the Great Sphinx, with the pyramids of Menkaure and Khafre in the background in Giza, Cairo, Egypt. The Great Sphinx of Giza remains mysterious. The colossal half-man, half-lion statue was created around 2500 B.C.E. for Pharaoh Khafre, builder of Giza’s Second Pyramid. Yet questions remain about the terrain the ancient Egyptians encountered when building the Sphinx—and whether the environment influenced its formation.

To explore this, scientists from New York University replicated the climatic conditions from the Sphinx’s era to study how wind could have shaped the local rock formations. “Our findings offer a possible 'origin story' for how Sphinx-like formations can arise from erosion,” says Leif Ristroph, associate professor at NYU's Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences and lead author of the study.

Ristroph and his team at NYU’s Applied Mathematics Laboratory used mounds of soft clay containing harder, less erodible material to mimic the Mokkatam Formation—a sequence of sediment layers covering the Giza Plateau. They exposed these models to a fast-flowing stream of water, simulating wind erosion. This process gradually shaped Sphinx-like forms, as the softer clay was worn away and the harder core remained.

“The unexpected shapes come from how the flows are diverted around the harder or less-erodible parts,” Ristroph explains. The more resistant material formed the ‘head’, while other features like an undercut ‘neck’, ‘paws’ in front, and an arched ‘back’ appeared as the softer material was removed.

The result was a lab-made Sphinx formed by simulated erosion. “Our results provide a simple origin theory for how Sphinx-like formations can come about from erosion,” Ristroph concludes. He notes that natural yardangs, wind-eroded formations found mostly in deserts, can resemble animals at rest, lending support to this theory.

Yardangs—meaning “steep bank” in a Turkic language—are created as winds carry dust and sand, shaping rocks into odd forms over time. At Dunhuang Yardang National Geopark in China’s Gobi Desert, these landforms developed over 700,000 years.

The study also found that the Sphinx faces the prevailing wind direction, consistent with a yardang origin. The research, “Sculpting the Sphinx,” will appear in Physical Review Fluids (2023). Additional material and interviews were provided by New York University.

美しいスフィンクスの景観が広がり、背後にはギザのメンカウラーとカフラーのピラミッドがそびえます。ギザの大スフィンクスは今なお多くの謎に包まれています。この巨大な半人半獅子の像は、紀元前2500年頃、ギザの第2ピラミッドの建設者カフラー王のために作られました。しかし、古代エジプト人がスフィンクスを造った当時の地形や、自然環境がその形成にどのように影響したのかは解明されていません。

この謎を解き明かすため、ニューヨーク大学の科学者たちがスフィンクス建造当時の気象条件を再現し、風が現地の岩にどのような影響を与えたかを実験しました。「今回の研究は、スフィンクスのような形が浸食によってどのように生まれるかを示す“起源説”となります」と、ニューヨーク大学コーラント数理科学研究所のリーフ・リストロフ准教授（主任著者）は説明します。

リストロフ氏らのグループは、ギザ高原に広がるモカッタム層を模し、柔らかい粘土に硬く侵食されにくい素材を埋め込んだ模型を作成しました。その模型に速い水流（風を模擬）を当てることで、柔らかい部分が削られ、硬い中心部が残るようにし、最終的にスフィンクスの姿のように形作られました。

「流れが硬い部分の周囲で迂回するため、思いがけない形状が生まれます」とリストロフ氏は語ります。硬い素材が“頭”となり、その他にも“くびれた首”や“前に突き出した足”、“アーチ状の背中”などが柔らかい材料が削れることで現れました。

こうして実験室で形成されたスフィンクスも浸食によって生まれました。「私たちの成果は、スフィンクスに似た形態が浸食でできるというシンプルな起源説を示しています」とリストロフ氏は結論付けています。砂漠に存在する自然のヤルダン（風食地形）の中には、動物が座った姿に見えるものもあり、この理論の根拠となっているそうです。

ヤルダンは、トルコ語で「急斜面」という意味で、主に砂漠にある風による侵食でできた地形です。砂や砂塵が風によって岩石を削り、長い年月をかけて奇妙な形に仕上げます。中国・ゴビ砂漠の敦煌ヤルダン国家地質公園の岩も、約70万年の歳月をかけて形成されました。

また、研究では、スフィンクスが卓越風を向いていることもわかり、ヤルダン起源説をさらに裏付けています。論文「Sculpting the Sphinx」は、2023年『Physical Review Fluids』誌に掲載予定です。追加資料やインタビューはニューヨーク大学より提供されています。
post_content: Did you know the Sphinx of Giza might owe its shape to wind and erosion? 🦁💨 NYU researchers recreated ancient conditions and got a mini Sphinx in the lab—just by letting wind (and water) do its thing! #AncientMysteries #SphinxScience #HistoryNerd

article_content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has remained in close contact with Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami as the mission to rescue 41 workers trapped in the Silkyara tunnel stretches into its ninth day after a landslide incident on November 12. Arnold Dix, an international expert from the International Tunneling and Underground Space Association based in Geneva, has joined experts on site to review rescue strategies. Cooperation between central and state authorities continues, with essential rescue tools, food, water, and medical supplies being provided to the workers underground. Regular updates confirm that oxygen and nutritious meals are being transported to the trapped group. CM Dhami informed PM Modi for the third time of the latest developments, emphasizing the workers' safety and the government's commitment. To further assist, Uttarakhand’s government is covering travel, food, and accommodation expenses for their families. At the rescue site, medical and psychological support teams are stationed to look after the workers' physical and mental health. Personnel from the Prime Minister’s Office are present to coordinate and directly observe the situation. After surveying the tunnel, Arnold Dix praised the impressive volume of work accomplished and underscored safety as the top priority for both rescuers and those trapped. The search for safe evacuation methods is ongoing, as authorities assess all possibilities. The affected Silkyara tunnel segment is part of the Char Dham highway project, located roughly 30 km from the Uttarkashi district headquarters. Family members of the trapped workers are being kept updated by officials, who have promised every possible measure will be taken for a successful rescue, though no deadline has been specified.

post_content: 41 workers remain trapped in Uttarakhand’s Silkyara tunnel for the 9th day. PM Modi and experts are overseeing intense rescue efforts; families and workers are getting full support. #SilkyaraRescue #StayStrong

article_content: Nine-year-old Cayman Terbroc had an unexpected encounter in Missouri when she met Pippa Middleton, who was taking a pit stop during the Race Across America charity cycling challenge. Pippa, dressed in a blue, white, and red lycra suit with sunglasses, was happy to pose for photos and chatted with Cayman and her mother, Lisa. She encouraged them to cheer on her brother James Middleton, who is participating alongside her. Pippa is taking part in the 3,000-mile race across the United States, which began in Oceanside, California and will finish in Annapolis, Maryland. The event, featuring a team that includes Pippa, James, and six others, aims to raise money for the Michael Matthews Foundation and the British Heart Foundation. Pippa is the only woman on her team, and the race is recognized for its grueling challenges—cyclists climb over 100,000 vertical feet and have little time for rest over twelve days. Both Pippa and James appeared upbeat at the start of their journey. Pippa, known for her active lifestyle and previous participation in endurance races such as a ski marathon in Switzerland and the Highland Cross in Scotland, is once again demonstrating her commitment to sports and charity.

article_content: Moderate Islamist Abdelmonen Abol Fotoh has attracted support from across the political spectrum after leaving the Muslim Brotherhood due to his decision to run for Egypt’s presidency. Now running as a respected independent in Egypt’s first democratic presidential election, Abol Fotoh says his platform focuses on strengthening democracy, ensuring freedom and respect for human rights, and guaranteeing fair treatment under Egyptian law. According to Dr. Omar Ashour, director of Middle East Studies at the University of Exeter and a visiting scholar at the Brookings Institution in Doha, Abol Fotoh’s ideals are backed by a longstanding history of opposition to former President Hosni Mubarak’s regime. He participated in the early demonstrations in Tahrir Square on January 25, 2011, and has maintained his support for the revolution since then. Ashour told CNN from Cairo that Abol Fotoh is gaining backing from a broad range of political groups, from ultraconservative factions to revolutionary activists. What unites these different groups, Ashour said, is a shared desire to change the status quo and a recognition that the current balance between civilian and military power in Egypt heavily favors the military. Abol Fotoh has demonstrated resolve when needed, suggesting he can keep his campaign promises, Ashour added. His commitments include combating widespread corruption, restoring the independence of the judiciary, and seeking justice for those killed during last year’s protests. A recent poll by the Al-Ahram Center for Political and Strategic Studies put Abol Fotoh in second place behind Amre Moussa, with particular strength among well-educated voters. Egyptians will go to the polls for this historic election, starting Wednesday. In an interview with Enigma magazine, posted on his official website, Abol Fotoh emphasized the need for Egypt’s new president to be "flexible on issues of religion" while maintaining the country’s safety and independence. He cited his four decades in public and political life as a source of his strength as a candidate. Becoming politically active as a medical student in the 1960s, Abol Fotoh continued his engagement over the ensuing decades. He was arrested twice for his association with the Muslim Brotherhood, in 1981 and again in 1996, when he was detained for five years. He was jailed again in 2009 for six months for his efforts with the Arab Doctors’ Union Relief Committee for Gaza to deliver medicines to the Gaza Strip. Abol Fotoh said he had already planned to leave the Muslim Brotherhood before his suspension last year, feeling it should focus on social and educational projects rather than politics. While his relationship with the Brotherhood remains poor, this separation has broadened his appeal, according to Khaled Elgindy, a visiting fellow at the Brookings Institution in Washington. Elgindy notes that Abol Fotoh’s broad vision, addressing both religious and secular interests, has made him popular with youth and secular revolutionaries. He also holds somewhat more liberal social views compared to most members of the Muslim Brotherhood. At the same time, Abol Fotoh appeals to ultraconservative Salafi groups because he is now an independent Islamist rather than a member of the Brotherhood. Elgindy explained that Salafis see the Brotherhood as both a competitor for Islamist support and as an organization seeking to dominate the political process, and so they are willing to back Abol Fotoh despite ideological differences. Many liberals also consider him a more practical candidate than some leftist revolutionaries and are thus rallying behind him as the best available option. Elgindy added that Abol Fotoh’s criticism of Egypt’s military leaders helps him stand out as someone who could bring change. Ultimately, Abol Fotoh’s success may depend on how much the revolutionary and liberal vote is divided, as other candidates such as Khaled Ali are also vying for support. Nonetheless, Abol Fotoh has consistently advocated for peaceful change and a continuation of Egypt’s revolution toward genuine democracy.

Mumbai's air quality index (AQI) worsened to 245 (poor category) by Monday evening, up from a satisfactory 78 recorded until Sunday noon, highlighting the health impact of firework celebrations. Despite a Bombay High Court order restricting firecracker use on Diwali to 8-10pm and the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation's (BMC) public appeal, residents in many areas—including Marine Drive, Shivaji Park, Powai, and Kandivli—set off firecrackers and loud explosives well past midnight. Only a few locations, such as Parel and Nerul (East), saw fewer violations.

Mumbai police filed 784 cases between November 10 and 12 against 806 individuals for breaching the High Court order and violating license and fire brigade norms. While overall noise intensity decreased this Diwali compared to previous years—likely due to the 8-10pm restriction and greater use of green crackers—certain areas like Marine Drive, Dadar, and parts of the suburbs experienced 'deafening' noise, with fireworks being set off well after the permitted hours.

Continued and uncontrolled use of firecrackers contributed to the city's average AQI reaching 245 (poor category) on Monday. According to SAFAR (System of Air Quality and Weather Forecasting And Research), air quality was 'very poor' (over 300 AQI) in Malad, Chembur, BKC, and Borivli, 'poor' in Mazgaon and Colaba, and 'moderate' in Andheri, Bhandup, Worli, and Navi Mumbai. B S Murthy, a scientist at SAFAR, IITM Pune, noted that similar spikes in AQI are seen in other cities across India during this period due to firecrackers.

Sumaira Abdulali from the Awaaz Foundation reported that Marine Drive experienced very high noise levels, up to 117 decibels—higher than last year’s 109 decibels. Shivaji Park recorded slightly lower noise this year (99 decibels) than in 2022 (100.4 decibels), but this still nearly doubles the maximum allowed for residential areas (55dB during the day and 45dB at night). Abdulali said overall average decibel levels in Mumbai were lower this year than in 2022 and 2020; no readings were taken in 2021 due to COVID-19 restrictions.

This year, for the first time in a decade, the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board and Awaaz Foundation did not conduct their annual joint cracker tests. Abdulali added that there were fewer aerial crackers compared to the past three years, but serial crackers still increased noise at certain sites. The highest noise levels were recorded at 9:55pm, close to the 10pm deadline, at Marine Drive. Police began shutting down firecracker activity after 10:10pm, detaining some individuals for violations.

ムンバイの大気質指数（AQI）は月曜日の夕方までに245（悪いカテゴリー）に悪化しました。これは日曜の正午までの78（満足）から大幅な悪化であり、花火による健康への影響を浮き彫りにしています。ディーワーリーでの爆竹使用を午後8時から10時までに制限するボンベイ高等裁判所の命令とブリハンムンバイ市民協会（BMC）の呼びかけにもかかわらず、マリンドライブ、シヴァジーパーク、ポワイ、カンディブリなど多くの地域で住民が深夜まで爆竹や大きな爆発音を鳴らし続けました。パレルやネルル（イースト）など一部の地域だけが違反が少なかったようです。

ムンバイ警察は11月10日から12日にかけて、高等裁判所の命令違反やライセンス・消防署規定違反で806人を対象に784件の摘発を行いました。今年のディーワーリーは午後8時から10時までの制限や「グリーンクラッカー」使用の増加により全体的な騒音は例年より減りましたが、マリンドライブやダダール、郊外の一部では認可時間後も「耳をつんざく」騒音が続きました。

爆竹の継続的かつ制御されていない使用が、月曜日の市全体の平均AQIを245（悪いカテゴリー）に押し上げました。SAFAR（大気質および気象予測研究システム）によると、マラード、チェンブル、BKC、ボリブリでは「非常に悪い」（AQI300超）、マズガオンとコラバは「悪い」、アーンデリー、バンドゥープ、ウォーリー、ナヴィムンバイは「中程度」でした。IITMプネーのSAFAR科学者B S Murthy氏によれば、インド全国の都市でもこの時期は爆竹により同様のAQI急増が見られるとのことです。

アワーズ財団のスマイラ・アブドゥラリ氏は、マリンドライブで最大117デシベルという非常に高い騒音レベルが記録され、昨年の109デシベルを上回ったと報告しています。シヴァジーパークは今年99デシベルで、2022年（100.4デシベル）よりやや低かったものの、住宅地の最大許容（昼55dB、夜45dB）の約2倍でした。アブドゥラリ氏によれば、市全体の平均デシベルは2022年・2020年よりも低く、2021年はコロナ対策で計測ができなかったそうです。

また、マハーラーシュトラ公害規制委員会とアワーズ財団による毎年恒例の合同花火テストは今世紀で初めて実施されませんでした。今年は過去3年より空中花火が少なかったものの、連発花火が一部の現場で騒音を増加させました。最大騒音は午後10時の締め切り直前である午後9時55分にマリンドライブで観測され、警察は午後10時10分ごろから取り締まりを始め、一部の違反者を拘束したとのことです。

Prime Minister David Cameron has suggested that reforming welfare and education systems is essential to encourage more British citizens to take up jobs currently held by immigrants. Speaking at the CBI conference, Cameron emphasized the need for 'proper immigration control,' both within the European Union and with the rest of the world. His comments follow news that Greencore Group, the UK's largest sandwich producer, plans to hire hundreds of workers from Eastern Europe after struggling to recruit locally.

Cameron asserted that any successful immigration policy must go hand in hand with a benefits system that rewards work and an education system that better equips people for available jobs. He has made revising freedom of movement within the EU a central part of his efforts to regain powers from Brussels, though EU leaders, including German Chancellor Angela Merkel, have publicly opposed altering this principle.

Home Secretary Theresa May argued there is growing recognition across Europe that the freedom of movement rules need revision, citing concerns about abuses such as trafficking and sham marriages. Despite past pledges to reduce net migration to 'tens of thousands,' recent figures showed 243,000 more people came to Britain than left in the latest year—well above the government's original target.

The Greencore Group, which supplies major supermarkets, expects to hire most of its 300 new staff from Hungary, citing low local interest and low unemployment rates in areas like Northampton. Wages in Hungary average just over £7,000, while minimum-wage jobs in the UK pay nearly double, with tax credits and housing benefits further increasing net income. Cameron argued that beyond immigration policy, welfare and education reform are necessary to persuade more UK residents to take available jobs.

Cameron is preparing to publish detailed proposals for changing EU freedom of movement rules before year's end, ahead of a planned in/out referendum on Britain's EU membership in 2017 if the Conservatives win the 2015 general election. Despite resistance from EU leaders, UK officials continue to press for the reforms.

キャメロン氏は、年内にEUの自由移動規則変更の詳細案を出す予定で、保守党が2015年の総選挙で勝利すれば2017年に英国のEU加盟の是非を問う国民投票を行うとしています。EU側の抵抗もありつつ、英国政府は引き続き改革を求めていく方針です。

article_content: Dylan Hartley is preparing for potentially disappointing news. The excitement following an Aviva Premiership title win is now at risk of fading as England’s rugby tour faces challenges this week. The complications of England’s two-stage tour are becoming apparent and players are dealing with the effects of administrative issues beyond their control. One of the toughest selection decisions of Stuart Lancaster’s tenure as England coach is approaching. Some players, including Freddie Burns, Kyle Eastmond, and James Haskell, performed well at Eden Park in the first Test against New Zealand, as England nearly caused an upset against the All Blacks. However, those efforts may not secure their spots, as returning Premiership finalists could enter the starting XV. Hartley, one of these late arrivals after winning the Premiership with Northampton Saints, could face losing his England No. 2 shirt. Rob Webber of Bath was outstanding as England’s starting hooker at Eden Park and could keep his place for the second Test in Dunedin. Hartley admitted he might have to wait for his chance and said: 'You just bide your time and wait for an opportunity, and when it comes, you take it. That’s what Rob’s done.' Hartley also commented on the competition: 'Me and Tom Youngs have had it for two years now. If you slip up, you give the other guy a chance. Rob took his opportunity well, and I wouldn’t be surprised if we stick with him. It’s good for the team to have strong hooker options, especially with the World Cup coming up.' Despite the difficult circumstances, Hartley’s focus is on preparation. Playing in the Premiership final helped him recover from a shoulder injury. He said the extra time played gave him valuable preparation time, and he feels fit and ready. Hartley may have to settle for a place among the replacements—a situation shared by other late arrivals such as Billy Vunipola. Hartley warned that reintroducing returning finalists does not guarantee improved performance: 'Last year, France’s Top 14 finalists joined their tour here, and they lost heavily. So just because our finalists are back, it does not automatically solve things. We have to be prepared.' England’s close performance in the first Test highlights their progress, but Hartley believes it is time to achieve a landmark victory, saying: 'We need to win something significant and here is the perfect place. If we beat the All Blacks, we’d be making history, since we’ve only won two Tests in New Zealand.' Exeter hooker Luke Cowan-Dickie has left the tour to treat a knee injury.

After a 13-year hiatus, the quirky 'Khichdi' family has returned to the big screen with a sequel, prompting questions about its necessity. Unlike before, the original show's frequent re-runs have kept its eccentric cast fresh in viewers’ minds, lessening the novelty of a reunion. Director Aatish Kapadia leans heavily on the series' signature nonsensical humor, sending the family on an offbeat trip to the made-up land of Paanthukistan. Here, they encounter a villainous ruler who bears a striking resemblance to Praful, along with other oddball characters and strange situations—like a place without running water, unusual costumes, and peculiar sidekicks named Ek Sau Bees Navratan and Gulkunda.

The main actors reprise their roles: Supriya Pathak delivers Hansa Ben’s trademark mispronunciations and comic lines, while Kirti Kulhari returns mainly for song and dance numbers. The film relies heavily on recycled jokes and exaggerated scenarios. Cameos from Pratik Gandhi as a fleeting helicopter pilot and Farah Khan add little impact. With storylines featuring inventions like a bullet-shooting robot, 'Khichdi 2' struggles to find fresh ground, falling back on familiar gags that often miss. Despite the reassembled cast's energy, critics gave the sequel a poor reception—just 1 out of 5 stars—citing its over-the-top antics and lack of originality.

article_content: A man received 24 parking fines in three weeks after leaving his car parked outside his east London home. Tony Hawkins, from Barking, said he was unaware his parking permit had expired before traveling to Manchester at the end of August. When he returned in late September, he discovered a pile of fines on his car. Barking and Dagenham Council stated it sent two reminder emails to Mr Hawkins before his permit expired, but he did not renew it. Mr Hawkins, 57, claimed that on one occasion, four fines were issued within three hours. He noted some fines were illegible due to rain damage and fears he may have to pay thousands of pounds. Mr Hawkins said, "I can pay them in dribs and drabs if I really squeeze my budget but I'm really scared if the other 20 come through the post because I've paid four already, which cost me £240. It's a huge cost just because I didn't renew my resident parking permit on time." He argues issuing multiple fines on the same day goes against the London Councils' code of practice for civil parking enforcement. "I've checked every London borough's website, and if you get multiple charges on the same day, most councils will cancel all but one," he added. In a statement, Barking and Dagenham Council said Mr Hawkins was sent reminder emails two and three weeks before expiry. "Unfortunately, the permit was not renewed, and he has since bought a new permit. Where multiple tickets have been issued on the same day, they have been cancelled without a challenge." The council said that tickets under appeal would await the outcome, and urged Mr Hawkins to contact parking services. Send your story ideas to hello.bbclondon@bbc.co.uk.

article_content: On Monday, a boat accident in the Ibi Local Government Area of Taraba State led to the deaths of more than 20 people, most of them fishermen. This heartbreaking incident follows a similar tragedy in Karim-Lamido Local Government Area less than a week earlier. Governor Dr. Agbu Kefas extended his condolences to the affected families, voicing deep concern over these repeated accidents. His Special Adviser on Media and Digital Communication, Emmanuel Bello, stated that the government is initiating plans to prevent future boat tragedies. Actions include retiring old boats and making life jackets mandatory for all passengers. Authorities have started investigations to uncover the exact causes of these disasters. Governor Kefas also plans to visit the communities affected to collaborate with stakeholders in the water transport sector and work towards safer waterways. Alhaji Jidda Suleiman, chairman of Taraba State Water Transportation, explained that the victims, mainly from Ibi and Wukari, were traveling for a seasonal fishing trip when their boat capsized near Anyiin, between Chinkai and Anyeci in Wukari Local Government Area on the River Benue. At least 12 of those who died were from Ibi, with others from Gareji in Gindin Doruwa, Wukari LGA. Suleiman highlighted that it is a regular tradition for Taraba fishermen to travel as far as Cameroon and Chad for fishing each year, but this time, the tradition turned tragic. He appealed to both state and federal authorities to provide life jackets, emphasizing this as a crucial step to prevent future incidents.

article_content: Are you prepared for next-generation hiring? Remote recruitment has emerged as the modern candidate onboarding process, catering to a generation of hires that is more tech-savvy and informed. This group values productivity and prefers to avoid lengthy traditional onboarding procedures. To streamline onboarding, remote recruitment uses digital assessments, training, and team orientation. These remote hiring tools make recruitment faster and more efficient than most traditional practices. To attract and secure top young talent, organizations should embrace modern recruitment processes. According to a Zippia study, 97% of organizations plan to increase investment in recruitment technologies this year, with 47% already using AI recruitment tools or services. Remote recruitment relies on advanced technology for tracking candidates, communication, and evaluation. These tools are designed with specific, user-friendly purposes, making the process manageable. Additionally, digital records of the hiring process can be maintained and reviewed to identify and address any issues. Remote recruitment eliminates many limitations associated with traditional hiring. It reduces costs for management, including less spending on travel, in-person interviews, onsite training, and candidate accommodations. This allows for quicker scheduling and rescheduling of candidate-employer communications, positively influencing candidates’ first impressions and facilitating smoother decision-making for organizations. Remote recruitment also widens access for candidates globally, offering a larger, more diverse talent pool. This increases competition and allows employers to select from the best applicants. However, managing a large number of applicants can be challenging. Specialized tools assist with applicant management, making outreach and sorting more efficient. The use of online assessments in remote hiring is known to reduce recruitment cycles. These tests provide comprehensive evaluations of candidates’ skills and competencies, helping to eliminate biases early on and supporting clear decisions for hiring managers. Nevertheless, remote recruitment is not without drawbacks. With the right selection of tools, however, common issues can be addressed. Here are some challenges and solutions: Problem: Difficulty assessing soft skills. Solution: While soft skills are typically evaluated in person, remote skills assessments can reliably check for these competencies. Problem: Evaluating candidates' cultural or ethical fit. Solution: Customized employability assessments can help gauge qualities important to your organization’s work culture. Problem: Selecting appropriate online assessments. Solution: Prepare a priority list before researching tools. If targeting millennials, consider clarity, accuracy, and reliability. For diverse candidates, opt for language-agnostic, visually based, or customizable assessments. Problem: Identifying dishonest or deceptive candidates. Solution: Choose assessments with proctoring or lie-scale integration features to detect and flag irregularities. article_content:
Elliot Kotek, co-founder of Nation of Artists, leads viewers into a world where creativity and meaningful impact converge. In a recent interview, Kotek discussed the philosophy behind his agency and his compelling project, 'The Hidden Power of Purpose,' a documentary developed with AARP and recently screened at the Newport Beach Film Festival.

'The Hidden Power of Purpose' examines the profound impact of having purpose in life, following four individuals who each found meaning through different paths: career, family, spirituality, and overcoming tragedy. The film intersperses their journeys with expert insights from psychologists, cancer researchers, neuroscientists, genome specialists, and psychiatrists, highlighting research that underscores how having purpose is as essential to health as diet or exercise.

The project originated during the pandemic when AARP could not hold its annual Purpose Prize gala, which celebrates founders advancing positive change and provides grants to their nonprofits. Instead, AARP partnered with Kotek for a documentary that would advance the Purpose Prize spirit and investigate the emerging science on purpose.

The documentary's aim is to inspire viewers to recognize that finding purpose can happen at any stage of life, through various routes, and that everyone has the power to redefine their purpose over time.

Featured in the documentary are individuals like Mark Barden (Sandy Hook Promise co-founder), Shirley Acevedo Buontempo (Latino U College Access founder), Grammy-nominated musician and U.S. Dream Academy founder Wintley Phipps, and lifelong nurse Karen Cassidy, who established a hospice in Louisville, Kentucky for those without family to spend their last weeks with dignity.

Expert voices include Dr. Todd Kashdan (co-author of the clinical definition of 'purpose'), Dr. Sanjay Gupta (CNN), and Dr. Michelle Carlson, who explores the neurological aspects of purpose. Additional perspectives come from Anthony Burrow, Leigh Pearce, Vic Strecher, Dr. Steve Cole, Deepak Chopra, and Dr. Dilip Jeste, enriching the exploration of this vital human experience. The documentary is narrated by Debbie Allen.

Kotek reflects on the process, sharing that he condensed over a hundred hours of conversations into the documentary and distilled three key lessons:

1. Behaviors vs. Motivators: Dr. Michelle Carlson points out that while we often focus on behavior, it’s more effective to concentrate on motivators—purpose, in particular—because it drives positive behaviors like regular activity and healthy eating more powerfully.

2. Purpose for All: Kotek stresses that discovering purpose isn’t reserved for the privileged; it can be even more crucial for those in under-served communities facing extra stressors. Living with purpose is linked to greater resilience and measurable health benefits.

3. Purpose vs. Happiness: Kotek clarifies that while pursuing purpose can yield happiness, its greatest benefits are biological and psychological, arising from meaningful engagement and selfless action rather than simply seeking pleasure.

'The Hidden Power of Purpose' will be available for streaming on Amazon Prime Video, Google Play, and AppleTV starting November 23. AARP also offers resources for hosting screenings and discussions, and Kotek is open to outreach via LinkedIn.

Nation of Artists, under Kotek’s direction, is devoted to impact and innovation, often collaborating with other agencies to create campaigns, documentaries, and branded content that foster meaningful connections between public and private sectors.

ネイション・オブ・アーティスツ共同創設者のエリオット・コテックは、創造性と意義深いインパクトが交差する世界に私たちを導きます。最新のインタビューで、コテックは同社の理念と、AARPと共に制作し、ニュー ポートビーチ映画祭で上映された注目のドキュメンタリー『ザ・ヒドゥン・パワー・オブ・パーパス（隠された目的の力）』について語りました。

このドキュメンタリーは、人生の目的がどれほど人々に深い影響を与えるかを探り、キャリア、家族、スピリチュアリティ、悲劇の克服という異なる道を歩んだ4人のストーリーを描いています。各ストーリーの合間には、心理学者、がん研究者、神経科学者、ゲノム専門家、精神科医などの専門家による洞察が織り交ぜられ、目的意識が食事や運動と同じくらい健康に重要であることが研究で示されています。

このプロジェクトは、パンデミックによってAARPが毎年実施しているPurpose Prize授賞式が開催できなかったことをきっかけに始まりました。AARPは社会を変える創設者を表彰し、彼らの非営利団体に助成金を授与しています。そうした中でAARPとコテックは、Purpose Prizeの精神を発展させ、目的に関する新たな科学を探るドキュメンタリー制作に取り組むことになりました。

作品の狙いは、人生のあらゆる段階で誰にでも目的を見出すことができ、時間とともにその目的を再定義する力があることを視聴者に伝えることです。

作中には、サンディフック・プロミス共同創設者マーク・バーデン、Latino U College Access創設者シャーリー・アセベド・ブオンテンポ、グラミー賞ノミネートのミュージシャンでU.S. Dream Academy創設者ウィントリー・フィップス、家族のいない人のためのホスピスをケンタッキー州ルイビルで設立した生涯看護師のカレン・キャシディなどが登場します。

また、「目的」の臨床定義を共著したトッド・カシュダン博士、CNNのサンジェイ・グプタ博士、目的の神経科学的側面を探るミシェル・カールソン博士ら専門家の見解も紹介。アンソニー・バロウ、リー・ピアース、ヴィック・ストレッチャー、スティーブ・コール博士、ディーパック・チョプラ、ディリップ・ジェステ博士も多様な視点を寄せています。ナレーションはデビー・アレン。

コテックは、100時間を超えるインタビューを経て得た知見を3つの重要なポイントにまとめています。

1. 行動と動機付け：カールソン博士によると、私たちは行動ばかり注目しがちですが、実は「目的」のような動機付けに焦点を当てる方が良いとのこと。目的があれば健康的な行動が自然と促されます。

2. すべての人のための目的：目的を持つことは特権的な人だけのものではなく、困難を抱えるコミュニティの人たちにも特に重要で、レジリエンスや健康面でもメリットがあるそうです。

3. 目的と幸福の違い：目的追求によって幸せを感じる場面もありますが、その真価は意味ある活動や他者への貢献から得られる生物学的・心理的利益にあると強調。

『ザ・ヒドゥン・パワー・オブ・パーパス』は11月23日よりAmazon Prime Video、Google Play、AppleTVで配信。AARPは視聴会やディスカッション開催へリソースも提供し、コテックもLinkedIn経由でのコンタクトを歓迎しています。

コテック率いるネイション・オブ・アーティスツは、インパクトとイノベーションにこだわりながら他エージェンシーと連携し、公的・民間両分野の橋渡しとなるキャンペーンやドキュメンタリー、ブランドコンテンツを制作しています。

TVS Motor Company has announced its entry into the European market through a strategic partnership with Zurich-based Emil Frey Group, a respected automotive distributor with over 100 years of history. The agreement grants Emil Frey responsibility for the import and distribution of TVS vehicles across selected European countries, utilizing Emil Frey's established sales, marketing, and service networks.

This collaboration marks a significant moment in TVS Motor’s global expansion. 'Europe will be a key market for us, and through this partnership we aim to bring our innovative products closer to European customers,' said TVS Motor Company’s Managing Director, Sudarshan Venu. He noted that TVS and Emil Frey are both long-standing organizations with shared values of responsible and sustainable mobility and customer service.

Emil Frey is among Europe’s leading automobile importers and retailers, representing many major automotive brands across the region. Through this alliance, TVS will introduce models such as the Jupiter 125, NTORQ, Raider, iQube S, Ronin, Apache RR 310, and Apache RTR 310 to European consumers.

Currently, TVS Motor exports to more than 80 countries spanning Asia, Africa, and Latin America, with exports accounting for nearly 25% of the company’s business in the first half of the current fiscal year.

この協業は、TVSモーターのグローバル展開の重要な節目となります。「ヨーロッパは当社にとって重要な市場であり、このパートナーシップを通じて革新的な製品をヨーロッパのお客様にお届けしたい」と、TVSモーターカンパニーのマネージングディレクターであるスダルシャン・ヴェヌ氏は述べています。また、TVSとエミル・フライはいずれも長い歴史を持ち、責任ある持続可能なモビリティと顧客サービスという共通の価値観を大切にしていることを強調しました。

エミル・フライは、欧州最大級の自動車輸入・小売業者であり、地域全体で多数の有名自動車ブランドを展開しています。この提携を通じて、TVSはジュピター125、NTORQ、レイダー、iQube S、ロニン、アパッチRR 310、アパッチRTR 310などのモデルを欧州市場に投入します。

現在、TVSモーターはアジア、アフリカ、ラテンアメリカなど80カ国以上に輸出しており、2023年度上半期の売上の約25%を輸出が占めています。
