article_content: Giglio, Italy (CNN) – Captain Francesco Schettino, who commanded the Costa Concordia cruise ship, admitted to making a mistake when the vessel struck rocks near the Italian island of Giglio, according to court transcripts. While speaking to a friend earlier this month, Schettino claimed that management pressured him to navigate close to the shore where the collision occurred, two Italian newspapers reported Wednesday. Costa Cruises and authorities have since criticized Schettino’s actions. He is currently under house arrest and faces potential charges of manslaughter, causing a shipwreck, and abandoning ship after the accident on January 13. A 16th body was discovered onboard Tuesday, and sixteen more people remain missing from the roughly 4,200 people on board—3,200 passengers and 1,000 crew—at the time of the crash. Schettino explained in a 126-page transcript, “I hit this projection of rock that seems almost embedded in the ship, but this was my mistake. There isn’t anything I can say, as I was convinced that passing within .28 of a mile wouldn’t be a problem.” He also rejected claims by prosecutors that he was speeding, saying, “There isn’t a speed limit. We had more or less the speed needed to reach Savona on time.” According to the transcript, Schettino said he steered the ship aground intentionally to prevent it from sinking: “This is what allowed me to limit the tilting.” Maritime lawyer Jim Allsworth confirmed that grounding a vessel in such a situation is standard practice to stop it from sinking. Italian newspapers La Repubblica and Corriere della Sera published excerpts from a phone call Schettino made to a friend after his January 14 arrest. The call, made from the prosecutor’s office, was tapped by authorities. Schettino’s lawyer Alessandro Antichi confirmed the call was recorded but declined to comment on its content, saying it was part of the ongoing investigation. In the call, Schettino appeared to refer to being pressured to bring the ship close to the island. He said, “The shallows were there but weren’t signaled by my instruments, and I went through...in order to follow what the managers wanted.” Jacob Rusli Bin, who was steering the ship, told investigators that Schettino cursed after the collision and said he did not see the rocks, according to La Repubblica. Costa Cruises CEO, Pier Luigi Foschi, briefed the Italian Senate on details provided by Roberto Ferrarini, the company’s director of marine operations. Schettino first reported the crash to Ferrarini at 9:57 p.m., roughly 15 minutes after the collision, saying the ship had lost power but remained navigable. In subsequent calls, Schettino updated Ferrarini as the situation deteriorated but continued to claim the ship could still move. Foschi said Ferrarini described Schettino as calm throughout their conversations. The captain last reported the situation as under control at 10:33 p.m., but called two minutes later to say the ship was being evacuated. Ferrarini was surprised by this sudden change. Foschi said the pair continued to communicate during the evacuation, but did not provide further details. Costa Cruises cannot carry out an independent investigation, as prosecutors seized the ship’s data recorder, which contains audio recordings and navigation data. There had been some technical issues with the recorder, but Foschi said it is operational. Schettino’s defense attorney, Bruno Leporatti, filed an appeal Wednesday against the judge’s decision to place the captain under house arrest. Both prosecution and defense are appealing: prosecutors want stricter custody, while the defense seeks Schettino’s release without restrictions. Schettino defended his decision not to immediately order an evacuation, stating, “It’s not like I can have a blackout and immediately say, ‘Let’s all get out of here.’ Where do I send these people? I need to be certain the ship can’t float; I am not going to risk the lives of 4,000 people.” Passengers described panic and confusion during the evacuation, noting that crew members appeared overwhelmed and did not always provide accurate information. Schettino recalled helping passengers into lifeboats and said some lifeboats got stuck due to the angle of the listing vessel. He also said he accidentally ended up on a lifeboat roof while trying to launch it. However, in the wiretapped call, Schettino reportedly told his friend that when he realized the ship was tilting, he decided to leave. Italian criminal defense attorney Ugo Meucci, who does not represent Schettino, noted that Italian law makes abandoning ship a serious offense for a captain and could carry a 15-year prison sentence. Schettino has remained steadfast in defending his actions, stating he kept Costa Cruises informed on the severity of the accident. He said in the wiretapped call, “I did everything afterwards with professionalism, which helps bring me some peace.” He also expressed pride in rescuing most passengers and said he never wants to go back to sea. CNN’s Hada Messia in Rome contributed to this report.
translated_content: イタリア、ジリオ島（CNN）– コスタ・コンコルディア号の船長フランチェスコ・スケッティーノは、船がイタリアのジリオ島近くの岩に衝突した際、自身のミスであったことを法廷で認めました。今月初め、友人との会話の中で、スケッティーノはマネージャーに岸に近づけるよう圧力をかけられたと主張しており、水曜日にイタリアの新聞2紙が報じました。コスタクルーズと当局はスケッティーノの行動を批判しています。彼は現在、自宅軟禁下にあり、1月13日の事故後、過失致死・難破・船の放棄などの容疑で訴追される可能性があります。事故当時、乗客3,200人、乗組員1,000人を含む約4,200人が乗船しており、火曜日に16番目の遺体が発見され、さらに16人が行方不明となっています。 スケッティーノは126ページに及ぶ記録の中で、「船にほぼ埋まっているような岩の突起にぶつかったが、これは自分のミスだ。0.28マイル以内を通過しても問題ないと確信していた」と説明しました。また、検察が主張するスピード違反については「制限速度はなかった。サヴォナに時間通りに到着するためにほぼ必要な速度だった」と否定しました。 記録によると、スケッティーノは船沈没を防ぐため、意図的に船体を座礁させたと述べています。「これによって傾きを抑えることができた」。海事弁護士ジム・オルズワースも、こういった状況での座礁措置は標準的だと認めています。 イタリア紙ラ・レプッブリカとコリエレ・デラ・セラは、スケッティーノが1月14日の逮捕後、友人にかけた電話の一部を公開しました。この電話は検察庁からかけられ、当局により盗聴されていました。スケッティーノの弁護士アレッサンドロ・アンティキは録音の存在を認めつつ、捜査中であるため内容へのコメントは控えました。 電話では、スケッティーノが岸近くに船を寄せるよう圧力を受けていたことを示唆しています。彼は「浅瀬があったが、私の計器には表示されなかった。それでも管理者の意向に従って進んだ」と述べています。操舵担当のジェイコブ・ルスリ・ビンは、衝突後スケッティーノが罵倒し、岩が見えなかったと話していたと捜査官に語っています（ラ・レプッブリカより）。 コスタクルーズCEOのピエル・ルイジ・フォスキは、自社の船舶運航部門責任者ロベルト・フェッラリーニからの情報をもとに、イタリア上院に報告しました。スケッティーノは事故から約15分後の21時57分、最初にフェッラリーニに連絡し、停電はしたものの航行は可能と伝えました。その後も状況悪化を報告しつつ、航行は可能だと主張し続けたといいます。フォスキによると、フェッラリーニは通話中のスケッティーノを冷静だったと述べています。最後に「状況は制御下にある」と報告があったのは22時33分でしたが、その2分後に船の避難開始を連絡し、フェッラリーニはこの急変に驚いたとのことです。その後も2人は避難中に連絡を取ったものの、詳細は明かされていません。 コスタクルーズは、検察が証拠品（いわゆる「ブラックボックス」）を押収したため、独自調査はできないとしています。ブラックボックスには通話の録音や航行データが含まれていますが、技術的な問題もあったものの現在は作動しているとフォスキは述べています。 スケッティーノの弁護士ブルーノ・レポラッティは、水曜日に船長の自宅軟禁決定に対し控訴しました。検察も弁護側も双方が決定に不服を訴えています。検察はより厳格な拘束を望み、弁護側は制限のない釈放を求めています。 スケッティーノは即時避難を命じなかった決断について、「停電が起きてもすぐに『みんな降りろ』とはできない。どこに避難させるのか。船が本当に浮かないと確信した上でないと4,000人の命は預かれない」と弁明。乗客らは、乗員の多くが混乱・情報不足だったため、避難時にパニックや困惑があったと語っています。スケッティーノも救命ボートに乗せる手伝いをし、傾いた船の角度のせいで一部ボートが動かなくなったと記憶しています。自身もボートを下ろそうとした際、偶然屋根の上に乗ってしまったと話しています。 一方、盗聴された電話では、スケッティーノは船が傾き始めたとき自ら退去を決断したと友人に語ったと報道されています。イタリアの刑事弁護士ウーゴ・メウッチ（スケッティーノの代理人ではない）は、イタリア法では船長による船の放棄は重大な違法行為であり、最大15年の実刑に問われる可能性があると指摘しています。 スケッティーノは自らの行動を擁護し続け、事故の深刻さをコスタクルーズに報告していたと主張しました。電話で「その後、全てを誠意をもって行った。これで少しは気持ちが落ち着く」とも述べています。また、ほとんどの乗客を救えたことに誇りを感じ、今後は二度と船には戻りたくないとも語っています。CNNローマ支局ハダ・メシアも本記事に寄稿しました。

article_content: At the Whatsonstage.com Theatre Awards in London, leading figures from the theatre world made stylish appearances on the red carpet. Kimberley Walsh, known for playing Princess Fiona in 'Shrek: The Musical,' traded her stage costume for a vibrant strapless red gown, paired with beige heels and a matching clutch. Kara Tointon, currently performing in 'Absent Friends,' left her character’s plain wardrobe behind and shone in an elegant silver dress with floral lace embellishments, completing her look with strappy heels and a new fringe hairstyle styled in an updo. Sheridan Smith embraced classic sophistication in a black ensemble as she co-hosted the event with comedian Alan Davies and Jenny Eclair at the Prince of Wales Theatre. Throughout the night, awards celebrated outstanding achievements in theatre. Amanda Holden earned Best Actress in a Musical for 'Shrek: The Musical,' while her co-star Nigel Harman took Best Supporting Actor. James Corden received Best Actor in a Play for 'One Man, Two Guvnors,' winning the prize over other acclaimed actors. Other honorees included Vanessa Redgrave (Best Actress in a Play for 'Driving Miss Daisy'), Tim Minchin (recognized for 'Matilda the Musical'), and Catherine Tate (Best Supporting Actress in a Play for 'Season’s Greetings'). The ceremony recognized both individual artists and ensemble performances. Notable productions honored during the evening included 'Matilda the Musical,' 'The Wizard of Oz,' 'Much Ado About Nothing,' and 'War Horse,' highlighting the range and vitality of the London stage.

Black Friday is the best time of year to purchase a new iPad, thanks to the largest discounts you'll find all year. Whether you’re shopping for yourself or searching for a gift, many Apple iPad models are on sale for significantly reduced prices on Amazon. We've rounded up our top picks below, but we recommend making your choice quickly—iPad Black Friday deals tend to sell out fast.

The ninth-generation Apple iPad, also known as the iPad 10.2 due to its 10.2-inch Retina display, remains a top budget option even after its 2021 release. It runs on the A13 Bionic chip, which still offers solid performance, and supports the latest iPadOS 17.

The tenth-generation Apple iPad is the newest entry-level model. It features a 10.9-inch Liquid Retina display and improved speed courtesy of the A14 Bionic chip. It retains the previous generation’s 12MP Ultra Wide front camera, which supports Center Stage for video calls, and upgrades the rear camera to a 12MP Wide camera.

For those who prefer a compact device, the sixth-generation Apple iPad Mini is a standout. With an 8.3-inch Liquid Retina display, it’s small enough to hold in one hand but packs a punch with the powerful A15 Bionic chip and impressive speakers.

Our overall top pick is the fifth-generation Apple iPad Air, thanks to its high-performance M1 processor, sharp and vibrant 10.9-inch Liquid Retina display, and the slim, lightweight design that defines the iPad Air line.

article_content: The cast has been set for 'Scar (Cicatriz)', a Spanish-Serbian thriller series backed by Asacha Media. Filming has begun in Spain on the European co-production, produced by Plano a Plano, Dopamine, and Adrenalin. Milena Radulovic, Juanlu González, and Luis Fernández will lead the series, joined by Stefan Kapicic, Mladen Sovilj, Goran Susljik, and Julen Serrano. Radulovic has been recognized for her work in the Serbian-British drama series 'Besa' and the Russian thriller 'Superdeep'. González starred in Netflix's 'Valeria' and the Spanish TV crime dramas 'La Caza' and 'La Otra Mirada', as well as the film 'Operación Camarón'. Fernández is known for his roles in Antena 3's fantasy series 'Los Protegidos' and other shows such as 'A Tres Metros Sobre el Cielo', 'Desaparecidos', and 'Servir y Proteger'. 'Scar' follows Irina (Radulovic), an enigmatic woman with a mysterious facial scar who has lived with emotional turmoil since childhood and is driven by a desire for revenge. González will play a talented but socially awkward IT specialist who meets Irina through a dating app and becomes enamored with her, drawing him into her dangerous world. Fernández will portray his best friend and business partner, a charismatic extrovert who serves as his link to everyday life. Asacha Media facilitated the collaboration between Spain’s Plano a Plano and Dopamine, and Serbia’s Adrenalin. The series is produced in association with RTVE, Prime Video Spain, and Telekom Srbija. Filming is taking place in Bilbao, directed by Miguel Ángel Vivas, Manuel Carballo, and Alejandro Bazzano. The writing team includes Fernando Sancristóbal, Pablo Roa, and Verónica Marza. Executive producers are César Benítez, Emilio Amaré, Emilio A. Pina, Álvaro Benítez, Fernando Sancristóbal, and Fidela Navarro.

A government report recommends establishing a specialized 'Food Crime Unit,' modeled after the FBI, to combat international gangs smuggling horse meat into processed foods and takeaways. The review, led by Professor Chris Elliott, also calls for unannounced inspections at factories and abattoirs, along with a strict zero-tolerance policy against food contamination. The proposed unit would be part of the Food Standards Agency, responding to concerns that organized crime is shifting focus from drug trafficking to food fraud. Experts warn that the safety of processed foods cannot be guaranteed, with beef burgers found to contain horse DNA.

Professor Elliott highlights that pressure on the British food industry to reduce costs may increase the risk to families. He stresses that consumers rely on suppliers and regulators for safe and genuine food, and urges that food safety and integrity be top priorities for government and industry. Lower-income households, who often depend on processed foods, and vulnerable populations in care facilities are particularly at risk.

Local authority and consumer organization surveys, including tests by Which?, have discovered that some fast food outlets are selling products that do not match their labels, sometimes due to accidental mislabeling but also potentially as a result of deliberate substitution with cheaper meat. 

Michael Ellis, assistant director at Interpol, reports a trend of criminal enterprises moving into food fraud by setting up front companies, falsifying records, and employing tactics from the drug trade. Coordinated police raids across 33 countries last year resulted in widespread seizures of counterfeit products and nearly 100 arrests. In 2013, Findus lasagna products were withdrawn after horse meat was detected, a major scandal in Europe.

The dangers of food fraud are illustrated by incidents such as the 2008 melamine-tainted milk tragedy in China, which led to six infant deaths, and the 2012 methanol poisoning in the Czech Republic, which claimed over 40 lives.

Professor Elliott’s report sets out multiple recommendations to prevent similar cases in the UK. Environment Secretary Elizabeth Truss expressed support for tougher measures and clearer labeling, aiming to protect consumers and maintain the UK’s food export reputation. However, some opposition politicians have criticized the government for a slow and inadequate response, urging quick implementation of the proposed food crime unit.

政府の報告書は、FBIをモデルにした専門の「食品犯罪ユニット」の設立を提案し、国際的なギャングによる馬肉の加工食品やテイクアウト食品への密輸を取り締まることを目的としています。クリス・エリオット教授が主導したこの調査では、工場や食肉処理場での抜き打ち検査、食品汚染に対するゼロトレランス（厳格な無容認）政策も求められています。このユニットは食品基準庁の一部となり、組織犯罪が麻薬取引から食品詐欺に焦点を移しつつあるという懸念に応えるものです。専門家は、加工食品の安全性は完全には保証できないと警告しており、牛肉バーガーに馬DNAが検出されたケースもあります。

エリオット教授は、英国食品業界がコスト削減を迫られていることが家族のリスク増大につながっていると指摘。消費者は、安全で本物の食品の供給を供給者と規制当局に依存していると述べ、政府と業界には食品の安全性と信頼性を最優先するよう強調しました。加工食品を利用することが多い低所得世帯や、高齢者施設などにいる弱い立場の人々も特にこうした詐欺のリスクが高いと警告しています。

地方自治体や消費者団体（Which?など）の調査で、ファストフード店の商品が実際と異なる表示で販売されていた例があり、その一部には偶発的な誤表示もありましたが、安価な肉の意図的な使用による場合も懸念されています。

インターポールのマイケル・エリス副局長は、犯罪組織が食品詐欺へ進出しつつあり、フロント企業の設立や記録の偽造、麻薬取引と同じような手口を用いていると報告。昨年、33カ国で実施された協調警察捜査では、大量の偽造食品や飲料が押収され、約100人が逮捕されました。2013年のフィンダス社ラザニア事件では馬肉混入が発覚し、ヨーロッパで大規模なリコールとなりました。

食品詐欺の深刻さは、中国で2008年に発生したメラミン混入粉ミルク事件（6人の乳児が死亡）や、2012年チェコ共和国でのメタノール混入酒事件（40人以上死亡）などからも明らかです。

エリオット教授の報告書は、同様の事件が再発しないよう、英国向けに複数の提言を盛り込んでいます。エリザベス・トラス環境相はさらなる取り組みの強化や表示の明確化を支持し、消費者保護と英国の食品輸出の評判維持を目指すと表明しています。一方、野党は政府の対応が遅く不十分であると批判し、食品犯罪ユニットの早期設立を求めています。

article_content: The United States has launched legal proceedings seeking to seize the Amadea, a $300 million superyacht that officials say is controlled by sanctioned Russian billionaire Suleiman Kerimov. The 106-meter yacht was seized in Fiji in May 2022 under a U.S. warrant, part of efforts to target Vladimir Putin’s associates after the Russian invasion of Ukraine. A complaint filed in Manhattan federal court kicks off what could become a lengthy court process in which the U.S. aims to claim the yacht, potentially auction it, and direct proceeds to Ukraine. Kerimov and his family have an estimated net worth of $10.7 billion, mainly through a share in Russian gold giant Polyus, according to Forbes. U.S. Treasury Department sanctions in 2014 and 2018 barred Kerimov from accessing the U.S. financial system over Russia’s actions in Syria and Ukraine. Polyus itself was sanctioned in 2023, though the company disputes these measures. The U.S. Department of Justice alleges Kerimov purchased the Amadea in 2021 and violated sanctions by funneling substantial maintenance payments through U.S. banks. The yacht’s true ownership is being contested. Attorneys for Millemarin Investments, the listed owner, told a court in Fiji that Amadea is actually owned by Eduard Khudainatov, a former Rosneft head who is not sanctioned. The latest complaint does not mention Khudainatov, but U.S. prosecutors say that a 2021 ownership transfer from Millemarin to Errigan Marine was designed to make it appear as if Evgeny Kochman of Imperial Yachts (also sanctioned) was the owner, though they allege Kochman was only a front. A spokesperson for Khudainatov stated that the U.S. Justice Department’s seizure of the vessel was unlawful.
translated_content: アメリカは、制裁を受けているロシアの大富豪スレイマン・ケリモフが所有しているとみられる3億ドルのスーパーヨット「アマデア」の差し押さえ手続きを開始しました。全長106メートルのこのヨットは、2022年5月、米国の要請でフィジー当局によって押収されました。これは、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻後、ウラジーミル・プーチン大統領の関係者を標的にした施策の一環です。 マンハッタンの連邦裁判所に提出された訴状は、アメリカがアマデアの所有権を主張し、最終的に競売にかけて、その収益をウクライナに送ることを目指す、長期化も予想される裁判の始まりです。 ケリモフ氏とその家族の資産は、フォーブスによると主にロシア金鉱大手ポリウスの持株によって107億ドルとされています。米財務省は2014年と2018年、シリアやウクライナでのロシアの行動を理由にケリモフ氏に制裁を科し、アメリカの金融システムへのアクセスを禁じています。ポリウスも2023年に制裁対象となりましたが、同社はこれを不当と主張しています。 米司法省は、ケリモフ氏が2021年にアマデアを購入し、維持費を米国の金融機関を通して多額に支払ったことで制裁違反があったとしています。 ヨットの所有権は争点です。登録上の所有者であるミレマリン・インベストメンツの弁護士はフィジーの裁判所で、アマデアは元ロスネフチ社長で制裁対象でないエドゥアルド・フダイナトフ氏が本当の所有者と主張。最新の訴状にはフダイナトフ氏の名前はありませんが、米検察はミレマリンから新設会社エリガン・マリンへの2021年の所有権移転が、制裁対象であるインペリアル・ヨット社長エフゲニー・コフマン氏を所有者に見せかけるためのものだったと述べており、コフマン氏は名義貸しに過ぎないとしています。 フダイナトフ氏の広報担当者は、アマデアの押収は米司法省による不当な行為だと述べています。

article_content:
Regulators are intensifying their scrutiny of at least four of Europe’s largest banks as they investigate attempts to manipulate the region’s benchmark interest rates. They believe that traders from Barclays led a network that included Crédit Agricole, HSBC, Deutsche Bank, and Société Générale. Authorities are examining evidence of communications between Barclays’ former euroswaps trader Philippe Moryoussef and traders at the other banks, according to information provided to the Financial Times.

This investigation follows the recent resignation of Barclays’ senior management after the bank agreed to pay a £290 million fine to resolve probes in the US and UK into its role in the attempted manipulation of the London interbank offered rate (Libor) and its European counterpart, Euribor. The scandal has led policymakers globally to call for thorough reforms of the system that underpins $500 trillion worth of contracts, ranging from complex derivatives to standard home loans.

In its settlement with Barclays, the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission described an unnamed trader who organized efforts to align trading strategies among multiple banks for profit. Multiple sources have told the Financial Times that this individual was Moryoussef, who worked at Barclays from 2005 until 2007. His alleged strategy involved coordinating three-month swaps pegged to Euribor, set in Brussels by averaging submissions from 44 banks.

An FT investigation indicates that Moryoussef reached out to traders he knew at other banks, either through former employment or personal and professional relationships. Regulators are specifically looking into his communications with Michael Zrihen from Crédit Agricole, Didier Sander from HSBC, and Christian Bittar from Deutsche Bank—all of whom are no longer at those institutions. The identities of Société Générale’s traders under scrutiny remain unclear, and the investigation there appears to be less advanced.

According to the Financial Services Authority, there were at least 20 documented requests from rival bank traders to Barclays’ Euribor submitters to alter rates between 2006 and 2008. While as many as 20 banks have attracted the attention of regulators, detailed information about specific involvement has only recently emerged.

Previously, most banks were thought to have manipulated Libor submissions during the 2007–2009 financial crisis to present themselves as healthier, sometimes with implicit backing from policymakers. However, the current probe suggests that trader activity at Crédit Agricole, HSBC, Deutsche Bank, and Société Générale started years before the crisis. Barclays’ settlement highlighted two separate periods of attempted rate manipulation—one for trading gains, another for financial stability.

Sir Mervyn King, governor of the Bank of England, has invited central bankers—including those from the European Central Bank and the Federal Reserve—to attend a meeting in Switzerland on September 9 to discuss possible comprehensive reforms to the Libor system. The investigation by regulators continues, but so far, no allegations of wrongdoing have been brought against any bank or trader apart from Barclays. All the banks have declined to comment beyond confirming their cooperation with regulators, and the traders in question could not be reached or declined to comment.

欧州の主要銀行4行以上が、地域の基準金利操作の調査対象となっており、規制当局はバークレイズのトレーダーがクレディ・アグリコル、HSBC、ドイツ銀行、ソシエテ・ジェネラルを含むネットワークを主導していたとみています。フィナンシャル・タイムズによると、規制当局はバークレイズ元ユーロスワップトレーダーのフィリップ・モリュセフと他行トレーダーとの間のやり取りの証拠を調査しています。

この調査は、バークレイズが米英の調査でロンドン銀行間取引金利（Libor）と欧州版Euriborの操作関与により2億9000万ポンドの罰金を支払い、経営陣が辞任したことを受けて行われています。この不祥事は、複雑なデリバティブから住宅ローンまで約500兆ドルの契約を支えるシステムの抜本的な改革を求める世界的な議論につながっています。

米商品先物取引委員会（CFTC）との和解では、複数銀行のトレーダーが取引戦略を調整し利益を得ようとしたとされ、その中心的存在は2005〜2007年までバークレイズに在籍していたモリュセフ氏だとフィナンシャル・タイムズは伝えています。彼は、ブリュッセルで44行の提出値を平均して決まるEuriborを基準とする3ヶ月スワップ取引の調整に関与していたとされています。

FTの調査によれば、モリュセフ氏は元同僚や人的ネットワークを通じて関係があった他行トレーダーに接触していたとみられます。規制当局は、クレディ・アグリコルのマイケル・ズリヘン氏、HSBCのディディエ・サンダー氏、ドイツ銀行のクリスチャン・ビタール氏（いずれも現職ではない）との連絡に着目しています。ソシエテ・ジェネラルでは詳細が不明で、調査は初期段階です。

金融サービス庁（FSA）によると、2006〜2008年にかけ他行トレーダーからバークレイズEuribor提出担当者に金利の上下操作を依頼する事例が少なくとも20件あったとされています。注目されている銀行は約20行にのぼりますが、個別の関与については最近まで明確ではありませんでした。

かつては、多くの銀行が2007〜09年の金融危機時に政策担当者の黙認のもと健全性を装うためLibor操作に関与したとみられていました。しかし今回の調査では、クレディ・アグリコル、HSBC、ドイツ銀行、ソシエテ・ジェネラルのトレーダーによる不正が危機の数年前からあった可能性が指摘されています。バークレイズの和解では、取引益を狙った時期と金融安定確保を目的とした時期、2つの異なるレート操作が示されたともされています。

イングランド銀行のキング総裁は欧州中央銀行やFRBなど中央銀行トップに9月9日スイスでの会議へ招待し、Libor改革の議論を呼びかけています。規制当局の調査は続いていますが、現在バークレイズ以外の銀行やトレーダーに対する違法行為の告発はありません。各行はいずれも規制当局への協力以外のコメントは控えており、関与が疑われるトレーダーも連絡が取れないかコメントを拒否しています。

article_content: DALLAS — Texas college student Jade Emerson became captivated while producing a podcast about Lady Bird Johnson, listening to hours of the former first lady recounting everything from childhood memories to advising her husband in the White House. “I fell in love very quickly,” said Emerson, host and producer of the University of Texas podcast “Lady Bird.” “She kept surprising me.” The podcast, released earlier this year, is one of several recent projects utilizing Johnson’s own voice to offer a new perspective on the former first lady, who died in 2007. Other projects include the documentary “The Lady Bird Diaries,” which premieres Monday on Hulu, and an exhibit at the LBJ Presidential Library in Austin, honoring her husband, Lyndon B. Johnson, who died in 1973. Lady Bird Johnson began recording audio diaries in the tumultuous days after her husband became president following the assassination of President John F. Kennedy in Dallas on November 22, 1963. The library released these recordings about a decade after her death, adding to her post-presidential interviews and home movies she narrated. “I don’t know that people appreciated or realized how much she was doing behind the scenes, and I think that’s just now starting to come out,” said Lara Hall, curator at the LBJ Presidential Library. “Lady Bird: Beyond the Wildflowers” highlights the many ways Johnson made an impact. Hall said the exhibit, which closes at the end of the year, has been so popular the library hopes to make parts of it permanent. Emerson, who graduated from UT in May with a journalism degree, relied heavily on Johnson’s interviews with library staff conducted after her husband’s presidency, which ended in 1969. “Just to have her telling her own story was fascinating,” Emerson said. “She kept surprising me. For example, during World War II, when LBJ was serving, she managed his congressional office. She also bought and renovated a radio station in Austin.” The new documentary by filmmaker Dawn Porter, based on Julia Sweig’s 2021 biography “Lady Bird Johnson: Hiding in Plain Sight” and a podcast hosted by Sweig, covers Lady Bird’s years in the White House. From advising her husband on strategy to critiquing his speeches, her influence is clear. Porter also points out that Johnson was a strong environmentalist, women’s advocate, and skilled campaigner. The documentary recalls Johnson’s 1964 “Lady Bird Special” train tour through the South amid racial tensions following the Civil Rights Act’s passage. President Johnson sent her as his surrogate to campaign in a challenging environment. “She did the whistle-stop tour in the very hostile South and did it beautifully,” Porter said. “She did all these things without seeking credit, but she deserves recognition,” Porter added. The couple’s daughter, Luci Baines Johnson, recalls the frustration she felt as a teenager seeing a sign on her mother’s door reading, “I want to be alone.” During this time, Lady Bird worked on her audio tapes, collecting her thoughts, photos, letters, and memories. “She was asking the world for time to do what she was uniquely trained for,” Luci Baines Johnson said, noting Lady Bird’s degrees in history and journalism from the University of Texas. “She was just exceptional,” she said. “She believed a day without learning was a wasted day.” Emerson describes her work on the podcast as “a huge gift,” saying she spent more time with Lady Bird than anyone else during college. “She taught me about the legacy I want to leave and how to treat people.” “Her voice always makes me smile,” Emerson said.

ダラス — テキサスの大学生ジェイド・エマーソンは、レディ・バード・ジョンソンについてのポッドキャスト制作中に、元大統領夫人が子ども時代の思い出やホワイトハウスで夫を助けた話など、長時間かけて自らの経験を語る記録を聴き、魅了されました。「すぐに夢中になりました」と、テキサス大学のポッドキャスト「Lady Bird」のホスト兼プロデューサー、エマーソンさんは語ります。「本当に何度も驚かされました。」

このポッドキャストは今年初めに公開され、2007年に亡くなったレディ・バード・ジョンソン元大統領夫人の声を活用し、彼女の人生と業績に新しい角度から光を当てる近年のプロジェクトの1つです。他にも、Huluで今週月曜に公開されるドキュメンタリー『The Lady Bird Diaries』や、1973年に亡くなったリンドン・B・ジョンソン大統領の功績を称えるオースティンのLBJ大統領図書館での展示があります。

レディ・バード・ジョンソンは、1963年11月22日にダラスでジョン・F・ケネディ大統領が暗殺された直後、夫の大統領就任という激動の日々の中で音声日記を録音し始めました。図書館は彼女の死後約10年後にこれらを公開し、退任後のインタビューや自己的に語ったホームムービーとも合わせて展示されています。「彼女がどれほど裏方で活躍していたのか、多くの人は気付いていなかったと思いますが、ようやく世の中に明らかになりつつあります」と、LBJ大統領図書館のラーラ・ホール主任は語ります。「Lady Bird: Beyond the Wildflowers」は、ジョンソン氏がどれだけ多方面で活躍したかを紹介しています。この展示は年末で終了予定ですが、好評のため一部を常設展示にすることも検討されています。

今年5月にジャーナリズムの学位を取得してUTを卒業したエマーソンさんは、夫の大統領退任後に図書館スタッフが行ったジョンソン夫人のインタビュー記録に大きく頼りました。「彼女自身が物語を語るのは、本当に面白かった」とエマーソンさん。「たとえば、第二次世界大戦中、LBJが従軍していた間に議員事務所を切り盛りしていたこと、そしてオースティンでラジオ局を買い取り、再興させたことなど、何度も驚かされました。」

ジュリア・スワイクの2021年の伝記『Lady Bird Johnson: Hiding in Plain Sight』や、スワイク本人がホストを務めるポッドキャストを元にしたドーン・ポーター監督の新作ドキュメンタリーは、ホワイトハウス時代のレディ・バード夫人の姿に迫ります。夫へのアドバイスやスピーチへの意見、環境問題や女性擁護活動など、多方面での彼女の影響力が描かれています。

ドキュメンタリーでは、1964年、公民権法成立後に緊張が高まる南部で、レディ・バード夫人が“Lady Bird Special”号に乗り選挙キャンペーンを担ったエピソードも紹介されています。大統領の代理として困難な南部を歴訪し、見事にやり遂げたとポーター監督は評価します。「彼女は評価を求めず多くのことを達成しましたが、その功績は称賛に値します」と監督は述べています。

夫妻の娘ルーシー・ベインズ・ジョンソンさんは、10代の頃、母の部屋のドアノブに「一人になりたい」と掲示されていた紙を見てもどかしかったと振り返ります。その間、レディ・バード夫人は写真や手紙、記憶を元に音声テープに思い付きを録音していました。「母は特別な能力や知識を活かす時間を周囲に求めていました」とルーシーさんは語り、母が歴史とジャーナリズムでテキサス大学の学位を取得していたことに触れました。「本当に素晴らしい人で、“学びのない日は無駄な日”が信念でした」と続けます。

エマーソンさんは制作を「大きな贈り物」と振り返り、「大学で誰よりも長くレディ・バード夫人と向き合っていた」と語りました。「彼女から自分がどんなレガシーを築きたいか、人との接し方を学びました。」「彼女の声を聞くと自然と笑顔になります」と結んでいます。

article_content: Formula One returned to Las Vegas for the first time since 1982, drawing the largest U.S. television audience for the series since June, according to ESPN. Despite airing in the middle of the night for East Coast viewers, the Las Vegas Grand Prix, which began at 1 a.m. Eastern, averaged 1.3 million viewers. This marks the third-largest F1 audience of the season on cable, and the sixth-largest overall on ESPN platforms. The broadcast, which ended just after 3 a.m. Eastern, peaked at 1.5 million viewers between 1:15 and 1:30 a.m. ET. The Las Vegas Grand Prix was also the most-watched F1 race since June’s Canadian Grand Prix on ABC, which had 1.76 million viewers, and it was the most-watched cable telecast after 11 p.m. Eastern on Saturday night and during the overnight hours. The 2023 F1 season has featured three of the four largest live F1 audiences ever on U.S. television: 1.96 million for Miami, 1.79 million for Monaco, and 1.76 million for Canada. Max Verstappen won the Las Vegas race, marking his 18th victory in 21 races this season. The season will conclude with the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix on Sunday, Nov. 26. For more, visit AP auto racing: https://apnews.com/hub/auto-racing

article_content: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) and the National Small Industries Corporation Limited (NSIC) are set to back Sorin Investments, a technology-focused startup fund co-founded by Sanjay Nayar, former head of KKR India. The Rs 10,000-crore Self Reliant India (SRI) Fund, managed by NSIC Venture Capital Fund Limited (NVCFL)—a wholly owned subsidiary of NSIC—and SIDBI will invest about Rs 300 crore in Sorin Investments, according to sources familiar with the development. These new investments will help Sorin complete its first fund at Rs 1,300 crore. NVCFL is registered with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) as a Category II Alternative Investment Fund. The SRI Fund, sponsored by NSIC, employs a fund-of-funds strategy, investing in SEBI-registered Category I and II alternative investment funds that, in turn, invest in micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs). Sorin Investments, co-founded by Sanjay Nayar and Angad Banga (a former principal at KKR), raised over Rs 1,000 crore in August and has invested about Rs 80 crore in two startups so far. The fund plans to invest another Rs 70 crore in two further deals by 2023, sources say. Sorin is backed by notable investors including Henry Kravis and George Roberts (co-founders of KKR & Co.), Sunil Kant Munjal (chairman of Hero Enterprise), and various Indian family offices. The fund focuses on early-stage technology startups across fintech, edtech, SaaS, logistics, clean technologies, and direct-to-consumer products and brands, typically investing between $2 million and $10 million in target companies. Sorin’s first investment was in Uniqus Consultech, an ESG consulting firm co-founded by Jamil Khatri (former global head of accounting advisory at KPMG) and Sandip Khetan (former head of financial accounting advisory services at EY India). In February, Sorin Investments, along with existing investors Accel and Nexus Venture Partners, invested $8.3 million in Venwiz, a SaaS-enabled marketplace for Capex and MRO (Maintenance, Repair and Operations) services, during its Series A funding round. Sorin Investments was launched in 2022 by Sanjay Nayar, who previously led KKR India for 14 years after a stint as CEO of Citibank’s Indian and South Asian operations.
translated_content: インド中小企業開発銀行（SIDBI）と国立中小企業公社（NSIC）は、KKRインディア元代表のサンジェイ・ナヤールが共同設立したテクノロジー特化型スタートアップファンド「Sorin Investments」を支援する予定です。NSICの100%子会社であるNSICベンチャーキャピタルファンドリミテッド（NVCFL）が運営する自己依存インド（SRI）ファンド（1兆ルピー規模）およびSIDBIが、関係者によるとSorin Investmentsに約30億ルピーを投資する計画です。これらの新しい出資によって、Sorinは初のファンドを130億ルピーで完了させる見込みです。 NVCFLは証券取引委員会（SEBI）のカテゴリーIIオルタナティブ投資ファンドとして登録されています。NSICがスポンサーのSRIファンドは「ファンド・オブ・ファンズ」戦略を採用し、SEBI登録済みのカテゴリーIおよびIIのオルタナティブ投資ファンドに投資し、それを通じて中小企業（MSME）に資金を間接的に供給します。 Sorin Investments はサンジェイ・ナヤール氏とアングド・バンガ氏（元KKRプリンシパル）が共同設立し、8月に100億ルピー以上を調達済みです。すでに2社のスタートアップに約8億ルピーを投資しており、2023年までにさらに2件で合計7億ルピーを投資する予定です。 Sorinは、ヘンリー・クラビス氏とジョージ・ロバーツ氏（いずれもKKR & Co共同創業者）、スニル・カント・ムンジャール氏（ヒーロー・エンタープライズ会長）、そして複数のインド系ファミリーオフィスなど、著名な投資家から支援を受けています。 このファンドは、フィンテック、エドテック、SaaS、ロジスティクス、クリーンテック、D2Cブランドなど、さまざまな業界の初期段階テクノロジースタートアップに注目し、1社あたり200万～1000万ドルを投資対象としています。 Sorinの最初の投資先は、ジミル・カトリ氏（KPMG元グローバル会計アドバイザリー部門責任者）とサンディープ・ケタン氏（EYインディア元会計アドバイザリーサービス責任者）が共同創業したESGコンサルタント企業Unquius Consultechです。 また、2023年2月には既存投資家AccelおよびNexus Venture Partnersとともに、SaaS型Capex・MRO（設備＆保守運用）領域のマーケットプレイスVenwizに830万ドル（シリーズAラウンド）を出資しました。 Sorin Investmentsは2022年創設され、サンジェイ・ナヤール氏は14年間KKRインディアのトップを務めた後、シティバンク・インド・南アジア部門の元CEOとしての経験も持っています。

article_content:
If Saido Berahino is called up to the full England squad next month, no one at West Bromwich Albion will be prouder than James Morrison. As a Scottish international with seven years at the club, Morrison is deeply invested in Albion’s progress, a commitment that came to the forefront last season during a heated dressing room incident where a punch was allegedly thrown at Berahino. After the altercation, there were concerns Berahino would seek a transfer, especially as former player Peter Odemwingie suggested similar experiences of being singled out during his tenure. 

Berahino, who has been in top form as the leading English goalscorer in the Premier League this season, is drawing praise for his performances. Morrison, who is pictured playing for Scotland and maintains high expectations for his teammates, would be delighted to see Berahino receive an England call-up.

Ahead of Albion’s upcoming match against Manchester United at the Hawthorns on Monday, Morrison stands by his actions, insisting senior players are not bullies but are committed to fostering high standards. 'We recently held a meeting on standards. The manager sets them and expects us to uphold them every day,' Morrison said. 'He leads, and we follow. It’s not about bullying—it’s about striving for excellence as professionals.'

Morrison notes that the team environment has improved markedly: new players have integrated seamlessly and the squad now boasts strong leadership. 'Saido’s been outstanding—his goal-scoring does the talking,' Morrison added. 'Give him a chance and he’ll put it away. He’s even stepping up to take penalties.'

Morrison has played a crucial role in West Brom’s bright start to the season, thriving in a deeper midfield position under new manager Alan Irvine, a role he mirrored successfully for Scotland in recent Euro 2016 qualifying matches. Berahino also impressed for Gareth Southgate’s England Under-21 side against Croatia last week.

Morrison is embracing the style encouraged by Irvine, who was initially an unpopular choice among fans. 'We’re focusing on passing much more. Against Burnley, we completed about 600 passes, which the analysts said was on par with Barcelona,' said Morrison. 'With 11 new players and a new manager, it was always going to need time. Now, everyone is fit and working hard for the manager. That’s our foundation—we just need to keep building.'

He credited team bonding on the training ground and praised the coaching staff for effective sessions. Looking ahead to the match against Manchester United, Morrison said the team is studying how Leicester managed to surprise United in an earlier fixture. 'We’re working on strategies to challenge them. They love to push forward, which gives us opportunities to counterattack.'

来月、サイド・ベラヒノがイングランド代表に選ばれれば、ウェスト・ブロムウィッチ・アルビオン（WBA）で最も誇りに思うのはジェームズ・モリソンだろう。スコットランド代表として7年間クラブに所属しているモリソンは、アルビオンへの思い入れが強く、その情熱は昨季のベラヒノに対するロッカールームでの激しい口論（パンチが投げられたともされる）で浮き彫りになった。この件を受け、かつての選手ピーター・オデムウィンギーが自分も同様に標的にされたと主張したこともあり、ベラヒノが移籍を望むのではないかとの懸念が広がった。

今季プレミアリーグでイングランド人最多得点を記録し絶好調のベラヒノは、そのプレーぶりが高く評価されている。モリソンはスコットランド代表としても活躍し、常にチームメイトに高い期待を持っており、ベラヒノが代表に入れば非常に誇らしく思うはずだ。

月曜、アルビオンはホームのホーソンズでマンチェスター・ユナイテッドを迎え撃つが、モリソンは自身の行動について反省する様子はなく、ベテラン選手がいじめをしているのではなく、単に高い基準を設けているだけだと主張した。「最近、基準についての話し合いをしました。マネージャーがしっかり方向性を示し、我々にクリアな目標を与えてくれます。彼が率い、私たちはその後に続くだけ。いじめというより、ただプロとしてベストを尽くそうとしているんです」とモリソン。

チームの雰囲気が大きく良くなったと語るモリソンは、「サイドは本当に素晴らしい活躍をしている。ゴールでしっかり結果を出しているし、ペナルティキックも任されている」とも述べた。

モリソンは今季序盤の好調なチームの中心として、新監督アラン・アーヴィンのもとで中盤のより深い位置でプレーしており、その役割は最近のユーロ2016予選のスコットランド代表でも同様に成功している。ベラヒノも先週、ギャレス・サウスゲート率いるイングランドU21代表のクロアチア戦で活躍した。

モリソンはいまや人気を得つつあるアーヴィン監督によるパス重視スタイルの変化に手応えを感じている。「僕たちはボールを回すことが増えました。バーンリー戦では600本近くパスをつなげたし、アナリストが“バルセロナみたいだ”って言ってたよ。新監督と新戦力11人が加わったから時間はかかったけど、みんな体調も良いし、監督のために頑張ってる。それが基盤。ここからもっと進んでいきたい」とモリソン。

チームが練習場で一体感を深めていることや、コーチングスタッフの質の高いセッションが良い影響を与えていると強調した。マンU戦に向けても、レスターが敵地でユナイテッドを打ち破った試合を研究している。「彼らは前がかりなプレーが多いからカウンターのチャンスがあると思っている」とモリソンは意気込みを語った。

article_content:
Americans frequently use profanity in everyday life, from conversations to movies, TV, books, and magazines. Yet there is a curious double standard: while swearing is common among the general public, we often expect our politicians to avoid it completely, condemning even minor lapses in public speech.

Recently, House Speaker John Boehner was criticized for asking his colleagues to “call bulls--- bulls---.” President Obama raised eyebrows in 2010 when, during a TV interview about the BP oil spill, he said he wanted to know “whose ass to kick.” Vice President Joe Biden also received backlash for telling Obama at a healthcare law signing, “This is a big f---- deal!”

The author argues that this restraint is unnecessary and even hypocritical. People express themselves passionately, and communication is often more genuine when uncensored. By forcing politicians to be overly cautious, we may be stifling their authenticity, making them seem bland and less relatable. The author doesn't advocate for swearing in all settings (such as speaking to schoolchildren), but suggests politicians should be permitted to show more emotion when appropriate.

The article mentions that even in the corporate world, recruiters sometimes view appropriate profanity as a sign of authenticity and commitment. The author then proposes a televised, uncensored presidential debate—perhaps on HBO—between President Obama and Mitt Romney. This, he argues, would offer voters a more genuine glimpse of the candidates, helping them evaluate sincerity and responses to criticism.

Some may object to profanity in politics. For instance, Middleborough, Massachusetts, voted to fine public profanity, and the Washington City Council banned council members from using bad language in meetings. The author acknowledges these objections, but points out that many U.S. presidents—including Harry Truman, John F. Kennedy, Lyndon Johnson, George W. Bush, Bill Clinton, and Richard Nixon—have used foul language, at least in private.

Allowing some swearing in political debates won’t solve major national problems, the author admits, but it could help voters see candidates’ true personalities and foster greater engagement in the democratic process. He predicts such a debate would attract widespread attention and maybe become the most quoted in presidential history.

The views expressed are those of Dean Obeidallah.
translated_content:
アメリカ人は日常生活でよく罵り言葉（プロファニティ）を使います。会話はもちろん、映画やテレビ、本や雑誌にも溢れています。しかし、面白いことに、一般ではよく使われるのに、政治家にはそれを絶対に許さず、少しでも公の場で口にすると厳しく非難されます。

最近では、ジョン・ベイナー下院議長が同僚に「ブルシットはブルシットと呼ぼう」と発言して批判されました。2010年、バラク・オバマ大統領もBPの原油流出対応で「ケツをける相手を突き止めたい」とテレビインタビューで語り、話題に。ジョー・バイデン副大統領も医療保険法署名の場で「これはとんでもなく重要なことだ！」と発言し、反発を受けました。

筆者は、こうした自粛は偽善的だと指摘します。人は熱くなる時、素直な表現が本音を伝えるものです。政治家に過度に抑制を強いることで、本音や親しみやすさが失われることもあります。もちろん、全ての場面での乱暴な言葉を許すべきとは思いませんが、適切な場面では感情を素直に出してもいいはずです。

最近はビジネスの世界でも、適切なプロファニティは「本気度」や「誠実さ」のサインとされることも。そこで筆者は、オバマ大統領とミット・ロムニー氏によるノーカットの大統領討論会をHBOで放送する案を提案します。これにより有権者が候補者の本心や人間性をより正確に見極められると主張しています。

もちろん、政治での乱暴な言葉に反対する意見もあります。例えば、マサチューセッツ州ミドルボロウでは公共の場での罵りに20ドルの罰金を科し、ワシントン市議会では会議中の不適切発言を禁止しました。筆者はそうした反論にも触れつつ、過去の大統領（ハリー・トルーマン、ジョン・F・ケネディ、リンドン・ジョンソン、ジョージ・W・ブッシュ、ビル・クリントン、リチャード・ニクソン）が私的に乱暴な言葉を使っていた実例を挙げます。

討論会でのプロファニティが国家の問題を解決するわけではありませんが、候補者の人間性や本心を知るきっかけとなり、民主主義への関心を高める助けになるかもしれません。実現すれば、史上最も話題になり、よく引用される討論会となるでしょう。

この記事の意見は、ディーン・オベイダラ氏個人のものです。

article_content: Aldi has become a go-to choice for British families looking to reduce grocery costs. However, shoppers in the UK are paying nearly twice as much for some items compared to Aldi stores in Europe. According to an investigation by The Mail on Sunday, products such as fruit, meat, and alcohol are significantly cheaper at Aldi branches in Germany, Spain, and France. A basket of common groceries was found to cost £44.92 at a North West London store, while the equivalent was £23.13 in Marbella (Spain), £23.38 in Berlin (Germany), and £26.64 in Paris (France). These price gaps are notable given that most food in Britain is VAT-free, unlike other European countries, although the UK does levy higher duties on alcohol. This is particularly striking since, given the current strength of the pound against the euro, British shoppers could expect to get better value abroad. Aldi has promoted itself as a low-cost retailer, especially for alcohol, yet research suggests European stores offer even better deals. For example, six 330ml beers cost £3.99 in England, compared to £1.19 in Spain, and larger six-packs range from £1.34 in Germany to £1.45 in France. A bottle of Bordeaux Superieur red wine sells for £4.99 in Britain, but similar wine costs just £1.97 in Germany. Meat and dairy are also less expensive overseas: a 1.65kg chicken is £3.99 in Britain (£2.42/kg), whereas in Germany, a 1.4kg chicken sells for £2.60 (£1.86/kg). Two pints of semi-skimmed milk are 79p in Britain (39.5p/pint), but just 20.4p per pint in Germany, and 22p per pint in France. Commenting on these findings, Tony Baines, joint managing director of corporate buying at Aldi, said the difference in prices is not unique to Aldi, claiming that the company offers the best quality at the most competitive price in the UK, with shoppers able to save 30–50% compared to traditional UK supermarkets.
translated_content: Aldiは、食費を節約したいイギリスの家族の強い味方として人気を集めています。しかし、イギリスのAldi利用者は、ヨーロッパの店舗と比べて一部商品でほぼ2倍の価格を支払っています。The Mail on Sundayの調査によれば、果物、肉類、アルコール類などの製品は、ドイツ、スペイン、フランスのAldiでより安く購入できます。北西ロンドンの店舗で共通の食料品バスケットを購入すると44.92ポンドですが、マルベーリャ（スペイン）では23.13ポンド、ベルリン（ドイツ）では23.38ポンド、パリ（フランス）では26.64ポンドでした。イギリスでは多くの食品にVAT（付加価値税）がかからない一方、他のヨーロッパ諸国では課税されており、ただしイギリスはアルコールの税金が高いことも価格差に影響しています。現在、ポンドの対ユーロ高もあり、イギリスの買い物客は本来ならもっとお得に買い物ができそうですが、実際にはヨーロッパ店舗の方が安いのが現状です。Aldiは特にアルコール商品に強い格安小売店として知られていますが、調査ではヨーロッパの店舗の方がさらにお得であることが分かりました。たとえば、330mlビール6本はイギリスで3.99ポンド、スペインで1.19ポンド。500mlビール6本はドイツで1.34ポンド、フランスで1.45ポンドです。ボルドー・スーペリュール赤ワインはイギリスで4.99ポンドですが、ドイツでは同等のワインがわずか1.97ポンドです。肉や乳製品も海外の方が安く、例えば1.65kgの鶏肉はイギリスで3.99ポンド（1kgあたり2.42ポンド）ですが、ドイツの1.4kgの鳥は2.60ポンド（1kgあたり1.86ポンド）です。イギリスでは低脂肪牛乳2パイントが79ペンス（1パイントあたり39.5ペンス）ですが、ドイツでは2.5パイントで51ペンス（1パイントあたり20.4ペンス）、フランスでは2.5パイントで55ペンス（1パイントあたり22ペンス）です。これらの調査結果について、Aldiの企業購買担当共同マネージングディレクターのトニー・ベインズ氏は「価格差はAldi特有の現象ではなく、Aldiはイギリスで最高品質の商品を最も競争力のある価格で提供している。イギリス国内の他のスーパーマーケットと比べて、毎週30～50％の節約ができる」とコメントしています。

article_content: An increasing number of people are indulging in gourmet, chef-prepared meals without leaving home, courtesy of an online platform that brings professional chefs to private kitchens. Although private dining at home isn’t brand new, internet-based services have made this option much more popular. Chef Enrico Lionti, based in Paris, left the restaurant industry to cook for clients in their homes. He joined La Belle Assiette—a site that pairs clients with independent, thoroughly evaluated chefs for bespoke in-home dining experiences. La Belle Assiette requires its chefs to pass strict assessments, ensuring high standards for clients. For Lionti, this offers the freedom to design his menus, set his own schedule, and focus fully on his passion for cooking. Lionti shared that while he knew of home-chef opportunities before, joining La Belle Assiette helped him transition smoothly without starting from scratch. From around €45 (£35) per guest, La Belle Assiette chefs handle every detail: buying ingredients, preparing dishes, serving guests, and cleaning up afterward. Lionti now works several evenings each week throughout the city and is satisfied with his new way of working. The company, co-founded by Stephen Leguillon, looks after bookings, billing, and customer support so that chefs can concentrate on their culinary work. The service runs in the UK, France, Belgium, Switzerland, and Luxembourg, taking a commission in return. La Belle Assiette aims to help people rediscover the pleasures of home entertaining and is planning to expand into other countries. Client Audrey Stora described her experience with Chef Lionti at her home, enjoying a surprise amuse-bouche and foie gras, and appreciated having everything prepared, served, and cleaned up, making it easy to relax with friends.

article_content:
David Cameron, the former UK prime minister who resigned following the 2016 Brexit referendum, has returned unexpectedly to government as foreign secretary in Rishi Sunak's cabinet. To assume the post, Cameron has become Lord Cameron and joined the House of Lords, succeeding James Cleverly.

This appointment surprised many in Westminster, as Sunak had recently tried to set his leadership apart from previous administrations. Although Cameron opposed Sunak's recent decision to cancel the northern section of the HS2 rail project, he now supports Sunak’s leadership, calling him capable and expressing a desire to help strengthen the Conservatives ahead of an election where Labour leads in the polls.

Cameron's leadership experience is viewed as valuable during a time of international crises like those in the Middle East and Ukraine. Still, his presence alongside seasoned ministers such as Jeremy Hunt and Michael Gove may make it harder for Sunak to present the government as renewed and different. Some Conservatives are wary of Cameron's past pro-engagement stance toward China while he was prime minister.

After stepping down, Cameron mostly left the political scene, writing his memoirs and supporting Alzheimer’s research. However, he drew scrutiny for lobbying on behalf of Greensill Capital, a financial firm that later collapsed, and was criticized for his actions during the Covid pandemic.

Earlier, Cameron led a coalition government with the Liberal Democrats, driving reforms in education, health care, welfare, and pensions, though austerity measures and tuition increases faced backlash. His leadership was shaped by the Scottish independence and European Union referendums—the latter leading to his resignation after voters chose Brexit.

Having left frontline politics, Cameron now returns to power under Prime Minister Sunak, a notable supporter of Brexit, opening a new chapter in his political life.

2016年のブレグジット国民投票後に辞任した元イギリス首相デービッド・キャメロン氏が、リシ・スナク政権で外相として予想外の復帰を果たしました。この職に就くため、キャメロン氏は「キャメロン卿」として貴族院入りし、ジェームズ・クレバリー氏の後任となります。

この人事は、スナク首相が直近まで自身のリーダーシップをこれまでの政権と差別化しようとしていたこともあり、ウェストミンスターで大きな驚きをもって受け止められました。キャメロン氏は先日、HS2鉄道計画北部区間の中止に反対する意向を示していましたが、現在はスナク氏を「有能なリーダー」と評価し、労働党が優勢の中で保守党の結束強化に意欲を示しています。

中東やウクライナなどで国際的な危機が続く現状で、キャメロン氏の豊富な経験が政権の強みとなる一方、ジェレミー・ハント氏やマイケル・ゴーブ氏らベテラン勢と並び、「刷新」イメージが弱まるとの見方もあります。また、首相時代に中国との関係強化を進めた過去に対する党内不安も残ります。

辞任後は政界の表舞台から距離を置き、自伝出版や認知症研究支援に携わっていたキャメロン氏ですが、金融会社グリーンスル・キャピタルへのロビー活動が物議を醸し、コロナ禍での行為も批判を受けました。

以前は自由民主党と連立政権を組み、教育・医療・福祉・年金分野で改革を断行した一方、緊縮財政や学費値上げは反発も招きました。スコットランド独立投票とEU離脱投票という2つの国民投票が政権を左右し、ブレグジット選択後に辞任。その後は一線を退きましたが、今回ブレグジット支持のスナク政権で中央政界へ復帰し、新たな政治人生の章が始まりました。

article_content:
Virgin Australia is undergoing a comprehensive revamp aimed at winning over business travelers from its competitor Qantas. Executives at the airline, formerly known as Virgin Blue, believe that the casual, cheeky approach of their cabin crews has become too relaxed for a corporate audience, and are seeking to establish a more sophisticated atmosphere.

As part of this shift, staff will participate in 'Elevate'—a program that focuses on etiquette, wine appreciation, grooming, and body language. The traditional Australian greeting 'mate' will only be permitted when addressing frequent flyers who have provided prior consent in the airline’s database.

Previously, Virgin Australia’s staff fostered a playful image, a style encouraged since the airline’s founding in 2000 by Sir Richard Branson. For example, last year, supermodel Elle Macpherson led 60 employees in a fashion show to debut new uniforms inspired by glamorous events.

Now, the airline aims to update not only staff behavior and appearance but also customer spaces. At Melbourne Airport, the lounge will be refurbished: the pool table will be replaced with trained baristas and a buffet to suit a more business-oriented clientele.

Mark Hassell, group executive of brand and customer experience, emphasized: 'We are not creating clones or straightjackets for our people. We want to retain the spirit that makes Virgin unique, but present it in a way that resonates with corporate and business travelers.'

These changes follow an earlier initiative by Virgin Atlantic to offer whispering lessons to flight attendants serving Upper Class passengers, aiming for a calming effect. As Richard Fitzgerald, Virgin Atlantic's whispering coach, explained, it is crucial for cabin crew to refine their skills to ensure the most comfortable experience for passengers.

ヴァージン・オーストラリアは、ライバルのカンタスからビジネストラベラーの支持を得るため、大規模な改革を進めています。旧ヴァージン・ブルーとして知られる同社の経営陣は、客室乗務員のカジュアルで親しみやすい対応が企業顧客にはややラフすぎると判断し、より洗練された雰囲気を目指しています。

この一環として、スタッフは「エレベート」というプログラムに参加します。このプログラムでは、エチケット、ワインの知識、身だしなみ、ボディランゲージに重点を置いた研修が行われます。また、伝統的なオーストラリアのあいさつ「mate（マイト）」は、事前に同意を得た常連顧客にのみ使用が許可されます。

これまでヴァージン・オーストラリアのスタッフは、2000年の創業者リチャード・ブランソン氏が推奨した遊び心あるスタイルで知られてきました。昨年はスーパーモデルのエル・マクファーソン氏が60名の従業員とともに、新しい華やかな制服を披露するファッションショーを実施しました。

今後はスタッフの振る舞いや外見だけでなく、顧客スペースにも変化が加えられます。メルボルン空港のラウンジでは、ビリヤード台が撤去され、バリスタによるコーヒーサービスやビュッフェが導入されます。

ブランドおよびカスタマーエクスペリエンス担当グループ・エグゼクティブのマーク・ハッセル氏は「私たちはスタッフを型にはめるつもりはありません。ヴァージンの持つ精神を残しつつ、ビジネス顧客や企業ユーザーにも合う形に進化させていきます」と述べています。

この動きは、以前ヴァージン・アトランティックがアッパークラス乗客のため、客室乗務員に「ささやきレッスン」を導入した事例に続くものです。講師のリチャード・フィッツジェラルド氏は「乗務員がスキルを磨いて最高の快適さを乗客に提供できるようにすることが大切です」と語っています。

article_content:
THIRUVANANTHAPURAM: India's space economy is expected to reach USD 40 billion by 2040, with improved working environments for scientists, Union Minister Jitendra Singh said here. Singh, who serves as the Minister of State for Science and Technology, Atomic Energy, and Space, stated that some foreign agencies, such as AKD, predict the figure could rise as high as USD 100 billion by 2040.

"Currently, our space economy is around USD 8 billion, but we are making significant advancements. For example, from launching foreign satellites alone, India has earned about EUR 230-240 million for European launches and around USD 170-180 million for American satellites," Singh said. He made these remarks to PTI after inaugurating the 60th-anniversary celebrations of ISRO's rocket launch on Saturday.

Singh emphasized that the establishment of the National Research Foundation (Anu Sandhan), modeled after similar organizations in the US, could boost industry participation. "With this, more than 70 percent of our space resources are expected to come from the non-government sector, supplementing our resources," he explained.

Acknowledging past resource constraints, Singh noted that India overcame them through scientific expertise. "We may even surpass other countries. While others were first to land a human on the Moon, Chandrayaan was the first to detect the H2O molecule there," he said.

Singh called the decision to open the space sector to private companies a game-changer, resulting in increased financial and knowledge resources. He added that this move has also made space science more popular in India, especially after the nation's involvement in the Chandrayaan mission.

The minister highlighted the upcoming Gaganyaan human spaceflight mission as the next major milestone for India, with the first trial flight test already completed. He stated that by 2025, India would send a human to space and safely return them, and that a female robot capable of mimicking an astronaut's actions would be launched a few months prior.

ティルヴァナンタプラム：インドの宇宙経済は2040年までに400億米ドルに達すると予測されており、科学者たちもより良い労働環境を享受できるようになるとジテンドラ・シン連邦大臣が述べました。科学技術・原子力・宇宙担当国務大臣のシン氏は、AKDのような海外機関の中には、この額が2040年までに1,000億米ドルに達する可能性もあると予測していると語っています。

「現時点で、私たちの宇宙経済は約80億米ドルですが、大きな進歩を遂げています。例えば、外国衛星の打ち上げだけで、ヨーロッパ向けに約2億3,000万～2億4,000万ユーロ、アメリカ向けに約1億7,000万～1億8,000万米ドルを獲得しています」とシン氏は述べ、土曜日に開かれたISROロケット打ち上げ60周年記念式典後にPTIへ語りました。

シン氏は、米国の類似組織を参考に設立された全国研究財団（アヌ・サンダン）が産業界の参入をさらに推進できると強調。「これにより、宇宙関連資源の70％超が非政府部門からもたらされ、リソースも拡充されるでしょう」と説明しました。

過去のリソース不足についても認めつつ、インドは科学技術の力でこれを乗り越えてきたと語ったシン氏。「他国が人類を最初に月へ着陸させましたが、チャンドラヤーンは月面でH2O分子を初めて発見しました」とも述べています。

宇宙分野を民間企業に開放した政策が転換点となり、資金面・知識面ともにリソースが大幅増となったとシン氏は指摘。特にチャンドラヤーン計画を通じて、国内で宇宙科学の関心が一気に広がったとも付け加えました。

次なる大きな目標として、既にテストフライトが成功した有人宇宙飛行計画「ガガンヤーン」を挙げ、2025年までにインド人宇宙飛行士が宇宙へ行き無事帰還する計画で、数か月前には宇宙飛行士の動きが再現できる女性型ロボットを宇宙へ送り込む予定だと述べました。

article_content: Reverend Wendy Dalrymple, the precentor and head of worship at Canterbury Cathedral, has faced online criticism for her tattoos. She recently revealed a new tattoo of a feather, which she says represents God's protection. After a photo of her with bare arms was shared online by her husband during the summer, Dalrymple was subjected to negative comments, including accusations of narcissism and remarks about her appearance. Dalrymple believes that much of the backlash is due to misogyny. She commented, 'I was accused of being a narcissist, people commented on my clothing, and there were remarks about my hair. Good old misogyny rears its head – people have opinions about what women do with their bodies. I wonder if a male cleric with tattoos would receive the same responses.' The Dean of Canterbury, the Very Reverend Dr. David Monteith, responded on social media, stating his commitment to making the cathedral a place that addresses misogyny, entitled power, and prejudice. Dalrymple encourages visitors to Canterbury Cathedral to talk to her about their own tattoos, noting that tattoos can be a meaningful way to share stories. 'Everyone is different,' she said, 'and it doesn’t matter what you look like, what clothes you wear, whether you have tattoos or not, dreadlocks or not, piercings or not. Whoever you are and whatever your background, you are welcome at Canterbury Cathedral.'
translated_content: カンタベリー大聖堂の礼拝主任であるウェンディ・ダルリンプル牧師は、自身のタトゥーを理由にオンラインで批判を受けてきました。彼女は最近、神の守りを象徴する羽のタトゥーを新たに入れたことを明かしました。夏に夫が撮影した腕を見せた写真がネット上で共有されてから、彼女にはナルシストだという非難や外見に関する否定的なコメントが寄せられました。 ダルリンプル牧師は、この反発の多くがミソジニー（女性蔑視）によるものだと考えています。彼女は「私はナルシストだと非難され、服装や髪型についてもコメントがありました。“古き良きミソジニー”が顔を出すのです。世間は女性の体について意見を持ちたがります。もし私がタトゥーのある男性聖職者だったら、同じ反応を受けたでしょうか」と述べました。 カンタベリー大聖堂の院長であるデイヴィッド・モンティース師は、SNSで「大聖堂をミソジニーや特権意識、偏見に立ち向かう場所にすることを誓う」と表明しました。 ダルリンプル牧師は、訪問者に自身のタトゥーの話をすることを勧めています。タトゥーは物語を分かち合う手段になると彼女は考えています。「誰もが違います。見た目や服装、タトゥーの有無、ドレッドヘアかどうか、ピアスがあってもなくても関係ありません。どんな人でも、どんな背景でも、カンタベリー大聖堂はみなさんを歓迎します」と語りました。

article_content: Ecuadorean authorities, aided by U.S. drug enforcement agents, have seized a fully operational submarine intended for large-scale cocaine transportation. The vessel was built by a drug trafficking organization and is currently held near the Ecuador-Colombia border. One individual has been taken into custody, and the investigation continues.  According to the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), this is the first recorded seizure of a clandestinely constructed, fully functional submarine designed to support trans-oceanic drug trafficking.  The submarine is diesel-electric powered, equipped with twin screws, a periscope, and air-conditioning. Measuring about 30 meters (98 feet) in length and nearly 3 meters (nine feet) in height from deck plate to ceiling, the vessel represents a significant advancement in smuggling technology.  Jay Bergman, DEA's Andean regional director, noted that smugglers have previously used fishing boats, sailboats, pleasure craft, and 'go-fast' boats. The emergence of the so-called 'narco-submarine' poses new challenges for maritime patrols, given its extended range, large payload, and enhanced stealth capabilities, raising the stakes for drug enforcement and national security.  Authorities say the submarine was secretly constructed in a remote jungle location to avoid detection by law enforcement or military forces. Acting on intelligence, Ecuadorean officials were able to intercept the vessel before it could make its first voyage.  Reporting by CNN's Carol Cratty.
translated_content: エクアドル当局は、米国の麻薬取締官の協力を得て、大量のコカイン輸送を目的とした完全に機能する潜水艦を押収しました。この船舶は麻薬密輸組織によって建造され、現在エクアドルとコロンビアの国境付近で保管されています。当局は1名を拘束し、捜査は継続中です。  米国麻薬取締局（DEA）によると、これは大西洋横断の麻薬密輸を目的とした秘密裏に建造された完全稼働の潜水艦が押収された初の事例です。  この潜水艦はディーゼル・電気併用で、ツインスクリュー、潜望鏡、エアコンを備えています。全長約30メートル、高さ約3メートル（デッキから天井まで）で、密輸技術の大きな進歩を示しています。  DEAアンデス地域局長のジェイ・バーグマン氏は、これまで密輸業者は漁船やヨット、プレジャーボート、ゴーファスト（高速艇）などを使用していたと指摘しています。しかし、いわゆる「ナルコ潜水艦」の登場により、長距離航行や大きな積載量、高度なステルス性が加わり、海上取り締まりや国家安全保障に新たな課題をもたらしています。  当局によると、この潜水艦は法執行機関や軍事の摘発から逃れるため、遠隔のジャングルで極秘に建造されました。エクアドル当局は、得た情報をもとに初航海前に同船を押収することに成功しました。  CNNのキャロル・クラッティの報道。

article_content: Russia is urged to exercise caution as its partnership with China deepens, with Beijing appearing eager to assume a dominant role—an arrangement Moscow finds uncomfortable. After the Ukraine conflict escalated, Russia’s economic and strategic dependence on China has intensified. Trade between the two nations has hit unprecedented highs this year, primarily because China's substantial imports of Russian oil have mitigated some effects of Western sanctions on Russia. In 2022, the two countries set a record with $190 billion in bilateral trade, according to Chinese customs, and aim for $200 billion in 2023. Analysts such as Bjorn Alexander Duben from Jilin University note that Moscow is seeking to deepen cooperation with Beijing, possibly hoping for greater, even military, support as Western backing for Ukraine appears uncertain. To date, China has only provided non-lethal assistance to Russia, but experts like Alicja Bachulska from the European Council on Foreign Relations warn that Beijing might change its approach if it seems Russia could lose significant ground. Russian analysts characterize Chinese negotiators as tenacious, and expect minimal breakthroughs soon on contentious matters, like the proposed gas pipeline. China has expanded its economic activities across the former Soviet Union, notably in Central Asia, where exports to some countries have doubled in two years. As demonstrated by the China-Central Asia Summit, trade with five Central Asian states rose 37% in the first four months of 2023 compared to the same period the previous year, reaching more than $25 billion. By the close of 2022, trade with these Central Asian nations surpassed $70 billion. Chinese exports nearly doubled to Tajikistan and Uzbekistan from late 2021 to mid-2023, and increased by more than half to Turkmenistan, Kazakhstan, and Kyrgyzstan. Exports to Georgia and Belarus also more than doubled, while Armenia saw over 60% growth. Observers believe China’s surge in exports and infrastructure investment—such as purchasing shares in Kazakhstan’s AktobeMunaiGas and contributing to energy pipeline projects—reflects efforts to obtain favorable energy supplies and extend influence in the region. Some analysts warn that this growing economic footprint could translate into increased political leverage for China. The United States has limited involvement in Central Asia, which leads countries in the region to prefer closer economic ties with China and Russia, who provide concrete benefits like migrant labor markets and investment in infrastructure. Russian experts also highlight that Russia’s principal exports to China—mainly discounted oil and mineral fuels—support both economies, with China reaping significant gains. Despite the robust economic cooperation, significant breakthroughs on longstanding Russia-China disputes remain unlikely in the near term.
translated_content: ロシアは中国との関係深化に際し慎重さが求められています。中国が主導的ポジションを志向する中で、モスクワには違和感がある模様です。ウクライナ情勢の悪化以降、ロシアの中国への経済的・戦略的依存はますます強まっています。今年、両国貿易は過去最高となり、中国がロシア産原油を大量に輸入したことで、西側の制裁効果が一部緩和されています。 2022年、両国の貿易額は1,900億ドルに到達し、2023年には2,000億ドルへの到達を目指しています。吉林大学のビョルン・アレクサンダー・デューベン氏などのアナリストは、モスクワが中国との協力をより深め、西側のウクライナ支援に陰りが見える中、中国からより強力な、ときに軍事的なサポートを期待していると指摘します。 現時点で中国のロシア支援は非致死的なものにとどまっていますが、欧州外交問題評議会のアリチャ・バクルスカ氏は、ロシアが劣勢になれば中国が方針転換をする可能性があると警告しています。ロシアの専門家は、中国の交渉姿勢を「手強い」とし、ガスパイプラインのような難題では、大きなブレイクスルーは見込めないと予想しています。 中国は旧ソ連地域、特に中央アジアで経済的存在感を急速に強めています。「中国・中央アジアサミット」に象徴されるように、2023年最初の4カ月で中央アジア5カ国との貿易額は前年比37％増の250億ドル超を記録しました。 2022年末時点でこれら中央アジア諸国との貿易総額は700億ドルを突破。2021年末から2023年半ばにかけて、中国のタジキスタン・ウズベキスタンへの輸出はほぼ倍増し、トルクメニスタン・カザフスタン・キルギスにも50％超の伸びです。さらに、ジョージアやベラルーシも2倍以上増、アルメニアは60％以上アップとなっています。 専門家は、中国による輸出・インフラ投資拡大――たとえばカザフスタンのアクトベムナイガス株取得やパイプライン事業――は、低コストのエネルギー確保や地域影響力拡大のためと分析します。一部では中国経済力が政治的圧力の源となることへの懸念も広がっています。 米国の中央アジア関与はごく限定的で、地域各国は中国やロシアとの経済的結びつきを重視しているのが現状です。ロシア労働者からの送金や、中国企業によるインフラ投資など、直接恩恵が得られるためです。ロシアの専門家は、主に割引原油など鉱物資源の対中輸出が両国にとって重要であり、中国経済に大きく貢献していると指摘しています。 こうした活発な経済協力が進む一方で、ロシア・中国間の懸案事項で目立った進展は今のところ期待されていません。

article_content: PASO CANOAS, Costa Rica — Buses carrying hundreds of Venezuelan, Haitian, and Ecuadorian migrants crossed the Panama-Costa Rica border, with many pressing their faces to the windows as they passed a sign reading 'Welcome to Costa Rica.' Few migrants, however, will see more of Costa Rica than the roads through foggy bus windows. Last week, Costa Rica and Panama announced that, amid a historic surge of people traveling to the United States, thousands of migrants per day would be bused from Panama’s Darien Gap through both countries to the Nicaraguan border. This measure is the latest in a series of temporary solutions by Central American governments, which are seeking to reduce the impact of migration on their own countries while facing U.S. pressure to control migration levels. Regional leaders plan to discuss longer-term migration solutions at a summit in Mexico on Sunday. For migrants like María Angelys, a 30-year-old Venezuelan traveling with her 2-year-old daughter, the bus program makes it clear that they are not welcome. 'There are a lot of Venezuelans everywhere, and the reality is that they don't want us here,' Angelys said while waiting in a Costa Rican detention facility for a bus. Angelys left Venezuela in October due to her country’s economic crisis and had hoped to rest after trekking through the jungle between Colombia and Panama. However, conditions at Costa Rica’s migrant camp were so poor that she wanted to move on quickly. She and her daughter are among more than 420,000 people to cross the Darien Gap this year, making their way through Central America and Mexico toward the U.S.-Mexico border, where U.S. authorities say they’ve stopped migrants over 1.8 million times in the first 11 months of the fiscal year. The influx led Costa Rica to declare a state of emergency in late September—a significant step for a country known for open asylum laws and hospitality. 'We don't have the capacity to handle this flow of people,' said Jorge Rodríguez, Costa Rica’s vice minister to the president. 'Aid has been generous, but it's not enough.' Buses now transport between 1,500 and 2,000 migrants daily from camps in eastern Panama across Costa Rica. Upon arrival, they are held in crowded detention facilities, sleeping on army cots, bunk beds, cardboard, or tents on the floor. Some report liquid seeping from portable toilets. Migrants are not permitted to leave these fenced-off buildings—formerly factories—until they buy bus tickets. Some migrants said they had not eaten since the weekend. Most tickets cost $30 per person and are paid by the migrants themselves. 'Costa Rica now hosts around 100,000 Venezuelan, Chinese, Indian, and Ecuadorian migrants. The government cannot afford to send them back. This is the least bad option,' said Adam Isacson, a migration analyst at the Washington Office on Latin America. He added that the system keeps migrants 'out of sight, out of mind,' but shifts the responsibility to the next country. Vice minister Rodríguez noted that while camps 'don't have the best conditions,' the situation is better than before when migrants slept on the street. The government is working to improve support but still needs aid staff training, as well as donations of food, beds, and vaccines to prevent disease. Angelys waited in line at a Western Union in the facility for hours to receive $200 from her husband in Chicago for bus tickets. She cradled her daughter as other children played and slept nearby. 'On one hand, it’s good that you can move quickly, since the goal is to reach the United States. But many don’t have the money,' she said. Other migrants, like 25-year-old Venezuelan Ebrard Sánchez, spent their last funds on government-organized buses from Panama to Costa Rica. After being robbed in the jungle, Sánchez, his wife, and 7-year-old son spent five days in the camp, unable to pay for the next bus to Nicaragua, waiting for a rare donated ticket from companies or aid groups. 'We honestly feel like we are in prison,' he said. 'All we want to do is work, but doors are being closed to us.' Officials and migrants told the Associated Press that leaving the camp is not allowed, though Vice Minister Rodríguez stated migrants are not officially prohibited from leaving, but doing so would be illegal due to their immigration status. Other countries on the migration route have different approaches. In Nicaragua, migration is reportedly less controlled, and transit can be quick. Daniel Cano, a 27-year-old Venezuelan traveling with his wife and dog, said they crossed Nicaragua in 13 hours without incident. Other migrants reported authorities directing them onto buses directly to the Honduran border. In Honduras, migrants can move freely, but lack access to basic sanitation and face poor living conditions. Denilson Borges, a coordinator for Doctors Without Borders in Danli, Honduras, said the number of migrants has created a health emergency, with doctors treating infections and injuries. President Xiomara Castro of Honduras called it 'a humanitarian crisis' requiring a regional response. Honduras issues an average of 4,000 five-day transit permits daily to migrants in its southern cities of Danli and Trojes. Tents fill every available green space in Danli. At one park, 48-year-old Suhail Briceño from Venezuela lived for two weeks in a small tent with her family, waiting for money from her son to continue traveling north. The U.S. government wants countries like Costa Rica and Honduras to better manage migrant flows. U.S. Assistant Secretary of State for Western Hemisphere Affairs Brian Nichols acknowledged these countries' efforts but said 'they need to step up and do more.' Costa Rica and Panama’s recent measures come after weeks of seeking more international aid. With no immediate solutions, leaders from countries like Cuba, Venezuela, and Haiti will meet with Central American leaders at the Mexico summit to discuss the root causes of migration and possible responses. U.S. President Biden and others have called for addressing deeper issues such as corruption, violence, and economic crises, but progress has been limited. 'The international community is in denial about how to address Venezuela, Haiti, and Nicaragua,' said Manuel Orozco, a migration expert at the Inter-American Dialogue. 'Transit countries are bearing the burden.' Associated Press reporters Marlon González in Danli, Honduras, and Elliot Spagat in San Diego contributed to this report.
translated_content: パソ・カノアス（コスタリカ）発 — 数百人のベネズエラ人、ハイチ人、エクアドル人の移民を乗せたバスがパナマ＝コスタリカ国境を越え、窓に顔を押し当てながら「コスタリカへようこそ」と書かれた看板を見上げました。 しかし、多くの移民がコスタリカで見るのは、曇ったバスの車窓からの道だけです。先週、コスタリカとパナマは、米国を目指す歴史的な移民の急増を受け、毎日数千人の移民をダリエン地峡からバスで自国を経由させ、ニカラグア国境まで送ると発表しました。 この措置は、中米各国政府が自国への影響を抑えつつ、米国の移民抑制要請に対応しようとする一時的な対応策の最新例です。 地域のリーダーたちは、日曜日にメキシコで開かれるサミットで長期的な移民対策について議論する予定です。 2歳の娘とともに旅する30歳のベネズエラ人女性マリア・アンヘリスのような移民にとって、このバス輸送プログラムは歓迎されていないというメッセージそのものです。「ベネズエラ人がどこにでもいますが、現実として彼らは私たちを欲しがっていません」とアンヘリスさんは、コスタリカの収容施設でバスを待ちながら話しました。 アンヘリスさんは、経済危機により10月にベネズエラを離れ、コロンビアとパナマを結ぶジャングルを歩いた後、休息を期待していました。しかし、コスタリカの移民キャンプの環境が悪かったため、早く次へ進みたいと感じたといいます。 彼女と娘は、今年ダリエン地峡を越えた42万人超の移民の一員です。彼らは中央アメリカやメキシコを通り、米墨国境を目指します。米国当局によれば、会計年度最初の11か月間に180万人以上の移民が摘発されました。 流入の増加を受け、コスタリカ政府は9月末に非常事態を宣言。寛容な難民制度とホスピタリティで知られる国にとって大きな決断でした。「この規模の人の流れには対応できません」とホルヘ・ロドリゲス副大臣は述べ、「支援は十分ではありません」とも語りました。 現在、バスはパナマ東部のキャンプから毎日1,500〜2,000人の移民をコスタリカ国内に運びます。到着後、元工場の狭い収容施設に収容され、緑色の軍用コットや二段ベッド、段ボール、床に設置したテントで寝ています。仮設トイレの液体が漏れていると訴える人もいます。 移民はバスチケットを購入するまで、フェンスで囲まれた建物の外には出られません。週末から何も食べていないと話す移民もいました。ほとんどのチケットは1人30ドルで、各自が支払います。 「現在コスタリカには10万人ほどのベネズエラ人、中国人、インド人、エクアドル人の移民がいます。政府は彼らを本国送還することはできません。これは最もマシな選択肢です」と米ワシントン・オフィス・オン・ラテンアメリカのアナリスト、アダム・イサクソン氏は語り、このシステムは「見えない場所に移民を置く」ものだが、次の国への問題の先送りにもなると指摘しました。 ロドリゲス副大臣は、「キャンプの状況は決して良くない」が、以前のように路上で野宿するよりはましだと述べています。政府は支援スタッフの訓練や、食料、ベッド、ワクチンの寄付を求めて状況改善に努めているとしています。 アンヘリスさんは、シカゴに住む夫からの200ドル送金を受け取るために、施設内のウエスタンユニオンに何時間も並びました。彼女は娘を抱き、近くでは他の子供たちが遊んだり床で眠ったりしていました。「良い点は早く進めること。でも、お金がない人には厳しいです」と語ります。 他の移民、25歳のベネズエラ人エブラルド・サンチェスさんは、パナマからコスタリカへのバスに家族の最後のお金を使い果たしました。ジャングルで強盗に遭い、妻と7歳の息子と5日間キャンプに滞在。ニカラグア行きの次のバス代が払えず、企業や支援団体の寄付によるわずかなチケットの順番を待っていました。「正直、牢獄にいるような気分です。働きたいだけなのに、どこも門を閉ざしています」と語りました。 APの取材に対し、当局者や移民はキャンプを出ることはできないと語っていますが、ロドリゲス副大臣は、公式に退所を禁止していないが、移民資格の関係で外出は違法になると説明しています。 経由地各国で対応は異なります。ニカラグアでは管理が緩く、短時間で通過できるとの報告もあります。27歳のベネズエラ人ダニエル・カノさんは、妻と犬とともに13時間で通過したと話しました。他の移民も当局がホンジュラス国境行きのバスに直接乗せたと証言しています。 ホンジュラスでは自由に移動できますが、衛生環境が悪く、劣悪な生活を強いられています。ダンリ市の国境なき医師団のコーディネーター、デニルソン・ボルヘス氏によれば、流入の増加で呼吸器感染や暴力によるケガの治療が急増し、健康危機になっているとのこと。シオマラ・カストロ大統領は「地域全体の人道的危機」だと呼びかけました。 ホンジュラスは南部のダンリ、トロジェス両市だけで毎日約4,000枚の5日間トランジット許可証を発行。ダンリの公園では、48歳のベネズエラ人女性スハイル・ブリセーニョさん一家が2週間滞在し、北上のための送金を息子から待っています。 米国政府は、コスタリカやホンジュラスなどにより厳格な移民管理を求めています。米国務省西半球担当次官補のブライアン・ニコルズ氏はこれらの国の努力を認めつつ、「さらなる対応が必要」と述べました。 コスタリカとパナマの今回の措置は、数週間にわたる国際支援要請の後に出されました。即効性のある解決策がない中、キューバ、ベネズエラ、ハイチなどの出身国や中米のリーダーたちは、メキシコでのサミットで移民の根本原因と対応策について協議する予定です。 バイデン大統領をはじめ多くのリーダーが、腐敗や暴力、経済危機といった根本的な問題への取り組みを訴えていますが、進展は限られています。「国際社会はベネズエラ、ハイチ、ニカラグアへの対応策で現実逃避し、経由国だけが負担を強いられている」とインターアメリカン・ダイアローグのマヌエル・オロスコ氏は指摘します。 この報道には、ホンジュラス・ダンリのマーロン・ゴンザレス記者とサンディエゴのエリオット・スパガット記者も貢献しました。

article_content: Two Israeli tourists and their Egyptian tour guide were killed during a shooting in Alexandria, Egypt, as confirmed by Israel's foreign ministry. Another Israeli was injured in the incident. According to reports from local media and security sources, a police officer used his own weapon to open fire on a group of tourists at Pompey's Pillar, a renowned archaeological site, on Sunday morning. The officer, who allegedly shot indiscriminately, was detained immediately. Videos posted on social media show at least two deceased individuals at the site after the attack. The Israeli foreign ministry noted it is collaborating with Egyptian authorities to repatriate the Israeli victims promptly. This attack occurred just a day after militants from Hamas launched a major offensive from Gaza into southern Israel, leading to significant casualties—over 350 fatalities in Israel and more than 300 in Gaza, according to official counts. Although Egypt and Israel have maintained a peace agreement since 1979, Egyptian public sentiment often remains critical of Israel due to its stance on Palestinian issues. In a separate incident in June, an Egyptian police officer killed three Israeli soldiers near the countries' border; Egyptian authorities described it as an exchange of fire related to drug smuggling, but Israel referred to it as a terrorist attack.

article_content: A patient undergoes a low-dose CT scan for lung cancer screening. On Wednesday, the American Cancer Society (ACS) recommended expanding the group of people who should receive this annual screening test. Lung cancer is the deadliest cancer in the United States, causing over 127,000 deaths every year. The ACS has updated its guidelines, now recommending that more current and former smokers with at least a 20 pack-year history should begin yearly screenings from age 50. There is no longer a restriction based on how long ago a person quit smoking, widening eligibility for former smokers. Dr. William Dahut, ACS Chief Scientific Officer, emphasized that early detection is crucial. "There are many new treatments and targeted therapies for lung cancer now, so the chances for survival are much better if the disease is caught early," Dahut said. The new recommendations expand the eligible age range from 55–74 to 50–80. An estimated 5 million additional Americans are now eligible for annual lung cancer screening under these guidelines. The screening test is a low-dose computed tomography (CT) scan, also known as LDCT. In 2023, ACS researchers estimate there will be 238,340 new cases of lung cancer in the U.S. (117,550 among men and 120,790 among women). Because treatment options can be limited by the time symptoms appear, early screening offers a greater chance for new treatments to succeed. While anyone can get lung cancer at any age, the majority of diagnoses occur in people aged 65 or older, according to the ACS. The last lung cancer screening guideline update was in 2013. The expanded recommendations could save many lives, says Dr. Robert Smith, ACS’s leader in early cancer detection science and the lead author of the new screening guidelines.

article_content:
Rhys Owen, 21, from Bedford, worked as a temporary employee at Amazon's Milton Keynes warehouse during the Christmas season, earning £7 per hour for 11-hour shifts. Soon after starting, he began suffering from severe back pain, which he attributes to the physically strenuous work—walking miles each day and picking up to 1,100 items per shift. Owen says that a four-hour induction, mostly consisting of videos, covered the basics and some health and safety topics, but he and many colleagues (some with limited English) did not receive comprehensive safety training. He witnessed coworkers with blisters and even bleeding feet. With only 15-minute breaks and a five-minute walk to the canteen, rest was minimal. After reporting his back injury, Owen was temporarily moved to lighter duties but was informed by his temp agency that failure to promptly return to work could result in contract termination. He describes the experience as aging beyond his years.

This case reflects wider concerns: Amazon hired approximately 15,000 temporary workers across the UK for the holiday rush, and similar reports describe demanding targets and intense workloads. In Germany, warehouse staff have gone on strike protesting wages, and a worker in New Jersey died in a warehouse accident. Owen continues to need daily painkillers and can no longer play football because of his chronic back pain. His solicitor, Andrew Lilley of JMW Solicitors in Manchester, cautions that workplace injuries at Amazon could result in long-term health issues, often seen in much older workers. He urges that consistent working conditions of this nature would pose significant risks for staff. An Amazon spokesperson declined to comment on specific personnel matters.

article_content: If you’ve ever accused someone of acting like a robot, you might want to reconsider. Softbank, a leading Japanese internet and telecom company, has introduced a new robot named Pepper, designed to sense and respond to human emotions. Masayoshi Son, Softbank’s CEO, called the launch a potentially historic event, suggesting that future generations might recognize its significance. Pepper stands about 4 feet tall, weighs 62 pounds, and greeted attendees in Tokyo with a traditional Japanese bow before chatting with Son, offering a handshake, and encouraging him to smile. The robot is fitted with facial recognition, several cameras, audio recorders, and various sensors in its head, all to help it interpret how people feel. Unlike most robots that work off fixed programming, Pepper learns from interacting with users. It uploads these experiences to the cloud so other Peppers can adjust their behavior as well. The robot tailors its interactions to each user’s mood. Pepper’s project manager, Kaname Hayashi, told CNN that its aim is to make people happy. Pepper features fully articulated arms and hands, moves around on wheels, and features a tablet display on its chest as its interface. It can interact in 17 languages. Pepper was developed in partnership with Aldebaran Robotics—the minds behind other humanoids like Nao and Romeo. The robot is intended for roles ranging from companionship to supporting care for the elderly or those needing help. Softbank has set Pepper’s initial price just under $2,000, which some observers see as an affordable entry point. For now, Pepper is displayed at two Softbank stores in Japan and is slated to go on sale there early next year. There's no word yet about international sales.

article_content:
Edin Dzeko has criticized referee Peter O'Leary after his first-half goal for Bosnia & Herzegovina was controversially disallowed for offside. The incident occurred 21 minutes into the World Cup match when Dzeko finished a precise through ball from Miralem Pjanic, only for the goal to be ruled out following an offside flag by the assistant referee. Dzeko expressed his anger over the decision, particularly as Bosnia were eliminated from the tournament following their 1-0 defeat.

Referee O'Leary, from New Zealand, faced substantial criticism for the call, which many believed was incorrect. Dzeko lamented, 'The referee was shameful. We are going home and we are sad because of that, but this referee should be going home too. He changed the result and he changed the game. That’s why we lost.'

Just eight minutes after the disallowed goal, Nigeria took the lead when Peter Odemwingie scored. Despite Bosnia's efforts in the second half, including several missed chances by Dzeko—one hitting the post in stoppage time—they could not find an equalizer. With this defeat, Bosnia & Herzegovina became the fifth team eliminated from the 2014 World Cup, joining Cameroon, Australia, Spain, and England.

Looking ahead to their final match against Iran, Bosnia only have pride left to play for as their first ever World Cup campaign nears its end.
